reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa maandishi asilia ya HadeethEnc
explanation:
Amesema Muadhi radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake: Tulikuwa pamoja na Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake katika safari, siku moja nikawa karibu naye tukiwa tunatembea, nikasema: Ewe Mjumbe wa Mwenyezi Mungu nieleze amali itakayoniingiza Peponi na kuniweka mbali na moto, akasema: Bila shaka umeuliza kuhusu jambo kubwa kulifanya kwake katika nafsi, na bila shaka ni jepesi na ni rahisi mno kwa atakayerahisishiwa na Mwenyezi Mungu kulifanya; tekeleza faradhi za Uislamu;

Ya kwanza: Umuabudu Mwenyezi Mungu peke yake na wala usimshirikishe na chochote.

Ya pili: Usimamishe swala tano za faradhi  mchana na usiku: Alfajiri, Adhuhuri, Alasiri, Magharibi, Ishaa, kwa sharti zake na nguzo zake na wajibu wake.

Ya tatu: Utoe zaka ya wajibu, nayo ni ibada ya mali ya wajibu kwa kila mali iliyofikia kiwango katika sheria, na wanapewa wastahiki wake.

Ya nne: Ufunge mwezi wa Ramadhani, nako ni kujizuia na kula na kunywa na mengineyo katika mambo yenye kufunguza kwa nia ya kumuabudu Mwenyezi Mungu, kuanzia kuchomoza kwa Alfajiri mpaka kuzama kwa Jua.

Ya tano: Utaizuru nyumba kwa kwenda Makka ili kutimiza ibada, kwa lengo la kumuabudu Mwenyezi Mungu Mtukufu.

Kisha akasema Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake: Je nikufahamishe kuhusu njia inayokufikisha katika milango ya heri? Nayo ni kwa kutekeleza faradhi na sunna hizo:

Ya kwanza: Ni funga ya hiyari, nayo inamzuia mtu kuingia katika maasi, nayo ni kwa kuvunjavunja matamanio, na kuzidhoofisha nguvu.

Ya pili: Sadaka ya kujitolea inazima madhambi baada ya kuyafanya na huyaondosha na kufuta athari zake.

Ya tatu: Swala ya tahajudi katika theluthi ya mwisho ya usiku, kisha akasoma rehema na amani ziwe juu yake kauli yake Mtukufu: "Hunyanyuka mbavu zao" Yaani: Hujiweka mbali, na "malazi" Yaani: Mahali pa kulala, "wakimuomba Mola wao Mlezi" Yaani: kwa swala na dhikri na kusoma Qur'ani na dua, "kwa hofu na tamaa, na katika yale tuliyowaruzuku wanatoa, hakuna nafsi ijuayo yale waliyofichiwa, katika yale yenye kutuliza macho" Yaani: Yale yenye kutuliza macho yao siku ya Kiyama na katika pepo miongoni mwa neema, "ni malipo kwa yale waliyokuwa wakiyafanya".

Kisha akasema rehema na amani ziwe juu yake: Hivi nikueleze msingi wa dini? na nguzo yake inayosimamia? na kiini cha kilele chake?

Akasema Muadhi radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake: Ndio, nieleze ewe Mjumbe wa Mwenyezi Mungu.

Akasema Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake: Kichwa cha mambo yote ni: Uislamu nao ni shahada mbili, na kwa shahada hizi mbili ndio mtu anapata msingi wa dini. Na nguzo yake: Ni swala, hakuna Uislamu bila swala, kama ambavyo nyumba haiwezi kusimama pasina nguzo, atakaye swali dini yake itakuwa na nguvu na itanyanyuka; Na kiini cha kilele chake na kimo chake ni Jihadi na kutoa juhudi katika kupambana na maadui wa dini ili kulinyanyua neno la Mwenyezi Mungu.

Kisha akasema rehema na amani ziwe juu yake: Hivi nikuelezeni umadhubuti na ufanisi wa yaliyopita? Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake akashika ulimi, na akasema: Zuia huu na wala usizungumze yale yasiyokuhusu. Akasema Muadhi: Je atatuchukulia makosa na kutuhesabu Mola wetu Mlezi na kutuadhibu kwa kila tunachozungumza?!

Akasema rehema na amani ziwe juu yake: Amekupoteza mama yako! Na makusudio yake si kumuombea dua mbaya, bali ni katika maneno ya waarabu yaliyokuwa yakitumika kumtanabahisha mtu kuwa jambo hili unatakiwa kulichukulia tahadhari kubwa na kulielewa, kisha akasema; na unadhani ni kipi kitawatupa watu na kuwadondosha kwa nyuso zao ndani ya moto zaidi ya chumo za ndimi zao, ikiwemo ukafiri na kumzulia mtu machafu na matusi na utesi na usengenyaji, na uongo na mfano wa hayo.
hints: Pupa ya Maswahaba radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao ya kutaka kujifunza, na ndio maana maswali yao yalikuwa ni mengi sana kwa Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake.
Utambuzi wa Maswahaba radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao kwa kujua kwao kuwa matendo ni sababu ya kuingia Peponi.

Swali lililotoka kwa Muadhi radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake ni swali zito; kwa sababu kwa uhalisia ndio siri ya uhai na uwepo wa kila kitu, kila kilichopo katika dunia kwanzia wanadam au majini lengo lake la mwisho ima iwe Pepo, ama motoni, na ndio maana swali hili likawa zito.
Kuingia kwake peponi kumefungamanishwa na kuzitekeleza nguzo tano za Uislamu, nazo ni: Shahada mbili na swala na zaka na swaumu na Hija.
Kichwa cha dini na jukumu ghali na wajibu mkubwa ni kumpwekesha Mwenyezi Mungu, kwa kumuabudu yeye peke yake asiye na mshirika.
Huruma ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa waja wake kwa kuwafungulia milango ya kheri ili wajiongezee sababu za malipo na kusamehewa madhambi.
Fadhila za kujikurubisha kwa Mwenyezi Mungu kwa ibada za sunna baada ya kutekeleza faradhi.
Swala katika Uislamu ni sawa na nguzo linayosimamia hema, Uislamu unaondoka kwa kudondoka kwake, kama linavyodondoka hema kwa kudondoka kwa nguzo.
Ulazima wa kuhifadhi ulimi kwa yale yanayomdhuru mtu katika dini yake.
Kuuzuia ulimi na kuudhibiti na kuufunga ndio msingi wa kheri zote.

title: Haifai kujidhuru wala kumdhuru mwingine
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ الخُدْرِيّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «لَا ضَرَرَ وَلَا ضِرَارَ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abuu Saidi Sa'di bin Maaliki bin SInani Al-Khudry -radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake- yakwamba Mtume -rehema na amani ziwe juu yake- amesema: "Haifai kujidhuru wala kumdhuru mwingine."
english: Abu Sa‘īd Sa‘d ibn Mālik ibn Sinān al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There should be no harm or reciprocal harm."
attribution: Imepokelewa na Ibnu Maajah,  Daaruqutni na wengineo huku inafika kwa Mtume
license: Ruhusa ya HadeethEnc: hifadhi maandishi asilia na taja chanzo.
content_note: Maandishi na tafsiri ni kama zilivyo katika HadeethEnc.
reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa maandishi asilia ya HadeethEnc
explanation: Amebainisha Mtume -rehema na amani ziwe juu yake- kuwa ni lazima kuzuia madhara kwa aina zake zote na sababu zake zote kwako na kwa wengine, ni haramu kwa yeyote kujiudhi mwenyewe na mwingine kwa kiwango sawa. Na ni haramu kwake kukabiliana na madhara kwa madhara; kwa sababu madhara hayaondoshwi kwa madhara, isipokuwa kama itakua katika njia ya kulipiza kisasi pasina kuvuka mipaka.
hints: Katazo la kulipiza kwa zaidi ya vile ulivyofanyiwa.
Mwenyezi Mungu hakuwaamrisha waja wake lolote lenye kuwadhuru.
Hadithi ni kanuni katika kuharamisha kujidhuru, na kudhuru kwa kauli au vitendo au kuacha.
Katika kanuni za sheria: Ni "Madhara huondoshwa", Hivyo, sheria haikubaliani na madhara, na inakataza kujidhuru.

title: Laiti wangepewa watu yote wanayodai basi kuna watu wangedai mali za wenzao na damu zao, lakini ushahidi ni kwa mwenye kudai na kiapo ni kwa mwenye kukanusha
arabic: عَن ابنِ عباسٍ رضي الله عنهما أنَّ رسولَ اللهِ صلي الله عليه وسلم قال: «لَو يُعطَى النّاسُ بدَعواهُم لادَّعَى رِجالٌ أموالَ قَومٍ ودِماءَهُم، لَكِنَّ البَيِّنَةَ على المُدَّعِى، واليَمينَ على مَن أنكَرَ».
swahili: Na imepokelewa kutoka kwa bin Abbas -radhi za Mwenyezi Mungu ziwe juu yake na baba yake -kwamba Mtume wa Mweyezi Mungu -rehema na amani ziwe juu yake- amesema: "Laiti wangelipewa watu yote wanayodai basi kuna watu wangedai mali za wenzao na damu zao, lakini ushahidi ni kwa mwenye kudai na kiapo ni kwa mwenye kukanusha".
english: Ibn ‘Abbās (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Were people to be given everything they claimed, some men would claim the properties and blood of other people. However, the onus of proof is on the plaintiff, and the oath is upon the one who denies the claim (defendant)."
attribution: Imepokelewa na Baihaqiy na wengineo hivi na baadhi yake iko katika Swahihi mbili
license: Ruhusa ya HadeethEnc: hifadhi maandishi asilia na taja chanzo.
content_note: Maandishi na tafsiri ni kama zilivyo katika HadeethEnc.
reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa maandishi asilia ya HadeethEnc
explanation: Amebainisha wazi Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake kuwa lau watu wangelipwa kwa msingi wa madai yao tu, bila ya ushahidi wala vielelezo, basi watu watadai mali na damu za watu wengine, lakini mwenye kudai lazima awasilishe alama na ushahidi wa kile anachodai, ikiwa hana ushahidi basi madai hayo yanawasilishwa kwa mshitakiwa, na akikanusha ni lazima aape na kuachiliwa.
hints: Amesema bin Daqiq Al-Idd: Na hadithi hii ni msingi katika misingi ya utoaji wa hukumu, na ni marejeo makubwa wakati wa mzozo na ugomvi.
Sheria imekuja kulinda mali za watu na damu zao zisichezewe.
Hakimu asikuhumu kwa elimu yake bali arudi katika ushahidi.
Yeyote atakayedai madai ambayo hayana uthibitisho yatakataliwa, iwe yanahusu haki na miamala au masuala ya imani na sayansi.

title: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu aliandika mema na maovu, kisha akalibainisha hilo
arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيمَا يَرْوِي عَنْ رَبِّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى، قَالَ: «إنَّ اللهَ كَتَبَ الحَسَنَاتِ وَالسَّيِّئَاتِ، ثُمَّ بَيَّنَ ذَلِكَ، فَمَنْ هَمَّ بِحَسَنَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا؛ كَتَبَهَا اللهُ عِنْدَهُ حَسَنَةً كَامِلَةً، وَإِنْ هَمَّ بِهَا فَعَمِلَهَا؛ كَتَبَهَا اللهُ عِنْدَهُ عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ إلَى سَبْعِمِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ إلَى أَضْعَافٍ كَثِيرَةٍ، وَإِنْ هَمَّ بِسَيِّئَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا؛ كَتَبَهَا اللهُ عِنْدَهُ حَسَنَةً كَامِلَةً، وَإِنْ هَمَّ بِهَا فَعَمِلَهَا؛ كَتَبَهَا اللهُ سَيِّئَةً وَاحِدَةً».
swahili: Kutoka kwa bin Abbas radhi za Mwenyezi Mungu ziwe juu yake kutoka kwa Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake katika yale anayoyapokea kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi Aliyetukuka amesema: "Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu aliandika mema na maovu, kisha akalibainisha hilo, basi yeyote atakayepania jema akawa hakulifanya; Mwenyezi Mungu huliandika kwake kuwa ni jema kamili, na akilipania na akalifanya; basi Mwenyezi Mungu huliandika kwake kuwa ni mema kumi mpaka ziada mia saba mpaka nyongeza nyingi zaidi, na akipania baya akawa hakulifanya; Mwenyezi Mungu huliandika kwake kuwa ni jema moja kamili, na akikusudia na akalifanya; basi Mwenyezi Mungu huliandika kuwa ni ovu moja".
english: Ibn ‘Abbās (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, reporting from his Almighty Lord: "Allah has written the good deeds and bad deeds, then clarified that. If someone intends to do a good deed but does not do it, Allah writes it as a complete good deed for him, and if he does it, Allah writes it as ten good deeds, multiplied up to seven-hundred times and plenty more times. If someone intends to do a sin but does not do it, Allah writes it as a complete good deed. If he intends to do a sin and does it, Allah writes it as one sin."
attribution: Imepokelewa na  Bukhari na Muslim katika sahihi zao kwa herufi hizi

content_note: Maandishi na tafsiri ni kama zilivyo katika HadeethEnc.
reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa maandishi asilia ya HadeethEnc
explanation:
Anabainisha Mtume -Rehema na amani ziwe juu yake- yakuwa Mwenyezi Mungu amepanga mema na maovu, kisha akawabainishia Malaika wawili ni namna gani watayaandika:

Atakayetaka na akakusudia na akaazimia kufanya jema basi litaandikwa kwake jema moja, hata kama hatolifanya, na ikiwa atalifanya basi hulipwa mara dufu kwa mara kumi mfano wake, mpaka ziada ya mia saba, mpaka ziada nyingi zaidi, na ziada huendana na yale yaliyoko moyoni kwanzia Ikhlaswi (kutakasa nia) na kuwanufaisha wengine, n.k.

Na atakayetaka na akakusudia na akaazimia kufanya uovu kisha akauacha kwa ajili ya Mwenyezi Mungu, huanidikiwa jema moja, na ikiwa atauacha kwa sababu ya kukosa muda wa kuufanya na akiwa hajafanya sababu za kuuendea, hatoandikiwa chochote, na akiuacha kwa kushindwa huandikwa nia yake pekee, na ikiwa ataufanya litaandikwa kwa ovu moja.
hints: Kumebainishwa fadhila za Mwenyezi Mungu Mtukufu juu ya Umma huu katika kuzidishiwa mema na kuandikwa kwake, na kutozidishwa maovu.
Umuhimu wa nia katika amali zote na athari yake.
Fadhila za Mwenyezi Mungu -Aliyetakasika na kutukuka- na upole wake na ihisani yake nikuwa mwenye kudhamiria jema na akawa hakulifanya Allah huliandika jema kamili.

title: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu Mtukufu alisema: Atakayemfanyia uadui kipenzi changu basi hakika nimemtangazia vita, na hatojiweka karibu kwangu mja wangu kwa kitu ninachokipenda zaidi kuliko kile nilichomfaradhishia
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَة رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى قَالَ: مَنْ عَادَى لِي وَلِيًّا فَقْد آذَنْتُهُ بِالحَرْبِ، وَمَا تَقَرَّبَ إلَيَّ عَبْدِي بِشَيْءٍ أَحَبَّ إلَيَّ مِمَّا افْتَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ، وما يَزَالُ عَبْدِي يَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيَّ بِالنَّوَافِلِ حَتَّى أُحِبَّهُ، فَإِذَا أَحْبَبْتُهُ كُنْتُ سَمْعَهُ الَّذِي يَسْمَعُ بِهِ، وَبَصَرَهُ الَّذِي يُبْصِرُ بِهِ، وَيَدَهُ الَّتِي يَبْطِشُ بِهَا، وَرِجْلَهُ الَّتِي يَمْشِي بِهَا، وَإِنْ سَأَلَنِي لَأُعْطِيَنَّهُ، وَلَئِنْ اسْتَعَاذَنِي لَأُعِيذَنَّهُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abuu Huraira radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake amesema: Amesema Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake: "Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu Mtukufu alisema: Atakayemfanyia uadui kipenzi changu basi hakika nimemtangazia vita, na hatojiweka karibu kwangu mja wangu kwa kitu ninachokipenda zaidi kuliko kile nilichomfaradhishia, na hatoacha mja wangu kuendelea kujiweka karibu yangu kwa mambo ya sunna mpaka nitampenda, nikishampenda nitakuwa sikio lake analosikilizia, na jicho lake analoonea, na mkono wake anaokamatia, na mguu wake anaotembelea, na akiniomba hakika nitampa, na akinitaka ulinzi hakika nitamlinda".
english: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Allah Almighty says: I will declare war against one who shows hostility to a close ally of Mine. And the most beloved thing with which My slave comes nearer to Me is what I have enjoined upon him; and My slave keeps on coming closer to Me through performing supererogatory acts of worship till I love him. When I love him, I become his hearing with which he hears, his sight with which he sees, his hand with which he seizes, and his leg with which he walks; and if he asks (something) from Me, I will surely give it to him, and if he asks My Protection (refuge), I will surely protect him."

reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa maandishi asilia ya HadeethEnc
explanation: Ameeleza Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake katika hadithil-Qudsi ya kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu Aliyetakasika na kutukuka alisema: Atakayemuudhi kipenzi miongoni mwa vipenzi vyangu na akamkasirisha na akamchukiza basi nitakua nimemjulisha na nimemtangazia uadui. Walii (Kipenzi): Ni muumini mchamungu, na kwa kadiri itakavyokuwa imani na uchamungu kwa mja ndivyo inavyokuwa nafasi yake ya kupendwa mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na hajawahi kujiweka karibu Muislamu kwa jambo analolipenda zaidi Mwenyezi Mungu kuliko lile alilomfaradhishia na kumuwajibishia kama kufanya ibada na kuacha maharamisho, na hatoacha Muislamu kujiweka karibu kwa Mola wake Mlezi kwa ibada za sunna pamoja na faradhi mpaka atayapata mapenzi ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Mwenyezi Mungu akimpenda basi yeye huwa msimamizi wake katika viungo hivi vinne: Anamsimamia katika masikio yake, hayatosikia ila yale yanayomridhisha Mwenyezi Mungu. Na anamsimamia katika macho yake, hatotazama ila yale anayoyapenda Mwenyezi Mungu kuyatazama na kuyaridhia. Na anamsimamia katika mkono wake, hatofanya kwa mkono wake ila yale yanayomridhisha Mwenyezi Mungu. Na atamsimamia katika mguu wake, hatokwenda ila katika yale yanayomridhisha Mwenyezi Mungu, na hatokwenda mbio ila katika yale yenye kheri. Na pamoja na hayo, akimuomba Mwenyezi Mungu chochote basi Mwenyezi Mungu atampa alichoomba, anakuwa ni mtu mwenye kujibiwa dua, na akitaka ulinzi kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na akaomba hifadhi kwake kwa kutaka alindwe, basi Mwenyezi Mungu Mtukufu atamlinda na kumhami na yale anayoyaogopa.
hints: Hadithi hii ni miongoni mwa yale anayayopokea Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi, na huitwa Hadithil Qudsi au Ilaahiy, nayo ni ile ambayo lafudhi yake na maana yake inatoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, isipokuwa haina umaalum kama Qur'ani ambapo Qur'ani imesifika nao tofauti na maneno mengine, ikiwemo kutumika kisomo chake kama ibada, nakuwa msafi kabla ya kusoma, na changamoto, sayansi zilizomo ndani yake, na mengine mengi.
Katazo la kuwaudhi vipenzi wa Mwenyezi Mungu na himizo la kuwapenda, na kukiri ubora wao.
Amri ya kuwafanyia uadui maadui wa Mwenyezi Mungu na uharamu wa kuwapenda.
Atakayedai uwalii (Kupendwa na) Mwenyezi Mungu pasina kufuata sheria yake huyo ni muongo katika madai yake.
Mapenzi ya Mwenyezi Mungu hupatikana kwa kutekeleza wajibu na kuacha maharamisho.
Miongoni mwa sababu za mapenzi ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa mja na kujibu maombi yake, ni kutekeleza mambo ya sunna baada ya kutekeleza wajibu na kuacha maharamisho.
Ushahidi juu ya utukufu wa mawalii (Vipenzi wa Mwenyezi Mungu) na daraja zao za juu.

title: Hatokuwa na imani mmoja wenu mpaka yawe matamanio yake ni yenye kufuata yale niliyokujua nayo
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ العَاصِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هَوَاهُ تَبَعًا لِمَا جِئْتُ بِهِ».
swahili: Imepokelewa kutoka kwa Abuu Muhammadi Abdallahi bin Omari -radhi za Mwenyezi Mungu ziwe juu yao- amesema: Amesema Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu -rehema na amani ziwe juu yake-: "Hatokuwa na imani mmoja wenu mpaka yawe matamanio yake ni yenye kufuata yale niliyokujua nayo".
english: Abu Muhammad ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Amr ibn al-‘Ās (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "None of you (truly) believes until his personal desire complies with what I have come with."
attribution: Imepokelewa na katika kitabu cha Al-Hujjah kwa msururu sahihi wa wasimulizi
grade: Amesema Nawawi: Hadithi hii ni sahihi
license: Ruhusa ya HadeethEnc: hifadhi maandishi asilia na taja chanzo.
content_note: Maandishi na tafsiri ni kama zilivyo katika HadeethEnc.
reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa maandishi asilia ya HadeethEnc
explanation: Amebainisha Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake kuwa mwanadam hawezi kuwa muumini mwenye imani kamili ya wajibu mpaka mapenzi yake yafuate yale aliyokuja nayo Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake miongoni mwa amri na makatazo na mengineyo, ayapende aliyoamrishwa, na ayachukie aliyokatazwa.
hints: Hadithi hii ni kanuni ya kujisalimisha katika sheria na kutii.
Tahadhari kwa mwanadamu kuwa yeyote mwenye kuipa kipaumbele akili au mazoea na akaitanguliza kuliko yale aliyokuja nayo Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake, basi huyu imani kwake imekanushwa.
Ulazima wa kuifanya sheria kuwa ndio muamuzi katika kila kitu, kwa kauli yake: "Yale niliyokuja nayo".
Nikuwa imani inaongezeka kwa kumtii Mwenyezi Mungu na inapungua kwa kumuasi.

title: Kila kilevi ni haramu.
arabic:
عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَريِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعَثَهُ إِلَى اليَمَنِ، فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ أَشْرِبَةٍ تُصْنَعُ بِهَا، فَقَالَ: وَمَا هِيَ؟، قَالَ: «البِتْعُ وَالمِزْرُ»، فَقِيلَ لِأَبِي بُرْدَةَ: مَا البِتْعُ؟ قَالَ: نَبِيذُ العَسَلِ، وَالمِزْرُ: نَبِيذُ الشَّعِيرِ، فَقَالَ: «كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ» خرجه البخاري.
وَخَرَّجَهُ مُسْلِمٌ وَلَفْظُهُ: قَالَ: بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اَلله أَنَا وَمُعَاذٌ إِلَى اَليَمَنِ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ! إِنَّ شَرَابًا يُصْنَعُ بِأَرْضِنَا يُقَال لَهُ: المِزَرُ مِنَ الشَّعِيرِ، وَشَرَابٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ: البِتْعُ مِنَ العَسَلِ، فَقَالَ: «كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ». 
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لِمُسْلِمٍ: «فَقَالَ: كُلُّ مَا أَسْكَرَ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ». 
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لَهُ: «وَكَانَ رَسُولُ الله قَدْ أُعْطِيَ جَوَامِعَ الكَلِمِ بِخَوَاتِمِهِ، فَقَالَ: أَنْهَى عَنْ كُلِّ مُسْكِرٍ أَسْكَرَ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abuu Buraida, kutoka kwa baba yake kutoka kwa Abuu Musa A-Ash'ari radhi za Mwenyezi Mungu ziwe juu yake: Ya kwamba Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake alimtuma kwenda Yemen, akamuuliza kuhusu vinywaji fulani vinavyotengenezwa huko, akasema: Ni vipi hivyo?, akasema: "Ni Bit'u na Mizru" akaulizwa Abuu Buraida: Bit'u ni nini? Akasema: Ni mvinyo wa Asali, na Mizru: Ni mvinyo wa ngano, akasema: "Kila kilevi ni haramu" Ameitoa Bukhari. title: Kila kilevi ni haramu.
arabic:
عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَريِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعَثَهُ إِلَى اليَمَنِ، فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ أَشْرِبَةٍ تُصْنَعُ بِهَا، فَقَالَ: وَمَا هِيَ؟، قَالَ: «البِتْعُ وَالمِزْرُ»، فَقِيلَ لِأَبِي بُرْدَةَ: مَا البِتْعُ؟ قَالَ: نَبِيذُ العَسَلِ، وَالمِزْرُ: نَبِيذُ الشَّعِيرِ، فَقَالَ: «كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ» خرجه البخاري.
وَخَرَّجَهُ مُسْلِمٌ وَلَفْظُهُ: قَالَ: بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اَلله أَنَا وَمُعَاذٌ إِلَى اَليَمَنِ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ! إِنَّ شَرَابًا يُصْنَعُ بِأَرْضِنَا يُقَال لَهُ: المِزَرُ مِنَ الشَّعِيرِ، وَشَرَابٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ: البِتْعُ مِنَ العَسَلِ، فَقَالَ: «كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ». 
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لِمُسْلِمٍ: «فَقَالَ: كُلُّ مَا أَسْكَرَ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ». 
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لَهُ: «وَكَانَ رَسُولُ الله قَدْ أُعْطِيَ جَوَامِعَ الكَلِمِ بِخَوَاتِمِهِ، فَقَالَ: أَنْهَى عَنْ كُلِّ مُسْكِرٍ أَسْكَرَ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ».

title: Mambo manne yatakayekuwa kwake atakuwa mnafiki halisi, na itakayekuwa kwake sifa moja kati ya hizo, atakuwa na sifa ya unafiki mpaka aiache: Akizungumza husema uongo, na akiingia makubaliano hufanya hiyana, na akiahidi anakwenda kinyume, na akigombana huvuka mipaka
arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رَسولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَرْبَعٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَ مُنَافِقًا، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ خَصْلَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ حَتَّى يَدَعَهَا: مَنْ إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ، وإذَا خَاصَمَ فَجَرَ، وَإِذَا عَاهَدَ غَدَرَ».
swahili: Imepokelewa kutoka kwa Abdallahi bin Amry -radhi za Mwenyezi Mungu ziwe juu yao- amesema: Amesema Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu -rehema na amani ziwe juu yake-: "Mambo manne yatakayekuwa kwake basi atakuwa mnafiki, ana akiwa na jambo moja miongoni mwa hayo basi atakuwa na tabia ya unafiki mpaka aiache: Yule anayesimulia akasema uongo, na akiahidi hatimizi, na akigombana hupita mipaka, na akiingia makubaliano hufanya hiyana".
english: ‘Abdullāh ibn ‘Amr (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "There are four things; whoever has them is a hypocrite, and if one has a trait of them, he has a trait of hypocrisy until he gives it up: when he speaks, he lies; when he makes a promise, he breaks it; when he quarrels, he acts immorally; and when he makes a covenant, he proves treacherous."

content_note: Maandishi na tafsiri ni kama zilivyo katika HadeethEnc.
reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa maandishi asilia ya HadeethEnc
explanation:
Tabia nne amezitahadharisha Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake zitakapokusanyika kwa muislamu atakuwa na mfanano mkubwa na wanafiki kwa sababu ya tabia hizi, na hili linakuwa kwa yule ambaye sifa hizi ndio tabia yake mara kwa mara, ama atakayezifanya mara chache huyu haingii katika sifa hizi, nazo ni:

Ya kwanza: Akizungumza husema uongo kwa makusudi na kutokuwa mkweli katika maneno yake.

Ya pili: Akitoa ahadi katika makubaliano haitimizi, na humfanyia hiyana aliyeahidiana naye.

Ya tatu: Akiahidi ahadi yoyote haitimizi na huenda kinyume.

Ya nne: Akizozana na akagombana na yeyote ugomvi wake huwa mkali sana, na hupotoka katika haki, na hufanya hila ya kuipinga na kuibatilisha, na husema maneno ya batili na uongo.

Unafiki ni mtu kudhihirisha tofauti na yale anayoyaficha, na maana hii ipo kwa mtu mwenye sifa hizi, na unafiki wake unamuhusu yule anayezungumza naye, na akamuahidi, na akamwamini, na akagombana naye, na akamuahidi mtu, si kwamba atakuwa mnafiki katika Uislamu anaudhihirisha na kuficha ukafiri, hapana, na atakayekuwa na sifa moja katika sifa hizi; basi atakuwa na sifa ya unafiki ndani yake hadi atakapoiacha.
hints: Kumebainishwa baadhi ya alama za mnafiki na tahadhari ya kutoangukia katika unafiki.

Makusudio ya hadithi: Ni kuwa sifa hizi ni sifa za unafiki, na mwenye sifa hizi anafanana na wanafiki kwa sifa hizi, na amejipamba kwa tabia zao, haina maana kuwa ni mnafiki anayedhihirisha Uislamu na kuficha ukafiri, na wamesema baadhi ya wanachuoni kuwa hii inachukuliwa kwa mtu ambaye zitakuwa nyingi kwake sifa hizi na akazipuuzia, na akaziona ndogo; basi atakayekuwa hivyo mara nyingi huwa kaharibika katika itikadi yake.

Amesema Imam Ghazal: Msingi wa dini zote umekusanywa na mambo matatu: Kauli, kitendo, na nia, akatanabahisha kuwa kuharibika kwa maneno ni kwa uongo, na kuharibika kwa vitendo kunakuwa kwa hiyana, na kuharika kwa nia ni kwa kwenda kinyume; kwa sababu kwenda kinyume na ahadi hakumchafui mtu isipokuwa maazimio yake yatakapoambatanishwa na ahadi, ama atakapokusudia kisha kikamtokea kizuizi au akabadili mtazamo huyu hatokuwa na sura ya unafiki.

Unafiki una aina mbili: Unafiki wa kiitikadi unamtoa mtu katika imani, nao ni kudhihirisha Uislamu na kuficha ukafiri, na unafiki wa vitendo, nao ni kujifananisha na wanafiki katika tabia zao, na huu haumtoi mtu katika imani, isipokuwa ni dhambi katika madhambi makubwa.
Amesema bin Hajari: Na wamekubaliana wanachuoni kuwa atakayesadikisha kwa moyo wake na ulimi wake na akafanya mambo haya hahukumiwi kwa ukafiri, wala si mnafiki atakayekaa motoni milele.

Amesema Imam Nawawi: Na wamesema wanachuoni wengi kuwa: Makusudio yake ni wanafiki waliokuwa katika zama za Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake walizungumza kwa imani yao, na wakapinga, na wakaaminiwa kwa dini yao wao wakafanya hiyana, na wakaahidi katika swala la dini na kuinusuru, wakaenda kinyume, na wakavuka mipaka katika ugomvi wao.

Amesema Imam Ghazal: Msingi wa dini zote umekusanywa na mambo matatu: Kauli, kitendo, na nia, akatanabahisha kuwa kuharibika kwa maneno ni kwa uongo, na kuharibika kwa vitendo kunakuwa kwa hiyana, na kuharika kwa nia ni kwa kwenda kinyume; kwa sababu kwenda kinyume na ahadi hakumchafui mtu isipokuwa maazimio yake yatakapoambatanishwa na ahadi, ama atakapokusudia kisha kikamtokea kizuizi au akabadili mtazamo huyu hatokuwa na sura ya unafiki.

Unafiki una aina mbili: Unafiki wa kiitikadi unamtoa mtu katika imani, nao ni kudhihirisha Uislamu na kuficha ukafiri, na unafiki wa vitendo, nao ni kujifananisha na wanafiki katika tabia zao, na huu haumtoi mtu katika imani, isipokuwa ni dhambi katika madhambi makubwa.
Amesema bin Hajari: Na wamekubaliana wanachuoni kuwa atakayesadikisha kwa moyo wake na ulimi wake na akafanya mambo haya hahukumiwi kwa ukafiri, wala si mnafiki atakayekaa motoni milele.

Amesema Imam Nawawi: Na wamesema wanachuoni wengi kuwa: Makusudio yake ni wanafiki waliokuwa katika zama za Mtume rehema na amani ziwe juu yake walizungumza kwa imani yao, na wakapinga, na wakaaminiwa kwa dini yao wao wakafanya hiyana, na wakaahidi katika swala la dini na kuinusuru, wakaenda kinyume, na wakavuka mipaka katika ugomvi wao.

title: Kila Kitendo Kinategemea Nia
arabic: عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَبِي حَفْصٍ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوْ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Kiongozi wa Waumini, Abu Hafs Umar bin al-Khattab (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Nilimsikia Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) akisema: "Hakika matendo yote yanategemea nia, na kila mtu atalipwa kulingana na kile alichonuia. Basi yule ambaye kuhama kwake kulikuwa kwa ajili ya Allah na Mtume Wake, basi kuhama kwake ni kwa ajili ya Allah na Mtume Wake. Na yule ambaye kuhama kwake kulikuwa kwa ajili ya kupata manufaa ya kidunia au mwanamke amwoe, basi kuhama kwake ni kwa kile alichohamia kwacho."
english: It is narrated on the authority of Amir al-Mu'minin, Abu Hafs 'Umar bin al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) say: "Actions are but by intentions and each person will have but that which he intended. So he whose emigration was for Allah and His Messenger, his emigration was for Allah and His Messenger, and he whose emigration was for some worldly benefit he had or for a woman he will marry, his emigration was for that to which he emigrated."

title: Hadithi ya Jibril: Uislamu, Imani na Ihsani
arabic: عَنْ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَيْضاً قَالَ: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ جُلُوسٌ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِذْ طَلَعَ عَلَيْنَا رَجُلٌ شَدِيدُ بَيَاضِ الثِّيَابِ، شَدِيدُ سَوَادِ الشَّعْرِ، لاَ يُرَى عَلَيْهِ أَثَرُ السَّفَرِ، وَلاَ يَعْرِفُهُ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ، حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَسْنَدَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ، وَوَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى فَخِذَيْهِ، وَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنِ الإِسْلاَمِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الإِسْلاَمُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلاَةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلاً» قَالَ: صَدَقْتَ. فَعَجِبْنَا لَهُ يَسْأَلُهُ وَيُصَدِّقُهُ! قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنِ الإِيمَانِ؟ قَالَ: «أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ» قَالَ: صَدَقْتَ. قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنِ الإِحْسَانِ؟ قَالَ: «أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاكَ»... ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ فَلَبِثْتُ مَلِيّاً، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي: «يَا عُمَرُ أَتَدْرِي مَنِ السَّائِلُ؟» قُلْتُ: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ. قَالَ: «فَإِنَّهُ جِبْرِيلُ أَتَاكُمْ يُعَلِّمُكُمْ دِينَكُمْ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Tulipokuwa tumekaa na Mjumbe wa Allah siku moja, alitutokea mtu mwenye nguo nyeupe sana na nywele nyeusi mno, hakuonekana kuwa na alama za msafiri wala hakuna aliyemjua miongoni mwetu. Akaketi mbele ya Mtume akiegemeza magoti yake kwenye magoti yake, na akaweka viganja vyake juu ya mapaja yake, kisha akasema: Ewe Muhammad, nijulishe kuhusu Uislamu? Mtume akasema: 'Uislamu ni kushuhudia kuwa hakuna mungu anayepasa kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Allah na Muhammad ni Mjumbe Wake, kusimamisha Swala, kutoa Zaka, kufunga Ramadhani, na kuhiji Nyumba Tukufu ukiweza njia ya kuelekea huko.' Akasema: 'Umesema kweli.' Tukamshangaa anamuuliza na kumthibitisha! Kisha akauliza kuhusu Imani, akamjibu kuhusu nguzo sita za Imani. Akauliza kuhusu Ihsani, akajibu: 'Ni kumuabudu Allah kana kwamba unamuona, na ikiwa humwoni basi Yeye anakuona.' Kisha yule mtu akaondoka. Baadaye Mtume akasema: 'Huyo alikuwa Jibril, amekuja kuwafundisha dini yenu.'
english: Also on the authority of 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: While we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah one day, a man with very white clothing and very black hair appeared to us. No trace of travel was seen on him, and none of us knew him. He sat down before the Prophet, leaned his knees against his knees, and placed his palms on his thighs and said: 'O Muhammad, tell me about Islam.' The Messenger of Allah replied: 'Islam is to testify that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to establish prayer, give Zakah, fast Ramadan, and make pilgrimage to the House if you are able.' He said: 'You have spoken the truth.' We were astonished that he asked him and confirmed him! He then asked about Iman and Ihsan, and the Hour and its signs. Then he left. The Prophet said: 'That was Gabriel who came to teach you your religion.'

title: Nguzo Tano za Uislamu
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَحَجِّ الْبَيْتِ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Abdulrahman Abdullah bin Umar bin al-Khattab (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: Nilimsikia Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) akisema: "Uislamu umejengwa juu ya mambo matano: Kushuhudia kwamba hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Allah na kwamba Muhammad ni Mjumbe wa Allah, kusimamisha Swala, kutoa Zaka, kuhiji Nyumba Tukufu (Makkah), na kufunga mwezi wa Ramadhani."
english: On the authority of Abu 'Abd al-Rahman 'Abdullah bin 'Umar bin al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with both of them) who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) say: "Islam is built upon five: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing regular prayer, paying the Zakah, Hajj to the House, and fasting Ramadan."

Kutamka shahada mbili ndio lango la kuingia katika Uislamu.

title: Kuumbwa kwa Mwanadamu na Jaaliwa Yake
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ الصَّادِقُ الْمَصْدُوقُ: «إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ يُجْمَعُ خَلْقُهُ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْماً نُطْفَةً، ثُمَّ يَكُونُ عَلَقَةً مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ يَكُونُ مُضْغَةً مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ يُرْسَلُ إِلَيْهِ الْمَلَكُ فَيَنْفُخُ فِيهِ الرُّوحَ، وَيُؤْمَرُ بِأَرْبَعِ كَلِمَاتٍ: بِكَتْبِ رِزْقِهِ، وَأَجَلِهِ، وَعَمَلِهِ، وَشَقِيٌّ أَوْ سَعِيدٌ...».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Abdulrahman Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Alituhadithia Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), naye ni mkweli mwenye kusadikiwa: "Hakika kila mmoja wenu hukusanywa umbo lake tumboni mwa mamaye kwa siku arobaini akiwa tone la manii, kisha huwa pande la damu kwa muda kama huo, kisha kipande cha nyama kwa muda kama huo. Kisha hutumwa malaika kwake na akampulizia roho, na akaamrishwa kuandika mambo manne: riziki yake, muda wa maisha yake, matendo yake, na kama atakuwa mtu wa motoni au wa peponi..."
english: On the authority of Abu 'Abd al-Rahman 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and he is the truthful, the believed, narrated to us: "Verily the creation of each one of you is brought together in his mother's womb for forty days in the form of a drop, then he becomes a clot for a like period, then a piece of flesh for a like period, then there is sent to him the angel who blows the breath of life into him and who is commanded with four matters: to write down his sustenance, his life span, his actions, and whether he will be happy or unhappy..."

title: Katazo la Kuzua Mambo Mapya katika Dini (Bid'ah)
arabic: عَنْ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أُمِّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِي أَمْرِنَا هَذَا مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ رَدٌّ». وفي رواية لمسلم: «مَنْ عَمِلَ عَمَلاً لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْرُنَا فَهُوَ رَدٌّ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Mama wa Waumini, Ummu Abdillah Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: "Yeyote atakayezua katika jambo letu hili (dini yetu) lile ambalo halimo ndani yake, basi jambo hilo litakataliwa." Na katika upokezi mwingine wa Muslim: "Yeyote atakayetenda amali yoyote ambayo haina muongozo wetu, basi amali hiyo inakataliwa."
english: On the authority of Mother of the Believers, Umm 'Abdullah 'A'ishah (may Allah be pleased with her) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said: "He who innovates something in this matter of ours that is not of it will have it rejected." And in another version by Muslim: "He who does an act which our matter is not in agreement with will have it rejected."

title: Kujiepusha na Mambo Yenye Shaka
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ الْحَلاَلَ بَيِّنٌ وَإِنَّ الْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَهُمَا أُمُورٌ مُشْتَبِهَاتٌ لاَ يَعْلَمُهُنَّ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَمَنِ اتَّقَى الشُّبُهَاتِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِينِهِ وَعِرْضِهِ، وَمَنْ وَقَعَ فِي الشُّبُهَاتِ وَقَعَ فِي الْحَرَامِ... أَلاَ وَإِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ مُضْغَةً إِذَا صَلَحَتْ صَلَحَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ، وَإِذَا فَسَدَتْ فَسَدَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ، أَلاَ وَهِيَ الْقَلْبُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Abdullah an-Nu'man bin Bashir (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: Nilimsikia Mjumbe wa Allah akisema: "Hakika halali iko wazi na haramu iko wazi, na baina ya hivyo viwili kuna mambo yenye utata ambayo watu wengi hawayajui. Basi mwenye kujiepusha na mambo yenye shaka, ameweka salama dini yake na heshima yake. Na mwenye kuangukia katika shaka ataangukia katika haramu... Jueni kuwa ndani ya mwili kuna kipande cha nyama, kikitengemaa basi mwili mzima unakuwa mwema, na kikiharibika basi mwili mzima unaharibika, jueni kwamba hicho ni moyo."
english: On the authority of Abu 'Abdullah al-Nu'man bin Bashir (may Allah be pleased with both of them) who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah say: "Truly, what is lawful is clear and what is unlawful is clear, and between them are matters of doubt which many people do not know. So whoever guards against doubts clears himself in regard to his religion and his honor, but whoever falls into doubts falls into what is unlawful... Truly, there is a piece of flesh in the body which, if it is sound, the whole body is sound, and if it is diseased, the whole body is diseased. Truly, it is the heart."

Kutunza moyo ndio msingi wa kudhibiti viungo vyote vya mwili.

title: Dini ni Nasiha na Uaminifu
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي رُقَيَّةَ تَمِيمِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ الدَّارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ» قُلْنَا: لِمَنْ؟ قَالَ: «لِلَّهِ، وَلِكِتَابِهِ، وَلِرَسُولِهِ، وَلأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَعَامَّتِهِمْ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Ruqayyah Tamim bin Aws ad-Dari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kwamba Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: "Dini ni nasiha (uaminifu na kutoa mwongozo mwema)." Tukauliza: Kwa nani? Akasema: "Kwa ajili ya Allah, Kitabu Chake, Mtume Wake, viongozi wa Waislamu, na Waislamu wote kwa ujumla."
english: On the authority of Abu Ruqayyah Tamim bin Aws al-Dari (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said: "The religion is sincerity (al-Nasihah)." We said: To whom? He said: "To Allah, His Book, His Messenger, to the leaders of the Muslims, and to their common folk."
license: Waqf wa Kiislamu / Elimu Huria
content_note: Matini asilia ya Hadithi 42 za Imam An-Nawawi zenye Kiarabu, Kiswahili na Kiingereza.

explanation: Hadithi hii Na. 7 ya Imam An-Nawawi inafundisha misingi mizito ya kiimani, kiroho na kimaadili inayompa Muislamu muongozo kamili maishani.
hints: Nasiha kwa ajili ya Allah inamaanisha kumwamini na kumpwekesha bila ushirikina.
Nasiha kwa Qur'ani ni kuisoma, kuitafakari na kuitekeleza maishani.
Kuwashauri na kuwatakia kheri viongozi na watu wote ni msingi wa jamii bora.

title: Utakatifu wa Maisha na Mali ya Muislamu
arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلاَةَ، وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ، فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ عَصَمُوا مِنِّي دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّ الإِسْلاَمِ، وَحِسَابُهُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) kwamba Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: "Nimeamrishwa nipigane na watu mpaka washuhudie kwamba hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Allah na kwamba Muhammad ni Mjumbe wa Allah, na wasimamishe Swala, na watoe Zaka. Wakifanya hayo, basi wamehifadhi kutoka kwangu damu zao na mali zao isipokuwa kwa haki ya Uislamu, na hesabu yao iko kwa Allah Ta'ala."
english: On the authority of Ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with both of them) that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said: "I have been ordered to fight against the people until they testify that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and they establish prayer and pay Zakah. If they do that, their blood and wealth are protected from me except by a right of Islam, and their account is with Allah."

explanation: Hadithi hii Na. 8 ya Imam An-Nawawi inafundisha misingi mizito ya kiimani, kiroho na kimaadili inayompa Muislamu muongozo kamili maishani.

Hesabu ya siri na mambo ya moyoni yanahukumiwa na Mwenyezi Mungu pekee.
Hukumu za kidunia zinasimamia yale yanayoonekana kwa dhahiri.

title: Kutenda Mema Kulingana na Uwezo
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْهُ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ، وَمَا أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِهِ فَأْتُوا مِنْهُ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ، فَإِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ كَثْرَةُ مَسَائِلِهِمْ وَاخْتِلاَفُهُمْ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah Abdulrahman bin Sakhr (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Nilimsikia Mjumbe wa Allah akisema: "Nililowakataza liepukeni, na nililowaamrisha lifanyeni kulingana na uwezo wenu. Kwani hakika kilichowaangamiza wale waliokuwa kabla yenu ni wingi wa maswali yao yasiyo na maana na kutofautiana kwao na manabii wao."
english: On the authority of Abu Hurayrah 'Abd al-Rahman bin Sakhr (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah say: "What I have forbidden for you, avoid. What I have ordered you to do, do as much of it as you can. For what destroyed those before you was their much questioning and their disputing with their prophets."

content_note: Matini asilia ya Hadithi 42 za Imam An-Nawawi zenye Kiarabu, Kiswahili na Kiingereza.
reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa Kielimu wa Matini na Rejea za Sunnah
explanation: Hadithi hii Na. 9 ya Imam An-Nawawi inafundisha misingi mizito ya kiimani, kiroho na kimaadili inayompa Muislamu muongozo kamili maishani.

Amri za wema zinatekelezwa kadiri ya uwezo na nguvu ya mtu.
Uislamu ni dini ya wepesi na rehema, haumtwishi mtu mzigo mzito.

chapter.title_sw: Chakula Halali na Kukubaliwa kwa Dua
chapter.title_ar: باب أكل الحلال وأثره في إجابة الدعاء

title: Kula Vilivyo Halali na Utakaso wa Dua
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى طَيِّبٌ لاَ يَقْبَلُ إِلاَّ طَيِّباً، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِمَا أَمَرَ بِهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ... ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الرَّجُلَ يُطِيلُ السَّفَرَ أَشْعَثَ أَغْبَرَ، يَمُدُّ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، وَمَطْعَمُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَمَشْرَبُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَمَلْبَسُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَغُذِيَ بِالْحَرَامِ، فَأَنَّى يُسْتَجَابُ لِذَلِكَ؟!».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Hakika Allah Ta'ala ni Mwema na hakubali isipokuwa kilicho kizuri. Na Allah amewaamrisha waumini yale aliyowaamrisha Mitume... Kisha akamtaja mtu anayesafiri safari ndefu, akiwa amenyauka na mwenye vumbi, akinyoosha mikono yake kuelekea mbinguni akiomba: Ee Mola wangu! Ee Mola wangu! Hali ya kuwa chakula chake ni haramu, kinywaji chake ni haramu, vazi lake ni haramu, na amelishwa kwa haramu; basi atawezaje kujibiwa dua yake?!"
english: On the authority of Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: The Messenger of Allah said: "Allah the Almighty is Pure and accepts only that which is pure. And Allah has commanded the believers what He has commanded the Messengers... Then he mentioned a man who, having journeyed far, is disheveled and dusty, and who spreads out his hands to the sky saying 'O Lord! O Lord!' while his food is unlawful, his drink is unlawful, his clothing is unlawful, and he has been nourished with what is unlawful; so how can his supplication be answered?!"

content_note: Matini asilia ya Hadithi 42 za Imam An-Nawawi zenye Kiarabu, Kiswahili na Kiingereza.
reviewed_by: Uhakiki wa Kielimu wa Matini na Rejea za Sunnah
explanation: Hadithi hii Na. 10 ya Imam An-Nawawi inafundisha misingi mizito ya kiimani, kiroho na kimaadili inayompa Muislamu muongozo kamili maishani.
hints: Kula na kupata riziki ya halali ni sharti kubwa la kukubaliwa kwa dua.
Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mtakatifu na hakubali amali au sadaka inayotokana na haramu.
Kujiepusha na mapato ya dhulma na hila huleta baraka maishani.

chapter.title_sw: Kuacha Yenye Shaka Kuelekea Yasiyo na Shaka

title: Kuacha Yenye Shaka Kuelekea Yasiyo na Shaka
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: حَفِظْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «دَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لاَ يَرِيبُكَ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Muhammad al-Hasan bin Ali bin Abi Talib (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: Nilihifadhi kutoka kwa Mjumbe wa Allah maneno haya: "Acha kile kinachokutia shaka na uende kwenye kile kisichokutia shaka."
english: On the authority of Abu Muhammad al-Hasan bin 'Ali bin Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with both of them) who said: I learned by heart from the Messenger of Allah: "Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt."

chapter.title_ar: باب الاشتغال بما يعني وترك الفضول

title: Kuacha Yasiyomhusu Mtu
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلاَمِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لاَ يَعْنِيهِ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Miongoni mwa uzuri wa Uislamu wa mtu ni kuacha yale yasiyomhusu."
english: On the authority of Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: The Messenger of Allah said: "Part of the perfection of one's Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him."

chapter.title_ar: باب كمال الإيمان بمحبة الخير للغير

title: Kumpendelea Nduguyo Unachojipendelea Mwenyewe
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ خَادِمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hamzah Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) mtumishi wa Mjumbe wa Allah, kutoka kwa Mtume amesema: "Hatoamini (kwa ukamilifu) mmoja wenu mpaka ampendelee ndugu yake kile anachojipendelea yeye mwenyewe."
english: On the authority of Abu Hamzah Anas bin Malik (may Allah be pleased with him) servant of the Messenger of Allah, that the Prophet said: "None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself."

title: Utakatifu wa Damu ya Muislamu
arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لاَ يَحِلُّ دَمُ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ بِإِحْدَى ثَلاَثٍ: الثَّيِّبُ الزَّانِي، وَالنَّفْسُ بِالنَّفْسِ، وَالتَّارِكُ لِدِينِهِ الْمُفَارِقُ لِلْجَمَاعَةِ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Haifai kumwaga damu ya mtu Muislamu anayeshuhudia kuwa hapana mola ila Allah na mimi ni Mjumbe wa Allah isipokuwa kwa moja ya mambo matatu: Mzini aliyeoa/kuolewa, uhai kwa uhai (kisasi cha kuua), na anayeacha dini yake akajitenga na umoja wa Waislamu."
english: On the authority of Ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: The Messenger of Allah said: "The blood of a Muslim is not lawful except in one of three cases: the married person who commits adultery, a life for a life, and the one who leaves his religion and forsakes the community."

chapter.title_sw: Kusema Mazuri au Kunyamaza na Kuheshimu Wageni
chapter.title_ar: باب آداب الكلام وإكرام الجار والضيف

title: Kusema Mazuri au Kunyamaza na Kuheshimu Wageni
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْراً أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ جَارَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kwamba Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Mwenye kumwamini Allah na Siku ya Mwisho aseme mazuri au anyamaze, na mwenye kumwamini Allah na Siku ya Mwisho amkirimu jirani yake, na mwenye kumwamini Allah na Siku ya Mwisho amkirimu mgeni wake."
english: On the authority of Abu Hurayrah that the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should show courtesy to his neighbor; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should show hospitality to his guest."

chapter.title_sw: Katazo la Hasira na Faida Zake

title: Katazo la Hasira na Faida Zake
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَوْصِنِي، قَالَ: «لاَ تَغْضَبْ». فَرَدَّدَ مِرَاراً، قَالَ: «لاَ تَغْضَبْ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kwamba mtu mmoja alimwambia Mtume: Niusie, akasema: "Usikasirike." Yule mtu akarudia mara kadhaa kuomba usia, naye Mtume akamwambia: "Usikasirike."
english: On the authority of Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him): A man said to the Prophet: Advise me. He said: "Do not become angry." The man repeated his request several times, and each time he said: "Do not become angry."

title: Kufanya Wema Katika Kila Kitu
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي يَعْلَى شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَإِذَا قَتَلْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الْقِتْلَةَ، وَإِذَا ذَبَحْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الذِّبْحَةَ، وَلْيُحِدَّ أَحَدُكُمْ شَفْرَتَهُ، وَلْيُرِحْ ذَبِيحَتَهُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Ya'la Shaddad bin Aws (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kutoka kwa Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Hakika Allah ameamuru wema (ihsani) katika kila kitu. Basi mnapoua basi ueni vizuri bila mateso, na mnapochinja chinjeni vizuri, na mmoja wenu anoe kisu chake na amstareheshe mnyama wake anayemchinja."
english: On the authority of Abu Ya'la Shaddad bin Aws from the Messenger of Allah: "Verily Allah has prescribed proficiency in all things. Thus, if you kill, kill well; and if you slaughter, slaughter well. Let each one of you sharpen his blade and let him spare pain to the animal he slaughters."

chapter.title_sw: Kumcha Mwenyezi Mungu na Tabia Njema

title: Kumcha Mwenyezi Mungu na Tabia Njema
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ جُنْدُبِ بْنِ جُنَادَةَ وَأَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr na Mu'adh bin Jabal (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) kutoka kwa Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Mche Mwenyezi Mungu popote pale ulipo, na fuatisha kosa kwa tendo jema litalifuta, na uishi na watu kwa tabia njema."
english: On the authority of Abu Dharr and Mu'adh bin Jabal from the Messenger of Allah: "Fear Allah wherever you are, and follow up a bad deed with a good deed and it will wipe it out, and behave well towards the people."

chapter.title_ar: باب حفظ حدود الله وتفويض الأمور إليه

title: Mlinde Mwenyezi Mungu Naye Atakulinda
arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كُنْتُ خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْماً فَقَالَ: «يَا غُلاَمُ، إِنِّي أُعَلِّمُكَ كَلِمَاتٍ: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ، إِذَا سَأَلْتَ فَاسْأَلِ اللَّهَ، وَإِذَا اسْتَعَنْتَ فَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ، وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ الأُمَّةَ لَوِ اجْتَمَعَتْ عَلَى أَنْ يَنْفَعُوكَ بِشَيْءٍ لَمْ يَنْفَعُوكَ إِلاَّ بِشَيْءٍ قَدْ كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ لَكَ... رُفِعَتِ الأَقْلاَمُ وَجَفَّتِ الصُّحُفُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: Nilikuwa nyuma ya Mtume siku moja akaniambia: "Ewe kijana! Mimi nakufundisha maneno machache: Mlinde Allah (hifadhi maamrisho Yake) Naye Atakulinda, mlinde Allah Utamkuta mbele yako. Ukiomba basi muombe Allah, na ukitaka msaada basi taka msaada kwa Allah. Na ujue kwamba umma mzima ungalikusanyika ili kukunufaisha kwa jambo, hawatokunufaisha ila kwa kile alichokwisha kukuandikia Allah... Kalamu zimeinuliwa na kurasa zimekauka."
english: On the authority of 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas who said: One day I was behind the Prophet and he said to me: "O young man, I shall teach you some words: Be mindful of Allah, and Allah will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him in front of you. If you ask, ask of Allah; if you seek help, seek help of Allah. Know that if the whole nation were to gather together to benefit you with anything, it would benefit you only with something that Allah had already prescribed for you... The pens have been lifted and the pages have dried."

title: Kuwa na Haya na Maadili
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الأَنْصَارِيِّ الْبَدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ مِمَّا أَدْرَكَ النَّاسُ مِنْ كَلاَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ الأُولَى: إِذَا لَمْ تَسْتَحِ فَاصْنَعْ مَا شِئْتَ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Mas'ud Uqbah bin Amr al-Ansari al-Badri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Hakika katika yale ambayo watu waliyoyapata kutokana na maneno ya utume wa kwanza ni: Ukikosa kuwa na haya, basi fanya utakalo."
english: On the authority of Abu Mas'ud 'Uqbah bin 'Amr al-Ansari who said: The Messenger of Allah said: "Verily from the words that people obtained from the first prophecy are: If you feel no shame, then do as you wish."

title: Msimamo Thabiti katika Imani (Al-Istiqamah)
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو -وَقِيلَ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ- سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قُلْ لِي فِي الإِسْلاَمِ قَوْلاً لاَ أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ أَحَداً غَيْرَكَ، قَالَ: «قُلْ: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ، ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sufyan bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Nilisema: Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! Niambie katika Uislamu kauli ambayo sitomuuliza yeyote mwingine baada yako, akasema: "Sema: Nimemwamini Allah, kisha simama imara (katika utiifu)."
english: On the authority of Sufyan bin 'Abdullah who said: I said: O Messenger of Allah, tell me something about Islam which I will not ask anyone about other than you. He said: "Say: I believe in Allah, and then remain steadfast."

chapter.title_ar: باب الاقتصار على الفرائض لدخول الجنة

title: Kuingia Peponi kwa Kutekeleza Faradhi
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: أَرَأَيْتَ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ الْمَكْتُوبَاتِ، وَصُمْتُ رَمَضَانَ، وَأَحْلَلْتُ الْحَلاَلَ، وَحَرَّمْتُ الْحَرَامَ، وَلَمْ أَزِدْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ شَيْئاً، أَأَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Abdullah Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) kwamba mtu mmoja alimuuliza Mtume: Je, unaonaje nikiswali swala za faradhi, nikafunga Ramadhani, nikahalalisha halali na nikaharamisha haramu, bila kuzidisha kitu kingine chochote, je, nitaingia Peponi? Mtume akamjibu: "Ndio."
english: On the authority of Abu 'Abdullah Jabir bin 'Abdullah that a man asked the Prophet: Tell me, if I pray the obligatory prayers, fast Ramadan, treat as lawful that which is lawful and forbid that which is unlawful, and do nothing in addition, will I enter Paradise? He said: "Yes."

title: Usafi, Swala, Sadaka na Subira
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الطَّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلآنِ -أَوْ تَمْلأُ- مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَالصَّلاَةُ نُورٌ، وَالصَّدَقَةُ بُرْهَانٌ، وَالصَّبْرُ ضِيَاءٌ، وَالْقُرْآنُ حُجَّةٌ لَكَ أَوْ عَلَيْكَ، كُلُّ النَّاسِ يَغْدُو فَبَائِعٌ نَفْسَهُ فَمُعْتِقُهَا أَوْ مُوبِقُهَا».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Malik al-Harith bin Asim al-Ash'ari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Usafi ni nusu ya Imani, na Al-hamdulillah inajaza mizani, na Subhanallah na Al-hamdulillah zinajaza kati ya mbingu na ardhi, na Swala ni nuru, na Sadaka ni uthibitisho, na Subira ni mwangaza unaong'aa, na Qur'ani ni hoja ya kukutetea au ya kukuangamiza. Kila mtu asubuhi anatoka kuiuza nafsi yake, ima akaikomboa au akaiangamiza."
english: On the authority of Abu Malik al-Harith bin 'Asim al-Ash'ari who said: The Messenger of Allah said: "Purity is half of faith, and Al-hamdulillah fills the scale, and Subhanallah and Al-hamdulillah fill that which is between heaven and earth. Prayer is light, charity is proof, patience is illumination, and the Qur'an is an argument for or against you. Every human being starts his day as a vendor of his soul, either freeing it or bringing about its ruin."

chapter.title_sw: Kuharamishwa kwa Dhulma Miongoni mwa Waja (Hadith Qudsi)
chapter.title_ar: باب تحريم الظلم وبيان فضل الله

title: Kuharamishwa kwa Dhulma Miongoni mwa Waja (Hadith Qudsi)
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ الْغِفَارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يَا عِبَادِي إِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ الظُّلْمَ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَجَعَلْتُهُ بَيْنَكُمْ مُحَرَّماً فَلاَ تَظَالَمُوا، يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ ضَالٌّ إِلاَّ مَنْ هَدَيْتُهُ فَاسْتَهْدُونِي أَهْدِكُمْ، يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ جَائِعٌ إِلاَّ مَنْ أَطْعَمْتُهُ فَاسْتَطْعِمُونِي أُطْعِمْكُمْ... يَا عِبَادِي إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ أُحْصِيهَا لَكُمْ ثُمَّ أُوَفِّيكُمْ إِيَّاهَا، فَمَنْ وَجَدَ خَيْراً فَلْيَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ، وَمَنْ وَجَدَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ يَلُومَنَّ إِلاَّ نَفْسَهُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kutoka kwa Mtume katika yale anayoyasimulia kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi Aliyetukuka kuwa amesema: "Enyi waja Wangu! Hakika Mimi nimejiharimishia dhulma juu ya Nafsi Yangu, na nikaifanya kuwa haramu baina yenu, basi msidhulumiane. Enyi waja Wangu! Nyote mmepotea isipokuwa yule Niliyemwongoza, basi niombeni mwongozo Nitawaongoza. Enyi waja Wangu! Nyote mna njaa isipokuwa yule Niliyemlisha, basi niombeni chakula Nitawalisha... Enyi waja Wangu! Hakika haya ni matendo yenu Nawayahifadhia kisha Nitawalipa kwayo kikamilifu; basi anayekuta kheri amhimidi Allah, na anayekuta kinyume cha hivyo basi asimlaumu yeyote ila nafsi yake."
english: On the authority of Abu Dharr al-Ghifari from the Prophet among the sayings he narrates from his Lord that He said: "O My servants, I have forbidden injustice for Myself and have made it forbidden amongst you, so do not oppress one another. O My servants, all of you are astray except for those I have guided, so seek guidance of Me and I shall guide you... O My servants, it is but your deeds that I reckon up for you and then recompense you for; so let him who finds good praise Allah, and let him who finds other than that blame no one but himself."

chapter.title_sw: Kila Tendo la Kheri ni Sadaka

title: Kila Tendo la Kheri ni Sadaka
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَيْضاً أَنَّ نَاساً مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ذَهَبَ أَهْلُ الدُّثُورِ بِالأُجُورِ، يُصَلُّونَ كَمَا نُصَلِّي، وَيَصُومُونَ كَمَا نَصُومُ، وَيَتَصَدَّقُونَ بِفُضُولِ أَمْوَالِهِمْ، قَالَ: «أَوَلَيْسَ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مَا تَصَّدَّقُونَ؟ إِنَّ بِكُلِّ تَسْبِيحَةٍ صَدَقَةً، وَكُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ صَدَقَةً، وَكُلِّ تَحْمِيدَةٍ صَدَقَةً، وَكُلِّ تَهْلِيلَةٍ صَدَقَةً، وَأَمْرٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَنَهْيٌ عَنْ مُنْكَرٍ صَدَقَةٌ، وَفِي بُضْعِ أَحَدِكُمْ صَدَقَةٌ»...
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) pia kwamba baadhi ya Masahaba walisema kumwambia Mtume: Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! Matajiri wameondoka na thawabu zote; wanaswali kama sisi tunavyoswali, wanafunga kama sisi tunavyofunga, na wanatoa sadaka kwa ziada ya mali zao! Mtume akasema: "Kwani Allah hakuwawekea nanyi mnavyoweza kutoa sadaka? Hakika kila tasbihi (Subhanallah) ni sadaka, na kila takbira (Allahu Akbar) ni sadaka, na kila tahmidi (Alhamdulillah) ni sadaka, na kila tahlili (La ilaha illa Allah) ni sadaka, na kuamrisha mema ni sadaka, na kukataza maovu ni sadaka, na katika tendo la ndoa la mmoja wenu kuna sadaka..."
english: On the authority of Abu Dharr also that some of the companions of the Messenger of Allah said to the Prophet: O Messenger of Allah, the rich have taken away all the rewards. They pray as we pray, they fast as we fast, and they give charity from the surplus of their wealth. He said: "Has not Allah made for you that wherewith you may give charity? Every tasbihah is a charity, every takbirah is a charity, every tahmidah is a charity, every tahlilah is a charity, enjoining the good is a charity, forbidding the evil is a charity, and in man's sexual act there is a charity..."

chapter.title_sw: Sadaka ya Kila Kiungo na Kusuluhisha Watu
chapter.title_ar: باب صدقة كل مفصل والإصلاح بين الناس

title: Sadaka ya Kila Kiungo na Kusuluhisha Watu
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «كُلُّ سُلاَمَى مِنَ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَطْلُعُ فِيهِ الشَّمْسُ: تَعْدِلُ بَيْنَ الاثْنَيْنِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَتُعِينُ الرَّجُلَ فِي دَابَّتِهِ فَتَحْمِلُهُ عَلَيْهَا أَوْ تَرْفَعُ لَهُ عَلَيْهَا مَتَاعَهُ صَدَقَةٌ، وَالْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ، وَبِكُلِّ خَطْوَةٍ تَمْشِيهَا إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَتُمِيطُ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ صَدَقَةٌ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Kila kiungo cha binadamu kinawajibika kutolewa sadaka kila siku inayochomoza jua: Kusuluhisha kwa haki baina ya watu wawili ni sadaka, kumsaidia mtu kupanda mnyama wake au kumbebea mzigo wake ni sadaka, neno zuri ni sadaka, kila hatua unayotembea kuelekea kuswali ni sadaka, na kuondoa maudhi njiani ni sadaka."
english: On the authority of Abu Hurayrah who said: The Messenger of Allah said: "Every joint of a person must perform a charity each day the sun rises: to judge justly between two people is a charity, to help a man with his mount, lifting him onto it or hoisting up his belongings onto it is a charity, a good word is a charity, every step you take towards prayer is a charity, and removing a harmful thing from the path is a charity."

chapter.title_sw: Wema ni Tabia Njema na Dhambi ni Linalotikisa Kifua

title: Wema ni Tabia Njema na Dhambi ni Linalotikisa Kifua
arabic: عَنِ النَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الْبِرُّ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ، وَالإِثْمُ مَا حَاكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ وَكَرِهْتَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِ النَّاسُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa An-Nawwas bin Sam'an (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kutoka kwa Mtume amesema: "Wema ni tabia njema, na dhambi ni lile linalokukwaza na kutikisa kifuani mwako na ukachukia watu walifahamu au kuliona."
english: On the authority of al-Nawwas bin Sam'an from the Prophet who said: "Righteousness is good character, and sin is that which wavers in your heart and which you would dislike for people to discover."

chapter.title_sw: Kushikamana na Sunnah na Kuacha Mambo ya Uzushi
chapter.title_ar: باب لزوم السنة والحذر من البدع

title: Kushikamana na Sunnah na Kuacha Mambo ya Uzushi
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ الْعِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: وَعَظَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَوْعِظَةً وَجِلَتْ مِنْهَا الْقُلُوبُ، وَذَرَفَتْ مِنْهَا الْعُيُونُ، فَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَأَنَّهَا مَوْعِظَةُ مُوَدِّعٍ فَأَوْصِنَا، قَالَ: «أُوصِيكُمْ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ، وَالسَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ وَإِنْ تَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَبْدٌ، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَعِشْ مِنْكُمْ فَسَيَرَى اخْتِلاَفاً كَثِيراً، فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِسُنَّتِي وَسُنَّةِ الْخُلَفَاءِ الرَّاشِدِينَ الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، عَضُّوا عَلَيْهَا بِالنَّوَاجِذِ، وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَمُحْدَثَاتِ الأُمُورِ، فَإِنَّ كُلَّ بِدْعَةٍ ضَلاَلَةٌ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Najih Al-Irbadh bin Sariyah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah alitupa mawaidha yaliyotikisa nyoyo na yakatiririsha machozi. Tukasema: Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! Ni kana kwamba haya ni mawaidha ya mtu anayeaga, basi tuusie. Akasema: "Nawausia kumcha Allah, na kusikiliza na kutii hata akitawazwa juu yenu mtumwa. Kwani hakika atakayeishi miongoni mwenu ataona mifarakano mingi. Basi shikamaneni na Sunnah yangu na Sunnah ya Makhalifa waongofu baada yangu, ziumeni kwa meno ya magego, na tahadharini na mambo ya kuzua, kwani kila uzushi ni upotevu."
english: On the authority of Abu Najih al-'Irbad bin Sariyah who said: The Messenger of Allah gave us a sermon by which our hearts were filled with fear and tears flowed from our eyes. We said: O Messenger of Allah, it is as though this were a farewell sermon, so advise us. He said: "I counsel you to fear Allah and to hear and obey, even if a slave were to rule over you. Verily he among you who lives long will see great controversy, so stick to my sunnah and the sunnah of the rightly-guided caliphs, bite onto it with your molars, and beware of newly-invented matters, for every bid'ah is astray."
attribution: Imepokewa na Abu Dawud na At-Tirmidhi

chapter.title_sw: Milango ya Kheri na Mhimili Mkuu wa Dini
chapter.title_ar: باب أبواب الخير والجهاد وضبط اللسان

title: Milango ya Kheri na Mhimili Mkuu wa Dini
arabic: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَخْبِرْنِي بِعَمَلٍ يُدْخِلُنِي الْجَنَّةَ وَيُبَاعِدُنِي عَنِ النَّارِ، قَالَ: «لَقَدْ سَأَلْتَ عَنْ عَظِيمٍ، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَسِيرٌ عَلَى مَنْ يَسَّرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: تَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ لاَ تُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً، وَتُقِيمُ الصَّلاَةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ»... ثُمَّ قَالَ: «أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِمَلاَكِ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ؟» قُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ. فَأَخَذَ بِلِسَانِهِ وَقَالَ: «كُفَّ عَلَيْكَ هَذَا».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Mu'adh bin Jabal (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Nilisema: Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! Nieleze amali itakayoniingiza Peponi na kunitenga mbali na Moto. Akasema: "Hakika umeuliza jambo kubwa, nalo ni jepesi kwa yule ambaye Allah Amemfanyia wepesi: Muabudu Allah bila kumshirikisha na chochote, simamisha Swala, toa Zaka, funga Ramadhani, na uhiji Nyumba Tukufu... Kisha akasema: Je, nisikujulishe nguzo inayomiliki na kulinda haya yote? Nikasema: Ndio ewe Nabii wa Allah. Akakamata ulimi wake akasema: Uzuie huu usiseme hovyo!"
english: On the authority of Mu'adh bin Jabal who said: I said: O Messenger of Allah, tell me of an act which will take me into Paradise and keep me away from the Hellfire. He said: "You have asked for something great, yet it is easy for him for whom Allah makes it easy: worship Allah, associate nothing with Him, establish prayer, pay Zakah, fast Ramadan, and make pilgrimage to the House... Then he said: Shall I not tell you of the foundation of all of that? I said: Yes, O Prophet of Allah. So he took hold of his tongue and said: Restrain this."

chapter.title_sw: Kutunza Mipaka na Faradhi za Mwenyezi Mungu

title: Kutunza Mipaka na Faradhi za Mwenyezi Mungu
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ جُرْثُومِ بْنِ نَاشِرٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى فَرَضَ فَرَائِضَ فَلاَ تُضَيِّعُوهَا، وَحَدَّ حُدُوداً فَلاَ تَعْتَدُوهَا، وَحَرَّمَ أَشْيَاءَ فَلاَ تَنْتَهِكُوهَا، وَسَكَتَ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ رَحْمَةً لَكُمْ غَيْرَ نِسْيَانٍ فَلاَ تَبْحَثُوا عَنْهَا».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani Jurthum bin Nashir (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kutoka kwa Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Hakika Allah Ta'ala amefaradhisha faradhi basi msizipoteze, na akaweka mipaka basi msiivuke, na akaharamisha mambo basi msiyavunje, na amenyamazia mambo mengine kwa rehema Kwenu bila kusahau, basi msiyachimbue kwa udadisi mwingi."
english: On the authority of Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani that the Messenger of Allah said: "Verily Allah the Almighty has laid down religious duties, so do not neglect them; and He has set limits, so do not overstep them; and He has forbidden some things, so do not violate them; and He was silent about some things as a mercy to you and not out of forgetfulness, so do not seek after them."

chapter.title_sw: Zuhudi Duniani na Kupendwa na Allah na Watu
chapter.title_ar: باب الزهد في الدنيا ومحبة الناس

title: Zuhudi Duniani na Kupendwa na Allah na Watu
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، دُلَّنِي عَلَى عَمَلٍ إِذَا عَمِلْتُهُ أَحَبَّنِيَ اللَّهُ وَأَحَبَّنِيَ النَّاسُ، فَقَالَ: «ازْهَدْ فِي الدُّنْيَا يُحِبَّكَ اللَّهُ، وَازْهَدْ فِيمَا فِي أَيْدِي النَّاسِ يُحِبَّكَ النَّاسُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu al-Abbas Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mtu mmoja alikuja kwa Mtume akasema: Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! Nielekeze kwenye amali ambayo nikiitenda Mwenyezi Mungu atanipenda na watu watanipenda. Akasema: "Usiwe na pupa na dunia Allah atakupenda, na usiwe na tamaa ya vilivyomo mikononi mwa watu basi watu watakupenda."
english: On the authority of Abu al-'Abbas Sahl bin Sa'd al-Sa'idi who said: A man came to the Prophet and said: O Messenger of Allah, direct me to an act which, if I do it, Allah will love me and the people will love me. He said: "Renounce the world and Allah will love you, and renounce what is in the hands of people and people will love you."

chapter.title_sw: Kanuni ya Kuzuia Madhara (Hakuna Kujidhuru Wala Kudhuru)

title: Kanuni ya Kuzuia Madhara (Hakuna Kujidhuru Wala Kudhuru)
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لاَ ضَرَرَ وَلاَ ضِرَارَ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Sa'd bin Malik bin Sinan al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kwamba Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Hakuna kujidhuru mwenyewe wala kumdhuru mtu mwingine."
english: On the authority of Abu Sa'id Sa'd bin Malik bin Sinan al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah said: "There should be neither harming nor reciprocating harm."

chapter.title_sw: Ushahidi ni Juu ya Mwenye Kudai na Kiapo ni kwa Mkanushaji
chapter.title_ar: باب البينة على المدعي واليمين على من أنكر

title: Ushahidi ni Juu ya Mwenye Kudai na Kiapo ni kwa Mkanushaji
arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَوْ يُعْطَى النَّاسُ بِدَعْوَاهُمْ لاَدَّعَى رِجَالٌ أَمْوَالَ قَوْمٍ وَدِمَاءَهُمْ، لَكِنِ الْبَيِّنَةُ عَلَى الْمُدَّعِي، وَالْيَمِينُ عَلَى مَنْ أَنْكَرَ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) kwamba Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Kama watu wangelipewa haki kwa madai yao tu bila uthibitisho, watu wangedai mali za wengine na damu zao; lakini ushahidi ni juu ya mwenye kudai, na kiapo ni juu ya anayekanusha."
english: On the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah said: "Were people to be given according to their claims, some men would claim the wealth and blood of others, but the burden of proof is upon the claimant and the oath is upon the one who denies."

chapter.title_sw: Wajibu wa Kubadilisha Maovu Katika Jamii

title: Wajibu wa Kubadilisha Maovu Katika Jamii
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ مُنْكَراً فَلْيُغَيِّرْهُ بِيَدِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِلِسَانِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِقَلْبِهِ، وَذَلِكَ أَضْعَفُ الإِيمَانِ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Nilimsikia Mjumbe wa Allah akisema: "Yeyote miongoni mwenu anayeona uovu au maasi, basi ayabadilishe kwa mkono wake (kwa mamlaka yake), asipoweza basi kwa ulimi wake (kwa kusema na kueleza), na asipoweza basi kwa moyo wake (kuchukia maovu hayo), na hiyo ndiyo daraja dhaifu zaidi ya imani."
english: On the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah say: "Whosoever of you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand; and if he is not able to do so, then with his tongue; and if he is not able to do so, then with his heart — and that is the weakest of faith."

chapter.title_sw: Undugu wa Kiislamu na Katazo la Kusalitiana na Kufitiniana

title: Undugu wa Kiislamu na Katazo la Kusalitiana na Kufitiniana
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لاَ تَحَاسَدُوا، وَلاَ تَنَاجَشُوا، وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا، وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا، وَلاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ، وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَاناً، الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ: لاَ يَظْلِمُهُ، وَلاَ يَخْذُلُهُ، وَلاَ يَكْذِبُهُ، وَلاَ يَحْقِرُهُ... كُلُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَامٌ: دَمُهُ، وَمَالُهُ، وَعِرْضُهُ».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) amesema: Mjumbe wa Allah amesema: "Msihusudiane, msipandishiane bei kwa hadaa bila nia ya kununua, msichukiane, msipuuzeane na kugeuziana migongo, wala msiingiliane katika biashara za wenzenu; na kuweni waja wa Allah, ndugu. Muislamu ni ndugu ya Muislamu: hamdhulumu, hamtelekezi, hamwambii uongo, wala hamdharau... Kila Muislamu kwa Muislamu mwingine ni haramu: damu yake, mali yake, na heshima yake."
english: On the authority of Abu Hurayrah who said: The Messenger of Allah said: "Do not envy one another, do not inflate prices for one another, do not hate one another, do not turn away from one another, and do not undercut one another in trade, but be, O servants of Allah, brothers. A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim: he does not oppress him, nor does he fail him, nor does he lie to him, nor does he hold him in contempt... All of a Muslim is sacred to a Muslim: his blood, his wealth, and his honor."

chapter.title_sw: Kusaidia Mahitaji ya Waislamu na Thawabu za Kutafuta Elimu
chapter.title_ar: باب قضاء حوائج المسلمين وفضل العلم

title: Kusaidia Mahitaji ya Waislamu na Thawabu za Kutafuta Elimu
arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَمَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، وَمَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِماً سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ، وَمَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقاً يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْماً سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقاً إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ...».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) kutoka kwa Mtume amesema: "Mwenye kumwondoshea muumini dhiki miongoni mwa dhiki za dunia, Allah Atamwondoshea dhiki miongoni mwa dhiki za Siku ya Qiyama. Na mwenye kumfanyia wepesi mwenye shida, Allah Atamfanyia wepesi duniani na Akhera. Na mwenye kumsitiri Muislamu, Allah Atamsitiri duniani na Akhera. Na Allah Yuko katika kumnusuru mja maadamu mja huyo yuko katika kumnusuru nduguye. Na mwenye kufuata njia akitafuta elimu, Allah Atamsahilishia njia ya kuelekea Peponi..."
english: On the authority of Abu Hurayrah from the Prophet: "Whoever relieves a believer's distress of the distressful aspects of this world, Allah will relieve his distress of the distressful aspects of the Day of Resurrection. Whoever makes things easy for a person in difficulty, Allah will make things easy for him in this world and the Hereafter. Whoever covers the faults of a Muslim, Allah will cover his faults in this world and the Hereafter. Allah helps His servant as long as the servant is helping his brother. Whoever takes a path in pursuit of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him by it a path to Paradise..."

chapter.title_sw: Uadilifu na Neema za Allah Katika Kulipa Mema na Maovu
chapter.title_ar: باب سعة فضل الله في كتابة الحسنات والسيئات

title: Uadilifu na Neema za Allah Katika Kulipa Mema na Maovu
arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَالسَّيِّئَاتِ ثُمَّ بَيَّنَ ذَلِكَ: فَمَنْ هَمَّ بِحَسَنَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حَسَنَةً كَامِلَةً، وَإِنْ هَمَّ بِهَا فَعَمِلَهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ إِلَى سَبْعِمِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ إِلَى أَضْعَافٍ كَثِيرَةٍ، وَإِنْ هَمَّ بِسَيِّئَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حَسَنَةً كَامِلَةً، وَإِنْ هَمَّ بِهَا فَعَمِلَهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ سَيِّئَةً وَاحِدَةً».
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) kutoka kwa Mjumbe wa Allah katika yale anayoyapokea kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi Aliyetukuka kuwa amesema: "Hakika Allah amekwisha andika mambo mema na maovu kisha akafafanua hilo: Mwenye kudhamiria kutenda tendo jema kisha asilitende, Allah Humwandikia kwake tendo jema kamili. Na akidhamiria kisha akalitenda, Allah Humwandikia mema kumi hadi mara mia saba na kuzidi maradufu mengi. Na akidhamiria tendo ovu kisha asilitende, Allah Humwandikia kwake tendo jema kamili, na akidhamiria kisha akalitenda, Allah Humwandikia kosa moja tu."
english: On the authority of Ibn 'Abbas from the Messenger of Allah among the sayings he narrates from his Lord: "Verily Allah has written down the good deeds and the bad deeds, and then explained it: Whosoever intended to do a good deed and did not do it, Allah writes it down with Himself as a full good deed, and if he intended it and did it, Allah writes it down with Himself as ten good deeds up to seven hundred times, or many times more. If he intended to do an evil deed and did not do it, Allah writes it down with Himself as a full good deed, and if he intended it and did it, Allah writes it down as one evil deed."
