chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 153: Kitabu cha Adabu za Kulala na Kuketi

title: Towards the end of his life, Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would supplicate before leav
arabic: وعن أبى برزة رضى الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول بآخرة إذا أراد أن يقوم من المجلس: "سبحانك الله وبحمدك، أشهد أن لا إله إلا أنت، أستغفرك وأتوب إليك" فقال رجل: يا رسول الله، إنك لتقول قولاً ما كنت تقوله فيما مضى؟ قال: "ذلك كفارة لما يكون في المجلس. ((رواه أبو داود)).((ورواه الحاكم أبو عبيد الله في  المستدرك  من رواية عائشة رضى الله عنها وقال: صحيح بإسناد))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Barzah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Towards the end of his life, Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) would supplicate before leaving an assembly thus: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaika (O Allah, You are free from every imperfection; all praise is for You. I testify that there is no true god except You, I ask Your msamaha and turn to You in toba).'' A man once said to him: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! You have spoken such words as you have never uttered before.'' He said, "It is an expiation of that which goes on in the assembly.'' ."
english:
Abu Barzah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Towards the end of his life, Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would supplicate before leaving an assembly thus: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaika (O Allah, You are free from every imperfection; all praise is for You. I testify that there is no true god except You, I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance).'' A man once said to him: "O Messenger of Allah! You have spoken such words as you have never uttered before.'' He said, "It is an expiation of that which goes on in the assembly.''

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 154: Kitabu cha Adabu za Kulala na Kuketi

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seldom left a gathering without supplicating in these ter
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنهُ قال: قلما كان رَسُول اللَّهِ ﷺ يقوم من مجلس حتى يدعو بهؤلاء الدعوات: 
"اللهم اقسم لنا من خشيتك ما تحول به بيننا وبين معاصيك، ومن طاعتك ما تبلغنا به جنتك، ومن اليقين ما تهون به علينا مصائب الدنيا، اللهم متعنا بأسماعنا وأبصارنا وقوتنا ما أحييتنا، واجعله الوارث منا، واجعل ثأرنا على من ظلمنا، وانصرنا على من عادانا، ولا تجعل مصيبتنا في ديننا، ولا تجعل الدنيا أكبر همنا، ولا مبلغ علمنا، ولا تسلط علينا من لا يرحمنا" ((رَوَاهُ التِّرمِذِيُّ وَقَالَ حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) seldom left a gathering without supplicating in these terms: "Allahumma-qsim lana min khashyatika ma tahulu bihi bainana wa baina ma'sika, wa min ta'atika ma tuballighuna bihi jannataka, wa minal-yaqini ma tuhawwinu 'alaina masa-'ibad-dunya. Allahumma matti'na biasma'ina, wa absarina, wa quwwatina ma ahyaitana, waj'alhul-waritha minna, waj'al tharana 'ala man zalamana, wansurna 'ala man 'adana, wa la taj'al musibatana fi dinina, wa la taj'alid-dunya akbara hammina, wa la mablagha 'ilmina, wa la tusallit 'alaina man-la yarhamuna, (O Allah, apportion to us such fear as should serve as a barrier between us and acts of disobedience; and such obedience as will take us to Your Jannah; and such as will make easy for us to bear in the calamities of this world. O Allah! let us enjoy our hearing, our sight and our power as long as You keep us alive and make our heirs from our own offspring, and make our revenge restricted to those who oppress us, and support us against those who are hostile to us let no misfortune afflict our Deen; let not worldly affairs be our principal concern, or the ultimate limit of our knowledge, and let not those rule over us who do not show mercy to us)."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seldom left a gathering without supplicating in these terms: "Allahumma-qsim lana min khashyatika ma tahulu bihi bainana wa baina ma'sika, wa min ta'atika ma tuballighuna bihi jannataka, wa minal-yaqini ma tuhawwinu 'alaina masa-'ibad-dunya. Allahumma matti'na biasma'ina, wa absarina, wa quwwatina ma ahyaitana, waj'alhul-waritha minna, waj'al tharana 'ala man zalamana, wansurna 'ala man 'adana, wa la taj'al musibatana fi dinina, wa la taj'alid-dunya akbara hammina, wa la mablagha 'ilmina, wa la tusallit 'alaina man-la yarhamuna, (O Allah, apportion to us such fear as should serve as a barrier between us and acts of disobedience; and such obedience as will take us to Your Jannah; and such as will make easy for us to bear in the calamities of this world. O Allah! let us enjoy our hearing, our sight and our power as long as You keep us alive and make our heirs from our own offspring, and make our revenge restricted to those who oppress us, and support us against those who are hostile to us let no misfortune afflict our Deen; let not worldly affairs be our principal concern, or the ultimate limit of our knowledge, and let not those rule over us who do not show mercy to us).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 155: Kitabu cha Adabu za Kulala na Kuketi

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Those people who leave a gathering in which they h
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنهُ قال، قال رَسُول اللَّهِ ﷺ: 
"ما من قوم يقومون من مجلس ولا يذكرون اللَّه تعالى فيه إلا قاموا عن مثل جيفة حمار وكان لهم حسرة" ((رَوَاهُ أبُو دَاوُدَ بإسناد صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Those people who leave a gathering in which they have not remembered Allah, will conclude it as if it has foul odour similar to that of a rotten carcass of a donkey. And it will be a cause of grief to them."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Those people who leave a gathering in which they have not remembered Allah, will conclude it as if it has foul odour similar to that of a rotten carcass of a donkey. And it will be a cause of grief to them.".

arabic: وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "ما جلس قوم مجلساً لم يذكروا الله تعالى فيه، ولم يصلوا على نبيهم فيه، إلا كان عليهم ترة؛ فإن شاء عذبهم، وإن شاء غفر لهم" ((رَوَاهُ التِّرمِذِيُّ وَقَالَ: "حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ")).

وفى رواية: "أصدقكم رؤيا أصدقكم حديثاً".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When the time draws near (i.e., near the end of the world), the dream of a muumini can hardly be false; and the dream of a muumini represents one part from forty-six parts of Prophethood.".One narration says: Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The most truthful of you in their speech are those who see the truest visions.""

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who sees me in his dream will see me in his wak

"من رآني في المنام فسيراني في اليقظة -أو كأنما رآني في اليقظة- لا يتمثل الشيطان بي" ((مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ)).

title: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "When one of you sees a dream that he likes, the
arabic:
وعن أبى سعيد الخدرى رضى الله عنه انه سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، يقول: 
"إذا رأى أحدكم رؤيا يحبها، فإنما هي من الله تعالى، فليحمد الله عليها، وليحدث بها -وفى رواية، فلا يحدث بها إلا من يحب- وإذا رأى غير ذلك مما يكره، فإنما هي من الشيطان، فليستعذ من شرها، ولا يذكرها لأحد، فإنها لا تضره" (( مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I heard Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "When one of you sees a dream that he likes, then it is from Allah. He should praise Allah for it and relate it to (others)."Another narration adds: Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said, "He should not report it except to those whom he loves. And if he sees one which he dislikes, then it is from the Satan. He should seek refuge in Allah against its evil and should not mention it to anyone. Then it will not harm him."."

He should praise Allah for it and relate it to (others)."Another narration adds: Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said, "He should not report it except to those whom he loves. And if he sees one which he dislikes, then it is from the Satan. He should seek refuge in Allah against its evil and should not mention it to anyone. Then it will not harm him.".

"الرؤيا الصالحة -وفى رواية: الرؤيا الحسنة- من الله، والحلم من الشيطان، فمن رأى شيئاً يكره فلينفث عن شماله ثلاثاً، وليتعوذ من الشيطان فإنها لا تضره" (( مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ)).
النفث  نفخ لطيف لا ريق معه.

He who sees something in a dream that he dislikes, should blow thrice on his left, must seek Allah's Refuge from the evil of the Satan (i.e., by saying: A'udhu billahi minash-Shaitanir-Rajim). Then it will not harm him."."

"إذا رأى أحدكم الرؤيا يكرهها، فليبصق عن يساره ثلاثاً، وليستعذ بالله من الشيطان ثلاثاً، وليتحول عن جنبه الذي كان عليه" ((رَوَاهُ مُسلِمٌ)).

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Of the worst lies are: to claim a false father, or
arabic:
وعن أبى الأسقع واثلة بن الأسقع رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
"إن من أعظم الفرى أن يدعى الرجل إلى غير أبيه، أو يرى عينيه ما لم تر، أو يقول على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ما لم يقل" ((رَوَاهُ البُخَارِيُّ)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Of the worst lies are: to claim a false father, or to pretend to have seen what one has not seen (tell a false dream), or to attribute to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) what he has not said."."
english: Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Of the worst lies are: to claim a false father, or to pretend to have seen what one has not seen (tell a false dream), or to attribute to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) what he has not said.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 165: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: A man asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "Which act in Islam is the best
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما أن رجلا سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: أي الإسلام خير؟ قال: 
"تطعم الطعام، وتقرأ السلام على من عرفت ومن لم تعرف". ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'as (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "A man asked the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake): "Which act in Islam is the best?" He (ﷺ) replied, "To give food, and to greet everyone, whether you know or you do not."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 166: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Allah created Adam (ﷺ), He said to him: 'Go and gree
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: لما خلق الله تعالى آدم عليه السلام قال: اذهب فسلم على أولئك -نفر من الملائكة جلوس- فاستمع ما يحيونك، فإنه تحيتك وتحية ذريتك. فقال: السلام عليكم فقالوا: السلام عليك ورحمة الله، فزادوه: ورحمة الله" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When Allah created Adam (ﷺ), He said to him: 'Go and greet that company of angels who are sitting there - and then listen to what they are going to say in reply to your greetings because that will be your greeting and your off-spring's.' Adam (ﷺ) said to the angels: 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum (May peace be upon you).' They replied: 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah (May peace be upon you and the Mercy of Allah).' Thus adding in reply to him: 'wa Rahmatullah (and the Mercy of Allah)' to his greeting."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Allah created Adam (ﷺ), He said to him: 'Go and greet that company of angels who are sitting there - and then listen to what they are going to say in reply to your greetings because that will be your greeting and your off-spring's.' Adam (ﷺ) said to the angels: 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum (May peace be upon you).' They replied: 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah (May peace be upon you and the Mercy of Allah).' Thus adding in reply to him: 'wa Rahmatullah (and the Mercy of Allah)' to his greeting.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 167: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to do seven things: to visit the sick, t
arabic: وعن أبي عمارة البراء بن عازب رضي الله عنهما قال: أمرنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بسبع: بعيادة المريض، واتباع الجنائز، وتشميت العاطس، ونصر الضعيف، وعون المظلوم، وإفشاء السلام وإبرار المقسم. ((متفق عليه هذا لفظ إحدى روايات البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) commanded us to do seven things: to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (of a dead muumini), to invoke the Mercy of Allah upon one who sneezes (i.e., by saying to him: Yarhamuk- Allah), to support the weak, to help the oppressed, to promote the greeting of 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum', and to help those who swear to do something to keep their oaths.."
english: Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to do seven things: to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (of a dead believer), to invoke the Mercy of Allah upon one who sneezes (i.e., by saying to him: Yarhamuk- Allah), to support the weak, to help the oppressed, to promote the greeting of 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum', and to help those who swear to do something to keep their oaths..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 168: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand is my life
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"لا تدخلوا الجنة حتى تؤمنوا ولا تؤمنوا حتى تحابوا أولا أدلكم على شيء إذا فعلتموه تحاببتم؟ أفشوا السلام بينكم" ((رواه مسلم )).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "By Him in Whose Hand is my life! You will not enter Jannah until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I inform you of something which, if you do, you will love one another? Promote greetings amongst yourselves."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand is my life! You will not enter Jannah until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I inform you of something which, if you do, you will love one another? Promote greetings amongst yourselves.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 169: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "O people, exchange greetings of peac
arabic:
وعن أبي يوسف عبد الله بن سلام رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: 
"يا أيها الناس أفشوا السلام، وأطعموا الطعام، وصلوا الأرحام وصلوا والناس نيام، تدخلوا الجنة بسلام" ((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Salam (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "O people, exchange greetings of peace (i.e., say: As-Salamu 'Alaikum to one another), feed people, strengthen the ties of kinship, and be in swala when others are asleep, you will enter Jannah in peace."."
english: 'Abdullah bin Salam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "O people, exchange greetings of peace (i.e., say: As-Salamu 'Alaikum to one another), feed people, strengthen the ties of kinship, and be in prayer when others are asleep, you will enter Jannah in peace.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 170: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: I used to visit 'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) in the morn
arabic: وعن الطفيل بن أبي بن كعب أنه كان يأتي عبد الله بن عمر، فيغدو معه إلى السوق، قال: فإذا غدونا إلى السوق، لم يمر عبد الله على سقاط ولا صاحب بيعة، ولا مسكين، ولا أحد إلا سلم عليه، قال الطفيل، فجئت عبد الله بن عمر يومًا، فاستتبعني إلى السوق فقلت له: ما تصنع بالسوق، وأنت لا تقف على البيع ولا تسأل عن السلع، ولا تسوم بها، ولا تجلس في مجالس السوق؟ وأقول: اجلس بنا هاهنا نتحدث، فقال يا أبا بطن- وكان الطفيل ذا بطن- إنما نغدو من أجل السلام فنسلم على من لقيناه. ((رواه مالك في الموطأ بإسناد صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa At-Tufail bin Ubayy bin Ka'b (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I used to visit 'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) in the morning and accompany him to the market. 'Abdullah offered greetings of peace to every one he met on the way, be they sellers of petty goods, traders or poor people. One day when I came to him, he asked me to accompany him to the market. I said to him: "What is the point of your going to the market when you do not sell, nor ask about articles, nor offer a price for them, nor sit down with any company of people. Let us sit down here and talk." He replied: "O Abu Batn (father of a belly) - Tufail had a large belly - we go to the market to greet everyone we meet."."
english: At-Tufail bin Ubayy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I used to visit 'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) in the morning and accompany him to the market. 'Abdullah offered greetings of peace to every one he met on the way, be they sellers of petty goods, traders or poor people. One day when I came to him, he asked me to accompany him to the market. I said to him: "What is the point of your going to the market when you do not sell, nor ask about articles, nor offer a price for them, nor sit down with any company of people. Let us sit down here and talk." He replied: "O Abu Batn (father of a belly) - Tufail had a large belly - we go to the market to greet everyone we meet.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 171: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (May peace be upon y
arabic:
عن عمران بن الحصين رضي الله عنهما قال: جاء رجل إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: السلام عليكم، فرد عليه ثم جلس، فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: “عشر” ثم جاء آخر، فقال: السلام عليكم ورحمة الله، فرد عليه فجلس، فقال: 
"عشرون" ثم جاء آخر، فقال: السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، فرد عليه فجلس، فقال: “ثلاثون” ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Imran bin Husain (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "A man came to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (May peace be upon you). The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) responded to his greeting and the man sat down. Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Ten (meaning the man had earned the merit of ten matendo mema)." Another one came and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah (May peace be upon you and the Mercy of Allah)." The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) responded to his greeting and the man sat down. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Twenty." A third one came and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (May peace be upon you and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings)." The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) responded to his greeting and the man sat down. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Thirty."."
english: 'Imran bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (May peace be upon you). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) responded to his greeting and the man sat down. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ten (meaning the man had earned the merit of ten good deeds)." Another one came and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah (May peace be upon you and the Mercy of Allah)." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) responded to his greeting and the man sat down. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Twenty." A third one came and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (May peace be upon you and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings)." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) responded to his greeting and the man sat down. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Thirty.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 172: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "This is Jibril (Gabriel) who is conveyin
arabic:
وعن عائشة رضي الله عنه قالت: قال لي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: “هذا جبريل يقرأ عليك السلام" قالت: قلت: "وعليه السلام ورحمة الله وبركاته" ((متفق عليه))
وهكذا وقع في بعض روايات الصحيحين: "وبركاته" وفي بعضها بحذفها وزيادة الثقة مقبولة
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to me, "This is Jibril (Gabriel) who is conveying you greetings of peace." I responded: "Wa 'Alaihis-Salamu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (May peace be upon him and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings)."."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "This is Jibril (Gabriel) who is conveying you greetings of peace." I responded: "Wa 'Alaihis-Salamu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (May peace be upon him and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 173: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported the Prophet (ﷺ) used to repeat his
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، كان إذا تكلم بكلمة أعادها ثلاثًا حتى تفهم عنه، وإذا أتى على قوم فسلم عليهم سلم عليهم ثلاثًا. ((رواه البخاري))
وهذا محمول على ما إذا كان الجمع كثيرًا.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Masahaba (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: "Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to repeat his words thrice so that the meaning thereof would be fully understood, and whenever he came upon a gathering of people, he would greet them. He would repeat Salam thrice.."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 174: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: We used to reserve for the Prophet (ﷺ) his share of the milk, and he would come
arabic: وعن المقداد رضي الله عنه في حديثه الطويل قال: كنا نرفع للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نصيبه من اللبن، فيجيء من الليل، فيسلم تسليمًا لا يوقظ نائمًا، ويسمع اليقظان، فجاء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فسلم كما كان يُسلم. ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Al-Miqdad (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported in a long Hadith: "We used to reserve for Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) his share of the milk, and he would come at night and offer greetings in such a manner as did not disturb those asleep and was heard only by those who were awake. In fact, Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) came and offered greetings as usual.."
english: Al-Miqdad (May Allah be pleased with him) reported in a long Hadith: We used to reserve for the Prophet (ﷺ) his share of the milk, and he would come at night and offer greetings in such a manner as did not disturb those asleep and was heard only by those who were awake. In fact, the Prophet (ﷺ) came and offered greetings as usual..

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed through the mosque one day and there was a gro

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 176: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Those who are nearest to Allah are they who are first to g
arabic:
وعن أبي أمامة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
"إن أولى الناس بالله من بدأهم بالسلام" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد جيد، ورواه الترمذي بنحوه وقال: حديث حسن، وقد ذكر بعده)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Narrated Abu Umamah: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: Those who are nearest to Allah are they who are first to give a salutation. And At- Tirmidhi narrated its meaning and classified it as Hasan."
english:
Narrated Abu Umamah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Those who are nearest to Allah are they who are first to give a salutation.

 And At- Tirmidhi narrated its meaning and classified it as Hasan.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 177: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: "Alaikas-Salamu ya Rasulallah
arabic:
وعن أبي جري الهجيمي رضي الله عنه قال: أتيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقلت: عليك السلام يا رسول الله قال: 
"لا تقل عليك السلام؛ فإن عليك السلام تحية الموتى". 
((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح. وقد سبق بطوله)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Juraiy Al-Hujaimi (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I saw the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and said: "Alaikas-Salamu ya Rasulallah! (Upon you be peace, Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah)!" He said, "Do not say: 'Alaikas-Salamu (Upon you be peace).' This is the Salam to the dead."."
english: Abu Juraiy Al-Hujaimi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: "Alaikas-Salamu ya Rasulallah! (Upon you be peace, O Messenger of Allah)!" He said, "Do not say: 'Alaikas-Salamu (Upon you be peace).' This is the Salam to the dead.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 178: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'A rider should greet a pedestrian; a pedestria
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "يسلم الراكب على الماشي، والماشي على القاعد، والقليل على الكثير” ((متفق عليه))  
وفي رواية للبخاري: "والصغير على الكبير"
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, 'A rider should greet a pedestrian; a pedestrian should greet one who is sitting; and a small group should greet a large group (of people).'' . The narration in Al-Bukhari adds: The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The young should greet the elderly.''"
english:

.

The narration in Al-Bukhari adds: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The young should greet the elderly.''

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 179: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The person nearest to Allah is one who is the
arabic:
وعن أبي أمامة صُدي بن عجلان الباهلي رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: “إن أولى الناس بالله من بدأهم بالسلام" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد جيد)). 
ورواه الترمذي عن أبي أمامة رضي الله عنه: قيل: يا رسول الله، الرجلان يلتقيان، أيهما يبدأ بالسلام؟ قال: "أولاهما بالله تعالى" قال الترمذي : حديث حسن.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Umamah Sudaiy bin `Ajlan Al-Bahili (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The person nearest to Allah is one who is the first to offer greeting." . The narration in At-Tirmidhi is: The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) was asked: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! When two persons meet, who should greet the other first?'' The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The person nearest to Allah (i.e., one who is more obedient and therefore closer to Allah will say: As-Salam first).""
english:
Abu Umamah Sudaiy bin `Ajlan Al-Bahili (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The person nearest to Allah is one who is the first to offer greeting."

.

The narration in At-Tirmidhi is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: "O Messenger of Allah! When two persons meet, who should greet the other first?'' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The person nearest to Allah (i.e., one who is more obedient and therefore closer to Allah will say: As-Salam first)."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 180: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: He came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and greeted him
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه في حديث المسيء صلاته أنه جاء فصلى، ثم جاء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، فسلم عليه، فرد عليه السلام، فقال: 
"ارجع فصلِ، فإنك لم تصلِ" فرجع فصلى، ثم جاء فسلم على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، حتى فعل ذلك ثلاث مرات” ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake)reported in the Hadith concerning the person who was at fault in performing his Salat (prayer): "He came to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and greeted him. Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) responded to the greeting and said, "Go back and repeat your Salat because you have not performed the Salat (properly).'' He again performed Salat as he had prayed before and came to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and greeted him. Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) responded to the greetings (and repeated his words to him). This act of repeating (the Salat and the Salam) was done thrice. ."
english:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported in the Hadith concerning the person who was at fault in performing his Salat (prayer): He came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and greeted him. The Prophet (ﷺ) responded to the greeting and said, "Go back and repeat your Salat because you have not performed the Salat (properly).'' He again performed Salat as he had prayed before and came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and greeted him. The Prophet (ﷺ) responded to the greetings (and repeated his words to him). This act of repeating (the Salat and the Salam) was done thrice.

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 181: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you meets a brother (in Faith) he
arabic:
وعنه عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، قال: 
"إذا لقي أحدكم أخاه، فليسلم عليه، فإن حالت بينهما شجرة، أو جدار، أو حجر، ثم لقيه، فليسلم عليه" ((رواه أبو داود)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When one of you meets a brother (in Faith) he should greet him. Then if a tree or a wall or a stone intervenes between them and then he meets him again, he should greet him."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you meets a brother (in Faith) he should greet him. Then if a tree or a wall or a stone intervenes between them and then he meets him again, he should greet him.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 182: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "Dear son, when you enter your house, say
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال لي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"يا بُني، إذا دخلت على أهلك، فسلم، يكن بركة عليك، وعلى أهل بيتك" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to me, "Dear son, when you enter your house, say As- Salamu 'Alaikum to your family, for it will be a blessing both to you and to your family."."
english: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "Dear son, when you enter your house, say As- Salamu 'Alaikum to your family, for it will be a blessing both to you and to your family.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 183: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: "Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do the same
arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه أنه مر على صبيان، فسلم عليهم، وقال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يفعله” ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported that he passed by some children and greeted them. Then he said: ""Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to do the same." ."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 184: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: There was a woman (in another narration; an old woman) among us who would put be
arabic: عن سهل بن سعد رضي الله عنه قال: كانت فينا امرأة -وفي رواية: كانت لنا عجوز- تأخذ من أصول السلق فتطرحه في القدر، وتكركر حبات من شعير، فإذا صلينا الجمعة، وانصرفنا، نُسلم عليها، فتقدمه إلينا" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sahl bin Sa`d (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "There was a woman (in another narration; an old woman) among us who would put beet root in a pot and add to it some ground barley. She used to cook them together. On returning from the Friday swala, we would greet her and she would offer it to us. ."
english:

She used to cook them together. On returning from the Friday prayer, we would greet her and she would offer it to us.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 185: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of the conquest of Makkah
arabic: وعن أم هانئ فاختة بنت أبي طالب رضي الله عنه قالت: أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يوم الفتح وهو يغتسل، وفاطمة تستره بثوب، فسلمت، وذكرت الحديث” ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Hani (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake), the daughter of Abu Talib reported: "I went to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) on the day of the conquest of Makkah. He was taking a bath and Fatimah was screening him with a cloth. I greeted him. And she mentioned the rest of the Hadith. ."
english:
Umm Hani (May Allah be pleased with her), the daughter of Abu Talib reported: I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of the conquest of Makkah. He was taking a bath and Fatimah was screening him with a cloth. I greeted him. And she mentioned the rest of the Hadith.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 186: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by us when we were with a party of women, and he greeted
arabic:
وعن أسماء بنت يزيد رضي الله عنه قالت: مر علينا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في نسوة فسلم علينا. 
((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن، وهذا لفظ أبي داود))
ولفظ الترمذي: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مر في المسجد يومًا، وعصبة من النساء قعود، فألوى بيده بالتسليم.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Asma bint Yazid (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) passed by us when we were with a party of women, and he greeted us with salam.. This is the wording of Abu Dawud. In At-Tirmidhi: that the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) passed through the Masjid one day, and a group of women were sitting, so he motioned his hand with the salam."
english:
Asma bint Yazid (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by us when we were with a party of women, and he greeted us with salam.. This is the wording of Abu Dawud.

In  At-Tirmidhi: that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed through the Masjid one day, and a group of women were sitting, so he motioned his hand with the salam.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 187: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not greet the Jews and the Christians befor
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" لا تبدءوا اليهود ولا النصارى بالسلام، فإذا لقيتم أحدهم في طريق فاضطروه إلى أضيقه" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Do not greet the Jews and the Christians before they greet you; and when you meet any one of them on the road, force him to go to the narrowest part of it." ."
english:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not greet the Jews and the Christians before they greet you; and when you meet any one of them on the road, force him to go to the narrowest part of it."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 188: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When the people of the Book greet you, respond wit
arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إذا سلم عليكم أهل الكتاب فقولوا: وعليكم” ((متفق عليه))

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 189: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a mixed company of people which included Muslims, poly
arabic: وعن أسامة رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مر على مجلس فيه أخلاط من المسلمين والمشركين -عبدة الأوثان واليهود- فسلم عليهم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Usamah bin Zaid (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) passed by a mixed company of people which included Waislamu, polytheists and Jews, and he gave them the greeting (i.e., saying As- Salamu 'Alaikum).."

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you arrives in a gathering, he sho
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إذا انتهى أحدكم إلى المجلس فليسلم، فإذا أراد أن يقوم فليسلم، فليست الأولى بأحق من الآخرة" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن")).

The first act of greeting is not more meritorious than the last.'' ."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 191: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Permission is to be sought thrice
arabic: وعن أبي موسي الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : “ الاستئذان ثلاث، فإن أذن لك وإلا فارجع" ((متفق عليه))

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 192: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Seeking permission to enter (somebody's house)
arabic:
وعن سهل بن سعد قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  : 
"إنما جعل الاستئذان من أجل البصر" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sahl bin Sa'd (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Seeking permission to enter (somebody's house) has been prescribed in order to restrain the eyes (from looking at something we are not supposed to look at)."."
english: Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Seeking permission to enter (somebody's house) has been prescribed in order to restrain the eyes (from looking at something we are not supposed to look at).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 193: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: A man of Banu 'Amir tribe has told us that he had asked the Prophet (ﷺ) for perm
arabic: وعن ربعي بن حراش قال: حدثنا رجل من بني عامر استأذن علي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  وهو في بيت، فقال: أألج؟ فقال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  لخادمه: "أخرج إلي هذا وعلمه الاستئذان، فقل له: قل: السلام عليكم، أأدخل؟” فسمعه الرجل فقال: السلام عليكم، أأدخل؟ فأذن له النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فدخل. ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Rib'i bin Hirash (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A man of Banu 'Amir tribe has told us that he had asked Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) for permission to enter when he was at home. He said: "May I enter?" the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to the servant, "Go out and instruct him about the manner of seeking permission. Tell him to say: As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may peace be upon you). May I come in?" The man heard this and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may peace be upon you). May I come in?" Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) then granted him permission and he entered.."
english: Rib'i bin Hirash (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A man of Banu 'Amir tribe has told us that he had asked the Prophet (ﷺ) for permission to enter when he was at home. He said: "May I enter?" the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to the servant, "Go out and instruct him about the manner of seeking permission. Tell him to say: As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may peace be upon you). May I come in?" The man heard this and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may peace be upon you). May I come in?" The Prophet (ﷺ) then granted him permission and he entered..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 194: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: I visited the Prophet (ﷺ) and I entered his house without seeking permission
arabic:
عن كلدة بن الحنبل رضي الله عنه قال: أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فدخلت عليه ولم أسلم، فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"ارجع فقل السلام عليكم أأدخل؟" 
((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Kildah bin Al-Hanbal (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I visited Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and I entered his house without seeking permission. So he said, "Go back and say: 'As-Salamu 'alaikum (may peace be upon you). May I come in?"'."
english: Kildah bin Al-Hanbal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I visited the Prophet (ﷺ) and I entered his house without seeking permission. So he said, "Go back and say: 'As-Salamu 'alaikum (may peace be upon you). May I come in?"'.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 195: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: `Who is there
arabic:
عن أنس رضي الله عنه في حديثه المشهور في الإسراء قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : 
"ثم صعد بي جبريل إلي السماء الدنيا فاستفتح، فقيل: من هذا؟ قال: جبريل، قيل:ومن معك؟ قال: محمد. ثم صعد إلي السماء الثانية والثالثة والرابعة وسائرهن، ويقال في باب كل سماء: من هذا؟ فيقول: جبريل" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported in the course of his famous Hadith pertaining to Al-Isra' (the Ascension) that Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Then Jibril (Gabriel) ascended along with me to the nearest heaven and requested for the gate to be opened. He was asked: "`Who is there?' He replied: `Jibril.' He was asked: `Who is with you?' He said: `Muhammad.' Then he ascended to the second heaven and requested for the opening of the gate. He was asked: `Who is there?' He said: `Jibril.' He was asked: `Who is with you?' He replied: `Muhammad.' In the same way he ascended to the third, fourth and all the heavens (i.e., until the seventh). At all of the gates he was asked: `Who is there?' He replied: Jibril.''' ."
english:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported in the course of his famous Hadith pertaining to Al-Isra' (the Ascension) that Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Then Jibril (Gabriel) ascended along with me to the nearest heaven and requested for the gate to be opened. He was asked: `Who is there?' He replied: `Jibril.' He was asked: `Who is with you?' He said: `Muhammad.' Then he ascended to the second heaven and requested for the opening of the gate. He was asked: `Who is there?' He said: `Jibril.' He was asked: `Who is with you?' He replied: `Muhammad.' In the same way he ascended to the third, fourth and all the heavens (i.e., until the seventh). At all of the gates he was asked: `Who is there?' He replied: Jibril.'''

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 196: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: I stepped out one night and saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) walking by himself
arabic:
وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه قال: خرجت ليلة من الليالي، فإذا رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يمشي وحده، فجعلت أمشي في ظل القمر، فالتفت فرآني فقال: 
"من هذا؟" فقلت: أبو ذر، ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I stepped out one night and saw the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) walking by himself. I began to walk in the moonlit night. He turned round and saw me and asked, "Who is there?" I replied: "Abu Dharr."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 197: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who was taking a bath while Fatimah was screening him
arabic:
وعن أم هانيء رضي الله عنها قالت: أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  وهو يغتسل وفاطمة تستره فقال 
" من هذه؟" فقلت: أنا أم هانيء. ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Hani (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I went to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) who was taking a bath while Fatimah was screening him. He asked, "Who is there?" I replied: "I am Umm Hani."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 198: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and knocked at the door (to seek permission)
arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  فدققت الباب، فقال "من ذا؟" فقلت: أنا، فقال: "أنا أنا؟!" كـأنه كرهها ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I went to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and knocked at the door (to seek permission). He asked, "Who is there?" I said: "I". He repeated, " I, I?!" as if he disliked it.."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and knocked at the door (to seek permission). He asked, "Who is there?" I said: "I". He repeated, " I, I?!" as if he disliked it..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 199: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah likes sneezing and dislikes yawning
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"إن الله يحب العطاس، ويكره التثاؤب، فإذا عطس أحدكم وحمد الله تعالي كان حقاً علي كل مسلم سمعه أن يقول له:يرحمك الله، وأما التثاؤب فإنما هو من الشيطان، فإذا تثاءب أحدكم فليرده ما استطاع، فإن أحدكم إذا تثاءب ضحك منه الشيطان" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Allah likes sneezing and dislikes yawning. When any one of you sneezes and says `Al-hamdu lillah (praise be to Allah)', it becomes obligatory upon every Muislamu who hears him to respond with `Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you)'. Yawning is from the devil. When one of you feels like yawning, he should restrain it as much as possible, for the devil laughs when one of you yawns." ."
english:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah likes sneezing and dislikes yawning. When any one of you sneezes and says `Al-hamdu lillah (praise be to Allah)', it becomes obligatory upon every Muslim who hears him to respond with `Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you)'. Yawning is from the devil. When one of you feels like yawning, he should restrain it as much as possible, for the devil laughs when one of you yawns."

.

title: When two men sneezed in the presence of the Prophet (ﷺ), he responded to one wit
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: عطس رجلان عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فشمت أحدهما ولم يشمت الآخر، فقال الذي لم يشمته: عطس فلان فشمته، وعطست فلم تشمتني؟ فقال: 
"هذا حمد الله، وإنك لم تحمد الله" ((متفق عليه))

The latter said to him: "You invoked a blessing on this man but did not do so in my case." Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied, "He praised Allah (i.e., he said 'Al-hamdu lillah') but you did not."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 204: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 209: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: A man asked: "O Messenger of Allah
arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رجل: يا رسول الله، الرجل منا يلقي أخاه أو صديقه، أينحني له قال: "لا" قال: أفيلتزمه ويقبله؟فال: "لا" قال: فيأخذ بيده ويصافحه؟ قال:"نعم" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A man asked: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! When a man meets a brother or a friend, should he bow to him?" He said, "No." The man asked whether he should embrace and kiss him? The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied, "No." He asked whether he should hold his hand and shake it? The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied, "Yes."."

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Yes.".

title: A Jew asked his companion to take him to the Prophet (ﷺ); and when they came to
arabic: وعن صفوان بن عسال رضي الله عنه قال: قال يهودي لصاحبه: اذهب بنا إلي هذا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فأتيا رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، فسألاه عن تسع آيات بينات؛ فذكر الحديث إلي قوله: فقبلا يده ورجله، وقالا: نشهد أنك نبي. ((رواه الترمذي وغيره بأسانيد صحيحة)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Safwan bin 'Assal (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A Jew asked his companion to take him to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake); and when they came to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), they asked him about the nine clear signs (given to Prophet Musa). title: Zaid bin Harithah came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he was in my house
arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قدم زيد بن حارثة المدينة ورسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  في بيتي، فأتاه فقرع الباب، فقام إليه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  يجر ثوبه، فاعتنقه وقبله" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Zaid bin Harithah came to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) when he was in my house. Zaid knocked at the door. Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) rose to receive him, trailing his garment. He embraced and kissed him.."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: Zaid bin Harithah came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he was in my house. Zaid knocked at the door. The Prophet (ﷺ) rose to receive him, trailing his garment. He embraced and kissed him..

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "Do not belittle any good deed, even your
arabic:
وعن أبي ذر، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال لي رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : 
"لا تحقرن من المعروف شيئاً، ولو أن تلقي أخاك بوجه طلق" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to me, "Do not belittle any good deed, even your meeting with your brother (Muislamu) with a cheerful face."."
english: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "Do not belittle any good deed, even your meeting with your brother (Muslim) with a cheerful face.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 214: Kitabu cha Kusalimiana na Heshima

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) kissed his grandson Hasan bin 'Ali in the presence of Aqra' bin
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قبل النبي،صلى الله عليه وسلم الحسن بن على، رضي الله عنهما، فقال الأقرع بن حابس: إن لي عشرة من الولد ما قبلت منهم أحداً. فقال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : 
"من لا يرحم لا يرحم!" ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) kissed his grandson Hasan bin 'Ali in the presence of Aqra' bin Habis. Thereupon Aqra' remarked: "I have ten children and I have never kissed any one of them." The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) cast a glance upon him and said, "He who does not show mercy to others, will not be shown mercy."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) kissed his grandson Hasan bin 'Ali in the presence of Aqra' bin Habis. Thereupon Aqra' remarked: "I have ten children and I have never kissed any one of them." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cast a glance upon him and said, "He who does not show mercy to others, will not be shown mercy.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 215 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has ordered us to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (
arabic: عن البراء بن عازب رضي الله عنهما قال: أمرنا رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  بعيادة المريض، واتباع الجنازة، وتشميت العاطس، وإبرار المقسم، ونصر المظلوم، وإجابة الداعى، وإفشاء السلام” ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Al-Bara' bin `Azib (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) has ordered us to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (of a dead muumini), respond to the sneezer (i.e., by saying to him: Yarhamuk-Allah after he says: Al-hamdu lillah), to help those who vow to fulfill it, to help the oppressed, to accept the invitation extended by the inviter; and to promote greetings (i.e., saying As-Salamu `Alaikum). ."
english:
Al-Bara' bin `Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has ordered us to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (of a dead believer), respond to the sneezer (i.e., by saying to him: Yarhamuk-Allah after he says: Al-hamdu lillah), to help those who vow to fulfill it, to help the oppressed, to accept the invitation extended by the inviter; and to promote greetings (i.e., saying As-Salamu `Alaikum).

.

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Every Muslim has five rights over another Musl
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال: "حق المسلم علي المسلم خمس: رد السلام، وعيادة المريض، واتباع الجنائز، وإجابة الدعوة، وتشميت العاطس” ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Every Muislamu has five rights over another Muislamu (i.e., he has to perform five duties for another Muislamu): to return the greetings, to visit the sick, to accompany funeral processions, to accept an invitation, to respond to the sneezer ."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Every Muslim has five rights over another Muslim (i.e., he has to perform five duties for another Muslim): to return the greetings, to visit the sick, to accompany funeral processions, to accept an invitation, to respond to the sneezer .

chapter.title_ar: باب 217 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, Allah, the Exalted, and Glorious will
arabic: وعنه قالك قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : "عن الله عزو جل يقول يوم القيامة: "يا ابن آدم مرضت فلم تعدني! قال: يا رب كيف أعودك وأنت رب العالمين؟! قال: أما علمت أن عبدي فلاناً مرض فلم تعده؟ أما علمت أنك لو عدته لوجدتني عنده؟ يا ابن آدم استطعمتك فلم تطعمني! قال: يا رب كيف أطعمك وأنت رب العالمين؟! قال: أما علمت أنه استطعمك عبدي فلان فلم تطعمه، أما علمت أنك لو أطعمته لوجدت ذلك عندي؟ يا ابن آدم استسقيتك فلم تسقني! قال: يارب كيف أسقيك وأنت رب العالمين؟! قال: استسقاك عبدي فلان فلم تسقه! أما علمت أنك لو سقيته لوجدت ذلك عندي؟" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Verily, Allah, the Exalted, and Glorious will say on the Siku ya Qiyama: 'O son of Adam, I was ill but you did not visit Me.' He would say: 'O my Rubb, how could I visit you and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' Thereupon He would say: 'Did you not know that such and such a slave of Mine was ill but you did not visit him? Did you not realize that if you had visited him (you would have known that I was aware of your visit to him, for which I would reward you) you would have found Me with him? O son of Adam, I asked food from you but you did not feed Me.' He would submit: 'My Rubb, how could I feed You and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' He would say: 'Did you not know that such and such a slave of Mine asked you for food but you did not feed him? Did you not realize that if you had fed him, you would certainly have found (its reward) with Me? O son of Adam, I asked water from you but you did not give it to Me.' He would say: 'My Rubb, how could I give You (water) and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' Thereupon He would say: 'Such and such a slave of Mine asked you for water to drink but you did not give it to him. Did you not realize that if you had given him to drink you would have found (its reward) with Me?"'."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, Allah, the Exalted, and Glorious will say on the Day of Resurrection: 'O son of Adam, I was ill but you did not visit Me.' He would say: 'O my Rubb, how could I visit you and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' Thereupon He would say: 'Did you not know that such and such a slave of Mine was ill but you did not visit him? Did you not realize that if you had visited him (you would have known that I was aware of your visit to him, for which I would reward you) you would have found Me with him? O son of Adam, I asked food from you but you did not feed Me.' He would submit: 'My Rubb, how could I feed You and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' He would say: 'Did you not know that such and such a slave of Mine asked you for food but you did not feed him? Did you not realize that if you had fed him, you would certainly have found (its reward) with Me? O son of Adam, I asked water from you but you did not give it to Me.' He would say: 'My Rubb, how could I give You (water) and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' Thereupon He would say: 'Such and such a slave of Mine asked you for water to drink but you did not give it to him. Did you not realize that if you had given him to drink you would have found (its reward) with Me?"'.

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who visits his brother in Faith, will remain engaged i
arabic: وعن ثوبان، رضي الله عنه، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم ، قال: "إن المسلم إذا عاد أخاه المسلم لم يزل في خرفة الجنة حتي يرجع" قيل: يا رسول الله وما خرفة الجنة؟ قال: "جناها” ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Thauban (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who visits his brother in Faith, will remain engaged in picking the fresh fruits from the garden of Jannah till he returns."."

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "When a Muslim visits a sick Muslim a
arabic: وعن علي رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يقول: "ما من مسلم يعود مسلماً غدوة إلا صلى  عليه سبعون ألف ملك حتي يمسي، وإن عاده عشية إلا صلى  عليه سبعون ألف ملك حتي يصبح، وكان له خريف في الجنة” ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Ali bin Abu Talib (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "When a Muislamu visits a sick Muislamu at dawn, seventy thousand angels keep on praying for him till dusk. If he visits him in the evening, seventy thousand angels keep on praying for him till the morning; and he will have (his share of) reaped fruits in Jannah."."
english: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "When a Muslim visits a sick Muslim at dawn, seventy thousand angels keep on praying for him till dusk. If he visits him in the evening, seventy thousand angels keep on praying for him till the morning; and he will have (his share of) reaped fruits in Jannah.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 221: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 221 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: A young Jewish boy who was in the service of the Prophet (ﷺ) fell ill
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: كان غلام يهودي يخدم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  فمرض فأتاه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  يعوده، فقعد عند رأسه فقال له: 
"أسلم" فنظر إلي أبيه وهو عنده؟ فقال: أطع أبا القاسم، فأسلم، فخرج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  وهو يقول: “الحمد لله الذي أنقذه من النار” ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A young Jewish boy who was in the service of Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) fell ill. Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) went to visit him. He sat down by his head and said to him, "Embrace Islam." The little boy looked at his father who was sitting beside him. He said: "Obey Abul-Qasim (i.e., the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake))." So he embraced Islam and Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) stepped out saying, "Praise be to Allah Who has saved him from Motoni." ."
english:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A young Jewish boy who was in the service of the Prophet (ﷺ) fell ill. The Prophet (ﷺ) went to visit him. He sat down by his head and said to him, "Embrace Islam." The little boy looked at his father who was sitting beside him. He said: "Obey Abul-Qasim (i.e., the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ))." So he embraced Islam and the Prophet (ﷺ) stepped out saying, "Praise be to Allah Who has saved
him from Hell-fire."

.

title: When a person complained to the Prophet (ﷺ) about an ailment or suffered from a
arabic:
عن عائشة رضي الله عنها، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  كان إذا اشتكي الأنسان الشيء منه، أو كانت به قرحة أو جرح، قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  بأصبعه هكذا، ووضع سفيان بن عيينه الراوي سبابته بالأرض ثم رفعها وقال: 
"بسم الله، تربة أرضنا، بريقة بعضنا، يشفي سقيمنا، بإذن ربنا" ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa `Aishah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "When a person complained to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) about an ailment or suffered from a sore or a wound, Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) would touch the ground with his forefinger and then raise it (Sufyan bin `Uyainah, the narrator, demonstrated this with his forefinger) and would recite: `Bismil-lahi, turbatu ardina, biriqati ba`dina, yushfa bihi saqimuni, bi 'idhni Rabbina' (With the Name of Allah, the dust of our ground mixed with the saliva of some of us would cure our patient with the permission of our Rubb.'' ."
english:
`Aishah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: When a person complained to the Prophet (ﷺ) about an ailment or suffered from a sore or a wound, the Prophet (ﷺ) would touch the ground with his forefinger and then raise it (Sufyan bin `Uyainah, the narrator, demonstrated this with his forefinger) and would recite: `Bismil-lahi, turbatu ardina, biriqati ba`dina, yushfa bihi saqimuni, bi 'idhni Rabbina' (With the Name of Allah, the dust of our ground mixed with the saliva of some of us would cure our patient with the permission of our Rubb.''

.

title: I said to Thabit (May Allah had Mercy upon him) Should I not perform Ruqyah (i
arabic: وعن أنس، رضي الله عنه أنه قال لثابت رحمه الله: ألا أرقيك برقية رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم ؟ قال: بلى، قال: اللهم رب الناس، مذهب البأس، اشف أنت الشافي، لا شافي إلا أنت، شفاءً لا يغادر سقماً” ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I said to Thabit (May Allah had Mercy upon him) Should I not perform Ruqyah (i.e., recite dua or Quranic Ayat and blow) over you, such dua as was practised by the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake)?" He said: "Please do so." Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) supplicated: "Allahumma Rabban-nasi, mudh-hibal-ba'si, ishfi Antash-Shafi, la shafiya illa Anta, shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman ."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I said to Thabit (May Allah had Mercy upon him) Should I not perform Ruqyah (i.e., recite supplication or Quranic Ayat and blow) over you, such supplication as was practised by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?" He said: "Please do so." Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) supplicated: "Allahumma Rabban-nasi, mudh-hibal-ba'si, ishfi Antash-Shafi, la shafiya illa Anta, shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman .

title: I complained to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a pain I had in my body
arabic: وعن أبي عبد الله عثمان بن أبي العاص رضي الله عنه أنه شكي إلي رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  وجعاً يجده في جسده فقال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  "ضع يدك علي الذي تألم من جسدك وقل: بسم الله -ثلاثاً- وقل سبع مرات: أعوذ بعزة الله وقدرته من شر ما أجد وأحاذر” ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu 'Abdullah bin Abul-'as (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I complained to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) about a pain I had in my body. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Place your hand where you feel pain and say: 'Bismillah (With the Name of Allah)' three times; and then repeat seven times: 'A'udhu bi'izzatillahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa 'uhadhiru (I seek refuge with Allah and with His Power from the evil that afflicts me and that which I apprehend)."'."
english: Abu 'Abdullah bin Abul-'as (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I complained to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a pain I had in my body. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Place your hand where you feel pain and say: 'Bismillah (With the Name of Allah)' three times; and then repeat seven times: 'A'udhu bi'izzatillahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa 'uhadhiru (I seek refuge with Allah and with His Power from the evil that afflicts me and that which I apprehend)."'.

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who visits a sick person who is not on the point of de
arabic:
وعن ابن عباس، رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي،صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، قال: 
"من عاد مريضاً لم يحضره أجله، فقال عنده سبع مرات: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيك: إلا عافاه الله من ذلك المرض" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن، وقال الحاكم: حديث صحيح علي شرط البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who visits a sick person who is not on the point of death and supplicates seven times: As'alullahal-'Azima Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azimi, an yashfiyaka (I beseech Allah the Great, the Rubb of the Great Throne, to heal you), Allah will certainly heal him from that sickness."."
english: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who visits a sick person who is not on the point of death and supplicates seven times: As'alullahal-'Azima Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azimi, an yashfiyaka (I beseech Allah the Great, the Rubb of the Great Throne, to heal you), Allah will certainly heal him from that sickness.".

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) visited a bedouin who was sick
arabic:
وعنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، دخل علي أعرأبي يعوده وكان إذا دخل علي من يعوده قال: 
"لا بأس، طهور إن شاء الله" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) visited a bedouin who was sick. Whenever he visited an ailing person, he would say, "La ba'sa, tahurun in sha' Allah ."
english: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) visited a bedouin who was sick. Whenever he visited an ailing person, he would say, "La ba'sa, tahurun in sha' Allah .

title: Jibril (Gabriel) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Muhammad (ﷺ)
arabic:
وعن أبيسعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه أن جبريل أتي النبي،صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، فقال: يا محمد اشتكيت؟ قال: 
"نعم" قال: بسم الله أرقيك ، من كل شيء يؤذيك، ومن شر كل نفس أو عين حاسد، الله يشفيك، بسم الله أرقيك” ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Jibril (Gabriel) came to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and said: "O Muhammad (ﷺ)! Do you feel sick?" He (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Jibril supplicated thus (i.e., he performed Ruqyah): "Bismillahi arqika, min kulli shay'in yu'dhika, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni hasidi, Allahu yashfika, bismillahi arqika. ."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Jibril (Gabriel) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Muhammad (ﷺ)! Do you feel sick?" He (ﷺ) said, "Yes." Jibril supplicated thus (i.e., he performed Ruqyah): "Bismillahi arqika, min kulli shay'in yu'dhika, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni hasidi, Allahu yashfika, bismillahi arqika. .

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If a person says: 'La ilaha illallahu wallahu
arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري وأبي هريرة، رضي الله عنهما، أنهما شهدا علي رسول الله ، صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، أنه قال: "من قال: لا إله إلا الله والله اكبر، صدقه ربه، فقال: لا إله إلا أنا وأنا أكبر. وإذا قال: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، قال: يقول: لا إله إلا أنا وحدي لا شريك لي. وإذا قال: لا إله إلا الله له الملك وله الحمد، قال: لا إله إلا أنا لي الملك ولي الحمد. وإذا قال: لا إله إلا الله ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله، قال: لا إله إلا أنا ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بي" وكان يقول: "من قالها في مرضه ثم مات لم تطعمه النار" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If a person says: 'La ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar (There is no true god except Allah and Allah is Greatest)', his Rubb responds to him and affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, and I am the Greatest.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu Wahdahu la sharika Lahu (There is no true god except Allah, the One, He has no partner).' Allah (SWT) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I. I have no partner.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu Lahul mulku wa Lahul-hamdu (the sovereignty belongs to Him and all the praise is due to Him).' He (SWT) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, Mine is the praise and to Me belongs the sovereignty.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Billah (There is no true god except Allah, and there is no might and power but with Allah).' He (SWT) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, and there is no might and power but with Me."' The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) added, "He who recites this during his illness and dies, will not be touched by the Fire (Motoni)."."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If a person says: 'La ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar (There is no true god except Allah and Allah is Greatest)', his Rubb responds to him and affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, and I am the Greatest.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu Wahdahu la sharika Lahu (There is no true god except Allah, the One, He has no partner).' Allah (SWT) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I. I have no partner.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu Lahul mulku wa Lahul-hamdu (the sovereignty belongs to Him and all the praise is due to Him).' He (SWT) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, Mine is the praise and to Me belongs the sovereignty.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Billah (There is no true god except Allah, and there is no might and power but with Allah).' He (SWT) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, and there is no might and power but with Me."' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) added, "He who recites this during his illness and dies, will not be touched by the Fire (Hell).".

title: When `Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) came out after visiting the Messenger
arabic: عن ابن عباس، رضي الله عنهما، أن علي بن أبي طالب، رضي الله عنه خرج من عند رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، في وجعه الذي توفي فيه فقال الناس: يا أبا الحسن كيف أصبح رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم ؟ قال: أصبح بحمد الله بارئاً" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn `Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "When `Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) came out after visiting the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) during his last illness, the people asked: "How is Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), O Abul-Hasan?'' He replied: "Praise be to Allah, he (ﷺ) is feeling better.'' ."
english:
Ibn `Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: When `Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) came out after visiting the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during his last illness, the people asked: "How is Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), O Abul-Hasan?'' He replied: "Praise be to Allah, he (ﷺ) is feeling better.''

title: While the Prophet (ﷺ) was reclining against me (during his last illness) I heard
arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: سمعت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  وهو مستند إلي يقول: اللهم اغفر لي وارحمني وألحقني بالرفيق الأعلى" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa `Aishah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "While Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) was reclining against me (during his last illness) I heard him saying: "Allahumma-ghfir li, warhamni, wa alhiqni bir Rafiqil-A`la (O Allah, forgive me, bestow Your Mercy on me and let me join with the exalted companions.'' ."
english:
`Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: While the Prophet (ﷺ) was reclining against me (during his last illness) I heard him saying: "Allahumma-ghfir li, warhamni, wa alhiqni bir Rafiqil-A`la (O Allah, forgive me, bestow Your Mercy on me and let me join with the exalted companions.''

chapter.title_ar: باب 233 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he was at the point of death
arabic:
وعنها قالت: رأيت رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  وهو بالموت عنده قدح فيه ماء وهو يدخل يده في القدح، ثم يمسح وجهه بالماء، ثم يقول: 
"اللهم أعني علي غمرات الموت وسكرات الموت" ((رواه الترمذي)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I saw the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) when he was at the point of death. He had a drinking bowl with water in it. He would dip his hand into the bowl, and wipe his face. Then he would supplicate, "O Allah! Help me over pangs and agony of death."."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he was at the point of death. He had a drinking bowl with water in it. He would dip his hand into the bowl, and wipe his face. Then he would supplicate, "O Allah! Help me over pangs and agony of death.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 234: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 234 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: A woman belonging to the Juhainah tribe came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after
arabic:
عن عمران بن الحصين رضي الله عنهما أن امراة من جهينة أتت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  وهي حبلي من الزنا، فقالت: يا رسول الله، أصبت حداً فأقمه علي ، فدعا رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  وليها، فقال: 
"أحسن إليها فإذا وضعت فأتني بها” ففعل، فأمر بها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم ، فشدت عليها ثيابها، ثم أمر بها فرجمت، ثم صلى  عليها" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa `Imran bin Husain (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "A woman belonging to the Juhainah tribe came to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) after having conceived from Zina. She submitted: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! I am liable to Hadd (punishment ordained by Allah), so execute it.'' The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) called her guardian and said, "Treat her well and bring her to me after delivery.'' He acted accordingly. Then the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) commanded to tie her clothes firmly around her and then stoned her to death. He (ﷺ) then offered funeral swala for her. ."
english:
`Imran bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: A woman belonging to the Juhainah tribe came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after having conceived from Zina. She submitted: "O Messenger of Allah! I am liable to Hadd (punishment ordained by Allah), so execute it.'' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called her guardian and said, "Treat her well and bring her to me after delivery.'' He acted accordingly. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded to tie her clothes firmly around her and then stoned her to death. He (ﷺ) then offered funeral prayer for her.

.

title: I visited the Prophet ({ﷺ) while he was suffering
arabic:
عن بن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: دخلت علي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  وهو يوعك، فمسسته، فقلت: إنك لتوعك وعكاً شديداً فقال: 
"إني أوعك كما يوعك رجلان منكم" ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Mas`ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I visited the Prophet ({ﷺ) while he was suffering. I said: "(Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah!) You suffer too much.'' He said, "Yes, I suffer as much as two men of you.'' ."
english:
Ibn Mas`ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I visited the Prophet ({ﷺ) while he was suffering. I said: "(O Messenger of Allah!) You suffer too much.'' He said, "Yes, I suffer as much as two men of you.''

.

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to visit me when I had a severe pain
arabic: وعن سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه قال: جاءني رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يعودني من وجع اشتد بي، فقلت: بلغ بي ما ترى، وأنا ذو مال، ولايرثني إلا ابنتي، وذكر الحديث" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) came to visit me when I had a severe pain. I said: "I am suffering from such trouble as you are observing. I am a wealthy man and the only heir of mine is my daughter." (Then Sa'd narrated the whole incident).."
english: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to visit me when I had a severe pain. I said: "I am suffering from such trouble as you are observing. I am a wealthy man and the only heir of mine is my daughter." (Then Sa'd narrated the whole incident)..

title: "Oh, my head
arabic: وعن القاسم بن محمد قال: قالت عائشة رضي الله عنها: وا رأساه فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم : "بل أنا وا رأساه" وذكر الحديث" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Al-Qasim bin Muhammad reported Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: ""Oh, my head." (It was hurting due to pain.) Thereupon Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Rather it is I who says: 'Oh, my headache."' (Then Al-Qasim narrated the complete narration).."
english: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad reported 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: "Oh, my head." (It was hurting due to pain.) Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Rather it is I who says: 'Oh, my headache."' (Then Al-Qasim narrated the complete narration)..

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He whose last words are: `La ilaha illallah' (
arabic:
عن معاذ رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  : 
"من كان آخر كلامه لا إله إلا الله دخل الجنة" ((رواه أبو داود والحاكم وقال: صحيح الإسناد)).

Mu`adh bin Jabal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He whose last words are: `La ilaha illallah' (There is no true god except Allah) will enter Jannah.''

chapter.title_ar: باب 240 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) w
arabic: عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت: دخل رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  علي أبي سلمه وقد شق بصره فأغمضه، ثم قال: "إن الروح إذا قبض، تبعه البصر" فضج ناس من أهله، فقال: "لا تدعو علي أنفسكم إلا بخير فإن الملائكة يؤمنون علي ما تقولون” ثم قال: “اللهم اغفر لأبي سلمه، وارفع درجته في المهديين،واخلفه في عقبه في الغابرين، واغفر لنا وله يا رب العالمين، وافسح له في قبره، ونور له فيه" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Salamah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) visited Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) when his eyes were open soon after he died. He closed them (the eyes) for him and said, "When the soul is taken away, the sight follows it." Some members of his family began to weep. He (ﷺ) said: "Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for the angels say 'amin' to what you say." Then he said, "O Allah! Forgive Abu Salamah, raise his rank among those who are rightly-guided and grant him a successor from his descendants who remain behind. Grant him pardon and us, too. O Rubb of the worlds. Make his grave spacious for him and give him light in it." ."
english:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) when his eyes were open soon after he died. He closed them (the eyes) for him and said, "When the soul is taken away, the sight follows it." Some members of his family began to weep. He (ﷺ) said: "Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for the angels say 'amin' to what you say." Then he said, "O Allah! Forgive Abu Salamah, raise his rank among those who are rightly-guided and grant him a successor from his descendants who remain behind. Grant him pardon and us, too. O Rubb of the worlds. Make his grave spacious for him and give him light in it."

.
