chapter.title_ar: باب 241 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When you visit a sick or a dying person, you s
arabic: -عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : "إذا حضرتم المريض، أو الميت، فقولوا خيرا، فإن الملائكة يؤمنون علي ما تقولون، قالت: فلما مات أبو سلمة، أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  فقلت: يا رسول الله، إن أبا سلمة قد مات، قال: “قولي: اللهم اغفر لي وله، واعقبني منه عقبة حسنة" فقلت: فأعقبني الله من هو خير لي منه: محمداً صلى  الله عليه وسلم ." ((رواه مسلم هكَذا:"إِذا حَضَرْتُمُ المَرِيضَ" أَو"الميِّت"عَلَى الشَّكِّ، رواه أبو داود وغيره:"الميِّت"بلا شَكٍّ)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Salamah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake): "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When you visit a sick or a dying person, you should utter good words because the angels say `Amin' at what you say.'' She added: When Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) died, I came to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and said: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, Abu Salamah has died." He (ﷺ) directed me to supplicate thus: "Allahummaghfir li wa lahu, wa a`qibni minhu `uqba hasanatan ." So I supplicated as he directed, and Allah gave me a man who was better for me than Abu Salamah (i.e., the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)). (Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) married Umm Salamah afterwards.) ."
english:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When you visit a sick or a dying person, you should utter good words because the angels say `Amin' at what you say.'' She added: When Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) died, I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah, Abu Salamah has died." He (ﷺ) directed me to supplicate thus: "Allahummaghfir li wa lahu, wa a`qibni minhu `uqba hasanatan ." So I supplicated as he directed, and Allah gave me a man who was better for me than Abu Salamah (i.e., the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)). (The Prophet (ﷺ) married Umm Salamah afterwards.)

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 242: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 242 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "When a person suffers from a calamit
arabic: وعنها قالت: سمعت رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يقول:"ما من عبد تصيبه مصيبه، فيقول إن لله وإنا إليه راجعون: اللهم آجرني في مصيبتي، واخلف لي خيرا منها، إلا آجره الله تعالي في مصيبته واخلف له خيراً منها. قالت: فلما توفي أبو سلمة، قلت كما أمرني رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  ، فاخلف الله خيراص منه رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم “ ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Salamah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "When a person suffers from a calamity and utters: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un. Allahumma ujurni fi musibati, wakhluf li khairan minha (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. O Allah! Compensate me in my affliction, recompense my loss and give me something better in exchange for it), then Allah surely compensates him with reward and better substitute." Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: When Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) died, I repeated the same dua as the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) had commanded me (to do). So Allah bestowed upon me a better substitute than him (I was married to Muhammad, the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake)).."
english: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "When a person suffers from a calamity and utters: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un. Allahumma ujurni fi musibati, wakhluf li khairan minha (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. O Allah! Compensate me in my affliction, recompense my loss and give me something better in exchange for it), then Allah surely compensates him with reward and better substitute." Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: When Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) died, I repeated the same supplication as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had commanded me (to do). So Allah bestowed upon me a better substitute than him (I was married to Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ))..

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a man's child dies, Allah, the Exalted, a
arabic: وعن أبي موسي رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال: إذا مات ولد العبد، قال الله تعالي لملائكته: قبضتم ولد عبدي، فيقولون: نعم، فيقول: قبضتم ثمرة فؤاده، فيقولون: نعم. فيقول: ماذا قال عبدي، فيقولون: حمدك واسترجع، فيقول الله تعالى: ابنوا لعبدي بيتاً في الجنة، وسموه بيت الحمد" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Musa al-Ash'ari Al-Ash'ari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When a man's child dies, Allah, the Exalted, asks His angels, 'Have you taken out the life of the child of My slave?' and they reply in the affirmative. He (SWT) then asks, 'Have you taken the fruit of his heart?' and they reply in the affirmative. Thereupon He asks, 'What did my slave say?' They say: 'He praised You and said: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return).' Allah says: 'Build a house for my slave in Jannah and name it Baitul-Hamd (the House of Praise)."'."
english: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a man's child dies, Allah, the Exalted, asks His angels, 'Have you taken out the life of the child of My slave?' and they reply in the affirmative. He (SWT) then asks, 'Have you taken the fruit of his heart?' and they reply in the affirmative. Thereupon He asks, 'What did my slave say?' They say: 'He praised You and said: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return).' Allah says: 'Build a house for my slave in Jannah and name it Baitul-Hamd (the House of Praise)."'.

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I have no reward ex
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال: يقول الله تعالى: ما لعبدي المؤمن عندي جزاء إذا قبضت صفيه من أهل الدنيا، ثم احتسبه إلا الجنه" ((رواه البخاري)).

english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I have no reward except Jannah for a believing slave of Mine who shows patience and anticipates My reward when I take away his favourite one from the inhabitants of the world."'.

title: A daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) sent a message to him that her son was at his last
arabic: وعن أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما قال: أرسلت إحدي بنات النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  إليه تدعوه وتخبره أن صبياً لها -أو ابناً- في الموت فقال للرسول: ارجع إليها فأخبرها أن لله تعالي ما أخذ وله ما أعطى، وكل شئ عنده بأجل مسمى، فمرها، فلتصبر ولتحتسب” وذكر تمام الحديث" ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Usamah bin Zaid (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "A daughter of Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) sent a message to him that her son was at his last breath, and requested him to come to her. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) sent back the informer saying: "To Allah belongs what He takes and what He gives, and everything has a limited period (in this world). So ask her to endure patiently, and expect the reward of Allah."."
english: Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: A daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) sent a message to him that her son was at his last breath, and requested him to come to her. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent back the informer saying: "To Allah belongs what He takes and what He gives, and everything has a limited period (in this world). So ask her to endure patiently, and expect the reward of Allah.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 246: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 246 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness
arabic:
عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  عاد سعد بن عباده ومعه عبد الرحمن بن عوف، وسعد بن أبي وقاص، وعبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنهم، فبكي رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، فلما رأي القوم بكاء رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  ، بكوا ؛ فقال: “ألا تسمعون؟ إن الله لا يعذب بدمع العين، ولا بحزن القلب، ولكن بهذا أو يرحم
" وأشار إلا لسانه" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) began to weep. When his Companions saw this, their tears also started flowing. He (ﷺ) said, "Do you not hear, Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but punishes or bestows mercy for the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue)."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to weep. When his Companions saw this, their tears also started flowing. He (ﷺ) said, "Do you not hear, Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but punishes or bestows mercy for the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue).".

title: A grandson (child of the daughter) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was presented t
arabic:
وعن أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  رفع إليه ابن ابنته وهو في الموت، ففاض عينا رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  فقال له سعد: ما هذا يا رسول الله؟! قال:

Tears began to flow from the eyes of the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake). Sa'd said to him: "What is this, Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah?" He (ﷺ) said, "It is mercy which Allah has placed in the hearts of his salves. Allah bestows His Mercy on the merciful among His slaves."."

Allah bestows His Mercy on the merciful among His slaves.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 248: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to his son Ibrahim (May Allah be pleased with hi
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  دخل علي ابنه إبراهيم رضي الله عنه وهو يجود بنفسه فجعلت عينا رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  تذرفان . فقال له عبد الرحمن بن عوف: وأنت يا رسول الله ؟! فقال: “يا ابن عوف إنها رحمة” ثم أتبعها بأخرى، فقال:”إن العين تدمع والقلب يحزن ، ولا نقول إلا ما يرضي ربنا، وإنا بفراقك يا إبراهيم لمحزونون". ((رواه البخاري، وروي مسلم بعضه)). 
والأحاديث في الباب كثيرة في الصحيح مشهورة والله أعلم.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) came to his son Ibrahim (May Allah be pleased with him) when he was breathing his last. The eyes of the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) began shedding tears. 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf (May Allah be pleased with him) said, "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, you too weep?" He (ﷺ) said, "O Ibn 'Auf! It is mercy." Then he began to weep and said, "The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Rubb. O Ibrahim! Indeed we are grieved by your departure."."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to his son Ibrahim (May Allah be pleased with him) when he was breathing his last. The eyes of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began shedding tears. 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf (May Allah be pleased with him) said, "O Messenger of Allah, you too weep?" He (ﷺ) said, "O Ibn 'Auf! It is mercy." Then he began to weep and said, "The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Rubb. O Ibrahim! Indeed we are grieved by your departure.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 249 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who washes a dead body and conceals what he
arabic:
عن أبي رافع أسلم مولي رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
" من غسل ميتاً فكتم عليه ، غفر الله له أربعين مرة" ((رواه الحاكم وقال صحيح علي شرط مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Rafi` Aslam (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake), the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who washes a dead body and conceals what he notices of physical defects, he will be forgiven forty times.'' ."
english:
Abu Rafi` Aslam (May Allah be pleased with him), the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who washes a dead body and conceals what he notices of physical defects, he will be forgiven forty times.''

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 250: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 250 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever follows the funeral procession and off
arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : “من شهد الجنازة حتي يصلى  عليها، فله قيراط ، ومن شهدها حتي تدفن، فله قيراطان" قيل: وما القيراطان؟ قال: “مثل الجبلين العظيمين” ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Whoever follows the funeral procession and offers the funeral swala for it, will get a reward equal to one Qirat, and whoever attends it till burial, will get a reward equal to two Qirat.'' It was asked, "What are two Qirat?'' He (ﷺ) replied, "Equal to two huge mountains." ."
english:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever follows the funeral procession and offers the funeral prayer for it, will get a reward equal to one Qirat, and whoever attends it till burial, will get a reward equal to two Qirat.'' It was asked, "What are two Qirat?'' He (ﷺ) replied, "Equal to two huge mountains."

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 251: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 251 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whosoever attends the funeral of a Muslim beli
arabic: وعنه أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال: "من اتبع جنازة مسلم إيماناً واحتساباً، وكان معه حتي يصلى  عليها ويفرغ من دفنها، فإنه يرجع من الأجر بقيراطين كل قيراط مثل أحدٍ، ومن صلى  عليها، ثم رجع قبل أن تدفن ، فإنه يرجع بقيراط” ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Whosoever attends the funeral of a Muislamu believing and hoping for the reward from Allah and remains with it until the swala is offered over it and the burial is completed, he will return with a reward of two Qirat; each Qirat is equivalent to Mount Uhud; and whosoever offers his swala over it and returns before its burial, he will come back with one Qirat."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whosoever attends the funeral of a Muslim believing and hoping for the reward from Allah and remains with it until the prayer is offered over it and the burial is completed, he will return with a reward of two Qirat; each Qirat is equivalent to Mount Uhud; and whosoever offers his prayer over it and returns before its burial, he will come back with one Qirat.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 252 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: We (womenfolk) were prohibited from accompanying a funeral procession, but we we
arabic:
وعن أم عطية رضي الله عنها قالت: نهينا عن اتباع الجنائز، ولم يعزم علينا" ((متفق عليه)) . 
"ومعناه " ولم يشدد في النهي كما يشدد في المحرمات.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Atiyyah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "We (womenfolk) were iliyokatazwa from accompanying a funeral procession, but we were not compelled (not to do so).."
english: Umm Atiyyah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: We (womenfolk) were prohibited from accompanying a funeral procession, but we were not compelled (not to do so)..

chapter.title_ar: باب 253 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If a group of Muslims numbering a hundred perf
arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها، قالت: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: “ما من ميت يصلي عليه أمة من المسلمين يبلغون مائة كلهم يشفعون له إلا شفعوا فيه“ ((رواه مسلم).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If a group of Waislamu numbering a hundred perform funeral swala over a dead person, and all of them ask Allah's msamaha for him, their swala for him will be accepted." ."
english:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If a group of Muslims numbering a hundred perform funeral prayer over a dead person, and all of them ask Allah's forgiveness for him, their prayer for him will be accepted."

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 254: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 254 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If a Muslim dies and forty people, who do not
arabic:
وعن ابن عباس رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنهُما قال سمعت رَسُول اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّم يقول : 
"ما من رجل مسلم يموت فيقوم على جنازته أربعون رجلاً لا يشركون بالله شيئاً إلا شفعهم اللَّه فيه." ((رَوَاهُ مُسلِمٌ)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If a Muislamu dies and forty people, who do not associate anything with Allah in worship, participate in the funeral swala over him, Allah will accept their intercession for him."."
english: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If a Muslim dies and forty people, who do not associate anything with Allah in worship, participate in the funeral prayer over him, Allah will accept their intercession for him.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 255: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 255 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: When Malik bin Hubairah (May Allah be pleased with him) offered a funeral prayer
arabic: وعن مرثد بن عبد الله اليزني قال: كان مالك بن هبيرة رضي الله عنه إذا صلى  علي الجنازة ، فتقال الناس عليها، جزأهم عليها ثلاثة أجزاء، ثم قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : “من صلى  عليه ثلاثة صفوف، فقد أوجب “ ((رواه أبو دواد، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Marthad bin 'Abdullah Al-Yazni reported: "When Malik bin Hubairah (May Allah be pleased with him) offered a funeral swala and found a small number of participants, he would divide them into three rows and would say that the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If three rows of men offer funeral swala over anyone, his entry into Jannah will become certain."."
english: Marthad bin 'Abdullah Al-Yazni reported: When Malik bin Hubairah (May Allah be pleased with him) offered a funeral prayer and found a small number of participants, he would divide them into three rows and would say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If three rows of men offer funeral prayer over anyone, his entry into Jannah will become certain.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 256: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 256 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered a funeral prayer and I memorized his supplica
arabic: عن أبي عبد الرحمن بن عوف بن مالك رضي الله عنه قال: صلى  رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  علي جنازة، فحفظت من دعائه وهو يقول: "اللهم اغفر له، وارحمه، وعافه، واعف عنه، وأكرم نزله، ووسع مدخله واغسله بالماء والثلج والبرد ونقه من الخطايا، كما نقيت الثوب الأبيض من الدنس، وأبدله داراً خيراً من داره، وأهلاً خيراً من أهله، وزوجاً خيراً من زوجه، وأدخله الجنة، وأعذه من عذاب القبر، ومن عذاب النار” حتي تمنين أن أكون ذلك الميت. ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu 'Abdur-Rahman 'Auf bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) offered a funeral swala and I memorized his dua. He (ﷺ) prayed: "Allahummaghfir lahu, warhamhu, wa 'afihi, wa'fu 'anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi' mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-baradi, wa naqqihi minal-khataya, kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danasi, wa abdilhu daran khairan min darihi, wa ahlan khairan min ahlihi, wa zawjan khairan min zawjihi, wa adkhilhul-Jannata, wa a'idh-hu min 'adhabil- qabri, wa min 'adhabin-nar ."
english: Abu 'Abdur-Rahman 'Auf bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered a funeral prayer and I memorized his supplication. He (ﷺ) prayed: "Allahummaghfir lahu, warhamhu, wa 'afihi, wa'fu 'anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi' mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-baradi, wa naqqihi minal-khataya, kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danasi, wa abdilhu daran khairan min darihi, wa ahlan khairan min ahlihi, wa zawjan khairan min zawjihi, wa adkhilhul-Jannata, wa a'idh-hu min 'adhabil- qabri, wa min 'adhabin-nar .

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 257: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 257 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a funeral prayer and said: "Allahummaghfir lihaiyina wa
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة وأبي قتادة، وأبي إبراهيم الأشهلي عن أبيه -وأبوه صحابي- رضي الله عنهم، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  أنه صلى  علي جنازة فقال:
"اللهم اغفر لحينا وميتنا، وصغيرنا وكبيرنا، وذكرنا وأنثانا، وشاهدنا وغائبنا. اللهم من أحييته منا، فأحيه علي الإسلام، ومن توفيته منا، فتوفه علي الإيمان؛ اللهم لا تحرمنا أجره، ولا تفتنا بعده" ((رواه الترمذي))
 من رواية أبي هريرة وأبو هريرة صحيح والأشهلي، ورواه أبو داود من رواية أبي هريرة وأبي قتادة. قال الحاكم: حديث أبي هريرة صحيح علي شرط البخاري ومسلم، قال الترمذي: قال البخاري: أصح روايات هذا الحديث رواية الأشهلي. قال البخاري: وأصح شيء في الباب حديث عوف بن مالك.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah, Abu Qatadah, and Abu Ibrahim Al-Ash-hali (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) offered a funeral swala and said: "Allahummaghfir lihaiyina wa maiyitina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina. Allahumma man ahyaiytahu minna, fa'ahyihi 'alal-Islam, wa man tawaffaiytahu minna, fatawaffahu 'alal-Iman. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu, wa la taftinna ba'dahu (O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, our present and our absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, whosoever of us You keep alive, keep him alive (faithful) to Islam, and whosoever of us You cause to die, let him die having Iman. O Allah, do not deprive us of our reward (for being patient) and do not subject us to trials after his death." ."
english:
Abu Hurairah, Abu Qatadah, and Abu Ibrahim Al-Ash-hali (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a funeral prayer and said: "Allahummaghfir lihaiyina wa maiyitina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina. Allahumma man ahyaiytahu minna, fa'ahyihi 'alal-Islam, wa man tawaffaiytahu minna, fatawaffahu 'alal-Iman. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu, wa la taftinna ba'dahu (O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, our present and our absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, whosoever of us You keep alive, keep him alive (faithful) to Islam, and whosoever of us You cause to die, let him die having Iman. O Allah, do not deprive us of our reward (for being patient) and do not subject us to trials after his death."

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 258: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 258 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "When you pray over the dead, make a
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يقول: “إذا صليتم علي الميت، فأخلصوا له الدعاء" ((رواه أبو داود)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying: "When you pray over the dead, make a sincere dua for him."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "When you pray over the dead, make a sincere supplication for him.".

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) supplicated in course of funeral prayer: "Allahumma Anta Rabbuha
arabic: وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  في الصلاة علي الجنازة: “اللهم أنت ربها، وأنت خلقتها، وأنت هديتها للإسلام، وأنت قبضت روحها، وأنت أعلم بسرها وعلانيتها، جئناك شفعاء له، فاغفر له” ((رواه أبو داود)).

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the funeral prayer of a Muslim man in our presenc

وعن واثلة بن الأسقع رضي الله عنه قال: صلى  بنا رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  علي رجل من المسلمين، فسمعته يقول: 
"اللهم إن فلان ابن فلان في ذمتك وحبل جوارك، فقه فتنة القبر، وعذاب النار، وأنت أهل الوفاء والحمد؛ اللهم اغفر له وارحمه، إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم" ((رواه أبو داود)).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 261: Kitabu cha Kuwajulia Hali Wagonjwa na Mazishi
chapter.title_ar: باب 261 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: While offering the funeral prayer of one of his daughters, he recited four Takbi
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن أبي أوفي رضي الله عنهما أنه كبر علي جنازة ابنة له أربع تكبيرات، فقام بعد الرابعة كقدر ما بين التكبيرتين يستغفر لها ويدعو، ثم قال: كان رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يصنع هكذا. 
وفي رواية:  كبر أربعاً، فمكث ساعة حتي ظننت أنه سيكبر خمساً، ثم سلم عن يمينه وعن شماله. فلما انصرف قلنا له: ما هذا؟ فقال: إني لا أزيدكم علي ما رأيت رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يصنع، أو: هكذا صنع رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم   ((رواه الحاكم وقال: حديث صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "While offering the funeral swala of one of his daughters, he recited four Takbir, and after the fourth Takbir he continued standing for a time equal to an interval between two Takbir, praying for her and seeking Allah's msamaha for her." Then he said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to do so."Another narration is: He (Abdullah) recited four Takbir and remained standing in swala for some time till we thought that he would recite the fifth Takbir. Then he gave Salam on the right and on the left. When he turned aside, we asked him about it. He replied: "I would add nothing to what I saw the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) doing," or he said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to do so."."
english: 'Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: While offering the funeral prayer of one of his daughters, he recited four Takbir, and after the fourth Takbir he continued standing for a time equal to an interval between two Takbir, praying for her and seeking Allah's forgiveness for her." Then he said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do so."Another narration is: He (Abdullah) recited four Takbir and remained standing in prayer for some time till we thought that he would recite the fifth Takbir. Then he gave Salam on the right and on the left. When he turned aside, we asked him about it. He replied: "I would add nothing to what I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing," or he said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do so.".

title: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Hurry up with the dead body (for its burial), f
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  قال: "أسرعوا بالجنازة، فإن تك صالحة، فخير تقدمونها إليه، وإن تك سوي ذلك، فشر تضعونه عن رقابكم" ((متفق عليه)).  
((وفي رواية لمسلم: "فخير تقدمونها عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I heard Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "Hurry up with the dead body (for its burial), for if it is pious, you are speeding it to goodness and if it is otherwise, you are laying an evil off your necks." ."
english:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Hurry up with the dead body (for its burial), for if it is pious, you are speeding it to goodness and if it is otherwise, you are laying an evil off your necks."

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a dead body is placed on a bier and men carry it on
arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه قال: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  يقول: "إذا وضعت الجنازة، فاحتملها الرجال علي أعناقهم، فإن كانت صالحة، قال: قدموني، وإن كانت غير صالحة، قالت لأهلها: يا ويلها أين تذهبون بها؟ يسمع صوتها كل شيء إلا الأنسان، ولو سمع الأنسان لصعق” ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When a dead body is placed on a bier and men carry it on their shoulders, if he was a pious man, it (corpse) says: 'Take me in haste.' But if he was not wema, it says to its bearers: 'Woe to it. Where are you taking it?' Everything except man hears its voice. Had a human being heard its voice, he would have surely fallen into swoon."."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a dead body is placed on a bier and men carry it on their shoulders, if he was a pious man, it (corpse) says: 'Take me in haste.' But if he was not righteous, it says to its bearers: 'Woe to it. Where are you taking it?' Everything except man hears its voice. Had a human being heard its voice, he would have surely fallen into swoon.".

title: When Talhah bin Al-Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) fell ill, the Prophet (
arabic: وعن حصين بن وحوح رضي الله عنه أن طلحة بن البراء رضي الله عنه مرض، فأتاه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  يعوده فقال: إني لا أري طلحة إلا قد حدث فيه الموت فآذوني به وعجلوا به، فإنه لا ينبغي لجيفة مسلم أن تحبس بين ظهراني أهله" ((رواه أبو داود)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Hussain bin Wahwah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "When Talhah bin Al-Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) fell ill, Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) came to visit him and said, "Verily, I think that Talhah is about to die. So inform me when he is dead and make haste (in burying him). Indeed, it is improper for the corpse of a Muislamu to be kept lying unburied among his family members."."
english: Hussain bin Wahwah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: When Talhah bin Al-Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) fell ill, the Prophet (ﷺ) came to visit him and said, "Verily, I think that Talhah is about to die. So inform me when he is dead and make haste (in burying him). Indeed, it is improper for the corpse of a Muslim to be kept lying unburied among his family members.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 266 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: We were accompanying a funeral procession in Baqi` Al-Gharqad (graveyard in Al-M
arabic:
عن علي رضي الله عنه قال: كنا في جنازة في بقيع الغرقد فأتانا رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  فقعد، وقعدنا حوله ومعه مخصرة فنكس وجعل ينكت بمخصرته، ثم قال: ما منكم من أحد إلا وقد كتب مقعده من النار ومقعده من الجنة” فقالوا: يا رسول الله أفلا نتكل علي كتابنا؟ فقال: 
"اعملوا فكل ميسر لما خلق له" وذكر تمام الحديث. ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa `Ali (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "We were accompanying a funeral procession in Baqi` Al-Gharqad (graveyard in Al-Madinah) when the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) proceeded towards us and sat down. We sat around him. He had a small stick in his hand. He was bending down his head and scraping the ground with the stick. He said, "There is none among you but has a place assigned for him either in the Jannah or in the Motoni." The Companions said: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, should we not depend upon what has been written for us (and give up doing matendo mema)?'' The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Carry on doing matendo mema. Every one will find it easy to do such deeds (as will lead him to his destined place) for which he has been created." ."
english:
`Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: We were accompanying a funeral procession in Baqi` Al-Gharqad (graveyard in Al-Madinah) when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) proceeded towards us and sat down. We sat around him. He had a small stick in his hand. He was bending down his head and scraping the ground with the stick. He said, "There is none among you but has a place assigned for him either in the Jannah or in the Hell." The Companions said: "O Messenger of Allah, should we not depend upon what has been written for us (and give up doing good deeds)?'' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Carry on doing good deeds. Every one will find it easy to do such deeds (as will lead him to his destined place) for which he has been created."

.

title: After the burial of a dead man, the Prophet (ﷺ) would stand by the grave and say
arabic:
عن أبي عمرو -وقيل: أبو عبد الله، وقيل: أبو ليلى- عثمان بن عفان رضي الله عنه قال: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  إذا فرغ من دفن الميت وقف عليه، وقال: 
"استغفروا لأخيكم وسلوا له التثبيت، فإنه الآن يسأل" ((رواه أبو داود)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu `Amr (also called Abu `Abdullah and also Abu Laila) from `Uthman bin `Affan (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "After the burial of a dead man, Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) would stand by the grave and say, "Ask Allah to forgive your brother and supplicate for him for steadfastness because he is being questioned (about his deeds) now." ."
english:
Abu `Amr (also called Abu `Abdullah and also Abu Laila) from `Uthman bin `Affan (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: After the burial of a dead man, the Prophet (ﷺ) would stand by the grave and say, "Ask Allah to forgive your brother and supplicate for him for steadfastness because he is being questioned (about his deeds) now."

.

title: "When you have buried me, keep standing near my grave till (for the time it take
arabic: وعن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنه قال: إذا دفنتمونى، فأقيموا حول قبري قدر ما تنحر  جذور، ويقسم لحمها حت أستأنس بكم، وأعلم ماذا أراجع به رسل ربي" ((رواه مسلم. وقد سبق بطوله)). وقال الشافعي رحمه الله: ويستحب أن يقرأ عنده شيء من القرآن، وإن ختموا القرآن عنده كان حسناً.
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Amr bin Al-'as (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to say: ""When you have buried me, keep standing near my grave till (for the time it takes to) a camel is slaughtered and its meat is distributed, so that I may feel your nearness and know what to reply to the angels sent by my Rubb."."
english: 'Amr bin Al-'as (May Allah be pleased with him) used to say: "When you have buried me, keep standing near my grave till (for the time it takes to) a camel is slaughtered and its meat is distributed, so that I may feel your nearness and know what to reply to the angels sent by my Rubb.".

title: A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ): "My mother has died suddenly
arabic:
وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن رجلاً قال للنبي صلى  الله عليه وسلم : إن أمي افتلتت نفسها وأراها لو تكلمت، تصدقت، فهل لها أجر إن تصدقت عنها؟ قال: 
"نعم" ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A man said to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake): "My mother has died suddenly. I think that if she were able to talk (alive) she would have given in Sadaqah (sadaka). So, if I give Sadaqah now on her behalf, will she get the reward?" The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Yes (she will be rewarded for that)."."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ): "My mother has died suddenly. I think that if she were able to talk (alive) she would have given in Sadaqah (charity). So, if I give Sadaqah now on her behalf, will she get the reward?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Yes (she will be rewarded for that).".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a man dies, his deeds come to an end, exc
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال: “إذا مات الأنسان انقطع عمله إلا من ثلاث: صدقة جارية، أو علم ينتفع به، أو ولد صالح يدعو له" ((رواه مسلم)).

english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a man dies, his deeds come to an end, except for three: A continuous charity, knowledge by which people derive benefit, pious son who prays for him.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 271 من كتاب عيادة المريض وتشييع الجنائز

title: Some Companions happened to pass by a funeral procession (bier) and they praised
arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: مروا بجنازة، فأثنوا عليها خيراً، فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم : "وجبت”، ثم مروا بأخرى، فأثنوا عليها شراً، فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم : "وجبت" فقال عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه: ما وجبت؟ قال: "هذا أثنيتم عليه خيراً، فوجبت له الجنة، وهذا أثنيتم عليه شراً فوجبت عليه النار، أنتم شهداء الله في الأرض” ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Some Companions happened to pass by a funeral procession (bier) and they praised him (the deceased). Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He will certainly enter it." Then they passed by another funeral procession and they spoke ill of the deceased. Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He will certainly enter it." `Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "(Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah,) what do you mean by `He will certainly enter it?'' He (ﷺ) replied, "You praised the first person, so he will enter Jannah; and you spoke ill of the second person, so he will enter Motoni. You are Allah's witnesses on earth." ."
english:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Some Companions happened to pass by a funeral procession (bier) and they praised him (the deceased). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He will certainly enter it." Then they passed by another funeral procession and they spoke ill of the deceased. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He will certainly enter it." `Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "(O Messenger of Allah,) what do you mean by `He will certainly enter it?'' He (ﷺ) replied, "You praised the first person, so he will enter Jannah; and you spoke ill of the second person, so he will enter Hell. You are Allah's witnesses on earth."

.

title: I came to Al- Madinah, and while I was sitting beside 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, a fu
arabic: وعن أبي الأسود قال: قدمت المدينة، فجلست إلي عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه فمرت بهم جنازة، فأثني علي صاحبها خيراً فقال عمر: وجبت، ثم مر بأخرى، فأثني علي صاحبها خيراً، فقال عمر: وجبت، ثم مر بالثالثة، فأثني علي صاحبها شراً، فقال عمر: وجبت: قال أبو الأسود: فقلت: وما وجبت يا أمير المؤمنين؟ قال: قلت كما قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم : “أيما مسلم شهد له أربعة بخير، أدخله الله الجنة: فقلنا: وثلاثة؟ قال: “وثلاثة" فقلنا: واثنان؟ قال: "واثنان" ثم لم نسأله عن الواحد" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abul-Aswad (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I came to Al- Madinah, and while I was sitting beside 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, a funeral procession passed by. The people praised the deceased, and 'Umar bin Al-Khattab said: "He will certainly enter it." Then another funeral procession passed by and the people praised the deceased. 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "He will certainly enter it." A third funeral procession passed by and the people spoke ill of the deceased. He said: "He will certainly enter it." I (Abul-Aswad) asked: "O Amir Al-Mu'minin (i.e., Leader of the waumini)! What do you mean by 'He will certainly enter it'?" He replied: "I said the same as was said by Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake). He (ﷺ) said, 'If four persons testify the wemaness of a Muislamu, Allah will grant him Jannah.' We asked: 'If three persons testify his wemaness?' He (ﷺ) replied, 'Even three'. Then we asked: 'If two?' He (ﷺ) replied, 'Even two.' We did not ask him (regarding the testimony) of one."."
english: Abul-Aswad (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I came to Al- Madinah, and while I was sitting beside 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, a funeral procession passed by. The people praised the deceased, and 'Umar bin Al-Khattab said: "He will certainly enter it." Then another funeral procession passed by and the people praised the deceased. 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "He will certainly enter it." A third funeral procession passed by and the people spoke ill of the deceased. He said: "He will certainly enter it." I (Abul-Aswad) asked: "O Amir Al-Mu'minin (i.e., Leader of the Believers)! What do you mean by 'He will certainly enter it'?" He replied: "I said the same as was said by the Prophet (ﷺ). He (ﷺ) said, 'If four persons testify the righteousness of a Muslim, Allah will grant him Jannah.' We asked: 'If three persons testify his righteousness?' He (ﷺ) replied, 'Even three'. Then we asked: 'If two?' He (ﷺ) replied, 'Even two.' We did not ask him (regarding the testimony) of one.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim whose three children die (in infancy)
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : “لا يموت لأحد من المسلمين ثلاثة من الولد لا تمسه النار إلا تحلة القسم" ((متفق عليه))

english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim whose three children die (in infancy) will not be touched by the Fire (of Hell) except for the fulfillment of Allah's Oath."

title: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah
arabic:
وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه قال: جاءت امرأة إلي رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، فقالت: يا رسول الله ذهب الرجال بحديثك، فاجعل لنا مننفسك يوماً ناتيك فيه تعلمنا مما علمك الله، قال: “اجتمعن يوم كذا وكذا” فاجتمعن، فأتاهن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم   فعلمهن مما علمه الله، ثم قال: 
"ما منكن من امرأة تقدم ثلاثة من الولد إلا كانوا لها حجاباً من النار" فقالت امرأة: واثنين؟ فقال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  “واثنين” ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A woman came to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and said: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! Only men benefit from your talks, so please fix a day for us, to teach us the knowledge which Allah has taught you." The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) fixed a day and directed them to assemble. When they gathered, Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) went to them and taught them what Allah had taught him. He (ﷺ) then said, "Any woman of you whose three children die (in infancy) they will be a guard for her against Fire (of Motoni)." One of the women asked: "What if she loses two?" The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied, "Even two."."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah! Only men benefit from your talks, so please fix a day for us, to teach us the knowledge which Allah has taught you." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fixed a day and directed them to assemble. When they gathered, the Prophet (ﷺ) went to them and taught them what Allah had taught him. He (ﷺ) then said, "Any woman of you whose three children die (in infancy) they will be a guard for her against Fire (of Hell)." One of the women asked: "What if she loses two?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Even two.".

title: Ibn `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: When the Messenger of Allah
arabic:
عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال لأصحابه -يعني لما وصلوا الحجر: ديار ثمود-: "لا تدخلوا علي هؤلاء المعذبين إلا أن تكونوا باكين، فإن لم تكونوا باكين، فلا تدخلوا عليهم، لا يصيبكم ما أصابهم” ((متفق عليه)) 
وفي رواية قال: لما مر رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  بالحجر قال: "لا تدخلوا مساكن الذين ظلموا أنفسهم أن يصيبكم ما أصابهم إلا ان تكونوا باكين" ثم قنع رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  رأسه وأسرع  السير حتي أجاز الوادي.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Narrated Ibn Umar: "Ibn `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: When the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and his Companions reached Al-Hijr, the dwellings of the Thamud people, he admonished his Companions (saying), "Do not pass by these people who are being tormented, without weeping, lest the punishment should befall you as it had befallen them." ."
english:
Narrated Ibn 'Umar: Ibn `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his Companions reached Al-Hijr, the dwellings of the Thamud people, he admonished his Companions (saying), "Do not pass by these people who are being tormented, without weeping, lest the punishment should befall you as it had befallen them."

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 277: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) set out on Thursday for the expedition of Tabuk
arabic:
عن كعب بن مالك، رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  خرج في غزوة تبوك يوم الخميس، وكان يحب أن يخرج يوم الخميس" ((متفق عليه)).
وفي رواية في “الصحيحين” لقلما كان رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يخرج إلا في يوم الخميس.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ka'b bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) set out on Thursday for the expedition of Tabuk. He liked to set out on a journey on Thursdays."
english: Ka'b bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) set out on Thursday for the expedition of Tabuk. He liked to set out on a journey on Thursdays.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 278: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "O Allah
arabic: وعن صخر بن وداعة الغامدي الصحابي رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال: “اللهم بارك لأمتي في بكورها" وكان إذا بعث سرية أو جيشاً بعثهم من أول النهار. وكان صخر تاجراً فكان يبعث تجارته أول النهار، فأثري وكثر ماله” ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sakhr bin Wada'ah Al-Ghamidi (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "O Allah! Bless my people in the early part of the day (morning). Whenever he dispatched a detachment or an army-unit, he would dispatch it at the beginning of the day (soon after dawn). The narrator, Sakhr (May Allah be pleased with him) was a merchant, and he used to send off his merchandise at the beginning of the day. So his trade flourished and he made a good fortune.."
english: Sakhr bin Wada'ah Al-Ghamidi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Bless my people in the early part of the day (morning). Whenever he dispatched a detachment or an army-unit, he would dispatch it at the beginning of the day (soon after dawn). The narrator, Sakhr (May Allah be pleased with him) was a merchant, and he used to send off his merchandise at the beginning of the day. So his trade flourished and he made a good fortune..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 279: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Were people to know of what I know about the d
arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : "لو أن الناس يعلمون من الوحدة ما أعلم ما سار راكب بليل وحده” ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Were people to know of what I know about the dangers of travelling alone, no rider would travel alone at night."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Were people to know of what I know about the dangers of travelling alone, no rider would travel alone at night.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 280: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A single rider is (accompanied with) Satan and
arabic: وعن عمر بن شعيب عن أبيه عن جده رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : “الراكب شيطان والراكبان شيطانان والثلاثة ركب" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي والنسائي بأسانيد صحيحة، وقال الترمذي: حديث حسن))
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Amr bin Shu'aib (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "A single rider is (accompanied with) Satan and two riders are (accompanied with) two Satans. Three riders form a group."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 281: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When three persons set out on a journey, they
arabic: وعن أبي سعيد وأبي هريرة رضي الله عنهما قالا: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  : “إذا خرج ثلاثة في سفر فليأمروا أحدهم" حديث حسن، ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When three persons set out on a journey, they should appoint one of them as their leader."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 282: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best number of companions is four; the best detachmen
arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم   قال: “خير الصحابة أربعة وخير السرايا أربعمائة وخير الجيوش أربعة آلاف ولن يغلب اثنا عشر ألفاً عن قلة" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The best number of companions is four; the best detachment is four hundred and the best army is four thousand; and twelve thousand men will not be defeated as a result of smallness of number."."
english: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best number of companions is four; the best detachment is four hundred and the best army is four thousand; and twelve thousand men will not be defeated as a result of smallness of number.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 283: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When you travel through green and lush land, g
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  : “إذا سافرتم في الخصب فأعطوا الإبل حظها من الأرض وإذا سافرتم في الجدب فأسرعوا عليها السير وبادروا بها نقيها، وإذا عرستم، فاجتنبوا الطريق، فإن طرق الدواب، ومأوي الهوام بالليل” ((رواه مسلم)).
معنى: “أعطوا الإبل حظها من الأرض” أي: ارفقوا بها في السير لترعي في حال سيرها وقوله:  نقيها  وهو بكسر النون، وإسكان القاف، وبالياء المثناة من تحت وهو: المخ، معناه: أسرعوا بها حتي تصلوا المقصد قبل أن يذهب مخها من ضنك السير. و التعريس  النزول في الليل.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "When you travel through green and lush land, give the camels their due from the ground, and when you travel through a dry and barren land, make them walk quickly lest their strength falters. When you encamp at night, keep away from the roads, for beasts pass there and they are the resort of insects at night."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When you travel through green and lush land, give the camels their due from the ground, and when you travel through a dry and barren land, make them walk quickly lest their strength falters. When you encamp at night, keep away from the roads, for beasts pass there and they are the resort of insects at night.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 284: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) encamped at night during a journey, he would lie
arabic:
وعن أبي قتادة، رضي الله عنه، قال: كان رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، إذا كان في سفر، فعرس بليل اضطجع علي يمينه وإذا عرس قبيل الصبح نصب ذراعه، ووضع رأسه علي كفه" ((رواه مسلم)).
قال العلماء: إنما نصب ذراعه لئلا يستغرق في النوم، فتفوته صلاة الصبح عن وقتها أو عن أول وقتها.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Qatadah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "When the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) encamped at night during a journey, he would lie down on his right side, and when he stayed a little before dawn he would raise his forearm and place his head on the palm of his hand.."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 285: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Keep to travelling by night because the earth
arabic:
عن أنس، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : 
"عليكم بالدلجة، فإن الأرض تطوي بالليل" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن))
الدلجة  : السير في الليل
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Keep to travelling by night because the earth is folded (traversed more easily) during the night."."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Keep to travelling by night because the earth is folded (traversed more easily) during the night.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 286: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: Whenever the people encamped during the journey, they would disperse in the moun
arabic:
وعن أبي ثعلبة الخشني، رضي الله عنه، قال: كان الناس إذا نزلوا منزلاً تفرقوا في الشعاب والأودية. فقال رسول الله، صلى  الله عليه وسلم : 
"إن تفرقكم في هذه الشعاب والأودية إنما ذلكم من الشيطان!" فلم ينزلوا بعد ذلك منزلا إلا انضم بعضهم إلي بعض. ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Whenever the people encamped during the journey, they would disperse in the mountain passes and valleys. (When) the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) noticed this he said, "Your act of scattering in the mountain passes and valleys is from Satan." Afterwards the Companions kept close together whenever they encamped.."
english: Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Whenever the people encamped during the journey, they would disperse in the mountain passes and valleys. (When) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) noticed this he said, "Your act of scattering in the mountain passes and valleys is from Satan." Afterwards the Companions kept close together whenever they encamped..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 287: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a camel whose belly was sticking
arabic:
وعن سهل بن عمرو -وقيل سهل بن الربيع بن عمرو الأنصاري المعروف بابن الحنظلية، وهو من أهل بيعة الرضوان، رضي الله عنه، قال: مر رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  ببعير قد لحق ظهره بطنه، فقال: 
"اتقوا الله في هذه البهائهم المعجمة، فاركبوها صالحة وكلوها صالحة" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sahl bin 'Amr known as Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) happened to pass by a camel whose belly was sticking to its back (because of hunger), whereupon he said, "Fear Allah in respect of these dumb (animals). Ride them while they are fit, and slaughter them and eat their meat when they are fit."."
english: Sahl bin 'Amr known as Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a camel whose belly was sticking to its back (because of hunger), whereupon he said, "Fear Allah in respect of these dumb (animals). Ride them while they are fit, and slaughter them and eat their meat when they are fit.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 288: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made me ride behind him one day and confided somethin
arabic:
وعن أبي جعفر عبد الله بن جعفر، رضي الله عنهما، قال: أردفني رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  ، ذات يوم خلفه، وأسر إلي حديثاً لا أحدث به أحداً من الناس وكان أحب ما أستتر به رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  لحاجته هدف أو حائش نخل. يعنى: حائط نخل" ((رواه هكذا مختصراً)).
وزاد فيه البرقاني بإسناد مسلم بعد قوله: حائش نخل: فدخل حائطاً لرجل من الأنصار، فإذا فيه جمل، فلما رأي رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  جرجر وذرفت عيناه، فأتاه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم ، فمسح سراته -أى: سنامه- وذفراه فسكن؛ فقال:  من رب هذا الجمل، لمن هذا الجمل؟  فجاء فتى من الأنصار، فقال: هذا لي يا رسول الله، فقال:  أفلا تتقي الله في هذه البهيمة التي ملكك الله إياها؟ فإنه يشكو إلي أنك تجيعه وتدئبه  ((رواه أبو داود كرواية البرقاني)).
قوله:  ذفراه  وهو بكسر الذال المعجمة وإسكان الفاء، وهو لفظ مفرد مؤنث. قال أهل اللغة: الذفري: الموضع الذي يعرق من البعير خلف الأذن، وقوله:  تذئبه  أي: تتعبه.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Ja'far 'Abdullah bin Ja'far (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) made me ride behind him one day and confided something to me which I shall never disclose to anyone. ('Abdullah added:) He ((ﷺ) preferred to screen himself from others when responding to the call of nature, either behind a wall or the trunk of a date-palm.."
english: Abu Ja'far 'Abdullah bin Ja'far (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made me ride behind him one day and confided something to me which I shall never disclose to anyone. ('Abdullah added:) He ((ﷺ) preferred to screen himself from others when responding to the call of nature, either behind a wall or the trunk of a date-palm..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 289: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: When we encamped, we would not offer (voluntary) prayers until we had unsaddled
arabic:
وعن أنس، رضي الله عنه، قال: كنا إذا نزلنا منزلا لا نسبح حتي نحل الرحال. ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد علي شرط مسلم)).
وقوله:  لا نسبح : أي لا نصلي  النافلة، ومعناه: أنا -مع حرصنا علي الصلاة- لا نقدمها على حط الرحال وإراحة الدواب
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "When we encamped, we would not offer (voluntary) swala until we had unsaddled our beasts.."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: When we encamped, we would not offer (voluntary) prayers until we had unsaddled our beasts..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 290: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: While we were travelling with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a rider came and began
arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري، رضي الله عنه، قال: بينما نحن في سفر إذ جاء رجل علي راحلة له، فجعل يصرف بصره يميناً وشمالاً، فقال رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : "من كان معه فضل ظهر؛ فليعد به علي من لا ظهر له، ومن كان له فضل زاد فليعد به علي من لا زاد له" فذكر من أصناف المال ما ذكره، حتي رأينا: أنه لا حق لأحد منا في فضل" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "While we were travelling with the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), a rider came and began to stare on the right and on the left. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who has an extra mount should hand it over to one who has none, and he who possesses surplus provision, should give it to him who is without provision." He named various kinds of possessions until we began to think (realize) that none of us had any right to anything surplus.."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: While we were travelling with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a rider came and began to stare on the right and on the left. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who has an extra mount should hand it over to one who has none, and he who possesses surplus provision, should give it to him who is without provision." He named various kinds of possessions until we began to think (realize) that none of us had any right to anything surplus..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 291: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made up his mind to go in an expedition, he woul
arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه، عن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم ، أنه أراد أن يغزو، فقال: يا معشر المهاجرين والأنصار! إن من إخوانكم قوماً، ليس لهم مال، ولا عشيرة، فليضم أحدكم إليه الرجلين، أو الثلاثة، فما لأحدنا من ظهر يحمله إلا كعقبة، يعني أحدهم. قال: فضممت إلي اثنين أو ثلاثة مالي إلا عقبة كعقبة أحدهم من جملي. ((رواه أبو داود))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "When the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) made up his mind to go in an expedition, he would say to us, "O Muhajirin and the Ansar! There are among you such people who have no property and no kinsfolk. Let everyone of you take along with him two or three men. None of us had a spare animal we took rides by turn." So I took two or three men with me and I rode my camel by turn equally with them.."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made up his mind to go in an expedition, he would say to us, "O Muhajirin and the Ansar! There are among you such people who have no property and no kinsfolk. Let everyone of you take along with him two or three men. None of us had a spare animal we took rides by turn." So I took two or three men with me and I rode my camel by turn equally with them..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 292: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to lag behind while travelling and urge the weak
arabic: وعنه قال: كان رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  يتخلف في المسير، فيزجي الضعيف ويردف ويدعو له، ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to lag behind while travelling and urge the weak to walk quickly. He used to take up someone behind him and make dua for him.."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to lag behind while travelling and urge the weak to walk quickly. He used to take up someone behind him and make supplication for him..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 293: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mounted his camel for setting out on a journ
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهما، أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  كان إذا استوى علي بعيره خارجاً إلى سفر، كبر ثلاثاً، ثم قال: "سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين، وإنا إلي ربنا لمنقلبون. اللهم إنا نسألك في سفرنا هذا البر والتقوى، ومن العمل ما ترضي. اللهم هون علينا سفرنا هذا واطو عنا بعده. اللهم أنت الصاحب في السفر والخليفة في الأهل. اللهم إني أعوذ بك من وعثاء السفر وكآبة المنظر وسوء المنقلب في الأهل والمال والولد" وإذا رجع قالهن وزاد فيهن: "آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون" ((رواه مسلم)).
معنى  مقرنين : مطيقين.  والوعثاء  بفتح الواو وإسكان العين المهملة وبالثاء المثلثة وبالمد، وهي: الشدة. و الكآبة  بالمد، وهي: تغير النفس من حزن ونحوه.  والمنقلب : المرجع.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Whenever the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) mounted his camel for setting out on a journey, he would recite: "Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)," thrice. Then he (ﷺ) would supplicate: "Subhanal-ladhi sakh-khara lana hadha, wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadh al-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alaina safarana hadha, watwi 'anna bu'dahu. Allahumma Antas-Sahibu fissafari, wal-Khalifatu fil- ahli. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'ta'is-safari, wa kaabatil- manzari, wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahli wal-waladi (Far removed from imperfection is the One Who has made this subservient to us, for we have no power to subjugate it, and certainly to our Rubb shall we return. O Allah, we ask You during this journey of ours for wemaness, piety and such deeds as are pleasing to You. O Allah, make easy for us this journey of ours and make the distance short for us. O Allah, You are our Companion during the journey and the Guardian of the family and the property in our absence. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travelling, unhappiness connected with ghastly scenes and evil turns in property and family)." When he returned, he recited this dua making addition of these words: "Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li-Rabbina hamidun (We are those who return; those who repent; those who worship and those who praise our Rubb)."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mounted his camel for setting out on a journey, he would recite: "Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)," thrice. Then he (ﷺ) would supplicate: "Subhanal-ladhi sakh-khara lana hadha, wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadh al-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alaina safarana hadha, watwi 'anna bu'dahu. Allahumma Antas-Sahibu fissafari, wal-Khalifatu fil- ahli. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'ta'is-safari, wa kaabatil- manzari, wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahli wal-waladi (Far removed from imperfection is the One Who has made this subservient to us, for we have no power to subjugate it, and certainly to our Rubb shall we return. O Allah, we ask You during this journey of ours for righteousness, piety and such deeds as are pleasing to You. O Allah, make easy for us this journey of ours and make the distance short for us. O Allah, You are our Companion during the journey and the Guardian of the family and the property in our absence. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travelling, unhappiness connected with ghastly scenes and evil turns in property and family)." When he returned, he recited this supplication making addition of these words: "Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li-Rabbina hamidun (We are those who return; those who repent; those who worship and those who praise our Rubb).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 294: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) proceeded on a journey, he would seek refuge
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن سرجس، رضي الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  إذا سافر يتعوذ من وعثاء السفر، وكآبة المنقلب، والحور بعد الكون، ودعوة المظلوم. وسوء المنظر في الأهل والمال. ((رواه مسلم))
هكذا هو في صحيح مسلم: الحور بعد الكون، بالنون، وكذا رواه الترمذي والنسائي. قال الترمذي: يروي :الكور  بالراء، وكلاهما له وجه.   قال العلماء: ومعناه بالنون والراء جميعاً: الرجوع من الاستقامة أو الزيادة إلي النقص. قالوا: ورواية الراء مأخوذة من تكوير العمامة، وهو لفها وجمعها، ورواية النون، من الكون، مصدراً  كان يكون كوناً  إذا وجد واستقر.
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Sarjis (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Whenever the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) proceeded on a journey, he would seek refuge in Allah from the hardships of the journey, and against deviation after guidance, and against the dua of the oppressed, and occurrences of unpleasant events in the family and property. He would say: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is- safari, wa kaabatil-munqalabi, wal-hauri ba'dal-kauni, wa da'watil- mazlumi, wa su'il-manzari fil-ahli wal- mal."."
english: 'Abdullah bin Sarjis (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) proceeded on a journey, he would seek refuge in Allah from the hardships of the journey, and against deviation after guidance, and against the supplication of the oppressed, and occurrences of unpleasant events in the family and property. He would say: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is- safari, wa kaabatil-munqalabi, wal-hauri ba'dal-kauni, wa da'watil- mazlumi, wa su'il-manzari fil-ahli wal- mal.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 295: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: In my presence, a beast was brought to 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased
arabic:
وعن علي بن ربيعة قال: شهدت علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه أتي بدابة ليركبها، فلما وضع رجله في الركاب قال: بسم الله، فلما استوي علي ظهرها قال: الحمد لله الذي سخر لنا هذا، وما كنا له مقرنين، وإنا إلي ربنا لمنقلبون، ثم قال: الحمد الله، ثلاث مرات، ثم قال: الله اكبر ثلاث مرات، ثم قال: سبحانك إني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي فإنه لا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت، ثم ضحك، فقيل: يا أمير المؤمنين من أي شئ ضحكت؟ قال: رأيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فعل كما فعلت، ثم ضحك، فقلت: يا رسول الله من أي شئ ضحكت؟ قال: “إن ربك سبحانه يعجب من عبده إذا قال: اغفر لي ذنوبي، يعلم أنه لا يغفر الذنوب غيره" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)) 
وفي بعض النسخ: حديث صحيح. وهذا لفظ أبي داود
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Ali bin Rabi'ah reported: "In my presence, a beast was brought to 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) for riding. When he put his foot in the stirrup, he said: "Bismillah (With the Name of Allah)." When he had settled himself on its back he recited: "Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi sakh-khara lana hadha, wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun. (All praise belongs to Allah Who has made this subservient to us, for we had not the strength to overpower it; and to our Rubb shall we return)." He then recited thrice: "Alhamdu lillah (Praise be to Allah)," and then three times: "Allahu Abkar (Allah is Greatest)." Then he said: "Subhanaka inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li, innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Anta (You are far removed from imperfection I have wronged myself, so forgive me, because none but You can forgive sins)." Then he smiled. It was asked: "Why have you smiled, O Amir Al-Mu'minin (Leader of the waumini)?" He replied: "I saw the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) doing as I have done. I (i.e., Ali) asked him (the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake)) the reason for smiling. He (ﷺ) said, 'Your Rubb, Glorious is He, is pleased when His slave seeks His msamaha. He (the slave) has firm faith that none except Allah Alone can forgive sins)'."."
english: 'Ali bin Rabi'ah reported: In my presence, a beast was brought to 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) for riding. When he put his foot in the stirrup, he said: "Bismillah (With the Name of Allah)." When he had settled himself on its back he recited: "Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi sakh-khara lana hadha, wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun. (All praise belongs to Allah Who has made this subservient to us, for we had not the strength to overpower it; and to our Rubb shall we return)." He then recited thrice: "Alhamdu lillah (Praise be to Allah)," and then three times: "Allahu Abkar (Allah is Greatest)." Then he said: "Subhanaka inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li, innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Anta (You are far removed from imperfection I have wronged myself, so forgive me, because none but You can forgive sins)." Then he smiled. It was asked: "Why have you smiled, O Amir Al-Mu'minin (Leader of the Believers)?" He replied: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing as I have done. I (i.e., Ali) asked him (the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)) the reason for smiling. He (ﷺ) said, 'Your Rubb, Glorious is He, is pleased when His slave seeks His forgiveness. He (the slave) has firm faith that none except Allah Alone can forgive sins)'.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 298: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from Hajj or 'Umrah and ascended a height or h
arabic:
وعنه قال كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا قفل من الحج أو العمرة كلما أوفى علي ثنيه أو فدفد كبر ثلاثاً، ثم قال: 
" لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو علي كل شئ قدير آيبون تائبون عابدون ساجدون لربنا حامدون. صدق الله وعده، ونصر عبده، وهزم الأحزاب وحده" ((متفق عليه))
وفي رواية لمسلم: إذا قفل من الجيوش أو السرايا أو الحج أو العمرة
قوله:  أوفى  أي: ارتفع، وقوله:  فدفد  هو بفتح الفاءين بينهما دال مهملة ساكنة وآخره دال أخرى وهو : الغليظ المرتفع من الأرض.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Whenever Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) returned from Hajj or 'Umrah and ascended a height or hill, he would recite thrice: "Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)." Then he would say, "La ilaha ill-allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul- mulku, wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer. Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna li-Rabbina hamidun. Sadaq-Allahu wa'dahu, wa nasara 'abdahu, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdahu ."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from Hajj or 'Umrah and ascended a height or hill, he would recite thrice: "Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)." Then he would say, "La ilaha ill-allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul- mulku, wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer. Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna li-Rabbina hamidun. Sadaq-Allahu wa'dahu, wa nasara 'abdahu, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdahu .

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 299: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: A man said: "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I intend to set out on a journey, so coun
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رجلاً قال: يا رسول الله ، إني أريد أن أسافر فأوصني، قال: "عليك بتقوى الله، والتكبيرعلي كل شرف" فلما ولى الرجل قال: " اللهم اطو له البعد، وهون عليه السفر” ((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A man said: "O Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), I intend to set out on a journey, so counsel me." He (ﷺ) said, "Fear Allah, and ascending towards the raised ground, you should recite: "Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)." When the man turned away, he (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Shorten the distance for him and make the journey easy for him." ."

Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A man said: "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I intend to set out on a journey, so counsel me." He (ﷺ) said, "Fear Allah, and ascending towards the raised ground, you should recite: "Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)." When the man turned away, he (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Shorten the distance for him and make the journey easy for him."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 300: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: We accompanied the Prophet (ﷺ) in a journey, and when we climbed up a height, we
arabic:
وعن أبي موسي الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: كنا مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في سفر، فكنا إذا أشرفنا على واد هللنا وكبرنا وارتفعت أصواتنا، فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم   :”يا أيها الناس أربعوا عل أنفسكم فإنكم لا تدعون أصم ولا غائباً. إنه معكم ، إنه سميع قريب" ((متفق عليه))
أربعوا” بفتح الباء الموحدة أي : أرفقوا بأنفسكم.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Musa al-Ash'ari Al-Ash'ari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "We accompanied Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) in a journey, and when we climbed up a height, we proclaimed aloud: "La ilaha illallah (There is no true god except Allah)" and "Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)." Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) admonished us saying, "O people, take it easy. He Whom you are calling is not deaf or absent. He is with you (i.e., by His Knowledge), He is Hearing and He is Near."."
english: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: We accompanied the Prophet (ﷺ) in a journey, and when we climbed up a height, we proclaimed aloud: "La ilaha illallah (There is no true god except Allah)" and "Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)." The Prophet (ﷺ) admonished us saying, "O people, take it easy. He Whom you are calling is not deaf or absent. He is with you (i.e., by His Knowledge), He is Hearing and He is Near.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 301: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Three supplications are answered without doubt
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال : رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم : 
" ثلاث دعوات مستجابات لا شك فيهن: دعوة المظلوم، ودعوة المسافر، ودعوة الوالد على ولده" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن))
وليس في رواية أبي داود: “على ولده”
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Three duas are answered without doubt. The dua of the oppressed, the dua of the traveller, and the dua of the parent for his son."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Three supplications are answered without doubt. The supplication of the oppressed, the supplication of the traveller, and the supplication of the parent for his son.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 303: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Whosoever alights somewhere and says
arabic:
-عن خولة بنت حكيم رضي الله عنها قالت: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول: 
"من نزل منزلاً ثم قال: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق: لم يضره شيء حتي يرتحل من منزله ذلك" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Khaulah bint Hakim (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "Whosoever alights somewhere and says: 'A'udhu bikalimat-illahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaqa (I seek refuge with the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created),' nothing will harm him until he leaves that place."."
english: Khaulah bint Hakim (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Whosoever alights somewhere and says: 'A'udhu bikalimat-illahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaqa (I seek refuge with the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created),' nothing will harm him until he leaves that place.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 304: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set out on a journey, he would say by nightf
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا سافر فأقبل الليل قال: 
" يا أرض ، ربي وربك الله، أعوذ بالله من شرك وشر ما فيك ، وشر ما خلق فيك، وشر ما يدب عليك أعوذ بالله من شر أسد وأسود، ومن الحية والعقرب، ومن ساكن البلد، ومن والد وما ولد" ((رواه أبو داود))
والأسود : الشخص، قال الخطابي: و ساكن البلد : هم الجن الذين هم سكان الأرض . قال: والبلد من الأرض: ما كان مأوى الحيوان، وإن لم يكن فيه بناء ومنازل . قال: ويحتمل أن المراد   بالوالد  : إبليس  وماولد  : الشياطين

So when one of you has accomplished his purpose of journey, let him return home quickly."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 306: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you stays away (from his family) f
arabic:
عن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى  الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"إذا أطال أحدكم الغيبة فلا يطرقن أهله ليلاً"
وفي رواية أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  نهى أن يطرق الرجل أهله ليلاً. ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When one of you stays away (from his family) for a long period of time, let him not surprise his family by night."In another narration, Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) iliyokatazwa us from coming back to our family at night.."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 307: Kitabu cha Adabu za Safari

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would not come (back) to his family by night
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  لا يطرق أهله ليلاً، وكان يأتيهم غدوة أو عشية. ((متفق عليه))
 الطروق  :المجيء في الليل.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) would not come (back) to his family by night. He used to come in the morning or in the evening (before dark).."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would not come (back) to his family by night. He used to come in the morning or in the evening (before dark)..
