chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 394: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No Salat is more burdensome to the hypocrites
arabic:
وعنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"ليس صلاة أثقل على المنافقين من صلاة الفجر والعشاء ولو يعلمون ما فيهما  لأتوهما ولو حبوًا" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "No Salat is more burdensome to the hypocrites than the Fajr (dawn) swala and the 'Isha' (night) swala; and if they knew their merits, they would come to them even if they had to crawl to do so."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No Salat is more burdensome to the hypocrites than the Fajr (dawn) prayer and the 'Isha' (night) prayer; and if they knew their merits, they would come to them even if they had to crawl to do so.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 395: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "Which act is the best
arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : أي الأعمال أفضل؟ قال: "الصلاة على أوقتها" قلت: ثم أي؟ قال: "بر الوالدين" قلت ثم أي؟ قال: " الجهاد في سبيل الله" ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I asked the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake): "Which act is the best?" He (ﷺ) said, "As-Salat at their fixed times." I asked, "What next?" He (ﷺ) said, "Being dutiful to parents." I asked, "What next?" He (ﷺ) said, "Striving (Jihad) in the way of Allah."."
english: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "Which act is the best?" He (ﷺ) said, "As-Salat at their fixed times." I asked, "What next?" He (ﷺ) said, "Being dutiful to parents." I asked, "What next?" He (ﷺ) said, "Striving (Jihad) in the way of Allah.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 396: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Islam is based on five (pillars): testifying t
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
" بني الإسلام على خمس: شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدًا رسول الله، وإقام الصلاة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وحج البيت، وصوم رمضان" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Islam is based on five (pillars): testifying that there is no true god except Allah and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is His slave and Messenger; performing of Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat); the payment of Zakat; performing Hajj (pilgrimage) to the House ."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 397: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "I have been commanded to fight against the peo
arabic:
وعنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم 
"أمرت أن أقاتل الناس حتى يشهدوا أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدًا رسول الله، ويقيموا الصلاة ويؤتوا الزكاة، فإذا فعلوا ذلك، عصموا مني دماءهم وأموالهم إلا بحق الإسلام، وحسابهم على الله" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "I have been commanded to fight against the people till they testify La ilaha illAllah (There is no true god except Allah) and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is His slave and Messenger, and to establish As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat), and to pay Zakat; and if they do this, then their blood and property are secured except by the rights of Islam, and their accountability is left to Allah."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 398: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me as a governor to Yemen and (at the time of de
arabic:
وعن معاذ رضي الله عنه قال: بعثني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى اليمن فقال: 
"إنك تأتي قومًا من أهل الكتاب، فادعهم إلى شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله وأني رسول الله، فإن هم أطاعوا لذلك، فأعلمهم أن الله تعالى افترض عليهم خمس صلوات في كل يوم وليلة، فإن هم أطاعوا لذلك، فأعلمهم أن الله تعالى افترض عليهم صدقة تؤخذ من أغنيائهم فترد على فقرائهم، فإن هم اطاعوا لذلك، فإياك وكرائم أموالهم واتقِ دعوة المظلوم فإنه ليس بينها وبين الله حجاب" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Mu'adh (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) sent me as a governor to Yemen and (at the time of departure) he instructed me thus: "You will go to people of the Scripture (i.e., the Jews and the Christians). First of all invite them to testify that La ilaha ill Allah (There is no true god except Allah) and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is His slave and Messenger; and if they accept this, then tell them that Allah has enjoined upon them five Salat (swala) during the day and night; and if they accept it, then tell them that Allah has made the payment of Zakat obligatory upon them. It should be collected from their rich and distributed among their poor; and if they agree to it, don't take (as a share of Zakat) the best of their properties. Beware of the duas of the oppressed, for there is no barrier between it and Allah."."
english: Mu'adh (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me as a governor to Yemen and (at the time of departure) he instructed me thus: "You will go to people of the Scripture (i.e., the Jews and the Christians). First of all invite them to testify that La ilaha ill Allah (There is no true god except Allah) and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is His slave and Messenger; and if they accept this, then tell them that Allah has enjoined upon them five Salat (prayers) during the day and night; and if they accept it, then tell them that Allah has made the payment of Zakat obligatory upon them. It should be collected from their rich and distributed among their poor; and if they agree to it, don't take (as a share of Zakat) the best of their properties. Beware of the supplications of the oppressed, for there is no barrier between it and Allah.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 400: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "That which differentiates us from the disbelievers
arabic:
وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"العهد الذي بيننا وبينهم الصلاة، فمن تركها فقد كفر" ((رواه  الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

english: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "That which differentiates us from the disbelievers and hypocrites is our performance of Salat. He who abandons it, becomes a disbeliever.".

title: The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not consider the abandonment of

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 402: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The first of man's deeds for which he will be
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
"إن أول ما يحاسب به العبد يوم القيامة من عمله صلاته، فإن صلحت، فقد أفلح وأنجح، وإن فسدت، فقد خاب وخسر، فإن انتقص من فريضته شيئًا، قال الرب، عز وجل: انظروا هل لعبدي من تطوع، فيكمل منها ما انتقص من الفريضة؟ ثم يكون سائر أعماله على هذا" ((رواه  الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The first of man's deeds for which he will be called to account on the Siku ya Qiyama will be Salat. If it is found to be perfect, he will be safe and successful; but if it is incomplete, he will be unfortunate and a loser. If any shortcoming is found in the obligatory Salat, the Glorious and Exalted Rubb will command to see whether His slave has offered any voluntary Salat so that the obligatory Salat may be made up by it. Then the rest of his actions will be treated in the same manner."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The first of man's deeds for which he will be called to account on the Day of Resurrection will be Salat. If it is found to be perfect, he will be safe and successful; but if it is incomplete, he will be unfortunate and a loser. If any shortcoming is found in the obligatory Salat, the Glorious and Exalted Rubb will command to see whether His slave has offered any voluntary Salat so that the obligatory Salat may be made up by it. Then the rest of his actions will be treated in the same manner.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 403: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out to us (once) and said, "Why do you not stand
arabic: عن جابر بن سمرة، رضي الله عنهما، قال: خرج علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: "ألا تصفون كما تصف الملائكة عند ربها؟" فقلنا: يا رسول الله وكيف تصف الملائكة عند ربها؟ قال: "يتمون الصفوف الأُول، ويتراصون في الصف" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah bin Samurah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) came out to us (once) and said, "Why do you not stand in rows as the angels do before their Rubb?" We asked: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! how do the angels stand in rows before their Rubb?" He (ﷺ) replied, "They complete each row beginning with the first and filling all the gaps."."
english: Jabir bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out to us (once) and said, "Why do you not stand in rows as the angels do before their Rubb?" We asked: "O Messenger of Allah! how do the angels stand in rows before their Rubb?" He (ﷺ) replied, "They complete each row beginning with the first and filling all the gaps.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If people came to know the blessing of calling

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The best of the men's rows (in Salat) is the f
arabic:
وعنه قال: قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
"خير صفوف الرجال أولها، وشرها آخرها، وخير صفوف النساء آخرها، وشرها أولها". ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The best of the men's rows (in Salat) is the first row and the worst is the last; but the best of the woman's row is the last and the worst of their rows is the first."."

title: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) perceived a tendency among his Companions to sta
arabic:
وعن أبي سعيد الخدري، رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم رأي في أصحابه تأخرًا، فقال لهم: 
"تقدموا فَأتموا بي وليأتم بكم مَن بعدكم، لا يزال قوم يتأخرون حتى يؤخرهم الله" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "When the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) perceived a tendency among his Companions to stand in the back rows, he said to them, "Come forward and be close to me and let those who come after you, follow your lead. If people continue to fall behind (i.e., in acquiring virtues), Allah puts them behind."."

If people continue to fall behind (i.e., in acquiring virtues), Allah puts them behind.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 407: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to gently pat our shoulders when we were standin
arabic:
وعن أبي مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم يمسح مناكبنا في الصلاة، ويقول: 
"استووا ولا تختلفوا فتختلف قلوبكم، ليلني منكم أولو الأحلام والنهى، ثم الذين يلونهم ثم الذين يلونهم". ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to gently pat our shoulders when we were standing in rows at the time of Salat and say, "Keep (the rows) straight; do not differ from each other lest your hearts should suffer from discord. Let those of you who are mature and prudent be nearer to me, and then those who are next to them."."
english: Abu Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to gently pat our shoulders when we were standing in rows at the time of Salat and say, "Keep (the rows) straight; do not differ from each other lest your hearts should suffer from discord. Let those of you who are mature and prudent be nearer to me, and then those who are next to them.".

title: When the Iqamah had been announced, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned his face t
arabic:
وعنه قال: أقيمت الصلاة، فأقبل علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بوجهه فقال: "أقيموا صفوفكم وتراصوا، فإني أراكم من وراء ظهري" ((رواه البخاري بلفظه، ومسلم بمعناه)).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 410: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Straighten your rows; otherwise, All
arabic:
وعن النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنهما، قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "لتسون صفوفكم، أو ليخالفن الله بين وجوهكم" ((متفق عليه)) 
وفي رواية لمسلم: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يسوي صفوفنا حتى كأنما يسوي بها القداح، حتى رأى أنا قد عقلنا عنه. ثم خرج يومًا فقام حتى كاد يكبر، فرأى رجلا باديا صدره من الصف، فقال "عباد الله لتسون صفوفكم، أو ليخالفن الله بين وجوهكم".
swahili: Kutoka kwa An-Nu'man bin Bashir (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "Straighten your rows; otherwise, Allah will create dissension among you.".The narration in Muislamu is: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) directed us to keep our rows as straight as arrows. He continued stressing this until he realized that we had learnt it from him (recognized its significance). One day he came into the mosque and stood up. He was just about to say Takbir (Allah is Greater) when he noticed a man whose chest was projected from the row, so he said, "O slaves of Allah, you must straighten your rows or Allah will certainly put your faces in opposite directions.""
english: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Straighten your rows; otherwise, Allah will create dissension among you.".The narration in Muslim is: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) directed us to keep our rows as straight as arrows. He continued stressing this until he realized that we had learnt it from him (recognized its significance). One day he came into the mosque and stood up. He was just about to say Takbir (Allah is Greater) when he noticed a man whose chest was projected from the row, so he said, "O slaves of Allah, you must straighten your rows or Allah will certainly put your faces in opposite directions."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 411: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pass between the rows from one end to the oth
arabic: وعن البراء بن عازب رضي الله عنهما، قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يتخلل من ناحية إلى ناحية، يمسح صدورنا ومناكبنا ويقول،: "لا تختلفوا فتختلف قلوبكم" وكان يقول: "إن الله وملائكته يصلون على الصفوف الأُول" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to pass between the rows from one end to the other, touching our chest and shoulders (i.e., arranging the rows) in line and saying, "Do not be out of line; otherwise your hearts will be in disagreement". He would add, "Allah and His angels invoke blessings upon the first rows."."

He would add, "Allah and His angels invoke blessings upon the first rows.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 412: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Arrange the rows in order, stand shoulder to s
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"أقيموا الصفوف، وحاذوا المناكب، وسدوا الخلل، ولينوا بأيدي إخوانكم، ولا تذروا فرجات للشيطان، ومن وصل صفًا وصله الله، ومن قطع صفًا قطعه الله". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Arrange the rows in order, stand shoulder to shoulder, close the gaps, be accommodating to your brothers, and do not leave gaps for Satan. Whoever joins up a row, he will be joined to Allah (i.e., to the Mercy of Allah); and whoever cuts off a row, he will be cut off from Allah (i.e., from His Mercy)."."

Whoever joins up a row, he will be joined to Allah (i.e., to the Mercy of Allah); and whoever cuts off a row, he will be cut off from Allah (i.e., from His Mercy).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 413: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Stand close together in your rows, keep nearer
arabic:
وعن أنس، رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"رصوا صفوفكم، وقاربوا بينها وحاذوا الأعناق فوالذي نفسي بيده إني لأرى الشيطان يدخل من خلل الصف، كأنها الحذف" ((حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد على شرط مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Stand close together in your rows, keep nearer to one another, and put your necks in line, for by Him in Whose Hands my soul is, I see the Satan entering through the opening in the row like Al- hadhaf (i.e., a type of small black sheep found in Yemen)."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 416: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: Whenever we performed Salat behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we liked to be on
arabic: وعن البراء، رضي الله عنه قال: "كنا إذا صلينا خلف رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، أحببنا أن نكون عن يمينه، يقبل علينا بوجهه، فسمعته يقول: "رب قني عذابك يوم تبعث - أو تجمع- عبادك". ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Al-Bara' (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Whenever we performed Salat behind the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), we liked to be on his right side so that his face might turn towards us (at the end of the Salat). One day, I heard Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) supplicating, "O my Rubb! Shield me from Your Torment on the Day when You will gather (or said, 'resurrect') Your slaves."."
english: Al-Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Whenever we performed Salat behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we liked to be on his right side so that his face might turn towards us (at the end of the Salat). One day, I heard Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) supplicating, "O my Rubb! Shield me from Your Torment on the Day when You will gather (or said, 'resurrect') Your slaves.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 418: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "A house will be built in Jannah for
arabic: عن أم المؤمنين أم حبيبة رملة بنت أبي سفيان، رضي الله عنهما، قالت سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، يقول: ما من عبد مسلم يصلي لله تعالى كل يوم ثنتي عشرة ركعة تطوعًا غير الفريضة، إلا بنى الله له بيتًا في الجنة أو: إلا بني له بيت في الجنة" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Habibah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) the Mother of the Believers reported: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "A house will be built in Jannah for every Muislamu who offers twelve Rak'ah of optional Salat other than the obligatory Salat in a day and a night (to seek the Pleasure of Allah)."."
english: Umm Habibah (May Allah be pleased with her) the Mother of the Believers reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "A house will be built in Jannah for every Muslim who offers twelve Rak'ah of optional Salat other than the obligatory Salat in a day and a night (to seek the Pleasure of Allah).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 419: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I performed along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) two Rak'ah of optional prayers
arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، قال: صليت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، ركعتين قبل الظهر وركعتين بعدها، وركعتين بعد الجمعة، وركعتين بعد المغرب، وركعتين بعد العشاء" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "I performed along with the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) two Rak'ah of optional swala before Zuhr and two after the Zuhr (noon swala), and two after the Friday swala, and two after the Maghrib (evening) swala, and two after the 'Isha' (night) swala."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 420: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There is a Salat (prayer) between every Adhan
arabic: وعن عبد الله بن مغفل، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "بين كل أذانين صلاة، بين كل أذانين صلاة، بين كل أذانين صلاة" وقال في الثالثة: "لمن شاء" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "There is a Salat (swala) between every Adhan and Iqamah; there is a Salat between every Adhan and Iqamah." (While saying the same for the) third time (he (ﷺ) added), "It is for him who desires (to perform it)."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 423: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The two Rak'ah before the dawn (Fajr) prayer are better t
arabic:
وعنها عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"ركعتا الفجر خير من الدنيا وما فيها" ((رواه مسلم)). وفي رواية لهما لأحب إلي من الدنيا جميعًا.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 424: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I went to inform the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the time of the dawn (Fajr) pr
arabic: وعن أبي عبد الله بلال بن رباح، رضي الله عنه مؤذن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه أتى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليؤذنه بصلاة الغداة، فشغلت عائشة بلالا بأمر سألته عنه، حتى أصبح جدا فقام بلال فآذنه بالصلاة، وتابع أذانه، فلم يخرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فلما خرج صلى بالناس، فأخبره أن عائشة شغلته بأمر سألته عنه حتى أصبح جدا، وأنه أبطأ عليه بالخروج، فقال -يعني النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم -: "إني كنت ركعت ركعتي الفجر" فقال: يا رسول الله إنك أصبحت جدا؟ فقال: "لو أصبحت أكثر مما أصبحت، لركعتهما وأحسنتهما، وأجملتهما". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu 'Abdullah Bilal bin Rabah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) the Mu'adhdhin of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported: "I went to inform the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) about the time of the dawn (Fajr) swala, and 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) kept me busy and began to ask me about something till the day grew bright. Then I got up and informed the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) of the time of Salat. I informed him again but he did not came out immediately to lead As- Salat. When he came out, he led As-Salat. I said to him: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) kept me busy and thus diverted my attention by asking about something and the morning grew bright. You also came out late. Upon that the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "I was engaged in performing two Rak'ah of Fajr swala." Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him)said: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! You delayed As-Salat so long as the morning grew bright." He (ﷺ) replied, "Even if the morning had become brighter than it had, I would have performed two Rak'ah of swala in an excellent manner."."
english: Abu 'Abdullah Bilal bin Rabah (May Allah be pleased with him) the Mu'adhdhin of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported: I went to inform the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the time of the dawn (Fajr) prayer, and 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) kept me busy and began to ask me about something till the day grew bright. Then I got up and informed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) of the time of Salat. I informed him again but he did not came out immediately to lead As- Salat. When he came out, he led As-Salat. I said to him: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) kept me busy and thus diverted my attention by asking about something and the morning grew bright. You also came out late. Upon that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "I was engaged in performing two Rak'ah of Fajr prayer." Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him)said: "O Messenger of Allah! You delayed As-Salat so long as the morning grew bright." He (ﷺ) replied, "Even if the morning had become brighter than it had, I would have performed two Rak'ah of prayer in an excellent manner.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 425: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to perform two Rak'ah short prayer between the Adhan (call
arabic:
عن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، كان يصلي ركعتين خفيفتين بين النداء والإقامة من صلاة الصبح". ((متفق عليه))  
وفي رواية لهما: يصلي ركعتي الفجر، إذا سمع الأذان فيخففهما حتى أقول هل قرأ فيهمابأم القرآن!. وفي رواية لمسلم: كان يصلى ركعتيي الفجر إذا سمع الأذان ويخففهما.
وفي رواية: إذا طلع الفجر.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to perform two Rak'ah short swala between the Adhan (call to swala) and the Iqamah of the dawn (Fajr) swala.In the narration of Muislamu, 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: When the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to hear the Adhan (of Fajr swala) he would perform two supererogatory Rak'ah swala and would make them short."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to perform two Rak'ah short prayer between the Adhan (call to prayer) and the Iqamah of the dawn (Fajr) prayers.In the narration of Muslim, 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to hear the Adhan (of Fajr prayer) he would perform two supererogatory Rak'ah prayer and would make them short.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 426: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform two short Rak'ah prayer when it was d

english: Hafsah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform two short Rak'ah prayer when it was dawn and the Mu'adhdhin had called Adhan (for the Fajr prayer)..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 427: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform his optional night prayers at night,
arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي من الليل مثنى مثنى، ويوتر بركعة من آخر الليل، ويصلي الركعتين قبل صلاة الغداة، وكأن الأذان بأذنيه". ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to perform his optional night swala at night, two Rak'ah followed by two Rak'ah, and at the end he would conclude with an odd Rak'ah (Witr). Then he would perform two Rak'ah swala before the dawn (Fajr) swala after hearing the Adhan, and he would make them so brief as if he could hear the Iqamah being called.."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform his optional night prayers at night, two Rak'ah followed by two Rak'ah, and at the end he would conclude with an odd Rak'ah (Witr). Then he would perform two Rak'ah prayer before the dawn (Fajr) prayer after hearing the Adhan, and he would make them so brief as if he could hear the Iqamah being called..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 428: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite during the two Rak'ah of Fajr prayer:
arabic:
وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، كان يقرأ في ركعتي الفجر في الأولى منهما: {قولوا آمنا بالله وما أنزل إلينا} الآية التي في البقرة، وفي الآخرة منهما: {آمنا بالله واشهد بأنا مسلمون}. 
وفي رواية: في الآخرة التي في آل عمران: {تعالوا إلى كلمة سواء بيننا وبينكم}. ((رواهما مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to recite during the two Rak'ah of Fajr swala: "Say (O Waislamu): We believe in Allah and that which has been sent down to us..." (2:136) which is in Surat Al-Baqarah in the first Rak'ah and the Verse: "We believe in Allah, and bear witness that we are Waislamu (i.e., we submit to Allah." (3:52) in the second Rak'ah.According to another narration, he (ﷺ) recited from Surat Al-'Imran the Verses: "Come to a word which is just between us and you..." (3:64).."
english: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite during the two Rak'ah of Fajr prayer: "Say (O Muslims): We believe in Allah and that which has been sent down to us..." (2:136) which is in Surat Al-Baqarah in the first Rak'ah and the Verse: "We believe in Allah, and bear witness that we are Muslims (i.e., we submit to Allah." (3:52) in the second Rak'ah.According to another narration, he (ﷺ) recited from Surat Al-'Imran the Verses: "Come to a word which is just between us and you..." (3:64)..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 432: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the 'Isha prayer, he would perform eleven Rak'ah b
arabic: وعنها قالت: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي فيما بين أن يفرغ من صلاة العشاء إلى الفجر إحدى عشرة ركعة يسلم بين كل ركعتين، ويوتر بواحدة، فإذا سكت المؤذن من صلاة الفجر، وتبين له الفجر وجاء المؤذن، قام فركع ركعتين خفيفتين، ثم اضطجع على شقه الأيمن هكذا حتى يأتيه المؤذن للإقامة". ((رواه مسلم)). (15)
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "When Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) finished the 'Isha swala, he would perform eleven Rak'ah before the Fajr swala, concluding each two Rak'ah with Taslim (i.e., saying As-Salamu 'Alaikum) and observing the Witr (odd) at the end. When the Mu'adhdhin finished proclaiming Adhan for the Fajr swala and it was dawn, he would rise and perform two short Rak'ah, and then would lie down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin came to (inform) him about Iqamah.."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the 'Isha prayer, he would perform eleven Rak'ah before the Fajr prayer, concluding each two Rak'ah with Taslim (i.e., saying As-Salamu 'Alaikum) and observing the Witr (odd) at the end. When the Mu'adhdhin finished proclaiming Adhan for the Fajr prayer and it was dawn, he would rise and perform two short Rak'ah, and then would lie down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin came to (inform) him about Iqamah..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 433: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you has performed two of Sunnah
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
"إذا صلى أحدكم ركعتي الفجر، فليضطجع على يمينه". ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي بأسانيد صحيحة. قال الترمذي: حديث حسن صحيح.

english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you has performed two of Sunnah before the Fajr prayer, he should lie down on his right side.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 436: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) stayed in my house, he would perform four Rak'ah (super
arabic: وعنها قالت: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي في بيتي قبل الظهر أربعًا، ثم يخرج فيصلي بالناس، ثم يدخل فيصلي ركعتين، وكان يصلي بالناس المغرب ثم يدخل بيتي فيصلي ركعتين، ويصلي بالناس العشاء، ويدخل بيتي، فيصلي ركعتين. ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Whenever Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) stayed in my house, he would perform four Rak'ah (supererogatory swala) before Zuhr swala. Then he would go out and lead Salat. He (ﷺ) would then come back and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory swala). He would lead the Maghrib swala and come back and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory swala). When he (ﷺ) had led the 'Isha' swala, he would enter the house and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory swala)."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) stayed in my house, he would perform four Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer) before Zuhr prayer. Then he would go out and lead Salat. He (ﷺ) would then come back and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer). He would lead the Maghrib prayer and come back and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer). When he (ﷺ) had led the 'Isha' prayer, he would enter the house and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer).

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform four Rak'ah prayer after the declinin
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن السائب، رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يصلى أربعًا بعد أن تزول الشمس قبل الظهر، وقال 
"إنها ساعة تفتح فيها أبواب السماء، فأحب أن يصعد لي فيها عمل صالح" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

english: 'Abdullah bin As-Sa'ib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform four Rak'ah prayer after the declining of the sun before Zuhr prayer and would say, "This is an hour at which the gates of heaven are opened, and I like that my good deeds should rise to heaven at that time.".

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perform two Rak'ah before Maghrib prayer

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 445: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: In the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we used to perform two Rak'ah (op
arabic: وعنه قال: كنا نصلي على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ركعتين بعد غروب الشمس قبل المغرب، فقيل: أكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم صلاها؟ قال: كان يرانا نصليهما فلم يأمرنا ولم ينهنا". ((رواه مسلم)).

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When you have finished your (Fard) Salat (pray
arabic:

"إذا قضى أحدكم صلاته في مسجده، فليجعل لبيته نصيبًا من صلاته، فإن الله جاعل في بيته صلاته خيرًا". ((رواه مسلم)).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 452: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: "Yes, I performed the Friday prayer along with him in the enclosure (Maqsurah),
arabic: وعن عمر بن عطاء أن نافع بن جبير أرسله إلى السائب ابن أخت نمر يسأله عن شيء رآه منه معاوية في الصلاة فقال: نعم صليت معه الجمعة في المقصورة، فلما سلم الإمام، قمت في مقامي، فصليت فلما دخل أرسل إلي فقال: لا تعد لما فعلت: إذا صليت الجمعة فلا تصلها بصلاة حتى تتكلم أو تخرج، فإن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أمرنا بذلك أن لا نوصل صلاة بصلاة حتى نتكلم أو نخرج. ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Umar bin 'Ata reported that Nafi' bin Jubair sent him to Sa'ib bin Ukht Namir to ask him about something that Mu'awiyah had seen him doing in Salat (prayer). He said: ""Yes, I performed the Friday swala along with him in the enclosure (Maqsurah), and when the Imam concluded the Salat with Taslim, I stood up in my place and performed the Sunnah swala. When Mu'awiyah went home, he sent for me (and when I came) he said: "Never do again what you have done. When you have observed the Friday swala, you must not start another Sunnah swala till you have spoken to some one or have shifted your place; because the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) ordered us not to follow up the congregational Salat with any other Salat until we have talked (to some one) or moved from the place."."
english: 'Umar bin 'Ata reported that Nafi' bin Jubair sent him to Sa'ib bin Ukht Namir to ask him about something that Mu'awiyah had seen him doing in Salat (prayer). He said: "Yes, I performed the Friday prayer along with him in the enclosure (Maqsurah), and when the Imam concluded the Salat with Taslim, I stood up in my place and performed the Sunnah prayer. When Mu'awiyah went home, he sent for me (and when I came) he said: "Never do again what you have done. When you have observed the Friday prayer, you must not start another Sunnah prayer till you have spoken to some one or have shifted your place; because the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered us not to follow up the congregational Salat with any other Salat until we have talked (to some one) or moved from the place.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 453: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Witr prayer is not obligatory as the prescribed Salat (prayers), but the Mes
arabic:
عن علي رضي الله عنه قال: الوتر ليس بختم كصلاة المكتوبة ولكن سن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"إن الله وتر يحب الوتر، فأوتروا يا أهل القرآن". ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي)). وقال: حديث حسن.
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Ali (bin Abu Talib) (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Witr swala is not obligatory as the prescribed Salat (swala), but the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) observed it as his regular practice (Sunnah). He (ﷺ) said, "Allah is Witr (single, odd) and loves what is Witr. So perform Witr swala. O followers of Qur'an, observe Witr (swala)."."
english: 'Ali (bin Abu Talib) (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Witr prayer is not obligatory as the prescribed Salat (prayers), but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed it as his regular practice (Sunnah). He (ﷺ) said, "Allah is Witr (single, odd) and loves what is Witr. So perform Witr prayer. O followers of Qur'an, observe Witr (prayer).".

arabic:

"بادروا الصبح بالوتر" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي)). وقال: حديث حسن صحيح.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Hasten to perform the Witr swala before dawn."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Hasten to perform the Witr prayer before dawn.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 459: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who apprehends that he may not get up in th
arabic:
وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"من خاف أن لا يقوم الليل فليوتر أوله، ومن طمع أن يقوم آخره، فليوتر آخر الليل، فإن صلاة آخر الليل مشهودة، وذلك أفضل". ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake)reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who apprehends that he may not get up in the later part of the night, should observe the Witr swala in the first part of it; and he who is certain to get up in the last part of it, he should observe Witr at the end of the night, because Salat at the end of the night is attended (by the angels), and that is better."."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him)reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who apprehends that he may not get up in the later part of the night, should observe the Witr prayer in the first part of it; and he who is certain to get up in the last part of it, he should observe Witr at the end of the night, because Salat at the end of the night is attended (by the angels), and that is better.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 460: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: My Khalil (the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)) directed me to fast three days of each mo
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: أوصاني خليلي صلى الله عليه وسلم بصيام ثلاثة أيام من كل شهر، وركعتي الضحى، وأن أوتر قبل أن أرقد" . ((متفق عليه))  
والإيتار قبل النوم إنما يستحب لمن لا يثق باستيقاظ آخر الليل، فإن وثق فآخر الليل أفضل.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "My Khalil (the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake)) directed me to fast three days of each month, and to observe two Rak'ah Duha (optional swala) at forenoon, and to perform the Witr swala before going to bed.."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: My Khalil (the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)) directed me to fast three days of each month, and to observe two Rak'ah Duha (optional prayer) at forenoon, and to perform the Witr prayer before going to bed..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 461: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "In the morning, charity is due on every joint bone of the
arabic:
وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"يصبح على كل سلامى من أحدكم صدقة: فكل تسبيحة صدقة، وكل تهليلة صدقة، وكل تكبيرة صدقة، وأمر بالمعروف صدقة، ونهي عن المنكر صدقة، ويجزئ من ذلك ركعتان يركعهما من الضحى". ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake)reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "In the morning, sadaka is due on every joint bone of the body of everyone of you. Every utterance of Allah's Glorification (i.e., saying Subhan Allah) is an act of sadaka, and every utterance of His Praise (i.e., saying Al-hamdu lillah) is an act of sadaka and every utterance of declaration of His Greatness (i.e., saying La ilaha illAllah) is an act of sadaka; and enjoining M'aruf (good) is an act of sadaka, and forbidding Munkar (evil) is an act of sadaka, and two Rak'ah Duha swala which one performs in the forenoon is equal to all this (in reward)."."
english: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him)reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "In the morning, charity is due on every joint bone of the body of everyone of you. Every utterance of Allah's Glorification (i.e., saying Subhan Allah) is an act of charity, and every utterance of His Praise (i.e., saying Al-hamdu lillah) is an act of charity and every utterance of declaration of His Greatness (i.e., saying La ilaha illAllah) is an act of charity; and enjoining M'aruf (good) is an act of charity, and forbidding Munkar (evil) is an act of charity, and two Rak'ah Duha prayers which one performs in the forenoon is equal to all this (in reward).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 463: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the conquest of Makkah
arabic: وعن أم هانئ فاختة بنت أبي طالب رضي الله عنها قالت: ذهبت إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عام الفتح فوجدته يغتسل فلما فرغ من غسله صلى ثمان ركعات، وذلك ضحى" ((متفق عليه وهذا مختصر لفظ إحدى روايات مسلم))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Hani, daughter of Abu Talib (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I went to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) on the day of the conquest of Makkah. He was taking a bath at that time. When he finished the bath, he performed eight Rak'ah (of optional) swala. This was during the Duha (forenoon).."

When he finished the bath, he performed eight Rak'ah (of optional) prayers. This was during the Duha (forenoon)..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 464: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I saw some people performing Duha (prayers) in the early forenoon and warned the
arabic:
عن زيد بن أرقم رضي الله عنه أنه رأى قومًا يصلون من الضحى، فقال: أما لقد علموا أن الصلاة في غير هذه الساعة أفضل، إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"صلاة الأوابين حين ترمض الفصال". ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Zaid bin Arqam (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I saw some people performing Duha (swala) in the early forenoon and warned them (saying): These people must know that performing Salat a little later is better. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The Salat of the penitent is to be observed when the young ones of camels feel the heat of the sun (i.e., when it becomes very hot)."."
english: Zaid bin Arqam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw some people performing Duha (prayers) in the early forenoon and warned them (saying): These people must know that performing Salat a little later is better. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The Salat of the penitent is to be observed when the young ones of camels feel the heat of the sun (i.e., when it becomes very hot).".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you enters the mosque, he shoul

" إذا دخل أحدكم المسجد فلا يجلس حتى يصلي ركعتين". ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Qatadah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake)reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When anyone of you enters the mosque, he should perform two Rak'ah (of voluntary swala) before sitting."."
english: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you enters the mosque, he should perform two Rak'ah (of voluntary prayer) before sitting.".

title: I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was in the mosque, and he said to me, "Perform

"صلِ ركعتين" ((متفق عليه)).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 467: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him) "Tell m
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال لبلال: يا بلال حدثني بأرجى عمل عملته في الإسلام، فإني سمعت دف نعليك بين يدي في الجنة، قال: ما عملت عملا أرجى عندي من أني لم أتطهر طهورًا في ساعة من ليل أو نهار إلا صليت بذلك الطهور ما كتب لي أن أصلي. ((متفق عليه وهذا لفظ البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him) "Tell me about the most hopeful act (i.e., one which you deem the most rewarding with Allah) you have done since your acceptance of Islam because I heard the sound of the steps of your shoes in front of me in Jannah." Bilal said: "I do not consider any act more hopeful than that whenever I make Wudu' (or took a bath) in an hour of night or day, I would immediately perform Salat (swala) for as long as was destined for me to perform."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him) "Tell me about the most hopeful act (i.e., one which you deem the most rewarding with Allah) you have done since your acceptance of Islam because I heard the sound of the steps of your shoes in front of me in Jannah." Bilal said: "I do not consider any act more hopeful than that whenever I make Wudu' (or took a bath) in an hour of night or day, I would immediately perform Salat (prayer) for as long as was destined for me to perform.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 468: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The best day on which the sun has risen is Fri
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
" خير يوم طلعت عليه الشمس يوم الجمعة: فيه خلق آدم، وفيه أدخل الجنة، وفيه أخرج منها". ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On that day Adam was created, he was admitted to Jannah, and he was expelled therefrom."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On that day Adam was created, he was admitted to Jannah, and he was expelled therefrom.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 469: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone performs Wudu' properly, then comes
arabic:
وعنه قال: قال رسول الله، صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"من توضأ فأحسن الوضوء ثم أتي الجمعة، فاستمع وأنصت، غفر له ما بينه وبين الجمعة وزيادة ثلاثة أيام، ومن مس الحصى،  فقد لغا" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If anyone performs Wudu' properly, then comes to the Friday swala, listens to the Khutbah (religious talk) attentively and keeps silent, his (minor) sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven, with the addition of three more days; but he who touches pebbles has caused an interruption. "."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone performs Wudu' properly, then comes to the Friday prayer, listens to the Khutbah (religious talk) attentively and keeps silent, his (minor) sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven, with the addition of three more days; but he who touches pebbles has caused an interruption. ".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 470: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The five daily (prescribed) Salat, and Friday (prayer) to
arabic:
وعنه عن النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"الصلوات الخمس والجمعة إلى الجمعة، ورمضان إلى رمضان، مكفرات ما بينهن إذا اجتنبت الكبائر" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake)reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The five daily (prescribed) Salat, and Friday (swala) to the next Friday (swala), and the kufunga of Ramadan to the next Ramadan, is expiation of the sins committed in between them, so long as major sins are avoided."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 471: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: We heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying (while delivering Khutbah on his wood
arabic:
وعنه وعن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهم، أنهما سمعا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يقول على أعواد منبره: 
"لينتهين أقوام عن وَدعهم الجمعات، أو ليختمن الله على قلوبهم، ثم ليكونن من الغافلين" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar and Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "We heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying (while delivering Khutbah on his wooden pulpit), "Either some people (i.e., hypocrites) stop neglecting the Friday swala, or Allah will seal their hearts and they will be among the heedless."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 472: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you intends to come for the Friday

وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال: 
"إذا جاء أحدكم الجمعة، فليغتسل" ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When one of you intends to come for the Friday swala, he should take a bath."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 473: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Taking a bath (before coming to Friday prayers
arabic:
وعن أبي سعيد الخدري، رضي الله عنه، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال: 
"غسل الجمعة واجب على كل محتلم" ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Taking a bath (before coming to Friday swala) is obligatory on every adult."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 474: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It suffices to perform Wudu' properly for the
arabic:
وعن سمرة،  رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"من توضأ يوم الجمعة، فبها ونعمت، ومن اغتسل فالغسل أفضل" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال حديث حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Samurah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "It suffices to perform Wudu' properly for the Friday swala; but it is better to take a bath."."
english: Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It suffices to perform Wudu' properly for the Friday prayer; but it is better to take a bath.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 475: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If a man takes bath on Friday, (or) purifies h
arabic:
- وعن سلمان، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"لا يغتسل رجل يوم الجمعة، ويتطهر ما استطاع من طهر، ويدهن من دهنه، أو يمس من طيب بيته، ثم يخرج فلا يفرق بين اثنين، ثم يصلي ما كتب له، ثم ينصت إذا تكلم الإمام، إلا غفر له ما بينه وبين الجمعة الأخرى" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Salman (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If a man takes bath on Friday, (or) purifies himself as much as he can with Wudu', oils his hair, applies whatever perfume available in his house, sets forth for the mosque, does not separate two people (to make a seat for himself), performs Salat what is prescribed for him, remains silent when the Imam speaks, his (minor) sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven."."
english: Salman (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If a man takes bath on Friday, (or) purifies himself as much as he can with Wudu', oils his hair, applies whatever perfume available in his house, sets forth for the mosque, does not separate two people (to make a seat for himself), performs Salat what is prescribed for him, remains silent when the Imam speaks, his (minor) sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 476: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who takes a bath on Friday, like the bath f
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال: 
"من اغتسل يوم الجمعة غسل الجنابة، ثم راح في الساعة الأولى فكأنما قرب بدنة، ومن راح في الساعة الثانية، فكأنما قرب بقرة، ومن راح في الساعة الثالثة، فكأنما قرب كبشًا أقرن، ومن راح في الساعة الرابعة، فكأنما قرب دجاجة، ومن راح في الساعة الخامسة، فكأنما قرب بيضة، فإذا خرج الإمام، حضرت الملائكة يستمعون الذكر" ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who takes a bath on Friday, like the bath for ceremonial purity, and then goes (to the mosque), he is like one who offers a camel as a sacrifice to seek the Pleasure of Allah; and he who comes at the second hour is like one who offers a cow to win the Pleasure of Allah; and he who comes at the third hour is like one who offers a ram with horns (in sacrifice); and he who comes at the fourth hour is like one who offers a hen; and he who comes at the fifth hour is like one who offers an egg. And when the Imam ascends the pulpit, the angels (who write the names of those who come to the mosque before the coming of the Imam) close (their record) in order to listen to the Khutbah."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who takes a bath on Friday, like the bath for ceremonial purity, and then goes (to the mosque), he is like one who offers a camel as a sacrifice to seek the Pleasure of Allah; and he who comes at the second hour is like one who offers a cow to win the Pleasure of Allah; and he who comes at the third hour is like one who offers a ram with horns (in sacrifice); and he who comes at the fourth hour is like one who offers a hen; and he who comes at the fifth hour is like one who offers an egg. And when the Imam ascends the pulpit, the angels (who write the names of those who come to the mosque before the coming of the Imam) close (their record) in order to listen to the Khutbah.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 477: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said while talking about the merits of Friday, "There
arabic:
وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، ذكر يوم الجمعة، فقال: 
"فيها ساعة لا يوافقها عبد مسلم، وهو قائم يصلي يسأل الله شيئًا، إلا أعطاه إياه" وأشار بيده يقللها، ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said while talking about the merits of Friday, "There is a time on Friday at which a Muislamu, while he (or she) is performing Salat and is supplicating, will be granted whatever he (or she) is supplicating for." And he (ﷺ) pointed with his hand to indicate that this period of time is very short.."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said while talking about the merits of Friday, "There is a time on Friday at which a Muslim, while he (or she) is performing Salat and is supplicating, will be granted whatever he (or she) is supplicating for." And he (ﷺ) pointed with his hand to indicate that this period of time is very short..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 478: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: 'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said to me: "Did you hear y
arabic:
وعن أبي بردة بن أبي موسى الأشعري، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال عبد الله بن عمر رضي الله عنهما: أسمعت أباك يحدث عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، في شأن ساعة الجمعة؟ قال: قلت: نعم، سمعته يقول: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يقول: 
"هي ما بين أن يجلس الإمام إلى أن تقضى الصلاة" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Burdah bin Abu Musa al-Ash'ari Al-Ash'ari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said to me: "Did you hear your father narrating something from the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) about the special moment during Friday?" I said: "Yes, I heard him report from the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake): 'It occurs between the time when the Imam sits down (on the pulpit after the first Khutbah) and the time Salat is over."'."

I said: "Yes, I heard him report from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): 'It occurs between the time when the Imam sits down (on the pulpit after the first Khutbah) and the time Salat is over."'.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 479: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Among the best of your days is Friday
arabic:
وعن أوس بن أوس، رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"إن من أفضل أيامكم يوم الجمعة، فأكثروا علي من الصلاة فيه، فإن صلاتكم معروضة علي" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

english: Aus bin Aus (May Allah be pleased with him)reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Among the best of your days is Friday. On that day pray to Allah to exalt my mention frequently, for your such supplications are presented to me.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 480: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: We left Makkah with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for Al-Madinah, and when we were
arabic:
عن سعد بن أبي وقاص، رضي الله عنه، قال: خرجنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من مكة نريد المدينة، فلما كنا قريبًا من عزوراء نزل ثم رفع يديه، فدعا الله ساعة، ثم خر ساجدًا، فمكث طويلا، ثم قام فرفع يديه ساعة، ثم خر ساجدًا- فعله- ثلاثًا- وقال: 
"إني سألت ربي، وشفعت لأمتي، فأعطاني ثلث أمتي، فخررت ساجدًا لربي شكرًا، ثم رفعت رأسي، فسألت ربي لأمتي، فأعطاني ثلث أمتي، فخررت ساجدًا لربي شكرًا، ثم رفعت رأسي، فسألت ربي لأمتي، فأعطاني الثلث الآخر، فخررت ساجدًا لربي" ((رواه أبو داود)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "We left Makkah with the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) for Al-Madinah, and when we were near 'Azwara,' he (ﷺ) alighted (from his riding-camel) raised his hands in dua to Allah for a while and prostrated himself. He remained for a long time in prostration. Then he stood up and raised his hands for a while, after which he prostrated himself (again), and remained for a long time in prostration. Then he stood up and raised his hands for a while, after which he prostrated himself for the third time. Then he (ﷺ) said, "I supplicated my Rubb and made intercession for my Ummah, and He granted me one-third of them. So I again prostrated myself in gratitude to my Rubb. Then I raised my head and supplicated my Rubb for my Ummah, and He granted me another third of them. Again I raised my head and supplicated my Rubb for my Ummah and He granted me the last third of them. So I fell into prostration out of gratitude before my Rubb."."
english: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: We left Makkah with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for Al-Madinah, and when we were near 'Azwara,' he (ﷺ) alighted (from his riding-camel) raised his hands in supplication to Allah for a while and prostrated himself. He remained for a long time in prostration. Then he stood up and raised his hands for a while, after which he prostrated himself (again), and remained for a long time in prostration. Then he stood up and raised his hands for a while, after which he prostrated himself for the third time. Then he (ﷺ) said, "I supplicated my Rubb and made intercession for my Ummah, and He granted me one-third of them. So I again prostrated myself in gratitude to my Rubb. Then I raised my head and supplicated my Rubb for my Ummah, and He granted me another third of them. Again I raised my head and supplicated my Rubb for my Ummah and He granted me the last third of them. So I fell into prostration out of gratitude before my Rubb.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 481: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) kept standing (in prayer) so long that the skin of his feet woul
arabic:
وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها، قالت: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يقوم من الليل حتى تتفطر قدماه، فقلت له: لم تصنع هذا يا رسول الله، وقد غفر لك ما تقدم من ذنبك وما تأخر؟ قال: 
"أفلا أكون عبدًا شكورًا". ((متفق عليه وعن المغيرة بن شعبة نحوه، متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) kept standing (in swala) so long that the skin of his feet would crack. I asked him: "Why do you do this, while you have been forgiven of your former and latter sins?" He said, "Should I not be a grateful slave of Allah?"."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) kept standing (in prayer) so long that the skin of his feet would crack. I asked him: "Why do you do this, while you have been forgiven of your former and latter sins?" He said, "Should I not be a grateful slave of Allah?".

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) visited me and Fatimah (May Allah be pleased with her) one night

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 483: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: Salim bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with them) re
arabic:
وعن سالم بن عبد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب، رضي الله عنهم، عن أبيه: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال: 
"نعم الرجل عبد الله لو كان يصلي من الليل" قال سالم: فكان عبد الله بعد ذلك لا ينام إلا قليلا. ((متفق عليه))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Masahaba (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: "Salim bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with them) reported, on the authority of his father, that the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "What an excellent man 'Abdullah is! If only he could perform optional swala at night." Salim said that after this, (his father) 'Abdullah slept very little at night.."
english: Salim bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with them) reported, on the authority of his father, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "What an excellent man 'Abdullah is! If only he could perform optional prayers at night." Salim said that after this, (his father) 'Abdullah slept very little at night..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 484: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "Do not be like so-and-so O 'Abdullah
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص، رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"يا عبد الله لا تكن مثل فلان: كان يقوم الليل فترك قيام الليل" ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to me, "Do not be like so-and-so O 'Abdullah! He used to pray during the night, then stopped the practice."."
english: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "Do not be like so-and-so O 'Abdullah! He used to pray during the night, then stopped the practice.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 485: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: Mention was made before the Prophet (ﷺ) of a man who slept throughout the night
arabic:
وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه ، قال: ذكر عند النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم رجل نام ليلة حتى أصبح! قال: 
"ذاك رجل بال الشيطان في أذنيه- أو قال: في أذنه-" ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mention was made before Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) of a man who slept throughout the night till morning. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) remarked, "He is a man in whose ears Satan urinated.".n"

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 486: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When any one of you sleeps, Satan ties three k
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال: 
"يعقد الشيطان على قافية، رأس أحدكم، إذا هو نام، ثلاث عقد، يضرب على كل عقدة: عليك ليل طويل فارقد، فإن استيقظ أحدكم، فذكر الله تعالى انحلت عقدة، فإن توضأ انحلت عقدة، فإن صلى انحلت عقدة، فأصبح نشيطًا طيب النفس، وإلا أصبح خبيث النفس كسلان" ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When any one of you sleeps, Satan ties three knots at the back of his neck. He recites this incantation at every knot: 'You have a long night, so sleep.' If he awakes and remembers Allah, one knot is loosened. If he performs Wudu', the (second) knot is loosened; and if he performs swala, (all) knots are loosened. He begins his morning in a happy and refreshed mood; otherwise, he gets up in bad spirits and sluggish state."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When any one of you sleeps, Satan ties three knots at the back of his neck. He recites this incantation at every knot: 'You have a long night, so sleep.' If he awakes and remembers Allah, one knot is loosened. If he performs Wudu', the (second) knot is loosened; and if he performs prayer, (all) knots are loosened. He begins his morning in a happy and refreshed mood; otherwise, he gets up in bad spirits and sluggish state.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 487: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people, promote the greetings, feed (the poor and needy
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن سلام، رضي الله عنه ، أن النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم ،قال: 
"أيها الناس أفشوا السلام، وأطعموا الطعام، وصلوا بالليل والناس نيام، تدخلوا الجنة بسلام" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Salam (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "O people, promote the greetings, feed (the poor and needy) and perform Salat when others are asleep so that you will enter Jannah safely."."
english: 'Abdullah bin Salam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people, promote the greetings, feed (the poor and needy) and perform Salat when others are asleep so that you will enter Jannah safely.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The best month for observing Saum (fasting) af
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"أفضل الصيام بعد رمضان شهر الله المحرم، وأفضل الصلاة بعد الفريضة صلاة الليل". ((رواه مسلم)).

english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The best month for observing Saum (fasting) after Ramadan is Muharram, and the best Salat after the prescribed Salat is Salat at night.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 491: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to leave off observing Saum (fasting) during a m
arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه، قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يفطر من الشهر حتى نظن أن  لا يصوم منه، ويصوم حتى نظن أن لا يفطر منه شيئًا، وكان لا تشاء أن تراه من الليل مصليا إلا رأيته، ولا نائمًا إلا رأيته. ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to leave off observing Saum (kufunga) during a month until we thought that he would not observe Saum at all during it; and (sometimes) he would observe Saum till we began to think that he would not omit any day of that month. If one wished to see him performing Salat during the night, he could do that; and if one wished to see him sleeping at night, he could do that.."

If one wished to see him performing Salat during the night, he could do that; and if one wished to see him sleeping at night, he could do that..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 492: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform eleven Rak'ah (of Tahajjud) prayers a
arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، كان يصلي إحدى عشرة ركعة- تعني في الليل- يسجد السجدة من ذلك قدر ما يقرأ أحدكم خمسين آية قبل أن يرفع رأسه، ويركع ركعتين قبل صلاة الفجر، ثم يضطجع على شقه الأيمن حتى يأتيه المنادي للصلاة، ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) used to perform eleven Rak'ah (of Tahajjud) swala at night. He (ﷺ) would prostrate so long as one of you might recite fifty Ayat (of the Qur'an). Thereafter, he would perform two Rak'ah before Fajr swala and would lie down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin would come and inform him about the time of (Fajr) swala.."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to perform eleven Rak'ah (of Tahajjud) prayers at night. He (ﷺ) would prostrate so long as one of you might recite fifty Ayat (of the Qur'an). Thereafter, he would perform two Rak'ah before Fajr prayers and would lie down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin would come and inform him about the time of (Fajr) prayer..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 493: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not observe more than eleven Rak'ah (of Tahajjud
arabic:
وعنها قالت: ما كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يزيد- في رمضان ولا في غيره- على إحدي عشرة ركعة: يصلي أربعًا فلا تسأل عن حسنهن وطولهن! ثم يصلي أربعًا فلا تسأل عن حسنهن وطولهن! ثم يصلي ثلاثًا. فقلت: يا رسول الله أتنام قبل أن توتر!؟ فقال: 
"يا عائشة إن عيني تنامان ولا ينام قلبي". ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) did not observe more than eleven Rak'ah (of Tahajjud swala), be in Ramadan or any other month. First of all he would perform four Rak'ah. Ask not about their excellence and their length. He (ﷺ) would then perform four more Rak'ah; and do not ask about their excellence and their length. Then he would perform three Rak'ah (Witr swala). ('Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) added) I submitted: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! Do you sleep before performing the Witr swala?" He (ﷺ) said, "O 'Aishah! My eyes sleep but my heart does not sleep."."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not observe more than eleven Rak'ah (of Tahajjud prayers), be in Ramadan or any other month. First of all he would perform four Rak'ah. Ask not about their excellence and their length. He (ﷺ) would then perform four more Rak'ah; and do not ask about their excellence and their length. Then he would perform three Rak'ah (Witr prayer). ('Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) added) I submitted: "O Messenger of Allah! Do you sleep before performing the Witr prayer?" He (ﷺ) said, "O 'Aishah! My eyes sleep but my heart does not sleep.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 495: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: One night I joined the Prophet (ﷺ) in his (optional) Salat
arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه، قال: صليت مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، ليلة، فلم يزل قائمًا حتى هممت بأمر سوء. قيل: ما هممت؟ قال: هممت أن أجلس وأدعه. ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "One night I joined Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) in his (optional) Salat. He (ﷺ) prolonged the Qiyam (standing) so much that I made up my mind to commit an act of wrong. He was questioned: "What did you intend to do?" He replied: "I intended to sit down and stop following him (in Salat)."."
english: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: One night I joined the Prophet (ﷺ) in his (optional) Salat. He (ﷺ) prolonged the Qiyam (standing) so much that I made up my mind to commit an act of wrong. He was questioned: "What did you intend to do?" He replied: "I intended to sit down and stop following him (in Salat).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 496: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I performed Salat with the Prophet (ﷺ) one night, and he started reciting Surat
arabic: وعن حذيفة رضي الله عنه، قال: صليت مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، ذات ليلة فافتتح البقرة، فقلت: يركع عند المائة، ثم مضى، فقلت: يصلي بها في ركعة، فمضي، فقلت: يركع بها، ثم افتتح النساء فقرأها، ثم افتتح آل عمران، فقرأها، يقرأ مترسلا. إذا مر بآية فيها تسبيح سبح، وإذا بسؤال سأل، وإذا مر بتعوذ تعوذ، ثم ركع، فجعل يقول: سبحان ربي العظيم، فكان ركوعه نحوًا من قيامه، ثم قال: سمع الله لمن حمده، ربنا لك الحمد، ثم قام طويلا قريبًا مما ركع، ثم سجد فقال: سبحان ربي الأعلى، فكان سجوده قريبًا من قيامه. ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Hudhaifah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I performed Salat with Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) one night, and he started reciting Surat Al- Baqarah. I thought that he would go in Ruku' (bowing posture in Salat) at the end of one hundred Ayat, but he continued (reciting); and I thought that he would perhaps recite (this Surah) in the whole Rak'ah (swala), but he continued the recitation; I thought he would perhaps bow on completing (this Surah). He (ﷺ) then started reciting Surat An-Nisa' which he followed with Surat Al-Imran. He recited leisurely. When he recited an Ayah which mentioned the tasbeeh, he would say Subhan Allah and when he recited the Ayah which tells how the Rubb is to be asked, the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) would then ask from Him; and when he (ﷺ) recited an Ayah asking one to seek Protection Allah, he would seek Protection of Allah. Then he bowed and said, "Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim (My Rubb the Great is free from imperfection)"; his bowing lasted about the same length of time as his standing, (and then on returning to the standing posture after Ruku') he would say, "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana lakal-hamd (Allah listens to him who praises Him. Praise be to You, Our Rubb!)," and he would then stand about the same length of time as he had spent in bowing. He would then prostrate himself and say, "Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la (My Rubb the Supreme is free from imperfection)," and his prostration lasted nearly the same length of time as his standing (Qiyam).."
english: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I performed Salat with the Prophet (ﷺ) one night, and he started reciting Surat Al- Baqarah. I thought that he would go in Ruku' (bowing posture in Salat) at the end of one hundred Ayat, but he continued (reciting); and I thought that he would perhaps recite (this Surah) in the whole Rak'ah (prayer), but he continued the recitation; I thought he would perhaps bow on completing (this Surah). He (ﷺ) then started reciting Surat An-Nisa' which he followed with Surat Al-Imran. He recited leisurely. When he recited an Ayah which mentioned the tasbeeh, he would say Subhan Allah and when he recited the Ayah which tells how the Rubb is to be asked, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would then ask from Him; and when he (ﷺ) recited an Ayah asking one to seek Protection Allah, he would seek Protection of Allah. Then he bowed and said, "Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim (My Rubb the Great is free from imperfection)"; his bowing lasted about the same length of time as his standing, (and then on returning to the standing posture after Ruku') he would say, "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana lakal-hamd (Allah listens to him who praises Him. Praise be to You, Our Rubb!)," and he would then stand about the same length of time as he had spent in bowing. He would then prostrate himself and say, "Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la (My Rubb the Supreme is free from imperfection)," and his prostration lasted nearly the same length of time as his standing (Qiyam)..

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: "Which Salat is the best
arabic:
وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : أي الصلاة أفضل؟ قال: 
"طول القنوت" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) was asked: "Which Salat is the best?" He replied, " The best Salat is that in which Qiyam (the duration of standing) is longer."."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: "Which Salat is the best?" He replied, " The best Salat is that in which Qiyam (the duration of standing) is longer.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 498: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The Salat which is dearest to Allah is that of
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص، رضي الله عنهما، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال: 
"أحب الصلاة إلى الله صلاة داود، وأحب الصيام إلى الله صيام داود، كان ينام نصف الليل ويقوم ثلثه وينام سدسه ويصوم يومًا ويفطر يومًا". ((متفق عليه)) .
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin 'Amr (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The Salat which is dearest to Allah is that of (Prophet) Dawud; and As-Saum (the kufunga) which is dearest to Allah is that of (Prophet) Dawud. He used to sleep half the night, get up to perform Salat for one-third of it, then sleep through the remaining one-sixth of it; and he used to observe Saum on alternative days."."
english: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The Salat which is dearest to Allah is that of (Prophet) Dawud; and As-Saum (the fasting) which is dearest to Allah is that of (Prophet) Dawud. He used to sleep half the night, get up to perform Salat for one-third of it, then sleep through the remaining one-sixth of it; and he used to observe Saum on alternative days.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 499: Kitabu cha Fadhila za Amali na Ibada

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Every night there is a special time
arabic:
وعن جابر رضي اللله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يقول: 
"إن في الليل لساعة، لا يوافقها رجل مسلم يسأل الله تعالى خيرًا من أمر الدنيا والآخرة، إلا أعطاه إياه، وذلك كل ليلة" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "Every night there is a special time during which whatever a Muislamu asks Allah of any good relating to this life or the Hereafter, it will be granted to him; and this moment comes every night."."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Every night there is a special time during which whatever a Muslim asks Allah of any good relating to this life or the Hereafter, it will be granted to him; and this moment comes every night.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If anyone falls asleep and therefore fails to
arabic:

"من نام عن حزبه، أو عن شيء منه، فقرأه فيما بين صلاة الفجر وصلاة الظهر، كتب له كأنما قرأه من الليل" ((رواه مسلم)).

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "May Allah show mercy to a man who gets up duri
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه، قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"رحم الله رجلا قام من الليل، فصلى وأيقظ امرأته، فإن أبت نضح في وجهها الماء، ورحم الله امرأة قامت من الليل فصلت، وأيقظت زوجها فإن أبي نضحت في وجهه الماء" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "May Allah show mercy to a man who gets up during the night and performs Salat, awakens his wife to pray and if she refuses, he sprinkles water on her face (to make her get up). May Allah show mercy to a woman who gets up during the night and performs Salat, awakens her husband for the same purpose; and if he refuses, she sprinkles water on his face."."

May Allah show mercy to a woman who gets up during the night and performs Salat, awakens her husband for the same purpose; and if he refuses, she sprinkles water on his face.".
