chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 878: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 878 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey and there was a woman from
arabic:
وعن عمران بن الحصين رضي الله عنه الله عنهما قال: بينما رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في بعض أسفاره، وامرأة من الأنصار على ناقة، فضجرت، فلعنتها، فسمع ذلك رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: 
"خذوا ما عليها ودعوها، فإنها ملعونة" قال عمران: فكأني أراها الآن تمشي في الناس ما يَعرض لها أحد. ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Imran bin Husain (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "We were with the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) on a journey and there was a woman from the Ansar riding a she-camel. She abused and invoked curse upon it. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) heard it and said, "Off load the she- camel and set it free because it has been cursed."."
english: 'Imran bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with him) said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey and there was a woman from the Ansar riding a she-camel. She abused and invoked curse upon it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) heard it and said, "Off load the she- camel and set it free because it has been cursed.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 879: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 879 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: A young woman was riding a she-camel on which there was the luggage of people
arabic:
وعن أبي برزة نضلة بن عبيد الأسلمي رضي الله عنه قال بينما جارية على ناقة عليها بعض متاع القوم، إذ بصرت بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، وتضايق بهم الجبل، فقالت: حل، اللهم العنها. فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"لا تصاحبنا ناقة عليها لعنة" ((رواه مسلم)). قوله: حل بفتح الحاء المهملة، وإسكان اللام وهي كلمة لزجر الإبل واعلم أن هذا الحديث قد يستشكل معناه ولا إشكال فيه بل المراد النهي أن تصاحبهم تلك الناقة وليس فيه نهي عن بيعها وذبحها وركوبها في غير صحبة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بل كل ذلك وما سواه من التصرفات جائز لا منع منه إلا من مصاحبته صلى الله عليه وسلم بها لأن هذه التصرفات كلها كانت جائزة فمنع بعض منها فبقي الباقي على ما كان والله أعلم
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Barzah Nadlah bin 'Ubaid Al-Aslami (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "A young woman was riding a she-camel on which there was the luggage of people. Suddenly she saw Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake). The pass of the mountain became narrow for her people (because of fear). The young woman said to the she-camel: "Go ahead." When it did not move, she said, "O Allah! Curse it." Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The she-camel that has been cursed should not accompany us."."
english: Abu Barzah Nadlah bin 'Ubaid Al-Aslami (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A young woman was riding a she-camel on which there was the luggage of people. Suddenly she saw the Prophet (ﷺ). The pass of the mountain became narrow for her people (because of fear). The young woman said to the she-camel: "Go ahead." When it did not move, she said, "O Allah! Curse it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The she-camel that has been cursed should not accompany us.".

"لا يرمي رجل رجلا بالفسق أو الكفر، إلا ارتدت عليه، إن لم يكن صاحبه كذلك" ((رواه البخاري)).

"المتسابان ما قالا فعلى البادي منهما حتى يعتدي المظلوم" ((رواه مسلم)).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 883: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 883 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: A drunkard was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ)
arabic: وعنه قال: أتي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم برجل قد شرب قال: "اضربوه" قال أبو هريرة: فمنا الضارب بيده، والضارب بنعله، والضارب بثوبه. فلما انصرف، قال بعض القوم: أخزاك الله، قال: "لا تقولوا هذا، لا تُعينوا عليه الشيطان" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "A drunkard was brought to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake). He said, "Give him a beating." Then some beat him with their hands, some with their shoes, and some with (a folded) piece of cloth. When he left, someone said to him: "May Allah disgrace you!" Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Do not help Satan overcome him by uttering such words."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A drunkard was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ). He said, "Give him a beating." Then some beat him with their hands, some with their shoes, and some with (a folded) piece of cloth. When he left, someone said to him: "May Allah disgrace you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not help Satan overcome him by uttering such words.".

arabic:

"من أحب أن يزحزح عن النار، ويدخل الجنة، فلتأته منيته وهو يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر، وليأتِ إلى الناس الذي يحب أن يؤتى  إليه" ((رواه مسلم)). وهو بعض حديث طويل سبق في باب طاعة ولاة الأمور.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 888: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 888 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not harbour grudge against one another, nor jealousy,
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"لا تباغضوا، ولا تحاسدوا ولا تدابروا، ولا تقاطعوا، وكونوا عباد الله إخوانًا، ولا يحل لمسلم أن يهجر أخاه فوق ثلاث" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Do not harbour grudge against one another, nor jealousy, nor enmity; and do not show your backs to one another; and become as fellow brothers and slaves of Allah. It is not halali for a Muislamu to avoid speaking with his brother beyond three days."."
english: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not harbour grudge against one another, nor jealousy, nor enmity; and do not show your backs to one another; and become as fellow brothers and slaves of Allah. It is not lawful for a Muslim to avoid speaking with his brother beyond three days.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The gates of Jannah are opened on Mondays and
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "تُفتح أبواب الجنة يوم الاثنين ويوم الخميس، فيغفر لكل عبد لا يشرك بالله شيئًا، إلا رجلا كانت بينه وبين أخيه شحناء فيقال: أنظروا هذين حتى يصطلحا! أنظروا هذين حتى يصطلحا!" swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The gates of Jannah are opened on Mondays and Thursdays, and then every slave (of Allah) is granted msamaha if he does not associate anything with Allah in worship. But the person in whose heart there is rancour against his (Muislamu) brother, they will not be pardoned and with regard to them it will be said twice: 'Hold both of them until they are reconciled with each other."'."

But the person in whose heart there is rancour against his (Muslim) brother, they will not be pardoned and with regard to them it will be said twice: 'Hold both of them until they are reconciled with each other."'.

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Beware of envy because envy consumes (destroys) the virtu

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 891: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 891 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the wors
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إياكم والظن، فإن الظن أكذب الحديث، ولا تحسسوا، ولا تجسسوا ولا تنافسوا، ولا تحاسدوا، ولا تباغضوا، ولا تدابروا، وكونوا عباد الله إخوانًا كما أمركم. المسلم أخو المسلم، لا يظلمه، ولا يخذله ولا يحقره. التقوى ههنا، " ويشير إلى صدره "بحسب امرئ من الشر أن يحقر أخاه المسلم، كل المسلم على المسلم حرام: دمه، وعرضه، وماله، إن الله لا ينظر إلى أجسادكم، ولا إلى صوركم، ولكن ينظر إلى قلوبكم وأعمالكم". وفي رواية: "لا تحاسدوا، ولا تباغضوا، ولا تجسسوا، ولا تحسسوا ولا تناجشوا وكونوا عباد الله إخوانًا". 
وفي رواية: "لا تقاطعوا، ولا تدابروا، ولا تباغضوا ولا تحاسدوا، وكونوا عباد الله إخوانًا". وفي رواية: "لا تهاجروا ولا يبع بعضكم على بيع بعض".
((رواه مسلم بكل هذه الروايات، وروى البخاري أكثرها)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales. Do not look for other's faults. Do not spy one another, and do not practise Najsh (means to offer a high price for something in order to allure another customer who is interested in the thing). Do not be jealous of one another and do not nurse enmity against one another. Do not sever ties with one another. Become the slaves of Allah, and be brothers to one another as He commanded. A Muislamu is the brother of a Muislamu. He should neither oppress him nor humiliate him. The piety is here! The piety is here!" While saying so he pointed towards his chest. "It is enough evil for a Muislamu to look down upon his Muislamu brother. All things of a Muislamu are inviolable for his brother in Faith: his blood, his wealth and his honour. Verily, Allah does not look to your bodies nor to your faces but He looks to your hearts and your deeds."Another narration is: "Do not feel envy against one another; do not nurse enmity; do not spy on one another and do not cheat one another. Be Allah's slaves, brethren to one another."Another narration is: "Do not have estranged relations with one another. Do not nurse enmity and do not feel envy against one another. O Allah's worshippers! Be brothers!"Another narration is: "Do not estrange mutual relations and do not intervene into the transaction which is likely to be settled with another person."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales. Do not look for other's faults. Do not spy one another, and do not practise Najsh (means to offer a high price for something in order to allure another customer who is interested in the thing). Do not be jealous of one another and do not nurse enmity against one another. Do not sever ties with one another. Become the slaves of Allah, and be brothers to one another as He commanded. A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim. He should neither oppress him nor humiliate him. The piety is here! The piety is here!" While saying so he pointed towards his chest. "It is enough evil for a Muslim to look down upon his Muslim brother. All things of a Muslim are inviolable for his brother in Faith: his blood, his wealth and his honour. Verily, Allah does not look to your bodies nor to your faces but He looks to your hearts and your deeds."Another narration is: "Do not feel envy against one another; do not nurse enmity; do not spy on one another and do not cheat one another. Be Allah's slaves, brethren to one another."Another narration is: "Do not have estranged relations with one another. Do not nurse enmity and do not feel envy against one another. O Allah's worshippers! Be brothers!"Another narration is: "Do not estrange mutual relations and do not intervene into the transaction which is likely to be settled with another person.".

title: "We have been prohibited from spying (on Muslims) and finding faults (with them)
arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أنه أتي برجل فقيل له، هذا فلان تقطر لحيته خمرًا، فقال: إنَّا قد نهينا عن التجسس، ولكن إن يظهر لنا شئ، نأخذ به". حديث حسن صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد على شرط البخاري ومسلم.
swahili: Kutoka kwa It has been reported that a man was brought before Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) because his beard was giving out smell of wine. Abdullah bin Mas'ud said: ""We have been iliyokatazwa from spying (on Waislamu) and finding faults (with them). But we can take to task only and only if the sin is overt.."
english: It has been reported that a man was brought before Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) because his beard was giving out smell of wine. Ibn Mas'ud said: "We have been prohibited from spying (on Muslims) and finding faults (with them). But we can take to task only and only if the sin is overt..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 896: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 896 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The haughty, even with pride equal to a mustard seed in h
arabic:
وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "لا يدخل الجنة من كان في قلبه مثقال ذرة من كبر" فقال رجل: إن الرجل يحب أن يكون ثوبه حسنًا، ونعله حسنة، فقال: "إن الله جميل يحب الجمال، الكبر بَطَر الحق، وغمط الناس".((رواه مسلم)).  
ومعنى "بَطَر الحق": دفعه، "وغمطهم": احتقارهم، وقد سبق بيانه أوضح من هذا في باب الكبر.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The haughty, even with pride equal to a mustard seed in his heart, will not enter Jannah." A man enquired: "What about that a person likes fine dress and fine shoes?" He said: "Allah is Beautiful and likes beauty. Pride amounts to disclaiming truth out of self- esteem, and despising people ."."
english: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The haughty, even with pride equal to a mustard seed in his heart, will not enter Jannah." A man enquired: "What about that a person likes fine dress and fine shoes?" He said: "Allah is Beautiful and likes beauty. Pride amounts to disclaiming truth out of self- esteem, and despising people .".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 897: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 897 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Once someone said: 'By Allah
arabic:
وعن جُندب بن عبد الله رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"قال رجل: والله لا يغفر الله لفلان، فقال الله عز وجل: من ذا الذي يتألى علي أن لا أغفر لفلان! فإني قد غفرت له، وأحبطت عملك" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jundub bin 'Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Once someone said: 'By Allah! Allah will not forgive such and such (a person).' Thereupon Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious, said: 'Who is he who takes an oath in My Name that I will not grant pardon to so-and-so? I have granted pardon to so-and-so and rendered your matendo mema fruitless."'."
english: Jundub bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Once someone said: 'By Allah! Allah will not forgive such and such (a person).' Thereupon Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious, said: 'Who is he who takes an oath in My Name that I will not grant pardon to so-and-so? I have granted pardon to so-and-so and rendered your good deeds fruitless."'.

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not express pleasure at the misfortune of a

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Two matters are signs of disbelief on the part
arabic:

" اثنتان في الناس هما بهم كفر: الطعن في النسب، والنياحة على الميت" ((رواه مسلم)).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 900: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 900 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who takes up arms against us is none of us;
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: " من حمل علينا السلاح، فليس منا، ومن غشنا، فليس منا" ((رواه مسلم)). 
وفي رواية له أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مر على صبرة طعام، فأدخل يده فيها، فنالت أصابعه بللا، فقال: " ما هذا ياصاحب الطعام؟" قال أصابته السماء يارسول الله، قال: " أفلا جعلته فوق الطعام حتى يراه الناس! من غشنا فليس منا".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who takes up arms against us is none of us; and he who cheats us is none of us.".Another narration of Muislamu is: The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) happened to pass by a heap of corn. He thrust his hand in that (heap) and his fingers felt wetness. He said to the owner of that heap of corn, "What is this?" He replied: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! These have been drenched by rainfall." He remarked, "Why did you not place this (the drenched part of the heap) over the corn so that people might see it? He who deceives is not of us.""
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who takes up arms against us is none of us; and he who cheats us is none of us.".Another narration of Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a heap of corn. He thrust his hand in that (heap) and his fingers felt wetness. He said to the owner of that heap of corn, "What is this?" He replied: "O Messenger of Allah! These have been drenched by rainfall." He remarked, "Why did you not place this (the drenched part of the heap) over the corn so that people might see it? He who deceives is not of us."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 903: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)

title: A man mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he was often deceived in deal
arabic: وعنه قال: ذكر رجل لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه يُخدع في البيوع فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "من بايعت؟ فقل : لا خلابة" ((متفق عليه)). "الخِلابة" بخاء معجمة مكسورة، وباء موحدة: وهي الخديعة.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "A man mentioned to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) that he was often deceived in dealings. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to him, "When you enter into a transaction you should say: "There should be no deception."'."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 905: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 905 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whosoever possesses these four characteristics
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" أربع من كن فيه، كان منافقًا خالصًا، ومن كانت فيه خصلة منهن، كان فيه خصلة من النفاق حتى يدعها: إذا اؤتمن خان، وإذا حدث كذب، وإذا عاهد غدر، وإذا خاصم فجر" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Whosoever possesses these four characteristics is a sheer hypocrite; and anyone who possesses one of them possesses a characteristic of unafiki till he gives it up. These are: when he is entrusted with something, he proves dishonest; when he speaks, he tells a lie; when he makes a covenant, he proves treacherous; and when he quarrels, he behaves in very imprudent, evil, insulting manner."."
english: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whosoever possesses these four characteristics is a sheer hypocrite; and anyone who possesses one of them possesses a characteristic of hypocrisy till he gives it up. These are: when he is entrusted with something, he proves dishonest; when he speaks, he tells a lie; when he makes a covenant, he proves treacherous; and when he quarrels, he behaves in very imprudent, evil, insulting manner.".

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every one who breaks a covenant will have a flag by his b
arabic:
وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال : 
" لكل غادر لواء عند استه يوم القيامة يرفع له بقدر غدره، ألا لا غادر أعظم غدرًا من أمير عامة" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Every one who breaks a covenant will have a flag by his buttocks on the Siku ya Qiyama. It will be raised higher according to the nature of his breach. Behold, there will be no greater a sin with respect to breaking the covenant than that of a ruler who breaks his covenant with the Muislamu masses."."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every one who breaks a covenant will have a flag by his buttocks on the Day of Resurrection. It will be raised higher according to the nature of his breach. Behold, there will be no greater a sin with respect to breaking the covenant than that of a ruler who breaks his covenant with the Muslim masses.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 908: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 908 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I will contend on the Day of R
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" قال الله تعالى: ثلاثة أنا خصمهم يوم القيامة : رجل أعطى بي ثم غدر، ورجل باع حرًا فأكل ثمنه، ورجل استأجر أجيرًا، فاستوفى منه، ولم يعطه أجره" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I will contend on the Siku ya Qiyama against three (types of) people: One who makes a covenant in My Name and then breaks it; one who sells a free man as a slave and devours his price; and one who hires a workman and having taken full work from him, does not pay him his wages."'."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I will contend on the Day of Resurrection against three (types of) people: One who makes a covenant in My Name and then breaks it; one who sells a free man as a slave and devours his price; and one who hires a workman and having taken full work from him, does not pay him his wages."'.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 909: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 909 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) observed: "There are three (types of) people to whom Allah will
arabic:
وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: " ثلاثة لا يكلمهم الله يوم القيامة ولا ينظر  إليهم، ولا يزكيهم ولهم عذاب أليم" قال: فقرأها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثلاث مرار. قال أبو ذر: خابوا وخسروا من هم يا رسول الله؟ قال: المسبل، والمنان، والمنفق سلعته بالحلف الكاذب" ((رواه مسلم)). 
وفي رواية له : " المسبل إزاره" يعني: المسبل إزاره وثوبه أسفل من الكعبين للخُيلاء.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) observed: "There are three (types of) people to whom Allah will neither speak on the Siku ya Qiyama nor look at them nor purify them, and they will have a painful chastisement." The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) repeated it three times. Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) remarked: "They are ruined. Who are they, Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah?" Upon this, the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "One who lets down his lower garments (below his ankels) out of arrogance, one who boasts of his favours done to another; and who sells his goods by taking a false oath."."
english: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) observed: "There are three (types of) people to whom Allah will neither speak on the Day of Resurrection nor look at them nor purify them, and they will have a painful chastisement." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) repeated it three times. Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) remarked: "They are ruined. Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?" Upon this, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "One who lets down his lower garments (below his ankels) out of arrogance, one who boasts of his favours done to another; and who sells his goods by taking a false oath.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 910 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, Allah has revealed to me that you shou
arabic:
وعن عياض بن حمار رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"إن الله تعالى أوحى إلي أن تواضعوا حتى لا يبغي أحد على أحد، ولا يفخر أحد على أحد" ((رواه مسلم)) قال أهل اللغة: البغي: التعدي والاستطالة.
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Iyad bin Himar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Verily, Allah has revealed to me that you should adopt humility. So that no one may wrong another and no one may be disdainful and haughty towards another."."
english: 'Iyad bin Himar (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, Allah has revealed to me that you should adopt humility. So that no one may wrong another and no one may be disdainful and haughty towards another.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 911: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 911 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a person says: 'People have been ruined,
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"إذا قال الرجل: هلك الناس، فهو أهلكهم" ((رواه مسلم)). 
الرواية المشهورة:  أهلكَُهم  برفع الكاف، وروي بنصبها، وهذا هو الحرام، وأما من قاله ذلك عجبًا بنفسه، وتصاغرا للناس، وارتفاعًا عليهم، فهذا هو الحرام، وأما من قاله لما يرى في الناس من نقص في أمر دينهم، وقاله تحزنًا عليهم، وعلى الدين فلا بأس به. هكذا فسره العلماء وفصلوه، ومن قاله من الأئمة الأعلام: مالك بن أنس، والخطابي، والحميدي وآخرون، وقد أوضحته في كتاب  الأذكار .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When a person says: 'People have been ruined, he is the one to be ruined the most."'In another version: "He himself is the most ruined among them.""
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a person says: 'People have been ruined, he is the one to be ruined the most."'In another version: "He himself is the most ruined among them."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 912: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 912 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not desert (stop talking to) one another, d
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"لا تقاطعوا ولا تدابروا، ولا تباغضوا، ولا تحاسدوا، وكونوا عباد الله إخوانًا، ولا يحل لمسلم أن يهجر أخاه فوق ثلاث" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Do not desert (stop talking to) one another, do not nurse hatred towards one another, do not be jealous of one another, and become as fellow brothers and slaves of Allah. It is not halali for a Muislamu to stop talking to his brother (Muislamu) for more than three days.""
english: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not desert (stop talking to) one another, do not nurse hatred towards one another, do not be jealous of one another, and become as fellow brothers and slaves of Allah. It is not lawful for a Muslim to stop talking to his brother (Muslim) for more than three days."

chapter.title_ar: باب 913 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim to desert (stop
arabic:
وعن أبي أيوب رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"لا يحل لمسلم أن يهجر أخاه فوق ثلاث ليال: يلتقيان، فيعرض هذا ويعرض هذا، وخيرهما الذي يبدأ بالسلام" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "It is not halali for a Muislamu to desert (stop talking to) his brother beyond three nights, the one turning one way and the other turning to the other way when they meet, the better of the two is one who is the first to greet the other."."
english: Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim to desert (stop talking to) his brother beyond three nights, the one turning one way and the other turning to the other way when they meet, the better of the two is one who is the first to greet the other.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 914 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "People's deeds are presented before Allah on M
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"تعرض الأعمال في كل اثنين وخميس، فيغفر الله لكل امرئ لا يشرك بالله شيئا، إلا امرءا كانت بينه وبين أخيه شحناء، فيقول: اتركوا هذين حتى يصطلحا" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "People's deeds are presented before Allah on Mondays and Thursdays, and then every slave (of Allah) is granted msamaha (of minor sins) if he does not associate anything with Allah in worship. But the person in whose heart there is rancour against his brother, will not be pardoned. With regard to them, it is said twice: 'Hold these two until they are reconciled'."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "People's deeds are presented before Allah on Mondays and Thursdays, and then every slave (of Allah) is granted forgiveness (of minor sins) if he does not associate anything with Allah in worship. But the person in whose heart there is rancour against his brother, will not be pardoned. With regard to them, it is said twice: 'Hold these two until they are reconciled'.".

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying, "The Satan has despaired of being
arabic:
وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: 
"إن الشيطان قد يئس أن يعبده المصلون في جزيرة العرب، ولكن في والتحريش بينهم " ((رواه مسلم)). 
التحريش: الإفساد وتغيير قلوبهم وتقاطعهم.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) as saying, "The Satan has despaired of being worshipped by those who engage in swala in the Arabian Peninsula but (has not lost hope) in creating dissension among them."."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying, "The Satan has despaired of being worshipped by those who engage in prayer in the Arabian Peninsula but (has not lost hope) in creating dissension among them.".

title: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Whosoever forsakes his brother for a year is li

"من هجر أخاه سنة فهو كسفك دمه".((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Khirash Hadrad bin Abu Hadrad Al-Aslami (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I heard Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "Whosoever forsakes his brother for a year is like one who sheds his blood."."
english: Abu Khirash Hadrad bin Abu Hadrad Al-Aslami (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Whosoever forsakes his brother for a year is like one who sheds his blood.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 918: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 918 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not permissible for a believer to forsak
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"لا يحل لمؤمن أن يهجر مؤمنًا فوق ثلاث، فإن مرت به ثلاث، فليلقه، وليسلم عليه، فإن رد عليه السلام، فقد اشتركا في الأجر، وإن لم يرد عليه، فقد باء بالإثم، وخرج المسلم من الهجرة". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن قال أبو داود: إذا كانت الهجرة لله تعالى، فليس من هذا في شيء)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "It is not permissible for a muumini to forsake his (Muislamu) brother for more than three days. If three days have passed, he should meet him and greet him; and if other responds to it they will both share the reward; but if he does not respond, he will bear his sin and the one who (has taken the initiative to) greet (the other) will be absolved of the sin of forsaking (one's brother in Faith)."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not permissible for a believer to forsake his (Muslim) brother for more than three days. If three days have passed, he should meet him and greet him; and if other responds to it they will both share the reward; but if he does not respond, he will bear his sin and the one who (has taken the initiative to) greet (the other) will be absolved of the sin of forsaking (one's brother in Faith).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 919: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 919 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "In the presence of three people, two should no
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إذا كانوا ثلاثة فلا يتناجى اثنان دون الثالث" ((متفق عليه)). 
((ورواه أبو دواد وزاد: قال أبو صالح: قلت لابن عمر: فأربعة؟ قال: لا يضرك. ورواه مالك في الموطأ: عن عبد الله بن دينار قال: كنت أنا وابن عمر عند دار خالد بن عقبة التي في السوق، فجاء رجل يريد أن يناجيه، وليس مع ابن عمر أحد غيري، فدعا ابن عمر رجلا آخر حتى كنا أربعة فقال لي وللرجل الثالث الذي دعا: استأخرا شيئًا، فإني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "لا يتناجى اثنان دون واحد".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "In the presence of three people, two should not hold secret counsel, to the exclusion of the third.".In Abu Dawud, Abu Salih related: I asked Ibn 'Umar: "What if there are four people." He said, "There is no harm in that."Malik reported in Al-Muwatta that 'Abdullah bin Dinar related: Ibn 'Umar and I were together in Khalid bin 'Uqbah's house which was situated in the market place. A man came to consult Ibn 'Umar. None besides me was present. Ibn 'Umar called another man in and we became four and said to me and the man he had called: Move away a bit because I have heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "The two people should not hold secret counsel together excluding the third.""
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "In the presence of three people, two should not hold secret counsel, to the exclusion of the third.".In Abu Dawud, Abu Salih related: I asked Ibn 'Umar: "What if there are four people." He said, "There is no harm in that."Malik reported in Al-Muwatta that 'Abdullah bin Dinar related: Ibn 'Umar and I were together in Khalid bin 'Uqbah's house which was situated in the market place. A man came to consult Ibn 'Umar. None besides me was present. Ibn 'Umar called another man in and we became four and said to me and the man he had called: Move away a bit because I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The two people should not hold secret counsel together excluding the third."

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When three of you are together, two of you mus

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 921: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 921 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A woman was punished in Hell because of a cat
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"عذبت امرأة في هِرة حبستها حتى ماتت، فدخلت فيها النار، لا هي أطعمتها وسقتها، إذ هي حبستها، ولا هي تركتها تأكل من خشاش الأرض" ((متفق عليه)). ((خشاش الأرض)) يفتح الخاء المعجمة وبالشين المعجمة المكررة، وهي: هوامها وحشراتها.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "A woman was punished in Motoni because of a cat which she had confined until it died. She did not give it to eat or to drink when it was confined, nor did she free it so that it might eat the vermin of the earth.""
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A woman was punished in Hell because of a cat which she had confined until it died. She did not give it to eat or to drink when it was confined, nor did she free it so that it might eat the vermin of the earth."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 922: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 922 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I happened to pass by some lads of the Quraish who had tied a bird at which they
arabic:
وعنه أنه مر بفتيان من قريش قد نصبوا طيرًا وهم يرمونه، وقد جعلوا لصاحب الطير كل خاطئة من نبلهم، فلما رأوا ابن عمر تفرقوا، فقال ابن عمر: من فعل هذا؟ لعن الله من فعل هذا، إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لعن من اتخذ شيئًا فيه روح غرضًا. ((متفق عليه)). 

"الغَرَض" : بفتح الغين المعجمة والراء، وهو الهدف، والشيء الذي يرمى إليه.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "I happened to pass by some lads of the Quraish who had tied a bird at which they have been shooting arrows. Every arrow that they missed came into the possession of the owner of the bird. No sooner had they seen Ibn 'Umar, they dispersed. Thereupon, Ibn 'Umar said: "Who has done this? May Allah curse him who has done so. Verily, the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) has cursed anyone who makes a live thing the target (of one's marksmanship)."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: I happened to pass by some lads of the Quraish who had tied a bird at which they have been shooting arrows. Every arrow that they missed came into the possession of the owner of the bird. No sooner had they seen Ibn 'Umar, they dispersed. Thereupon, Ibn 'Umar said: "Who has done this? May Allah curse him who has done so. Verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has cursed anyone who makes a live thing the target (of one's marksmanship).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 924: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 924 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I was the seventh child of Banu Muqarrin and we had only one slave-girl
arabic:
وعن أبي علي سويد بن مقرن رضي الله عنه قال: لقد رأيتني سابع سبعة من بني مقرن ما لنا خادم إلا واحدة لطمها أصغرنا فأمرنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن نعتقها. ((رواه مسلم)). ورواية: 
"سابع إخوة لي".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Ali Suwaid bin Muqarrin (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I was the seventh child of Banu Muqarrin and we had only one slave-girl. When the youngest of us once happened to slap her (on the face) the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) ordered us to set her free.."
english: Abu Ali Suwaid bin Muqarrin (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I was the seventh child of Banu Muqarrin and we had only one slave-girl. When the youngest of us once happened to slap her (on the face) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered us to set her free..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 925: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 925 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I was beating my slave with a whip when I heard a voice behind me which said: "A
arabic:
وعن أبي مسعود البدري رضي الله عنه قال: "كنتُ أضرب غلامًا لي بالوسط، فسمعت صوتًا من خلفي: "اعلم أبا مسعود" فلم أفهم الصوت من الغضب، فلما دنا مني إذا هو رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فإذا هو يقول: "اعلم أبا مسعود أن الله أقدرُ عليك منك على هذا الغلام" فقلت: لا أضرب مملوكًا بعده أبدًا. 
((وفي رواية: فسقط السوط من يدي من هيبته))
((وفي رواية: فقلت: يارسول الله هو حر لوجه الله تعالى، فقال: "أما لو لم تفعل، للفحتك النار، أو لمستك النار" ((رواه مسلم بهذه الروايات)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I was beating my slave with a whip when I heard a voice behind me which said: "Abu Mas'ud! Bear in mind..." I did not recognize the voice for the intense anger I was in. Abu Mas'ud added: As he came near me, I found that he was the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) who was saying, "Abu Mas'ud! Bear in mind that Allah has more dominance upon you than you have upon your slave." Then I said: "I will never beat any slave in future."Another narration is: The whip dropped from my hand in awe of Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake).Still another narration is: I said: "He is free for the sake of Allah." He (ﷺ) said, "If you had not done this, you would have been scorched by the Fire."."
english: Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I was beating my slave with a whip when I heard a voice behind me which said: "Abu Mas'ud! Bear in mind..." I did not recognize the voice for the intense anger I was in. Abu Mas'ud added: As he came near me, I found that he was the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who was saying, "Abu Mas'ud! Bear in mind that Allah has more dominance upon you than you have upon your slave." Then I said: "I will never beat any slave in future."Another narration is: The whip dropped from my hand in awe of the Prophet (ﷺ).Still another narration is: I said: "He is free for the sake of Allah." He (ﷺ) said, "If you had not done this, you would have been scorched by the Fire.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 926 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The expiation for beating or slapping a slave on the face

وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"من ضرب غلامًا له حدًا لم يأتهِ، أو لطمه، فإن كفارته أن يعتقه" ((رواه مسلم)).

english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The expiation for beating or slapping a slave on the face for something he has not done is to set him free.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 927: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 927 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: "What is the matter
arabic: وعن هشام بن حكيم بن حزام رضي الله عنه أنه مر بالشام على أناس من الأنباط، وقد أقيموا في الشمس، وصُب على رءوسهم الزيت فقال: ما هذا؟ يُعذبون في الخراج وفي رواية: حُبسوا في الجزية. فقال هشام: أشهد لسمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول: "إن الله يعذب الذين يعذبون الناس في الدنيا" فدخل على الأمير، فحدثه، فأمر بهم فخلوا" ((رواه مسلم. "الأنباط" الفلاحون من العجم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa It has been narrated that Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) happened to pass by some (non-Arab) farmers of Syria who had been made to stand in the sun, and olive oil was poured on their heads. He said: ""What is the matter?" He was told that they had been detained for the non-payment of Jizyah. (Another narration says that they were being tortured for not having paid Al-Kharaj). Thereupon Hisham said: "I bear testimony to the fact that I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, 'Allah will torment those who torment people in the world."' Then he proceeded towards their Amir and reported this Hadith to him. The Amir then issued orders for their release.."
english: It has been narrated that Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam (May Allah be pleased with them) happened to pass by some (non-Arab) farmers of Syria who had been made to stand in the sun, and olive oil was poured on their heads. He said: "What is the matter?" He was told that they had been detained for the non-payment of Jizyah. (Another narration says that they were being tortured for not having paid Al-Kharaj). Thereupon Hisham said: "I bear testimony to the fact that I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, 'Allah will torment those who torment people in the world."' Then he proceeded towards their Amir and reported this Hadith to him. The Amir then issued orders for their release..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 928: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 928 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw an ass which had been branded on the face
arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: رأى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حمارًا موسوم الوجه، فأنكر ذلك؟ فقال: والله لا أسمه إلا أقصى شيء من الوجه، وأمر بحماره، فكوي في جاعرتيه، فهو أول من كوى الجاعرتين. ((رواه مسلم)).((الجاعرتان)): ناحية الوركين حول الدبر.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saw an ass which had been branded on the face. He disapproved of it. Upon this Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said, "By Allah, I shall not brand (the animal) but on a part at a distance from the face." Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) then commanded branding on the hips; he was the first person to brand the animals on hips.."
english: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw an ass which had been branded on the face. He disapproved of it. Upon this Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said, "By Allah, I shall not brand (the animal) but on a part at a distance from the face." Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) then commanded branding on the hips; he was the first person to brand the animals on hips..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 929: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 929 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: An ass with a brand on the face happened to pass before the Prophet (ﷺ)
arabic:
وعنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : مر عليه حمار قد وُسم في وجهه، فقال: 
"لعن الله الذي وسمه" ((رواه مسلم. وفي رواية لمسلم أيضًا: نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الضرب في الوجه، وعن الوسم في الوجه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "An ass with a brand on the face happened to pass before Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake). Thereupon he said, "May Allah curse the one who has branded it (on the face).".Another narration in Muislamu is: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) iliyokatazwa us from hitting across the face and branding on the face (of an animal).""
english: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said: An ass with a brand on the face happened to pass before the Prophet (ﷺ). Thereupon he said, "May Allah curse the one who has branded it (on the face).".Another narration in Muslim is: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited us from hitting across the face and branding on the face (of an animal)."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 930: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 930 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent us on an expedition and said to us, "If you find
arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: بعثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في بعث فقال: "إن وجدتم فلانًا وفلانًا" لرجلين من قريش سماهما "فأحرقوهما بالنار" ثم قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حين أردنا الخروج: "إني كنت أمرتكم أن تحرقوا فلانًا وفلانًا، وإن النار لا يعذب بها إلا الله، فإن وجدتموهما فاقتلوهما" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) sent us on an expedition and said to us, "If you find so- and-so (he named two persons belonging to the Quraish) commit them to the fire." When we were on the verge of departure, he said to us, "I ordered you to burn so-and-so, but it is Allah Alone Who punishes with the fire. So if you find them put them to death."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent us on an expedition and said to us, "If you find so- and-so (he named two persons belonging to the Quraish) commit them to the fire." When we were on the verge of departure, he said to us, "I ordered you to burn so-and-so, but it is Allah Alone Who punishes with the fire. So if you find them put them to death.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 931: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 931 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey when he drew apart (to reli
arabic:
وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: كنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في سفر، فانطلق لحاجته، فرأينا حمرة معها فرخان، فأخذنا فرخيها، فجاءت الحمرة فجعلت تعرش فجاء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: "من فجع هذه بولدها؟ ردوا ولدها  إليها" ورأى قرية نمل قد حرقناها، فقال: "من حرق هذه؟" قلنا: نحن. قال: "إنه لا ينبغي أن يعذِّب بالنار إلا رب النار".
قوله:  قرية نمل  معناه: موضع النمل مع النمل.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "We were with the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) in a journey when he drew apart (to relieve nature). In his absence, we saw a red bird which had two young ones with it. We caught them and the red mother bird came, beating the earth with its wings. In the meantime Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) returned and said, "Who has put this bird to distress on account of its young? Return them to her." He (ﷺ) also noticed a mound of ants which we had burnt up. He asked, "Who has set fire to this?" We replied: "We have done so." He (ﷺ) said, "None can chastise with fire except the Rubb of the fire."."
english: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey when he drew apart (to relieve nature). In his absence, we saw a red bird which had two young ones with it. We caught them and the red mother bird came, beating the earth with its wings. In the meantime the Prophet (ﷺ) returned and said, "Who has put this bird to distress on account of its young? Return them to her." He (ﷺ) also noticed a mound of ants which we had burnt up. He asked, "Who has set fire to this?" We replied: "We have done so." He (ﷺ) said, "None can chastise with fire except the Rubb of the fire.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 932: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 932 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is an act of oppression on the part of a pe
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "مطل الغني ظلم وإذا أُتبع أحدكم على مليء فليتبع" ((متفق عليه. معنى "أتبع": أحيل)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "It is an act of oppression on the part of a person to procrastinate in fulfilling his obligation; if the repayment of a debt due to any of you is undertaken by a rich person, you should agree to the substitution."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is an act of oppression on the part of a person to procrastinate in fulfilling his obligation; if the repayment of a debt due to any of you is undertaken by a rich person, you should agree to the substitution.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 933: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 933 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who gives something (to someone) as a gift
arabic:
عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "الذي يعود في هبته كالكلب يرجع في قيئه" ((متفق عليه)). 
((وفي رواية: "مثل الذي يرجع في صدقته، كمثل الكلب يقيء، ثم يعود في قيئه فيأكله". وفي رواية: "العائد في هبته كالعائد في قيئه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Abbas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who gives something (to someone) as a gift and then gets it back (from him or her) is like a dog which eats its own vomit."Another narration is: "He who gets back his sadaka is like a dog which vomits and then returns to that and eats it."."
english: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who gives something (to someone) as a gift and then gets it back (from him or her) is like a dog which eats its own vomit."Another narration is: "He who gets back his charity is like a dog which vomits and then returns to that and eats it.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 934: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 934 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I donated a horse in the way of Allah
arabic:
وعن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه قال: حملت على فرس في سبيل الله فأضاعه الذي كان عنده، فأردت أن أشتريه، وظننت أنه يبيعه برخص، فسألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: "لا تشتره ولا تعد في صدقتك وإن أعطاكه بدرهم، فإن العائد في صدقته كالعائد في قيئه" ((متفق عليه)). 
قوله: "حملت على فرس في سبيل الله" معناه: تصدقت به على بعض المجاهدين.
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I donated a horse in the way of Allah. Its new possessor did not treat it properly. I made my mind to buy it because I thought that he would sell it at a cheap price (now that it became weak and emaciated). I asked Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) about it, whereupon he said, "Do not buy it and do not get back your sadaka, for one who gets back the sadaka is like a dog that eats its own vomit.""
english: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I donated a horse in the way of Allah. Its new possessor did not treat it properly. I made my mind to buy it because I thought that he would sell it at a cheap price (now that it became weak and emaciated). I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it, whereupon he said, "Do not buy it and do not get back your charity, for one who gets back the charity is like a dog that eats its own vomit."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 935: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 935 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Keep away from the seven fatalities
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "اجتنبوا السبع الموبقات" قالوا: يا رسول الله وما هن؟ قال: "الشرك بالله، والسحر وقتل النفس التي حرم الله إلا بالحق، وأكل الربا، وأكل مال اليتيم، والتولي يوم الزحف، وقذف المحصنات المؤمنات الغافلات" ((متفق عليه. "الموبقات" المهلكات)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Keep away from the seven fatalities." It was asked: "What are they, Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship (i.e., committing an act of Shirk), sorcery, killing of one whom Allah has declared inviolable without a just cause, devouring the property of an orphan, the eating of usury (Riba), fleeing from the battlefield and accusing chaste believing women, who never even think of anything touching their chastity."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Keep away from the seven fatalities." It was asked: "What are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship (i.e., committing an act of Shirk), sorcery, killing of one whom Allah has declared inviolable without a just cause, devouring the property of an orphan, the eating of usury (Riba), fleeing from the battlefield and accusing chaste believing women, who never even think of anything touching their chastity.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the one who accepts Ar-Riba (the usury) and th

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 937: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 937 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Almighty Allah says, 'I am the One Who is most
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: 
" قال الله تعالى: أنا أغنى الشركاء عن الشرك، من عمل عملا أشرك فيه معي غيري، تركته وشركه" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Almighty Allah says, 'I am the One Who is most free from want of partners. He who does a thing for the sake of someone else beside Me, I discard him and his polytheism.."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 938: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 938 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The first to be judged on the Day of
arabic:
وعنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: 
" إن أول الناس يقضى يوم القيامة عليه رجل اسُتشهد، فأتي به، فعرفه نعمته، فعرفها، قال: فما عملت فيها؟ قال: قاتلت فيك حتى اسُتشهدت، قال: كذبت، ولكنك قاتلت لأن يقال: جريء، فقد قيل، ثم أمر به، فسحب على وجهه حتى ألقي في النار. ورجل تعلم العلم وعلمه، وقرأ القرآن، فأتي به، فعرفه نعمه فعرفها. قال فما عملت فيها؟ قال تعلمت العلم وعلمته وقرأت فيك القرآن. قال كذبت، ولكنك تعلمت ليقال: عالم. وقرأت القرآن ليقال: هو قارئ، فقد قيل: ثم أُمر به، فسُحب على وجهه حتى ألقي في النار، ورجل وسع الله عليه، وأعطاه من أصناف المال، فأتي به فعرفه نعمه، فعرفها. قال: فما عملت فيها ؟ قال: ما تركت من سبيل تحب أن ينفق فيها إلا أنفقت فيها لك، قال: كذبت، ولكنك فعلت ليقال: جواد، فقد قيل، ثم أُمر به فسُحب على وجهه ثم ألقي في النار" ((رواه مسلم)).
 جَريء  بفتح الجيم وكسر الراء وبالمد، أي: شجاع حاذق
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "The first to be judged on the Siku ya Qiyama will be a man who had died as a martyr. He will be brought forward. Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. Then He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I fought for Your Cause till I was martyred.' Allah will say: 'You have lied. You fought so that people might call you courageous; and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Motoni. Next a man who had acquired and imparted knowledge and read the Qur'an will be brought forward, Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. Then He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I acquired knowledge and taught it, and read the Qur'an for Your sake.' Allah will say to him: 'You have lied. You acquired knowledge so that people might call you a learned (man), and you read the Qur'an so that they might call you a reciter, and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him, and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Motoni. Next a man whom Allah had made affluent and to whom Allah had given plenty of wealth, will be brought forward, Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I did not neglect any of the ways You liked wealth to be spent liberally for Your sake'. Allah will say to him: 'You have lied. You did it so that people might call you generous, and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Motoni."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The first to be judged on the Day of Resurrection will be a man who had died as a martyr. He will be brought forward. Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. Then He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I fought for Your Cause till I was martyred.' Allah will say: 'You have lied. You fought so that people might call you courageous; and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell. Next a man who had acquired and imparted knowledge and read the Qur'an will be brought forward, Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. Then He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I acquired knowledge and taught it, and read the Qur'an for Your sake.' Allah will say to him: 'You have lied. You acquired knowledge so that people might call you a learned (man), and you read the Qur'an so that they might call you a reciter, and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him, and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell. Next a man whom Allah had made affluent and to whom Allah had given plenty of wealth, will be brought forward, Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I did not neglect any of the ways You liked wealth to be spent liberally for Your sake'. Allah will say to him: 'You have lied. You did it so that people might call you generous, and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 939: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 939 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Some people told me, "We visit our rulers and we tell them things contrary to th
arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن ناسًا قالوا له: إنا ندخل على سلاطيننا فنقول لهم بخلاف ما نتكلم إذا خرجنا من عندهم؟ قال ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما: كنا نعد هذا نفاقًا على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa `Abdullah bin `Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "Some people told me, "We visit our rulers and we tell them things contrary to those which we say when we depart from them." `Abdullah bin `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) replied: "In the era of the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) we considered this to be an act of unafiki." ."
english:
`Abdullah bin `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: Some people told me, "We visit our rulers and we tell them things contrary to those which we say when we depart from them."
`Abdullah bin `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) replied: "In the era of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we considered this to be an act of hypocrisy."

.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 940: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 940 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who so acts to show off, Allah will disgrace him on th
arabic:
وعن جُندب بن عبد الله بن سفيان رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : "من سمَّع سمَّع الله به، ومن يرائي الله يرائي به" ((متفق عليه)). ((رواه مسلم أيضًا من رواية ابن عباس رضي الله عنه)). 
"سمَّع" بتشديد الميم، ومعناه: أظهر عمله للناس رياء " سمَّع الله به" أي فضحه يوم القيامة، ومعنى: " من راءى" أي: من أظهر للناس العمل الصالح ليعظم عندهم "راءى الله به" أي: أظهر سريرته على رءوس الخلائق.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jundub (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who so acts to show off, Allah will disgrace him on the Siku ya Qiyama, and he who does matendo mema so that people (may hold him in high esteem), Allah will expose his hidden evil intentions before the people on the Siku ya Qiyama."."
english: Jundub (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who so acts to show off, Allah will disgrace him on the Day of Resurrection, and he who does good deeds so that people (may hold him in high esteem), Allah will expose his hidden evil intentions before the people on the Day of Resurrection.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 941: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 941 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A person who acquires (religious) knowledge, w
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم 
" من تعلم علمًا مما يبتغى به وجه الله عز وجل لا يتعلمه إلا ليصيب به عرضًا من الدنيا، لم يجد عَرف الجنة يوم القيامة"  يعني ريحها. رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح والأحاديث في الباب كثير مشهورة.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "A person who acquires (religious) knowledge, which is (normally) acquired to gain the Pleasure of Allah, (for the sole reason) to secure worldly comforts will not even smell the fragrance of Jannah on the Siku ya Qiyama (i.e., will not enter Jannah)."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A person who acquires (religious) knowledge, which is (normally) acquired to gain the Pleasure of Allah, (for the sole reason) to secure worldly comforts will not even smell the fragrance of Jannah on the Day of Resurrection (i.e., will not enter Jannah).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 942: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 942 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: "Tell us about a person who does some good
arabic:
وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه قال: قيل لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : أرأيت الرجل يعمل العمل من الخير، ويحمده الناس عليه؟ قال: 
" تلك عاجل بشرى المؤمن" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) was asked: "Tell us about a person who does some good deed and people praise him, will this be considered as showing off?" He replied, "This is the glad tidings which a muumini receives (in this life)."."
english: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: "Tell us about a person who does some good deed and people praise him, will this be considered as showing off?" He replied, "This is the glad tidings which a believer receives (in this life).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 943: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 943 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has written the very portion of Zina which a man wi
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
"كُتب على ابن آدم نصيبه من الزنا مدرك ذلك لا محالة: العينان زناهما النظر، والأذنان زناهما الاستماع، واللسان زناه الكلام، واليد زناها البطش، والرجل زناها الخطا، والقلب يهوى ويتمنى، ويصدق ذلك الفرج أو يكذبه". ((متفق عليه. وهذا لفظ مسلم، ورواية البخاري مختصرة)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Allah has written the very portion of Zina which a man will indulge in. There will be no escape from it. The Zina of the eye is the (lustful) look, the Zina of the ears is the listening (to voluptuous songs or talk), the Zina of the tongue is (the licentious) speech, the Zina of the hand is the (lustful) grip, the Zina of the feet is the walking (to the place where he intends to commit Zina), the heart yearns and desires and the private parts approve all that or disapprove it.".This is the wording in Muislamu; Al-Bukhari wording is a bit short."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has written the very portion of Zina which a man will indulge in. There will be no escape from it. The Zina of the eye is the (lustful) look, the Zina of the ears is the listening (to voluptuous songs or talk), the Zina of the tongue is (the licentious) speech, the Zina of the hand is the (lustful) grip, the Zina of the feet is the walking (to the place where he intends to commit Zina), the heart yearns and desires and the private parts approve all that or disapprove it.".This is the wording in Muslim; Al-Bukhari wording is a bit short.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 944: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 944 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Avoid sitting on roadsides
arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخُدري رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: "إياكم والجلوس في الطرقات". قالوا: يا رسول الله ما لنا من مجالسنا بُد نتحدث فيها. فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "فإذا أبيتم إلا المجلس، فأعطوا الطريق حقه" قالوا: وما حق الطريق يا رسول الله؟ قال: "غض البصر،  وكف الأذى، ورد السلام، والأمر المعروف والنهي عن المنكر" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Avoid sitting on roadsides." His Companions said: "O Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), there is no other alternative but to sit there to talk." Thereupon the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If you have to sit at all, then fulfill the rights of the road." They asked: "What are their rights?" Thereupon he said, "Lowering the gaze (so that you may not stare at unhalali things); refraining from doing some harm to others, responding to greeting (i.e., saying 'Wa'alaikumus- salam' to one another) and commanding the good and forbidding the evil."."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Avoid sitting on roadsides." His Companions said: "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), there is no other alternative but to sit there to talk." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If you have to sit at all, then fulfill the rights of the road." They asked: "What are their rights?" Thereupon he said, "Lowering the gaze (so that you may not stare at unlawful things); refraining from doing some harm to others, responding to greeting (i.e., saying 'Wa'alaikumus- salam' to one another) and commanding the good and forbidding the evil.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 945: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 945 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: We were sitting and talking on a platform in front of our house when the Messeng
arabic: وعن أبي طلحة زيد بن سهل رضي الله عنه قال: كنا قعودًا بالأفنية نتحدث فيها فجاء رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقالم علينا فقال: "ما لكم ولمجالس الصعدات؟ فقلنا: إنما قعدنا لغير ما بأس، قعدنا نتذاكر، ونتحدث. قال: "إما لا فأدوا حقها: غض البصر، ورد السلام، وحسن الكلام" ((رواه مسلم)). "الصُّعُدات" بضم الصاد والعين، أي: الطرقات.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Talhah Zaid bin Sahl (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "We were sitting and talking on a platform in front of our house when the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) stopped by us and said, "Why do you sit on roads? Avoid sitting in them." We replied: "We sit there intending no harm. We only sit and discuss (religious) knowledge and talk." He said, "If you have to sit, you should fulfill the rights of the road: Lower your gaze, respond to greetings and talk in a good manner."."
english: Abu Talhah Zaid bin Sahl (May Allah be pleased with him) said: We were sitting and talking on a platform in front of our house when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stopped by us and said, "Why do you sit on roads? Avoid sitting in them." We replied: "We sit there intending no harm. We only sit and discuss (religious) knowledge and talk." He said, "If you have to sit, you should fulfill the rights of the road: Lower your gaze, respond to greetings and talk in a good manner.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 947: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 947 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with Maimunah (May Allah be pleased
arabic: وعن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت: كنت عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وعنده ميمونة، فأقبل ابن أم مكتوم، وذلك بعد أن أُمرنا بالحجاب فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : "احتجبا منه" فقلنا: يا رسول الله إلىس هو أعمى لا يبصرنا، ولا يعرفنا؟ فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : "أفعمياوان أنتما ألستما تبصرانه؟!" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي: وقال حديث حسن صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Salamah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I was with the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) along with Maimunah (May Allah be pleased with her) when Ibn Umm Maktum (May Allah be pleased with him) (who was blind) came to visit him. (This incident took place after the order of Hijab). Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) told us to hide ourselves from him (i.e., observe Hijab). We said: "O Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), he is blind and is unable to see us, nor does he know us." He replied; "Are you also blind and unable to see him?"."
english: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with Maimunah (May Allah be pleased with her) when Ibn Umm Maktum (May Allah be pleased with him) (who was blind) came to visit him. (This incident took place after the order of Hijab). The Prophet (ﷺ) told us to hide ourselves from him (i.e., observe Hijab). We said: "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), he is blind and is unable to see us, nor does he know us." He replied; "Are you also blind and unable to see him?".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 948: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 948 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A man must not look at a man's private parts n
arabic:
وعن أبي سعيد رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"لا ينظر الرجل إلى عورة الرجل، ولا المرأة إلى عورة المرأة، ولا يفضي الرجل إلى الرجل في ثوب واحد، ولا تفضي المرأة إلى المرأة في ثوب واحد" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "A man must not look at a man's private parts nor must a woman look at a woman's private parts; neither should two men lie naked under one cover, nor should two women lie naked under the same cover."."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A man must not look at a man's private parts nor must a woman look at a woman's private parts; neither should two men lie naked under one cover, nor should two women lie naked under the same cover.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Avoid (entering a place) in which are women (u
arabic:
وعن عقبة بن عامر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: "إياكم والدخول على النساء"، فقال رجل من الأنصار: أفرأيت الحمو؟ قال: "الحمو الموت" ((متفق عليه)).

A man from the Ansar said, "Tell me about the brother of a woman's husband." He replied, "The brother of a woman's husband is death."."

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No one of you should meet a woman in privacy u

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 951: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 951 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The sanctity of the wives of Mujahidun (i
arabic: وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "حرمة نساء المجاهدين على القاعدين كحرمة أمهاتهم، ما من رجل من القاعدين يخلف رجلا من المجاهدين في أهله، فيخونه فيهم إلا وقف له يوم القيامة، فيأخذ من حسناته ما شاء حتى يرضى" ثم التفت إلينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  وقال: "ما ظنكم؟" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Buraidah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The sanctity of the wives of Mujahidun (i.e., those who strive hard and fight in the way of Allah) for those who remain at home (i.e., those who do not go to the battlefield to fight Jihad) is like the sanctity of their own mothers. Anyone who remains behind to look after the family of a Mujahid and betrays his trust, will be made to stand on the Siku ya Qiyama before the Mujahid who will take away from his meritorious deeds whatever he likes till he is satisfied." The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) turned toward us and said, "Now, what do you think (i.e., will he leave anything with him)?"."
english: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The sanctity of the wives of Mujahidun (i.e., those who strive hard and fight in the way of Allah) for those who remain at home (i.e., those who do not go to the battlefield to fight Jihad) is like the sanctity of their own mothers. Anyone who remains behind to look after the family of a Mujahid and betrays his trust, will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection before the Mujahid who will take away from his meritorious deeds whatever he likes till he is satisfied." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned toward us and said, "Now, what do you think (i.e., will he leave anything with him)?".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 954: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 954 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There are two types of people who will be puni
arabic:
وعنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"صِنفان من أهل النار لم أرهما: قوم معهم سياط كأذناب البقر يضربون بها الناس، ونساء كاسيات عاريات مميلات مائلات، رءوسهن كأسنمة البخت المائلة لا يدخلن الجنة، ولا يجدن ريحها، وإن ريحها ليوجد من مسيرة كذا وكذا" ((رواه مسلم)). معنى ((كاسيات)) اي من نعمة الله ((عاريات)) من شكرها ، وقيل معناه: تستر بعض بدنها ، وتكشف بعضه إظهارا بحالها ونحوه ، وقيل : معناه تلبس ثوبا رقيقا يصف لون بدنها .
وأما ( مائلات ) فقيل : معناه عن طاعة الله ، وما يلزمهن حفظه . ( مميلات ) أي يعلمن غيرهن فعلهن المذموم ، وقيل : مائلات يمشين متبخترات ، مميلات لأكتافهن . وقيل : مائلات يمشطن المشطة المائلة ، وهي مشطة البغايا . مميلات يمشطن غيرهن تلك المشطة . ومعنى ( رءوسهن كأسنمة البخت ) أن يكبرنها ويعظمنها بلف عمامة أو عصابة أو نحوهما .
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "There are two types of people who will be punished in Motoni and whom I have not seen: men having whips like the tails of cows and they will be beating people with them, and, women who will be dressed but appear to be naked, inviting to evil; and they themselves will be inclined to it. Their heads will appear like the humps of the Bactrian camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Jannah and they will not smell its fragrance which is perceptible from such and such a distance."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There are two types of people who will be punished in Hell and whom I have not seen: men having whips like the tails of cows and they will be beating people with them, and, women who will be dressed but appear to be naked, inviting to evil; and they themselves will be inclined to it. Their heads will appear like the humps of the Bactrian camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Jannah and they will not smell its fragrance which is perceptible from such and such a distance.".

arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله قال: 
"لا يأكلن أحدكم بشماله، ولا يشربن بها. فإن الشيطان يأكل بشماله ويشرب بها" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "No person should eat and drink with his left hand for Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No person should eat and drink with his left hand for Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 957: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 957 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: "Jews and Christians do not dye th
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"إن اليهود والنصارى لا يصبغون، فخالفوهم" ((متفق عليه)) . المُرَادُ: خِضَابُ شَعْرِ اللِّحْيةِ والرَّأسِ الأبْيضِ بِصُفْرةٍ أوْ حُمْرةٍ، وأمَّا السَّوادُ، فَمنْهيُّ عَنْهُ كَما سَنَذْكُرُ في الْباب بعْدَهُ، إنْ شَاءَ اللَّه تَعَالَى.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) as saying: "Jews and Christians do not dye their hair, so act differently from them."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: "Jews and Christians do not dye their hair, so act differently from them.".
