chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 958: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 958 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Abu Quhafah, father of Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with them) was presented t
arabic:
عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: أتي بأبي قحافة والد أبي بكر الصديق رضي الله عنهما يوم فتح مكة ورأسه ولحيته كالثغامة بياضًا، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"غيروا هذا واجتنبوا السواد" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Abu Quhafah, father of Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with them) was presented to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) on the day of the conquest of Makkah and his head and beard were snow white. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Change it (i.e., dye it and avoid black colour)."."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: Abu Quhafah, father of Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with them) was presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the conquest of Makkah and his head and beard were snow white. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Change it (i.e., dye it and avoid black colour).".

chapter.title_ar: باب 960 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a boy, some portion of whose head was shaved and
arabic:
وعنه قال: رأى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  صبيًا قد حلق بعض شعر رأسه وترك بعضه فنهاهم عن ذلك وقال: 
"احلقوه كله، أو اتركوه كله". رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح على شرط البخاري ومسلم.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saw a boy, some portion of whose head was shaved and some of it was left out. He iliyokatazwa them from that and said, "Shave the whole of it or leave the whole of it."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a boy, some portion of whose head was shaved and some of it was left out. He prohibited them from that and said, "Shave the whole of it or leave the whole of it.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 961 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave respite for three days to the family of Ja'far (after his m
arabic: وعن عبد الله بن جعفر رضي الله عنهما أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  أمهل آل جعفر رضي الله عنه ثلاثًا، ثم أتاهم فقال: "لا تبكوا على أخي بعد اليوم". ثم قال: "ادعوا لي بني أخي" فجيء بنا كأننا أفرخ فقال: "ادعوا لي الحلاق" فأمره، فحلق رءوسنا". رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح على شرط البخاري ومسلم.
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Ja'far (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) gave respite for three days to the family of Ja'far (after his martydom). Then he came and said, "Don't weep for my brother after this day." He said, "Bring all of my nephews to me." We were accordingly brought as if we were chickens. Then he said, "Call for me a barber." He directed him to shave our heads which he did.."
english: 'Abdullah bin Ja'far (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave respite for three days to the family of Ja'far (after his martydom). Then he came and said, "Don't weep for my brother after this day." He said, "Bring all of my nephews to me." We were accordingly brought as if we were chickens. Then he said, "Call for me a barber." He directed him to shave our heads which he did..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 963: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 963 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah
arabic:
وعَنْ أسْمَاءَ رَضِيَ اللَّه عنْهَا: أنَّ امْرأَةً سألتِ النبيَّ ﷺ فَقَالتْ: يا رَسُولَ اللَّه، إنَّ ابْنَتِي أصَابَتْهَا الْحَصْبةُ، فتَمَرَّقَ شَعْرُهَا، وإنِّي زَوَّجْتُها، أفَأَصِلُ فِيهِ؟ فقالَ: لَعَنَ اللَّه الْواصِلةَ والْمَوصولة متفقٌ عليه.
وفي روايةٍ: الواصِلَةَ والمُسْتوصِلَةَ. قَوْلَهَا:"فَتَمرَّقَ"هو بالرَّاءِ، ومعناهُ: انْتثر وَسَقَطَ،"والْوَاصِلة": التي تَصِلُ شَعْرهَا، أو شَعْر غَيْرِهَا بشَعْرٍ آخَرَ."والمَوْصُولة": التي يُوصَلُ شَعْرُهَا. "والمُستَوصِلَةُ": التي تَسْأَلُ منْ يَفْعَلُ ذلكَ لَهَا.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Asma' (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "A woman came to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and said: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! I have a daughter who had an attack of small pox and her hair fell off. Now I want to celebrate her marriage. Can I get her a wig?" Thereupon Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Allah has cursed the maker and wearer of a wig."."
english: Asma' (May Allah be pleased with her) said: A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah! I have a daughter who had an attack of small pox and her hair fell off. Now I want to celebrate her marriage. Can I get her a wig?" Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has cursed the maker and wearer of a wig.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 965: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 965 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I saw Mu'awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) during the Hajj (pilgrimage) sta
arabic:
وَعَنْ حميْدِ بن عبْدِ الرَّحْمن أنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعاويَةَ رضي اللَّه عنْهُ عامَ حجَّ علَى المِنْبَر وَتَنَاول قُصَّةً مِنْ شَعْرٍ كَانَتْ في يَدِ حَرِسيٍّ فَقَالَ: يَا أهْل المَدِينَةِ أيْنَ عُلَمَاؤكُمْ؟، سمِعْتُ النبيَّ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وسَلَّم يَنْهَى عنْ مِثْلِ هَذِهِ ويقُولُ: 
"إنًَّمَا هَلَكَتْ بنُو إسْرَائِيل حِينَ اتخذ هذه نِسَاؤُهُمْ" متفقٌ عليه.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman (May Allah be pleased wth him) said: "I saw Mu'awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) during the Hajj (pilgrimage) standing on the pulpit. He took from the guard a bunch of hair, and said: "O people of Al-Madinah! Where are your scholars? (Why do they do not prohibit you) I heard Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) prohibiting from using this (false hair) and saying, 'The people of Bani Israel were ruined when their women wore such hair."'"
english: Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman (May Allah be pleased wth him) said: I saw Mu'awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) during the Hajj (pilgrimage) standing on the pulpit. He took from the guard a bunch of hair, and said: "O people of Al-Madinah! Where are your scholars? (Why do they do not prohibit you) I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibiting from using this (false hair) and saying, 'The people of Bani Israel were ruined when their women wore such hair."'

title: Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those women who have the
arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: لعن الله الواشمات والمستوشمات والمتنمصات والمتفلجات بالحسن، المغيرات خلق الله! فقالت له امرأة في ذلك فقال: وما لي لا ألعن من لعنه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو في كتاب الله؟! قال الله تعالى: {وما آتاكم الرسول فخذوه وما نهاكم عنه فانتهوا} ((الحشر:7)).((متفق عليه)).  المتفلجة هي: التي تبرد من أسنانها ليتباعد بعضها من بعض قليلا، وتحسنها وهو الوشر. والنامصة:  التي تأخذ من شعر حاجب غيرها، وترققه ليصير حسنا. والمتنمصة: التي تأمر من يفعل بها ذلك.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those women who have themselves tattooed, and those women who get their hair removed from their eyebrows and faces (except the beard and the mustache), and those who make artificial spaces between their teeth for beauty, whereby they change Allah's creation. A woman started to argue with him, saying: "What is all this?" He replied: "Why should I not curse those whom the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) cursed and who are cursed in Allah's Book? Allah, the Exalted, has said in His Book:"And whatsoever the Messenger (Muhammad (ﷺ)) gives you, take it; and whatsoever he forbids you, abstain (from it)." (59:7)."
english: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those women who have themselves tattooed, and those women who get their hair removed from their eyebrows and faces (except the beard and the mustache), and those who make artificial spaces between their teeth for beauty, whereby they change Allah's creation. A woman started to argue with him, saying: "What is all this?" He replied: "Why should I not curse those whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed and who are cursed in Allah's Book? Allah, the Exalted, has said in His Book:"And whatsoever the Messenger (Muhammad (ﷺ)) gives you, take it; and whatsoever he forbids you, abstain (from it)." (59:7).

"من عمل عملا ليس عليه أمرنا فهو رد" ((رواه مسلم)).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 969: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 969 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not touch your private parts with your right hand whil
arabic:
عن أبي قتادة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"إذا بال أحدكم، فلا يؤخذن ذكره بيمينه، ولا يستنجي بيمينه، ولا يتنفس في الإناء" ((متفق عليه)) وفي الباب أحاديث كثيرة صحيحة.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Qatadah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Do not touch your private parts with your right hand while urinating, nor for washing or cleaning (your private parts); and do not breathe into the drinking vessel from which you drink."."
english: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not touch your private parts with your right hand while urinating, nor for washing or cleaning (your private parts); and do not breathe into the drinking vessel from which you drink.".

arabic:

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "When the lace of one of the shoes of

"إذا انقطع شسع نعل أحدكم، فلا يمشِ في الأخرى حتى يصلحها" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "When the lace of one of the shoes of any one of you is cut off, he should not walk with the other until he has got the lace repaired."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "When the lace of one of the shoes of any one of you is cut off, he should not walk with the other until he has got the lace repaired.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 974: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 974 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: A house in Al-Madinah was burnt with its occupants inside it one night
arabic:
وعن أبي موسى الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: احترق بيت بالمدينة على أهله من الليل، فلما حدث رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  بشأنهم قال: 
"إن هذه النار عدو لكم، فإذا نمتم فأطفئوها" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Musa al-Ash'ari Al-Ash'ari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "A house in Al-Madinah was burnt with its occupants inside it one night. When this was reported to the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) he said, "Fire is your enemy. So, put it out before going to bed."."
english: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A house in Al-Madinah was burnt with its occupants inside it one night. When this was reported to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he said, "Fire is your enemy. So, put it out before going to bed.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 975: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 975 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Cover up the (kitchen) containers (i
arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: "غطوا الإناء، وأوكئوا السقاء، وأغلقوا الأبواب، وأطفئوا السراج، فإن الشيطان لا يحل سقاء، ولايفتح بابًا ولايكشف إناءً، إن لم يجد أحدكم إلا أن يعرض على إنائه عودا، ويذكر اسم الله، فليفعل، فإن الفويسقة تضرم على أهل البيت بيتهم" ((رواه مسلم)) "الفويسقة: الفأرة، و"تضرم": تحرق.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Cover up the (kitchen) containers (i.e., pots, pans, etc.), tie up the mouth of the water-skin, lock up the doors and extinguish the lamps, because Satan can neither untie the water-skin nor open the door nor uncover the containers. If one can cover the cooking pot even by placing a piece of wood across it, and pronounce the Name of Allah on it, let him do it. A mouse can sometimes cause a house to burn along its dwellers.""
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Cover up the (kitchen) containers (i.e., pots, pans, etc.), tie up the mouth of the water-skin, lock up the doors and extinguish the lamps, because Satan can neither untie the water-skin nor open the door nor uncover the containers. If one can cover the cooking pot even by placing a piece of wood across it, and pronounce the Name of Allah on it, let him do it. A mouse can sometimes cause a house to burn along its dwellers."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 977: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 977 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: We visited 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) and he said to u
arabic: وعن مسروق قال : دخلنا على عبدالله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه فقال : يا أيها الناس من علم شيئا فليقل به، ومن لم يعلم، فليقل :الله أعلم، فإن من العلم أن يقول الرجل لما لا يعلم: الله أعلم . قال الله تعالى لنبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم :{قل ما أسألكم عليه من أجر وما أنا من المتكلفين}. ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Masruq (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "We visited 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) and he said to us: O people! He who has the knowledge of any matter may convey it to the others. And he who has no knowledge, thereof, should say: "Allahu a'lam (Allah knows better)." It is a part and parcel of knowledge that a man who has no knowledge of a matter should say: "Allah knows better." Allah said to His Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake):"Say (O Muhammad (ﷺ)): 'No wage do I ask of you for this (the Qur'an), nor am I one of the Mutakallifun (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist)."' (38:86)."
english: Masruq (May Allah be pleased with him) said: We visited 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) and he said to us: O people! He who has the knowledge of any matter may convey it to the others. And he who has no knowledge, thereof, should say: "Allahu a'lam (Allah knows better)." It is a part and parcel of knowledge that a man who has no knowledge of a matter should say: "Allah knows better." Allah said to His Prophet (ﷺ):"Say (O Muhammad (ﷺ)): 'No wage do I ask of you for this (the Qur'an), nor am I one of the Mutakallifun (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist)."' (38:86).

chapter.title_ar: باب 978 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The deceased is tortured in his grave for bewailing over
arabic: عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  :"الميت يُعذب في قبره بما نِيح عليه ". وَفِي روايةٍ:"مَا نِيحَ علَيْهِ" ((متفق عليه)).

english: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The deceased is tortured in his grave for bewailing over him.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who (on befalling a calamity) slaps his che

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 980: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 980 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: (My father) Abu Musa got seriously ill and lost his consciousness
arabic:
وعن أبي بردة قال: وجع أبو موسى، فغشي عليه، ورأسه في حجر امرأة من أهله، فأقبلت تصيح برنة فلم يستطع أن يرد عليها شيئًا، فلما أفاق ،قال : أنا بريء ممن برئ منه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  برئ من الصالقة، والحالقة، والشاقة.((متفق عليه)) 
"الصالقة": التي ترفع صوتها بالنياحة والندب. 
والحالقة : التي تحلق رأسها عند المصيبة  الشاقة  :التي تشق ثوبها.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Burdah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "(My father) Abu Musa got seriously ill and lost his consciousness. His head was in the lap of a woman of the family and she began to wail. When Abu Musa recovered his consciousness, he said: "I am innocent of those from whom Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) is innocent. Verily, the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) declared himself free of (the responsibility) for a woman who wails, shaves her head and tears up her clothes."."
english: Abu Burdah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: (My father) Abu Musa got seriously ill and lost his consciousness. His head was in the lap of a woman of the family and she began to wail. When Abu Musa recovered his consciousness, he said: "I am innocent of those from whom Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is innocent. Verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) declared himself free of (the responsibility) for a woman who wails, shaves her head and tears up her clothes.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 981: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 981 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "He who allows (others) to wail over
arabic:
وعن المغيرة بن شعبة رضي الله عنه قال :سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول 
"من نِيح عليه، فإنه يُعذب بما نِيح عليه يوم القيامة" ((متفق عليه)).

english: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "He who allows (others) to wail over his death, will be punished for it on the Day of Resurrection.".

title: At the time of giving the pledge of allegiance, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 983: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 983 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, h
arabic: وعن النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنه قال: أغمي على عبد الله بن رواحة رضي الله عنه فجعلت أخته تبكي، وتقول: واجبلاه، وا كذا وا كذا: تعدد عليه  فقال حين أفاق: ما قلت شيئًا ألا قيل لي :أنت كذلك؟! ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa An-Nu'man bin Bashir (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, his sister began to weep and shout: "Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! for such and such (mentioning his virtuous qualities)." When he recovered his consciousness, he said: "I was asked (disapprovingly, by the angels) about everything you said concerning me whether I am as you said."."
english: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said: When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, his sister began to weep and shout: "Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! for such and such (mentioning his virtuous qualities)." When he recovered his consciousness, he said: "I was asked (disapprovingly, by the angels) about everything you said concerning me whether I am as you said.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 984: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 984 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness
arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: اشتكى سعد بن عبادة رضي الله عنه شكوى فأتاه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يعوده مع عبد الرحمن بن عوف، وسعد بن أبي وقاص، وعبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنهم، فلما دخل عليه، وجده في غشية فقال: "أقضي؟" قالوا: لا يا رسول الله فبكى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  فلما رأى القوم بكاء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  بكوا، قال: "ألا تسمعون؟ إن الله لا يُعذب بدمع العين، ولا بحزن القلب، ولكن يعذب بهذا" وأشار إلى لسانه "أو يرحم" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). When they entered his house, they found him unconscious. The Messenger of Allah asked, "Has he died?" They replied: "No, Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah." Hearing this the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) began to weep. When his Companions saw this, they also began to weep too. He said, "Listen attentively: Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but takes to task or show mercy because of the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue)."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). When they entered his house, they found him unconscious. The Messenger of Allah asked, "Has he died?" They replied: "No, O Messenger of Allah." Hearing this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to weep. When his Companions saw this, they also began to weep too. He said, "Listen attentively: Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but takes to task or show mercy because of the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue).".

chapter.title_ar: باب 985 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before sh
arabic:
وعن أبي مالك الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"النائحة إذا لم تتب قبل موتها تقام يوم القيامة وعليها سربال من قطران، ودرع من جرب" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Siku ya Qiyama wearing a garment of pitch and a garment of scabies (Allah knows the nature thereof)."."
english: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a garment of scabies (Allah knows the nature thereof).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 986: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 986 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: A woman who had taken a pledge of allegiance at the hand of the Messenger of All
arabic: وعن أسيد بن أبي أسيد التابعي عن امرأة من المبايعات قالت: كان فيما أخذ علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، في المعروف الذي أخذ علينا أن لا نعصيه فيه: أن لا نخمش وجهًا، ولا ندعو ويلا، ولا نشق جيبًا، وأن لا ننشر شعرًا". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن  ))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Asid bin Abu Usaid reported: "A woman who had taken a pledge of allegiance at the hand of the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Among the matters in respect of which we gave the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) the pledge not to disobey him in any Ma'ruf ."
english: Asid bin Abu Usaid reported: A woman who had taken a pledge of allegiance at the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Among the matters in respect of which we gave the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the pledge not to disobey him in any Ma'ruf .

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 987: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 987 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and say
arabic:
وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"ما من ميت يموت، فيقوم باكيهم، فيقول: واجبلاه، وأسيداه، أو نحو ذلك إلا وكل به ملكان يلهزانه: أهكذا كنت؟!". رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن.
«اللَّهْزُ»: الدَّفْعُ بِجُمْعِ اليَدِ فِي الصَّدْرِ.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ...' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' "."
english: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ...' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' ".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 988: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 988 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"اثنان في الناس هما بهم كفر: الطعن في النسب، والنياحة على الميت" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Slandering one's lineage and wailing over the dead."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Slandering one's lineage and wailing over the dead.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 989: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 989 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Some people asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about soothsayers
arabic:
عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  أناس عن الكهان، فقال: "ليسوا بشيء" فقالوا: يا رسول الله إنهم يحدثونا أحيانًا بشيء، فيكون حقًا؟ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "تلك الكلمة من الحق يخطفها الجني. فيقرها في أذن وليه، فيخلطون معها مائة كذبة" ((متفق عليه)).  
وفي رواية للبخاري عن عائشة رضي الله عنها أنها سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "إن الملائكة تنزل في العَنان -وهو السحاب-. فتذكر الأمر قضي في السماء، فيسترق الشيطان السمع، فيسمعه، فيوحيه إلى الكهان، فيكذبون معها مائة كذبة من عند أنفسهم" 
قَولُهُ: «فَيَقُرُّهَا» هو بفتح الياء وضم القاف والراء، أي: يُلْقِيها، «والعَنانِ» بفتح العين.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Some people asked the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) about soothsayers. He (ﷺ) said, "They are of no account." Upon this they said to him, "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! But they sometimes make true predictions." Thereupon the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches (from the angels) and whispers into the ears of his friend (the soothsayers) who will then mix more than a hundred lies with it.".The narration in Al-Bukhari is: "The angels descend in the clouds and mention matters which has been decreed in heaven; Satan steals a hearing (listens to it stealthily) and communicates it to the soothsayers who tell along with it a hundred lies.""
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Some people asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about soothsayers. He (ﷺ) said, "They are of no account." Upon this they said to him, "O Messenger of Allah! But they sometimes make true predictions." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches (from the angels) and whispers into the ears of his friend (the soothsayers) who will then mix more than a hundred lies with it.".The narration in Al-Bukhari is: "The angels descend in the clouds and mention matters which has been decreed in heaven; Satan steals a hearing (listens to it stealthily) and communicates it to the soothsayers who tell along with it a hundred lies."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 990: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 990 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives
arabic:
وعن قبيصة بنت أبي عبيد، عن بعض أزواج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، ورضي الله عنها، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"من أتي عرافًا فسأله عن شيء، فصدقه، لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين يومًا" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Masahaba (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: "Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives of Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) who said, "He who goes to one who claims to tell about matters of the Unseen and believes in him, his Salat (swala) will not be accepted for forty days."."
english: Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "He who goes to one who claims to tell about matters of the Unseen and believes in him, his Salat (prayers) will not be accepted for forty days.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 991: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 991 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The practice of 'Iyafah, the interpr
arabic:
وعن قبيصة بن المخارق رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول: 
"العِيافة، والطِّيَرة، والطرق، من الجبت". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).
وقال: «الطَّرْقُ» هُوَ الزَّجْرُ: أيْ زَجْرُ الطَّيْرِ وَهُوَ أنْ يَتَيَمَّنَ أو يَتَشَاءمَ بِطَيَرَانِهِ، فإنْ طَارَ إلَى جِهَةِ اليَمِين، تَيَمَّنَ، وإنْ طَارَ إلَى جِهَةِ اليَسَارِ، تَشَاءمَ. قال أبو داود: «والعِيَافَةُ»: الخَطُّ.
قالَ الجَوْهَريُّ في الصِّحَاحِ: الجِبْتُ كَلِمَةٌ تَقَعُ عَلَى الصَّنَمِ وَالكاهِنِ والسَّاحِرِ وَنَحْوِ ذلِكَ.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Qabisah bin Al-Mukhariq (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "The practice of 'Iyafah, the interpretation of omens from the flight of birds, the practice of divination by drawing lines on the ground and taking evil omens are all practices of Al-Jibt (the idol, the diviner, or sorcerer)."."
english: Qabisah bin Al-Mukhariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The practice of 'Iyafah, the interpretation of omens from the flight of birds, the practice of divination by drawing lines on the ground and taking evil omens are all practices of Al-Jibt (the idol, the diviner, or sorcerer).".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who acquires a branch of the knowledge of a

"من اقتبس علمًا من النجوم، اقتبس شعبة من السحر زاد ما زاد". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح))

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 993: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 993 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah
arabic: وعن معاوية بن الحكم رضي الله عنه قال: قلت يا رسول الله إني حديث عهد بجاهلية، وقد جاء الله تعالى بالإسلام، وإن منا رجالا يأتون الكهان؟ قال: "فلا تأتهم" قلت: ومنا رجال يتطيرون؟ قال: "ذلك شيء يجدونه في صدورهم، فلا يصدهم" قلت: ومنا رجال يخطون؟ قال: "كان نبي من الأنبياء يخط، فمن وافق خطه، فذاك" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I said: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah has favoured me with Islam. There are still some men among us who visit the soothsayers to consult them (on matters relating to the future)." He (ﷺ) replied, "Do not visit them." I said: "There are some men who are guided by omens." He replied, "These are the ideas which come up in their minds but you should not be influenced by them (i.e., these things) should not prevent them from pursuing their works." I said: "There are some men who practise divination by drawing lines on the ground." The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied, "There was a Prophet who drew lines, the line which agrees with the line drawn by that Prophet would be correct."."
english: Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah has favoured me with Islam. There are still some men among us who visit the soothsayers to consult them (on matters relating to the future)." He (ﷺ) replied, "Do not visit them." I said: "There are some men who are guided by omens." He replied, "These are the ideas which come up in their minds but you should not be influenced by them (i.e., these things) should not prevent them from pursuing their works." I said: "There are some men who practise divination by drawing lines on the ground." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "There was a Prophet who drew lines, the line which agrees with the line drawn by that Prophet would be correct.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 995: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 995 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person
arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لا عدوى ولا طِيَرة ويعجبني الفأل" قالوا: وما الفأل؟ قال: "كلمة طيبة" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I am pleased with good omens." He was asked: "What is good omen?" He replied, "A good word."."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I am pleased with good omens." He was asked: "What is good omen?" He replied, "A good word.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There is no infection and no evil omen; but if

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 998: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 998 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: When talking of omens was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ
arabic:
وعن عروة بن عامر رضي الله عنه قال: ذكرت الطِيَرة عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال: 
"أحسنها الفأل، ولا ترد مسلمًا فإذا رأى أحدكم ما يكره، فليقل: اللهم لا يأتي بالحسنات إلا أنت، ولا يدفع السيئات إلا أنت، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بك".((حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح))
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Urwah bin 'Amir (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "When talking of omens was mentioned in the presence of the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) he said, "The best type of omen is the good omen." He added, "A Muislamu should not refrain from anything because of an omen." He (ﷺ) told them, "When any of you sees anything which he dislikes, he should say: 'Allahuma la ya'ti bil-hasanati illa Anta, wa la yadfa'us- sayyi'ati illa Anta, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Bika (O Allah ! You Alone bring good things; You Alone avert evil things, and there is no might or power but in You)."'."
english: 'Urwah bin 'Amir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: When talking of omens was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he said, "The best type of omen is the good omen." He added, "A Muslim should not refrain from anything because of an omen." He (ﷺ) told them, "When any of you sees anything which he dislikes, he should say: 'Allahuma la ya'ti bil-hasanati illa Anta, wa la yadfa'us- sayyi'ati illa Anta, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Bika (O Allah ! You Alone bring good things; You Alone avert evil things, and there is no might or power but in You)."'.

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Those who draw pictures will be punished on th
arabic:
عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"إن الذين يصنعون هذه الصور يعذبون يوم القيامة، يقال لهم: أحيوا ما خلقتم" ((متفق عليه)).

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me after returning from a journey, and I had
arabic:
وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قدم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  من سفر وقد سترت سهوة لي بقرام فيه تماثيل فلما رآه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، تلون وجهه، وقال: 
"يا عائشة، أشد الناس عذابًا عن الله يوم القيامة الذين يضاهون بخلق الله" قالت: فقطعناه، فجعلنا منه وسادة أو وسادتين. ((متفق عليه)). «القِرامُ» بكسرِ القاف هو: السِّتْرُ. «وَالسَّهْوَةُ» بفتح السينِ المهملة وهي: الصُّفَّةُ تَكُونُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ البَيْتِ، وقيلَ: هِيَ الطَّاقُ النَّافِذُ في الحائِطِ.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hanging over it and on which there were portraits. When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Siku ya Qiyama will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that.."

When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that..

chapter.title_ar: باب 1006 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but delayed and th
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: وعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  جبريل أن يأتيه فراث عليه حتى اشتد على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، فخرج فلقيه جبريل فشكا إليه، فقال: إنا لا ندخل بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة. ((رواه البخاري)) ((
"راث": أبطأ، وهو بالثاء المثلثة)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) but delayed and this grieved him very much. When he came out of his house, Jibril met him. The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) asked him about the reason of delay, and he replied: "We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but delayed and this grieved him very much. When he came out of his house, Jibril met him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him about the reason of delay, and he replied: "We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1007: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1007 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Jibril (Gabriel) (ﷺ) made a promise with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to come at a
arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: واعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  جبريل عليه السلام في ساعة أن يأتيه، فجاءت تلك الساعة ولم يأته! قالت: وكان بيده عصًا، فطرحها من يده وهو يقول: "ما يخلف الله وعده ولا رسله" ثم التفت، فإذا جرو كلب تحت سريره. فقال: "متى دخل هذا الكلب؟" فقلت: والله ما دريت به، فأمر به فأخرج، فجاءه جبريل عليه السلام: فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "وعدتني، فجلست لك ولم تأتني" فقال: منعني الكلب الذي كان في بيتك، إنا لا ندخل بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Jibril (Gabriel) (ﷺ) made a promise with the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. There was a staff in the hand of the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake). He threw it from his hand and said, "Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers." Then he noticed a puppy under his bed and said, "O 'Aishah, when did this dog enter?" She said: "By Allah, I don't know." He then commanded that it should be turned out. No sooner than had they expelled it, Jibril came and the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to him, "You promised to visit me. I waited for you but you did not come." Whereupon he said: "The dog kept me from coming. We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture."."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Jibril (Gabriel) (ﷺ) made a promise with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. There was a staff in the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He threw it from his hand and said, "Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers." Then he noticed a puppy under his bed and said, "O 'Aishah, when did this dog enter?" She said: "By Allah, I don't know." He then commanded that it should be turned out. No sooner than had they expelled it, Jibril came and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him, "You promised to visit me. I waited for you but you did not come." Whereupon he said: "The dog kept me from coming. We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture.".

title: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Shall I not send
arabic: وعن أبي الهياج حيان بن حصين قال: قال لي علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه: ألا أبعثك على ما بعثني عليه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ؟ أن لا تدع صورة إلا طمستها، ولا قبرًا مشرفًا إلا سويته. ((رواه مسلم)).

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding
arabic:

"من اقتنى كلبًا إلا كلب صيد أو ماشية فإنه ينقص فإنه ينقص من أجره كل يوم قيراطان" ((متفق عليه)).

english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding the fields or herds or hunting, will lose two Qirat every day out of his rewards.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1010: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1010 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "من أمسك كلبًا فإنه ينقص كل يوم من عمله قيراط إلا كلب حرث أو ماشية" ((متفق عليه)).  
وفي رواية لمسلم: "من اقتنى كلبًا ليس بكلب صيد، ولا ماشية ولا أرض، فإنه ينقص من أجره قيراطان كل يوم".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his matendo mema equal to one Qirat every day, except one who keeps it for guarding the fields or the herd.".In a narration of Muislamu, the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) is reported to have said: "He who keeps a dog for any reason other than to guard his property (lands) or his flock of sheep, his matendo mema equal to two Qirat will be deducted every day.""
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good deeds equal to one Qirat every day, except one who keeps it for guarding the fields or the herd.".In a narration of Muslim, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is reported to have said: "He who keeps a dog for any reason other than to guard his property (lands) or his flock of sheep, his good deeds equal to two Qirat will be deducted every day."

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expia

عن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"البصاق في المسجد خطيئة، وكفارتها دفنها" ((متفق عليه)).  والمرادُ بِدَفْنِهَا إذَا كَانَ المَسْجِدُ تُرَابًا أوْ رَمْلًا ونَحْوَهُ فَيُوَارِيهَا تَحْتَ تُرَابِهِ. قالَ أبُو المحاسِنِ الرُّويَانِي مِنْ أصحابِنا في كِتَابِهِ (البحر) وقِيلَ: المُرَادُ بِدَفْنِهَا إخْراجُهَا مِنَ المَسْجِدِ، أمَّا إِذَا كَانَ المَسْجِدُ مُبَلَّطًا أَوْ مُجَصَّصًا، فَدَلَكَهَا عَلَيْهِ بِمَدَاسِهِ أَوْ بِغَيْرِهِ كَمَا يَفْعَلُهُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ الجُهَّالِ، فَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِدَفْنٍ، بَلْ زِيَادَةٌ فِي الخَطِيئَةِ وَتَكْثِيرٌ لِلقَذَرِ في المَسْجِدِ، وَعَلَى مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ أنْ يَمْسَحَهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِثَوْبِهِ أَوْ بِيَدِهِ أَوْ غَيرِهِ أَوْ يَغْسِلَهُ.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that the spittle should be buried in earth."."

They are merely built for the remembrance of Allah and the recitation of the Qur'an", or as he stated.."

chapter.title_ar: باب 1017 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول: 
"من سمع رجلا ينشد ضالة في المسجد فليقل: لا ردها الله عليك، فإن المساجد لم تبنَ لهذا" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: 'La raddaha Allahu 'alaika (May Allah not restore it to you),' for mosques are not built for this purpose.""
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: 'La raddaha Allahu 'alaika (May Allah not restore it to you),' for mosques are not built for this purpose."

chapter.title_ar: باب 1018 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah said, "When you see someone buying or selling in the mosq
arabic:
وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"إذا رأيتم من يبيع أو يبتاع في المسجد، فقولوا: لا أربح الله تجارتك، وإذا رأيتم من ينشد ضالة فقولوا: لا ردها الله عليك". رواه الترمذي، وقال: (حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Messenger of Allah said, "When you see someone buying or selling in the mosque, say to him: 'La arbaha-Allahu tijarataka (May Allah not make your bargain profitable)!' When you see someone announcing something lost in it, say: 'May Allah not restore it to you!"'."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah said, "When you see someone buying or selling in the mosque, say to him: 'La arbaha-Allahu tijarataka (May Allah not make your bargain profitable)!' When you see someone announcing something lost in it, say: 'May Allah not restore it to you!"'.

chapter.title_ar: باب 1019 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Ha
arabic:
وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن رجلا نشد في المسجد فقال: من دعا إلى الجمل الأحمر، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"لا وجدت، إنما بنيت المساجد لم بنيت له" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Buraidah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Has any one seen my red camel?" Upon this the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant to be (i.e., swala, remembrance of Allah, acquiring knowledge, etc.)."."
english: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Has any one seen my red camel?" Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant to be (i.e., prayer, remembrance of Allah, acquiring knowledge, etc.).".

chapter.title_ar: باب 1021 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I
arabic: وعن السائب بن زيد الصحابي رضي الله عنه قال: كنت في المسجد فحصبني رجل، فنظرت فإذا عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه فقال: اذهب فائتني بهذين، فجئته بهما، فقال: من أين أنتما؟ فقالا: من أهل الطائف، فقال: لو كنتما من أهل البلد، لأوجعتكما، ترفعان أصواتكما في مسجد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  ! ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I saw that it was 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, who said: "Go and call me these two men." I brought them and 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) asked them: "Where are you from?" On their replying that they belonged to At-Taif, he said: "Had you been the inhabitants of Al-Madinah, I would have given you a beating for raising your voices in the mosque of the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake)."."
english: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said: While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I saw that it was 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, who said: "Go and call me these two men." I brought them and 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) asked them: "Where are you from?" On their replying that they belonged to At-Taif, he said: "Had you been the inhabitants of Al-Madinah, I would have given you a beating for raising your voices in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).".

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosque

swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosque.".The narration in Muislamu is: "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosques.""

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten from this plant (i

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1024: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1024 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us
arabic:
وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : "من أكل ثومًا أو بصلا فليعتزلنا، أو فليعتزل مسجدنا" ((متفق عليه)).  
وفي رواية لمسلم: "من أكل البصل، والثوم، الكراث، فلا يقربن مسجدنا، فإن الملائكة تتأذى مما يتأذى منه بنو آدم".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques."."
english: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1025: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1025 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: "O you people
arabic: وعن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه أنه خطب يوم الجمعة فقال في خطبته: ثم إنكم أيها الناس تأكلون شجرتين ما أراهما إلا خبيثتين: البصل، والثوم -لقد رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا وجد ريحهما من الرجل في المسجد أمر به، فأخرج إلى البقيع، فمن أكلهما، فليمتهما طبخًا. ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa It has been narrated that 'Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said in the sermon of Friday prayer: ""O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odour of these to be very offensive. I saw that if the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) happened to find a man with such offensive odour in the mosque, he would order him to be taken out of the mosque and sent to Al-Baqi'. He who wants to eat any of these, should cook them till their odour dies out.."
english: It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said in the sermon of Friday prayer: "O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odour of these to be very offensive. I saw that if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to find a man with such offensive odour in the mosque, he would order him to be taken out of the mosque and sent to Al-Baqi'. He who wants to eat any of these, should cook them till their odour dies out..

chapter.title_ar: باب 1027 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the an
arabic:

"من كان له ذبح يذبحه، فإذا أهل هلال ذي الحجة، فلا  يأخذن من شعره ولا من أظفاره شيئًا حتى يضحي" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Salamah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the animal and enter in the month of Dhul-Hijjah, he should not get his hair cut or nails pared till he has offered his sacrifice."."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1028: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1028 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fath
arabic:
عن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال: "إن الله تعالى ينهاكم أن تحلفوا بآبائكم، فمن كان حالفًا، فليحلف بالله، أو ليصمت" ((متفق عليه)).  
وفي رواية في الصحيح "فمن كان حالفًا فلا يحلف إلا بالله أو ليسكت".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Allah has iliyokatazwa you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oath, may do so by swearing in the Name of Allah or he should remain silent."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oath, may do so by swearing in the Name of Allah or he should remain silent.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 1029 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i
arabic:
وعن عبد الرحمن بن سَمُرَة، رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لا تحلفوا بالطواغي، ولا بآبائكم". ((رواه مسلم)). 
"الطواغي": جمع طاغية، وهي الأصنام، ومنه الحديث: "هذه طاغية دوس": أي: صنمهم ومعبودهم، وروي في غير مسلم: "بالطواغيت" جمع طاغوت، وهو الشيطان والصنم.
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, false leaders, etc.) nor by your fathers."."
english: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, false leaders, etc.) nor by your fathers.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 1031 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone swears that in such and such case he
arabic:
وعنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"من حلف فقال: إني بريء من الإسلام، فإن كان كاذبًا، فهو كما قال، وإن كان صادقًا، فلن يرجع إلى الإسلام سالمًا". ((رواه أبو داود))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Buraidah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "If anyone swears that in such and such case he will be free from Islam and afterwards he turns out to be a liar, he will be as he has sworn; but if he is speaking the truth, he will not revert safely to Islam."."
english: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone swears that in such and such case he will be free from Islam and afterwards he turns out to be a liar, he will be as he has sworn; but if he is speaking the truth, he will not revert safely to Islam.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1032: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1032 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah
arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أنه سمع رجلا يقول: لا والكعبة، قال ابن عمر: لا تحلف بغير الله، فإني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول: "من حلف بغير الله، فقد كفر أو أشرك".(( رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن))	وفسر بعض العلماء قوله: "كفر أو أشرك" على التغليظ، كما روي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: "الرياء شرك".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah." I admonished him: "Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, 'He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah, has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk'.""
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah." I admonished him: "Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, 'He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah, has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk'."

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muslim unj
arabic:

"من خلف على مال امرئ مسلم بغير حقه، لقي الله وهو عليه غضبان" قال: ثم قرأ علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  مصداقه من كتاب الله عز وجل: {إن الذين يشترون بعهد الله وأيمانهم ثمنًا قليلا} ((آل عمران: 77)) إلى آخر الآية: ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muislamu unjustly will meet Allah and He will be angry with him" then he recited:"Verily, those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter. Neither will Allah speak to them nor look at them on the Siku ya Qiyama nor will He purify them, and they shall have a painful torment." (3:77)."

Neither will Allah speak to them nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection nor will He purify them, and they shall have a painful torment." (3:77).

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim b
arabic: وعن أبي أُمامة إياس بن ثعلبة الحارثي رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: "من اقتطع حق امرئ مسلم بيمينه، فقد أوجب الله له النار. -وحرم عليه الجنة" فقال له رجل: وإن كان شيئًا يسيرًا يا رسول الله؟ قال: "وإن كان قضيبًا من أراك" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muislamu by taking a false oath, Allah will condemn him to the fire of Motoni and will forbid Jannah for him." A person asked: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, even if it is something insignificant?" He replied, "Yes, even if it is the twig of the Arak tree."."
english: Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim by taking a false oath, Allah will condemn him to the fire of Hell and will forbid Jannah for him." A person asked: "O Messenger of Allah, even if it is something insignificant?" He replied, "Yes, even if it is the twig of the Arak tree.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1035: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1035 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship wi
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"الكبائر: الإشراك بالله، وعقوق الوالدين، وقتل النفس، واليمين الغموس" ((رواه البخاري)). 
وفي رواية: أن أعرابيًا جاء إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال: يا رسول الله ما الكبائر؟ قال:  الإشراك بالله  قال: ثم ماذا؟ قال:  اليمين الغموس  قلت: وما اليمين الغموس؟ قال:  الذي يقتطع مال امرئ مسلم  يعني بيمين هو فيها كاذب
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship with Allah, disobedience to the parents, killing without justification and taking a false oath (intentionally).".Another narration is: A bedouin came to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and asked him: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, what are the cardinal sins?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship." The man asked: "(What is) next?" The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied, "Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus." He asked: "What do you mean by Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus?" The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied, "Swearing falsely to usurp the property of a Muislamu.""
english: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship with Allah, disobedience to the parents, killing without justification and taking a false oath (intentionally).".Another narration is: A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him: "O Messenger of Allah, what are the cardinal sins?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship." The man asked: "(What is) next?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus." He asked: "What do you mean by Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Swearing falsely to usurp the property of a Muslim."

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "When you take an oath and consider somet

"وإذا حلفت على يمين، فرأيت غيرها خيرًا منها، فائت الذي هو خير، وكفر عن يمينك" ((متفق عليه)).

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I sh
arabic:
وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"إني والله إن شاء الله لا أحلف على يمين، ثم أرى خيرًا منها إلا كفرت عن يميني، وأتيت الذي هو خير". ((متفق عليه))

english: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I shall not swear to do something but that if I consider something else to be better than it, then I shall make expiation for my oath and adopt the thing that is better.".

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his f
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لأن يلج أحدكم في يمينه في أهله آثم له عند الله تعالى من أن يعطي كفارته التي فرض الله عليه". ((متفق عليه)) قوله: "يلَجّ" بفتح اللام، وتشديد الجيم: أي يتمادى فيها، ولا يكفر، قوله: "آثم" هو بالثاء المثلثة، أي: أكثر إثمًا.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with Allah than the payment of its expiation prescribed by Allah."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with Allah than the payment of its expiation prescribed by Allah.".

title: The Ayah: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths
arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: أنزلت هذه الآية: {لا يؤاخذكم الله باللغو في أيمانكم} في قول الرجل: لا والله، وبلى والله. ((رواه البخاري)).

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Beware of excessive swearing in sale

"إياكم وكثرة الحلف في البيع، فإنه ينفق ثم يمحق" ((رواه مسلم)).

chapter.title_ar: باب 1044 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Grant shelter to him who begs for it in the Na
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"من استعاذ بالله فأعيذوه، ومن سأل بالله، فأعطوه، ومن دعاكم فأجيبوه، ومن صنع إليكم معروفًا فكافئوه، فإن لم تجدوا ما تكافئونه به، فادعوا له حتى تروا أنكم قد كافأتموه". ((حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود والنسائي بأسانيد الصحيحين))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Grant shelter to him who begs for it in the Name of Allah, give to him who begs in the Name of Allah, accept the invitation of him who invites you, and requite him who does a favour to you, but if you are unable to requite him, go on praying for him till you are sure that you have requited him adequately."."

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not address a hypocrite with the title of c

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1047: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1047 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab) and asked her, "
arabic: عن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  دخل على أم السائب، أو أم المسيب فقال: "مالك يا أم السائب -أو يا أم المسيب- تزفزفين؟ " قالت: الحمى لا بارك الله فيها، فقال: "لا تسبي الحمى، فإنها تذهب خطايا بني آدم، كما يذهب الكير خبث الحديد" ((رواه مسلم)). «تُزَفْزِفِينَ» أيْ تَتَحَرَّكِينَ حَرَكَةً سَريعَةً، وَمَعْنَاهُ: تَرْتَعِدِين. وَهُوَ بِضَمِّ التاء وبالزاي المكررة والفاء المكررة، وَرُوِيَ أيضًا بالراء المكررة والقافينِ.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) visited Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab) and asked her, "What ails you O Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab)? You are shivering." She replied: "It is a fever, may Allah not bless it!" He said to her, "Do not revile fever, for it cleanses out the sins of the sons of Adam in the same way that a furnace removes the dirt of iron."."

You are shivering." She replied: "It is a fever, may Allah not bless it!" He said to her, "Do not revile fever, for it cleanses out the sins of the sons of Adam in the same way that a furnace removes the dirt of iron.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1048: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1048 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not revile the wind
arabic:
عن أبي المنذر أبي بن كعب رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"لا تسبوا الريح، فإذا رأيتم ما تكرهون، فقولوا: اللهم إنا نسألك من خير هذه الريح وخير ما فيها وخير ما أُمرت به، ونعوذ بك من شر هذه الريح وشر ما فيها وشر ما أُمرت به".((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن صحيح))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abominable (about it), supplicate: 'Allahumma inna nas'aluka min khairi hadhihir-rihi, wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma umirat bihi. Wa na'udhu bika min sharri hadhihir-rihi, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma umirat bihi. (O Allah, we beg of You the good of this wind and the good of that which it contains and the good of that which it has been commanded; and we seek refuge in you from the evil of this wind and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of that which it has been commanded)."."
english: Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abominable (about it), supplicate: 'Allahumma inna nas'aluka min khairi hadhihir-rihi, wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma umirat bihi. Wa na'udhu bika min sharri hadhihir-rihi, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma umirat bihi. (O Allah, we beg of You the good of this wind and the good of that which it contains and the good of that which it has been commanded; and we seek refuge in you from the evil of this wind and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of that which it has been commanded).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1049: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1049 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The wind is the Blessing of Allah
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول: 
"الريح من روح الله، تأتي بالرحمة، وتأتي بالعذاب، فإذا رأيتموها فلا تسبوها، وسلوا الله خيرها، واستعيذوا بالله من شرها".((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)) قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم من روح الله هو بفتح الراء أي رحمته بعباده
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "The wind is the Blessing of Allah. Sometimes it brings His Mercy and sometimes it brings His Chastisement. When you experience it, do not revile it but beg of Allah its good; and seek Allah's Refuge against its evil."."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "The wind is the Blessing of Allah. Sometimes it brings His Mercy and sometimes it brings His Chastisement. When you experience it, do not revile it but beg of Allah its good; and seek Allah's Refuge against its evil.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 1050 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Whenever the wind blew strongly, The Prophet (ﷺ) would say: "Allahumma inni as'a
arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا عصفت الريح قال: اللهم إني أسألك خيرها، وخير ما فيها، وخير ما أُرسلت به، وأعوذ بك من شرها، وشر ما فيها، وشر ما أُرسلت به" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Whenever the wind blew strongly, Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) would say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha, wa khaira ma fiha, wa khaira ma ursilat bihi. Wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bihi. (O Allah, I beg of You its good and the good of that which it contains and the good of the purpose for which it has been sent; and I seek Your Refuge from its evil and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of the purpose for which it has been sent)."."

Wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bihi. (O Allah, I beg of You its good and the good of that which it contains and the good of the purpose for which it has been sent; and I seek Your Refuge from its evil and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of the purpose for which it has been sent).".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1052: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1052 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the Fajr prayer at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfal
arabic:
عن زيد بن خالد رضي الله عنه قال: صلى بنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  صلاة الصبح بالحديبية في أثر سماء كانت من الليل، فلما انصرف أقبل على الناس، فقال: "هل تدرون ماذا قال ربكم؟ " قالوا: الله ورسوله أعلم. قال:  قال: "أصبح من عبادي مؤمن بي وكافر بي ، فأما من قال: مُطِرْنَا بفضل الله ورحمته، فذلك مؤمن بي كافر بالكواكب، وأما من قال: مُطِرْنَا بنوء كذا وكذا، فذلك كافر بي مؤمن بالكواكب" ((متفق عليه)).
والسماء هنا: المطر.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Zaid bin Khalid (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) led the Fajr swala at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of swala, he turned towards the people and said, "Do you know what your Rubb has said?" They replied: "Allah and His Messenger know better." Upon this he remarked, "He has said: 'Some of My slaves have entered the morning as My waumini and some as unwaumini. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Grace and Mercy of Allah, believes in Me and disbelieves in the stars; and he who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such star, disbelieves in Me and affirms his faith in the stars."'."
english: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the Fajr prayer at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of prayer, he turned towards the people and said, "Do you know what your Rubb has said?" They replied: "Allah and His Messenger know better." Upon this he remarked, "He has said: 'Some of My slaves have entered the morning as My believers and some as unbelievers. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Grace and Mercy of Allah, believes in Me and disbelieves in the stars; and he who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such star, disbelieves in Me and affirms his faith in the stars."'.

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1053: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1053 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a d
arabic:
عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"إذا قال رجل لأخيه: يا كافر، فقد باء بها أحدهما، فإن كان كما قال وإلا رجعت عليه" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a dismuumini, one of them will certainly deserve the title. If the addressee is so as he has asserted, the disbelief of the man is confirmed, but if it is untrue, then it will revert to him."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a disbeliever, one of them will certainly deserve the title. If the addressee is so as he has asserted, the disbelief of the man is confirmed, but if it is untrue, then it will revert to him.".

arabic:

chapter.title_ar: باب 1059 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The dearest and the closest of you to me on th
arabic:
وعن جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"إن من أحبكم إلي، وأقربكم مني مجلسًا يوم القيامة، أحاسنكم أخلاقًا، وإن أبغضكم إلي وأبعدكم مني يوم القيامة، والثرثارون، والمتشدقون، والمتفيهقون".((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)). وقد سبق شرحه في باب حسن الخلق.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Jabir bin Abdullah bin 'Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The dearest and the closest of you to me on the Siku ya Qiyama will be those who are the best in behaviour; and the most hateful and the farthest from me on the Siku ya Qiyama will be the talkative and the most pretentious and the most rhetorical."."
english: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The dearest and the closest of you to me on the Day of Resurrection will be those who are the best in behaviour; and the most hateful and the farthest from me on the Day of Resurrection will be the talkative and the most pretentious and the most rhetorical.".

swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "None of you should say: 'My soul has become evil.' He should say: 'My soul is in bad shape."'."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1061: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1061 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "None of you should use the word Al-Karm for gr
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لا تسموا العنب الكَرْم، فإن الكَرْم المسلم" ((متفق عليه)). ((وهذا لفظ مسلم)). 
وفي رواية: "فإنما الكرم قلب المؤمن" وفي رواية للبخاري ومسلم: "يقولون الكرم، إنما الكرم قلب المؤمن".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "None of you should use the word Al-Karm for grapes, for Al-Karm is a Muislamu (worthy of respect)."Another narration is: "Verily, Al-Karm is the heart of a true muumini."Another narration is: "People have named grapes as Al-Karm; verily, only the heart of a muumini is Al-Karm.""
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "None of you should use the word Al-Karm for grapes, for Al-Karm is a Muslim (worthy of respect)."Another narration is: "Verily, Al-Karm is the heart of a true believer."Another narration is: "People have named grapes as Al-Karm; verily, only the heart of a believer is Al-Karm."

chapter.title_ar: باب 1064 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "You must not supplicate: 'O Allah
arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: "لا يقولن أحدكم: اللهم اغفر لي إن شئت: اللهم ارحمني إن شئت، ليعزم المسألة، فإنه لا مكره له" ((متفق عليه)). ((وفي رواية لمسلم: "ولكن ليعزم، وليعظم الرغبة، فإن الله تعالى، لا يتعاظمه شيء أعطاه")).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "The Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "You must not supplicate: 'O Allah! forgive me if You wish; O Allah bestow mercy on me if You wish.' But beg from Allah with certitude for no one has the power to compel Allah."Another narration of Muislamu is: "A dua should be made in full confidence and one should persistently express his desire (before Allah) in his dua, for no bounty is too great for Allah to bestow (upon his slaves).""
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "You must not supplicate: 'O Allah! forgive me if You wish; O Allah bestow mercy on me if You wish.' But beg from Allah with certitude for no one has the power to compel Allah."Another narration of Muslim is: "A supplication should be made in full confidence and one should persistently express his desire (before Allah) in his supplication, for no bounty is too great for Allah to bestow (upon his slaves)."

title: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you supplicates, let him be decisi
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"إذا دعا أحدكم، فليعزم المسألة، ولا يقولن: اللهم إن شئت، فأعطني، فإنه لا مستكره له" ((متفق عليه)).

english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you supplicates, let him be decisive and he should not say: 'O Allah, bestow upon me such and such if You wish', because no one has the power to compel Him.".

chapter.title_ar: باب 1066 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say not: 'What Allah wills and so-and-so wills', but say:

عن حذيفة بن اليمان رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"لا تقولوا: ما شاء الله وشاء فلان، ولكن قولوا: ما شاء الله، ثم شاء فلان". رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1068: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1068 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Once, towards the end of his life, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) concluded the 'Ish
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  صلى العشاء في آخر حياته، فلما سلم، قال: 
"أرأيتكم ليلتكم هذه؟ فإن على رأس مائة سنة لا يبقي ممن هو على ظهر الأرض اليوم أحد" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) said: "Once, towards the end of his life, the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) concluded the 'Isha' (night) swala and said, "After one hundred years from tonight none of the people on the surface of the earth will survive."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: Once, towards the end of his life, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) concluded the 'Isha' (night) prayer and said, "After one hundred years from tonight none of the people on the surface of the earth will survive.".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1069: Kitabu cha Mambo Yaliyokatazwa (Makatazo)
chapter.title_ar: باب 1069 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) delayed the 'Isha' (night) prayer till midnight
arabic:
وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أنهم انتظروا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فجاءهم قريبًا من شطر الليل فصلى بهم، يعني العشاء، قال: ثم خطبنا فقال: 
"ألا إن الناس قد صلوا. ثم رقدوا، وإنكم لن تزالوا في صلاة ما انتظرتم الصلاة" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Once Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) delayed the 'Isha' (night) swala till midnight. He (ﷺ) turned to us after the swala and said, "All the people slept after offering their swala, but you who waited, will be accounted as if you were engaged in your swala throughout the period."."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) delayed the 'Isha' (night) prayer till midnight. He (ﷺ) turned to us after the prayer and said, "All the people slept after offering their prayers, but you who waited, will be accounted as if you were engaged in your prayer throughout the period.".

"لا يحل للمرأة أن تصوم وزوجها شاهد إلا بإذنه، ولا تأذن في بيته إلا بإذنه" ((متفق عليه)).

Nor should she allow anyone to enter his house without his permission."."

chapter.title_ar: باب 1074 من كتاب الأمور المنهي عنها

title: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "No Salat (prayer) should be performe
arabic:
عن عائشة رَضِيَ اللهُ عنها، قالت: سَمِعْتُ رسولَ الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - يقولُ: 
"لا صَلاَةَ بِحَضْرَةِ طَعَامٍ، وَلاَ وَهُوَ يُدَافِعُهُ الأَخْبَثَانِ". ((رواه مسلم))
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "I heard the Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying, "No Salat (swala) should be performed when the food has been served, nor should it be performed when a person is in need of relieving himself."."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "No Salat (prayer) should be performed when the food has been served, nor should it be performed when a person is in need of relieving himself.".
