chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1470: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: A man passed by the Prophet (ﷺ), so he asked a man who was sitting near him, "Wh
arabic: وعن أبي العباس سهل بن سعد الساعدي رضي الله عنه قال: مر رجل على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، فقال لرجل عنده جالس: "ما رأيك في هذا؟" فقال: رجل من أشراف الناس، هذا والله حري إن خطب أن ينكح، وإن شفع أن يشفع . فسكت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثم مر رجل آخر، فقال له رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: " ما رأيك في هذا؟" فقال: يا رسول الله هذا رجل من فقراء المسلمين هذا حري إن خطب أن لا ينكح، وإن شفع أن لا يشفع، وإن قال أن لا يسمع لقوله. فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: “هذا خير من ملء الأرض مثل هذا" ((متفق عليه)) . (22)
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A man passed by Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), so he asked a man who was sitting near him, "What is your opinion about this man?" That man replied: "He is one of the noblest men. By Allah he is certainly a proper person for (a girl) being given in marriage if he seeks to marry, and his recommendation is fit to be accepted if he recommends". Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) remained silent. Then another man passed. Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) enquired, "What is your opinion about this man?" He replied: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, he is one of the poor Waislamu. He is not a proper person (for a girl) to be given in marriage to, and his recommendation would not be accepted if he makes one; if he speaks, he is not to be listened to." Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He is better than the former by earthfuls".."
english: Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A man passed by the Prophet (ﷺ), so he asked a man who was sitting near him, "What is your opinion about this man?" That man replied: "He is one of the noblest men. By Allah he is certainly a proper person for (a girl) being given in marriage if he seeks to marry, and his recommendation is fit to be accepted if he recommends". Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remained silent. Then another man passed. Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) enquired, "What is your opinion about this man?" He replied: "O Messenger of Allah, he is one of the poor Muslims. He is not a proper person (for a girl) to be given in marriage to, and his recommendation would not be accepted if he makes one; if he speaks, he is not to be listened to." Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He is better than the former by earthfuls"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1471: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: There was a dispute between the Hell and Jannah
arabic:
وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" احتجت الجنة والنار فقالت النار: في الجبارون والمتكبرون، وقالت الجنة: في ضعفاء الناس ومساكينهم، فقضى الله بينهما: إنك الجنة رحمتي أرحم بك من أشاء، وإنك النار أعذب بك من أشاء، ولكليكما علي ملؤها" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: There was a dispute between the Motoni and Jannah. The Motoni said: "The haughty and proud are my inmates." Jannah said: "The modest and the humble are my residents". Thereupon, Mwenyezi Mungu Aliyetukuka and Glorious (addressing Jannah) said: "You are My Mercy, through you I shall show mercy to those whom I wish". (And addressing the Motoni), He said: "You are (the means) of My punishment by which I shall punish such of My slaves as I wish and each one of you would have its fill".."
english: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: There was a dispute between the Hell and Jannah. The Hell said: "The haughty and proud are my inmates." Jannah said: "The modest and the humble are my residents". Thereupon, Allah the Exalted and Glorious (addressing Jannah) said: "You are My Mercy, through you I shall show mercy to those whom I wish". (And addressing the Hell), He said: "You are (the means) of My punishment by which I shall punish such of My slaves as I wish and each one of you would have its fill"..

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection, there will be brought
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" إنه ليأتي الرجل السمين العظيم يوم القيامة لا يزن عند الله جناح بعوضة" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "On the Siku ya Qiyama, there will be brought forth a bulky person (person of noteworthy status) whose value to Allah will be less than that of the wing of a mosquito".."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1473: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: A black woman (or probably a young man) used to clean the mosque
arabic: وعنه أن امرأة سوداء كانت تقم المسجد، أو شابا، ففقدها، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، فسأل عنها أو عنه، فقالوا: مات. قال: " أفلا كنتم آذنتموني" فكأنهم صغروا أمرها، أو أمره، فقال: " دلوني على قبره" فدلوه فصلى عليه، ثم قال: " إن هذه القبور مملوءة ظلمة على أهلها، وإن الله تعالى ينورها لهم بصلاتي عليهم" ((متفق عليه)). (23)
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A black woman (or probably a young man) used to clean the mosque. Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) missed her (or him) and asked about her (or him). He was told that she (or he) had died. He (ﷺ) said, "Why did you not inform me?" (It seemed as if) they (Companions) considered the matter insignificant. Then he (ﷺ) said, "Show me her (or his) grave." When it was shown to him, he offered (Janazah-funeral) swala over it and said, "These graves cover those in them with darkness, and Allah illumines them for the inmates as a result of my dua for them".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A black woman (or probably a young man) used to clean the mosque. Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) missed her (or him) and asked about her (or him). He was told that she (or he) had died. He (ﷺ) said, "Why did you not inform me?" (It seemed as if) they (Companions) considered the matter insignificant. Then he (ﷺ) said, "Show me her (or his) grave." When it was shown to him, he offered (Janazah-funeral) prayer over it and said, "These graves cover those in them with darkness, and Allah illumines them for the inmates as a result of my supplication for them"..

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I stood at the gate of Jannah, and (I saw) that the major
arabic: وعن أسامة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: " قمت على باب الجنة، فإذا عامة من دخلها المساكين، وأصحاب الجد محبوسون، غير أن أصحاب النار قد أمر بهم إلى النار. وقمت على باب النار فإذا عامة من دخلها النساء” ((متفق عليه)). (24)
swahili: Kutoka kwa Usamah bin Zaid (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "I stood at the gate of Jannah, and (I saw) that the majority of those who entered it are the poor, and the wealthy were kept confined. The inmates of the Fire had been ordered to (enter) the Fire (Motoni), and I stood at the gate of Motoni and saw that the majority of its inmates are women".."
english: Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I stood at the gate of Jannah, and (I saw) that the majority of those who entered it are the poor, and the wealthy were kept confined. The inmates of the Fire had been ordered to (enter) the Fire (Hell), and I stood at the gate of Hell and saw that the majority of its inmates are women"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1476: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None spoke in the cradle but only three (persons), Isa (J
arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “ لم يتكلم في المهد إلا ثلاثة: عيسى ابن مريم، وصاحب جريج، وكان جريج رجلا عابدًا، فاتخذ صومعة فكان فيها، فأتته أمه وهو يصلي فقالت: يا جريج، فأتته أمه وهو يصلي فقالت: يا جريج، فقال: يا رب أمي وصلاتي فأقبل على صلاته فانصرفت. فلما كان من الغد أتته وهو يصلي، فقالت: يا جريج، فقال: أي رب أمي وصلاتي، فأقبل على صلاته، فقالت: اللهم لاتمته حتى ينظر إلى وجوه المومسات. فتذاكر بنو إسرائيل جريجًا وعبادته، وكانت امرأة بغي يتمثل بحسنها، فقالت: إن شئتم لأفتننه، فتعرضت له، فلم يلتفت إليها، فأتت راعيًا كان يأوي إلى صومعته، فأمكنته من نفسها فوقع عليها. فحملت، وجعلوا يضربونه، فقال: ما شأنكم؟ قالوا: زنيت بهذه البغي فولدت منك. قال: أين الصبي؟ فجاءوا به فقال: دعوني حتى أصلي، فصلى، فلما انصرف أتى الصبي فطعن في بطنه وقال: ياغلام من أبوك؟ قال: فلان الراعي، فأقبلوا على جريج يقبلونه ويتمسحون به وقالوا: نبني لك صومعتك من ذهب، قال: لا، أعيدوها من طين كما كانت، ففعلوا. وبينا صبي يرضع من أمه، فمر رجل راكب على دابة فارهة وشارة حسنة، فقالت: “ اللهم اجعل ابني مثل هذا، فترك الثدي وأقبل إليه فنظر إليه فقال: اللهم لا تجعلني مثله، ثم أقبل على ثديه فجعل يرتضع" فكأني أنظر إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو يحكي ارتضاعه بأصبعه السبابة في فيه، فجعل يمصها، قال: "ومروا بجارية وهم يضربونها، ويقولون: زنيت سرقت، وهي تقول: حسبي الله ونعم الوكيل. فقالت أمه: اللهم لا تجعل ابني مثلها، فترك الرضاع ونظر إليها فقال: اللهم اجعلني مثلها، فهناك تراجعا الحديث فقالت: مر رجل حسن الهيئة فقلت: اللهم اجعل ابني مثله فقلت: اللهم لا تجعلني مثله، ومروا بهذه الأمة وهم يضربونها ويقولون: زنيت سرقت، فقلت: اللهم لا تجعل ابني مثلها فقلت: اللهم اجعلني مثلها؟! قال: إن ذلك الرجل كان جبارًا فقلت: اللهم لا تجعلني مثله، وإن هذه يقولون لها زنيت، ولم تزن وسرقت، ولم تسرق، فقلت: اللهم اجعلني مثلها" ((متفق عليه)). (25)
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "None spoke in the cradle but only three (persons), Isa (Jesus) son of Maryam (Mary), the second one was the companion of Juraij who was a pious person. Juraij took a secluded monastery for worship and confined himself in it. His mother came to him as he was busy in swala and she called: 'Juraij.' He said: 'My Rubb, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged in) my swala.' He continued with the swala. She returned and she came on the next day and he was (still) busy in swala. She called: 'Juraij.' And he said: 'My Rubb, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged) in swala, and he continued with the swala,' and she returned. Then on the next day she again came while he was busy in swala and called: 'Juraij.' And he said: 'My Rubb, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged) in my swala.' And he continued with the swala. She said: 'My Rubb, don't let him die until he has seen the faces of the prostitutes.' The story of Juraij and that of his meditation and swala spread amongst Banu Israel. There was a prostitute who had been a beauty personified. She said (to the people): 'If you like, I can lure him to evil.' She presented herself to him but he paid no heed (to her). She came to a shepherd who lived near the temple and she offered herself to him. He (the shepherd) had sexual intercourse with her and so she became pregnant. When she gave birth to a baby she said: 'This is from Juraij.' So they came and asked Juraij to get down and demolished the temple and began to beat him. He asked them what the matter was. They said: 'You have committed fornication with this prostitute and she has given birth to a baby from you.' He said: 'Where is the baby?' They brought him (the baby) and then he said: 'Just leave me so that I should perform swala.' He performed swala and when he finished, he lifted the baby in his stomach and asked him: 'O boy, who is your father?' The baby answered: 'He is such and such a shepherd.' So, the people turned towards Juraij, kissed him and touched him (for seeking blessing) and said: 'We are prepared to construct your temple with gold.' He said, 'No just, rebuild it with mud as it had been,' and so they did". (Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) continued:) "Then there was a baby who was sucking at his mother's breast when a person dressed in fine garment came on a priceless riding animal's back. His mother said: 'O Allah, make my child like this one.' He (the babe) left sucking and looked at him, and said: 'O Allah, don't make me like him.' He then returned to the breast and resumed sucking." He (Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: As though I can see Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) as he is illustrating the scene of his sucking milk with his forefinger in his mouth and sucking that. He (Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)) further reported Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) as saying, "There happened to pass by them a slave girl who was being beaten and they were saying: 'You have committed fornication and theft.' She was saying: 'Allah is enough for me and He is my Good Protector, and his mother said: 'O Allah, don't make my child like her.' He left sucking looked at her and said: 'O Allah! Make me like her.' It was followed by a conversation between the mother and the child. She said: 'A good looking man happened to pass by and I said: O Allah, make my child like him, and you said: O Allah, don't make me like him, and there passed a girl while they were beating her and saying: You committed fornication and theft, and I said: O Allah, don't make my child like her, and you said: O Allah, make me like her.' The child said: 'That man was a tyrant, and I said: O Allah don't make me like him; and they were saying about the girl: You committed fornication, whereas in fact she had not committed that and they were saying: You have committed theft, whereas she had not committed theft, so I said: O Allah, make me like her".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None spoke in the cradle but only three (persons), Isa (Jesus) son of Maryam (Mary), the second one was the companion of Juraij who was a pious person. Juraij took a secluded monastery for worship and confined himself in it. His mother came to him as he was busy in prayer and she called: 'Juraij.' He said: 'My Rubb, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged in) my prayer.' He continued with the prayer. She returned and she came on the next day and he was (still) busy in prayer. She called: 'Juraij.' And he said: 'My Rubb, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged) in prayer, and he continued with the prayer,' and she returned. Then on the next day she again came while he was busy in prayer and called: 'Juraij.' And he said: 'My Rubb, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged) in my prayer.' And he continued with the prayer. She said: 'My Rubb, don't let him die until he has seen the faces of the prostitutes.' The story of Juraij and that of his meditation and prayer spread amongst Banu Israel. There was a prostitute who had been a beauty personified. She said (to the people): 'If you like, I can lure him to evil.' She presented herself to him but he paid no heed (to her). She came to a shepherd who lived near the temple and she offered herself to him. He (the shepherd) had sexual intercourse with her and so she became pregnant. When she gave birth to a baby she said: 'This is from Juraij.' So they came and asked Juraij to get down and demolished the temple and began to beat him. He asked them what the matter was. They said: 'You have committed fornication with this prostitute and she has given birth to a baby from you.' He said: 'Where is the baby?' They brought him (the baby) and then he said: 'Just leave me so that I should perform prayer.' He performed prayer and when he finished, he lifted the baby in his stomach and asked him: 'O boy, who is your father?' The baby answered: 'He is such and such a shepherd.' So, the people turned towards Juraij, kissed him and touched him (for seeking blessing) and said: 'We are prepared to construct your temple with gold.' He said, 'No just, rebuild it with mud as it had been,' and so they did". (The Prophet (ﷺ) continued:) "Then there was a baby who was sucking at his mother's breast when a person dressed in fine garment came on a priceless riding animal's back. His mother said: 'O Allah, make my child like this one.' He (the babe) left sucking and looked at him, and said: 'O Allah, don't make me like him.' He then returned to the breast and resumed sucking." He (Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: As though I can see Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he is illustrating the scene of his sucking milk with his forefinger in his mouth and sucking that. He (Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)) further reported Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying, "There happened to pass by them a slave girl who was being beaten and they were saying: 'You have committed fornication and theft.' She was saying: 'Allah is enough for me and He is my Good Protector, and his mother said: 'O Allah, don't make my child like her.' He left sucking looked at her and said: 'O Allah! Make me like her.' It was followed by a conversation between the mother and the child. She said: 'A good looking man happened to pass by and I said: O Allah, make my child like him, and you said: O Allah, don't make me like him, and there passed a girl while they were beating her and saying: You committed fornication and theft, and I said: O Allah, don't make my child like her, and you said: O Allah, make me like her.' The child said: 'That man was a tyrant, and I said: O Allah don't make me like him; and they were saying about the girl: You committed fornication, whereas in fact she had not committed that and they were saying: You have committed theft, whereas she had not committed theft, so I said: O Allah, make me like her"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1477: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Six of us were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when the infidels said to him: "Drive these
arabic: وعن سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه قال: كنا مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ستة نفر، فقال المشركون للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: اطرد هؤلاء لايجترئون علينا، وكنت أنا وابن مسعود ورجلان لست أسميهما، فوقع في نفس رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ما شاء الله أن يقع، فحدث نفسه، فأنزل الله تعالى: {ولا تطرد الذين يدعون ربهم بالغداة والعشي يريدون وجهه} ((الأنعام: 52: رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Six of us were with Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) when the infidels said to him: "Drive these ones away, lest they should begin to venture against us". The six were, myself, Ibn Mas'ud, a man of the Hudhail tribe, Bilal and two other men whose names I don't know. Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) thought what Allah wished him to think, and Allah revealed: "And turn not away those who invoke their Rubb, morning and afternoon seeking His Face." (6:52)."
english: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Six of us were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when the infidels said to him: "Drive these ones away, lest they should begin to venture against us". The six were, myself, Ibn Mas'ud, a man of the Hudhail tribe, Bilal and two other men whose names I don't know. Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thought what Allah wished him to think, and Allah revealed: "And turn not away those who invoke their Rubb, morning and afternoon seeking His Face." (6:52).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1478: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Abu Sufyan passed by Salman, Suhaib and Bilal and some other Companions (May All
arabic:
وعن أبي هبيرة عائذ بن عمرو المزني وهو من أهل بيعة الرضوان رضي الله عنه، أن أبا سفيان أتى على سلمان وصهيب وبلال في نفر فقالوا: ما أخذت سيوف الله من عدو الله مأخذها، فقال أبو بكر رضي الله عنه: أتقولون هذا لشيخ قريش وسيدهم؟ فأتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، فأخبره فقال: 
"يا أبا بكر لعلك أغضبتهم؟ لئن كنت أغضبتهم لقد أغضبت ربك" فأتاهم فقال: ياإخوتاه أغضبتكم؟ قالوا: لا، يغفر الله لك يا أخي. ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Aidh bin 'Amr Al-Muzani (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Abu Sufyan passed by Salman, Suhaib and Bilal and some other Companions (May Allah be pleased with them). They said to him: "Did not the swords of Allah exact their due from the foes of Allah?" Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) said to them: "Do you speak like this to the chief of the Quraish and their master?" Then he went to Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and related this to him. He (ﷺ) said, "Abu Bakr, perhaps you have angered them. If so, you have angered your Rubb". Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) went back to them and said: "Brothers, did I offend you?" They replied: "No. May Allah forgive you, brother".."
english: 'Aidh bin 'Amr Al-Muzani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Abu Sufyan passed by Salman, Suhaib and Bilal and some other Companions (May Allah be pleased with them). They said to him: "Did not the swords of Allah exact their due from the foes of Allah?" Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) said to them: "Do you speak like this to the chief of the Quraish and their master?" Then he went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and related this to him. He (ﷺ) said, "Abu Bakr, perhaps you have angered them. If so, you have angered your Rubb". Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) went back to them and said: "Brothers, did I offend you?" They replied: "No. May Allah forgive you, brother"..

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "I will be like this in Jannah with the person who
arabic:

" أنا وكافل اليتيم في الجنة هكذا" وأشار بالسبابة والوسطى، وفرج بينهما. ((رواه البخاري)).

Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) raised his forefinger and middle finger by way of illustration.."

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who takes care of an orphan, whether he is his
arabic:

" كافل اليتيم له أو لغيره أنا وهو كهاتين في الجنة" وأشار الراوي وهو مالك ابن أنس بالسبابة والوسطى. ((رواه مسلم)).

The narrator, Malik bin Anas raised his forefinger and middle finger for illustration.."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who takes care of an orphan, whether he is his relative or a stranger, will be in Jannah with me like these two". The narrator, Malik bin Anas raised his forefinger and middle finger for illustration..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1481: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A Miskin (needy) is not the one who can be turned
arabic:
وعنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
" ليس المسكين الذي  ترده التمرة والتمرتان، ولا اللقمة واللقمتان إنما المسكين الذي  يتعفف" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "A Miskin (needy) is not the one who can be turned away with a date-fruit or two, or a morsel or two. The true Miskin is one who, despite his poverty, abstains from begging".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A Miskin (needy) is not the one who can be turned away with a date-fruit or two, or a morsel or two. The true Miskin is one who, despite his poverty, abstains from begging"..

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One who strives to help the widows and the poor is like t
arabic: وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: " الساعي على الأرملة والمسكين كالمجاهد في سبيل الله" وأحسبه قال: " وكالقائم الذي لا يفتر، وكالصائم الذي لا يفطر" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "One who strives to help the widows and the poor is like the one who fights in the way of Allah." The narrator said: I think that he (ﷺ) added also: "I shall regard him as the one who stands up (for swala) without rest and as the one who observes fasts continuously".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One who strives to help the widows and the poor is like the one who fights in the way of Allah." The narrator said: I think that he (ﷺ) added also: "I shall regard him as the one who stands up (for prayer) without rest and as the one who observes fasts continuously"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1483: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The worst food is the food of the marriage banquet from w
arabic:
وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: " شر الطعام طعام الوليمة، يمنعها من يأتيها، ويدعى إليها من يأباها، ومن لم يجب الدعوة فقد عصى الله ورسوله" ((رواه مسلم)). 
وفي رواية في " الصحيحين" عن أبي هريرة من قوله: " بئس الطعام طعام الوليمة يدعى إليها الأغنياء ويترك الفقراء"((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The worst food is the food of the marriage banquet from which those are left out who would like to come; and to which those are invited who refuse to come. He who rejects an invitation disobeys Allah and His Messenger".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The worst food is the food of the marriage banquet from which those are left out who would like to come; and to which those are invited who refuse to come. He who rejects an invitation disobeys Allah and His Messenger"..

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever supports two girls till they attain maturity, he
arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “من عال جاريتين حتى تبلغا جاء يوم القيامة أنا وهو كهاتين" وضم أصابعه.((رواه مسلم)). (29)

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1485: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: A woman came to me with her two daughters
arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: "دخلت علي امرأة ومعها ابنتان لها تسأل ، فلم تجد عندي شيئا غير تمرة واحدة، فأعطيتها إياها فقسمتها بين ابنتيها ولم تأكل منها، ثم قامت فخرجت، فدخل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم علينا، فأخبرته فقال: "من ابتلي من هذه البنات بشيء فأحسن إليهن كن له سترًا من النار" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A woman came to me with her two daughters. She asked me (for sadaka) but she found nothing with me except one date-fruit, so I gave it to her. She accepted it and then divided it between her two daughters and herself ate nothing out of that. She then got up and went out. When Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) came in, and I narrated to him the story, he said, "He who is involved (in the responsibility) of (bringing up) daughters, and he is benevolent towards them, they would become protection for him against Motoni".."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: A woman came to me with her two daughters. She asked me (for charity) but she found nothing with me except one date-fruit, so I gave it to her. She accepted it and then divided it between her two daughters and herself ate nothing out of that. She then got up and went out. When Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came in, and I narrated to him the story, he said, "He who is involved (in the responsibility) of (bringing up) daughters, and he is benevolent towards them, they would become protection for him against Hell-fire"..

title: A poor woman came to me carrying her two daughters
arabic:
وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: جاءتني مسكينة تحمل ابنتين لها، فأطعمتها ثلاث تمرات، فأعطت كل واحدة منهما تمرة ورفعت إلى فيها تمرة لتأكلها ، فاستطعمتها ابنتاها، فشقت التمرة التي كانت تريد أن تأكلها بينهما، فأعجبني شأنها، فذكرت الذي صنعت لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: 
"إن الله قد أوجب لها بها الجنة، أو أعتقها بها من النار" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A poor woman came to me carrying her two daughters. I gave her three date-fruits. She gave a date to each of them and then she took up one date-fruit and brought that to her mouth to eat, but her daughters asked her that also. She then divided between them the date-fruit that she intended to eat. This (kind) treatment of her impressed me and I mentioned that to Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) who said, 'Verily, Allah has assured Jannah for her, because of (this act) of her," or said, "He (SWT) has rescued her from Motoni- Fire".."
english: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: A poor woman came to me carrying her two daughters. I gave her three date-fruits. She gave a date to each of them and then she took up one date-fruit and brought that to her mouth to eat, but her daughters asked her that also. She then divided between them the date-fruit that she intended to eat. This (kind) treatment of her impressed me and I mentioned that to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who said, 'Verily, Allah has assured Jannah for her, because of (this act) of her," or said, "He (SWT) has rescued her from Hell- Fire"..

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah, I declare inviolable the rights of two weak ones
arabic:
و عن أبي شريح خويلد بن عمرو الخزاعي رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"اللهم إني أحرج حق الضعيفين اليتيم والمرأة" ((حديث حسن رواه النسائي بإسناد جيد)).

title: Sa'd considered himself better than his inferiors, so the Prophet (ﷺ) said to hi
arabic:
وعن مصعب بن سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنهما قال: رأى سعد أن له فضلا على من دونه، فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
"هل تنصرون وترزقون إلا بضعفائكم" ((رواه البخاري)) هكذا مرسلا، فإن مصعب بن سعد تابعي، ((ورواه الحافظ أبو بكر البرقاني في صحيحه متصلا عن مصعب عن أبيه رضي الله عنه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Mus'ab bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Sa'd considered himself better than his inferiors, so Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to him, "You are given help and provision because of your weak ones".."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1490: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Take my advice with regard to women: Act kindly to
arabic:
و عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "استوصوا بالنساء خيرًا، فإن المرأة خلقت من ضلع، وإن أعوج ما في الضلع أعلاه، فإن ذهبت تقيمه كسرته، وإن تركته، لم يزل أعوج، فاستوصوا بالنساء" ((متفق عليه)). 
وفي رواية في ((الصحيحين)) : "المرأة كالضلع إن أقمتها كسرتها، وإن استمتعت بها، استمتعت وفيها عوج".
وفي رواية لمسلم: "إن المرأة خلقت من ضلع ، لن تستقيم لك على طريقة، فإن استمعت بها وفيها عوج، وإن ذهبت تقيمها كسرتها ، وكسرها طلاقها".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Take my advice with regard to women: Act kindly towards women, for they were created from a rib, and the most crooked part of a rib is its uppermost. If you attempt to straighten it; you will break it, and if you leave it alone it will remain crooked; so act kindly toward women"..In another narration of Al-Bukhari and Muislamu, Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "A woman is like a rib, if you attempt to straighten it, you will break it; and if you benefit from her, you will do so while crookedness remains in her".In another narration of Muislamu, Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: 'Woman has been created from a rib and will in no way be straightened for you; so if you want to benefit from her, you will benefit from her while crookedness remains in her. If you attempt to straighten her, you will break her, and breaking her is divorcing her"."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Take my advice with regard to women: Act kindly towards women, for they were created from a rib, and the most crooked part of a rib is its uppermost. If you attempt to straighten it; you will break it, and if you leave it alone it will remain crooked; so act kindly toward women"..In another narration of Al-Bukhari and Muslim, Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "A woman is like a rib, if you attempt to straighten it, you will break it; and if you benefit from her, you will do so while crookedness remains in her".In another narration of Muslim, Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Woman has been created from a rib and will in no way be straightened for you; so if you want to benefit from her, you will benefit from her while crookedness remains in her. If you attempt to straighten her, you will break her, and breaking her is divorcing her".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1491: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: "When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel)
arabic: وعن عبد الله بن زمعة رضي الله عنه ، أنه سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يخطب، وذكر الناقة والذي عقرها، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : (إذ انبعث أشقاها) انبعث لها رجل عزيز، عارم منيع في رهطه" ثم ذكر النساء، فوعظ فيهن، فقال : "يعمد أحدكم فيجلد امرأته جلد العبد فلعله يضاجعها من آخر يومه" ثم وعظهم في ضحكهم من الضرطة وقال: "لم يضحك أحدكم مما يفعل؟" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Zam'ah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) giving a speech when he mentioned the she- camel (of Prophet Salih) and the man who had killed her. Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ""When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel).' (91:12) signifies that a distinguished, wicked and most powerful chief of the people jumped up to kill the she- camel." Then he (ﷺ) made mention of women and said, "Some of you beat your wives as if they were slaves, and then lie with them at the end of the day".Then he (ﷺ) admonished them against laughing at another's passing of wind, saying, "Why does any of you laugh at another doing what he does himself"."
english: 'Abdullah bin Zam'ah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) giving a speech when he mentioned the she- camel (of Prophet Salih) and the man who had killed her. Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel).' (91:12) signifies that a distinguished, wicked and most powerful chief of the people jumped up to kill the she- camel." Then he (ﷺ) made mention of women and said, "Some of you beat your wives as if they were slaves, and then lie with them at the end of the day".Then he (ﷺ) admonished them against laughing at another's passing of wind, saying, "Why does any of you laugh at another doing what he does himself".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1493: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: 'Amr bin Al-Ahwas Al-Jushami (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that he ha
arabic:
وعن عمرو بن الأحوض الجشمي رضي الله عنه أنه سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في حجة الوداع يقول بعد أن حمد الله تعالى، وأثنى عليه وذكر ووعظ، ثم قال: 
"ألا واستوصوا بالنساء خيرًا فإنما هن عوانٍ عندكم ليس تملكون منهن شيئا غير ذلك إلا أن يأتين بفاحشة مبينة، فإن فعلن فاهجروهن في المضاجع، واضربوهن ضربا غير مبرح، فإن أطعنكم فلا تبغوا عليهن سبيلا، ألا إن لكم على نسائكم حقا، ولنسائكم عليكم حقا، فحقكم عليهن أن لا يوطئن فرشكم من تكرهون، ولا يأذن في بيوتكم لمن تكرهون، ألا وحقهن عليكم أن تحسنوا إليهن في كسوتهن وطعامهن" ((رواه الترمذي وقال : حديث حسن صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Masahaba (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: "'Amr bin Al-Ahwas Al-Jushami (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that he had heard Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) saying on his Farewell Pilgrimage, after praising and glorifying Allah and admonishing people, "Treat women kindly, they are like captives in your hands; you do not owe anything else from them. In case they are guilty of open indecency, then do not share their beds and beat them lightly but if they return to obedience, do not have recourse to anything else against them. You have rights over your wives and they have their rights over you. Your right is that they shall not permit anyone you dislike to enter your home, and their right is that you should treat them well in the matter of food and clothing".."
english: 'Amr bin Al-Ahwas Al-Jushami (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that he had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying on his Farewell Pilgrimage, after praising and glorifying Allah and admonishing people, "Treat women kindly, they are like captives in your hands; you do not owe anything else from them. In case they are guilty of open indecency, then do not share their beds and beat them lightly but if they return to obedience, do not have recourse to anything else against them. You have rights over your wives and they have their rights over you. Your right is that they shall not permit anyone you dislike to enter your home, and their right is that you should treat them well in the matter of food and clothing"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1494: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: I asked Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "What right can any wife demand of her husband
arabic: وعن معاوية بن حيدة رضي الله عنه قال : قلت يا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ما حق زوجة أحدنا عليه؟ قال: "أن تطعمها إذا طعمت ، وتكسوها إذا اكتسيت ولا تضرب الوجه، ولا تقبح، ولا تهجر إلا في البيت " حديث حسن رواه أبو داود وقال: معنى "لاتقبح" أي : لا تقل قبحك الله.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Mu'awiyah bin Haidah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I asked Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake): "What right can any wife demand of her husband?" He replied, "You should give her food when you eat, clothe her when you clothe yourself, not strike her on the face, and do not revile her or separate from her except in the house".."
english: Mu'awiyah bin Haidah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I asked Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "What right can any wife demand of her husband?" He replied, "You should give her food when you eat, clothe her when you clothe yourself, not strike her on the face, and do not revile her or separate from her except in the house"..

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The believers who show the most perfect Faith are

"أكمل المؤمنين إيمانا أحسنهم خُلقا، وخياركم خياركم لنسائهم" ((رواه الترمذي وقال : حديث حسن صحيح)).

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1496: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not beat Allah's bondwomen
arabic: وعن إياس بن أبي ذباب رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لاتضربوا إماء الله" فجاء عمر رضي الله عنه إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فقال : ذئرن النساء على أزواجهن، فرخص في ضربهن، فأطاف بآل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نساء كثير يشكون أزواجهن، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لقد أطاف بآل بيت محمد نساء كثير يشكون أزواجهن ليس أولئك بخياركم" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Iyas bin 'Abdullah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Do not beat Allah's bondwomen." When 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) came to Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and complained saying: "The women have become very daring towards their husbands," He (ﷺ) gave permission to beat them. Then many women went to the family of the Messenger of Allah (wives) complaining of their husbands, and he (Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake)) said, "Many women have gone round Muhammad's family complaining of their husbands. Those who do so, that is, those who take to beating their wives, are not the best among you".."
english: Iyas bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not beat Allah's bondwomen." When 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) came to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and complained saying: "The women have become very daring towards their husbands," He (ﷺ) gave permission to beat them. Then many women went to the family of the Messenger of Allah (wives) complaining of their husbands, and he (the Prophet (ﷺ)) said, "Many women have gone round Muhammad's family complaining of their husbands. Those who do so, that is, those who take to beating their wives, are not the best among you"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1498: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a man calls his wife to his bed, and she does
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم :"إذا دعا الرجل امرأته إلى فراشه فلم تأته فبات غضبان عليها لعنتها الملائكة حتى تصبح" ((متفق عليه)). 
وفي رواية لها "إذا باتت المرأة هاجرة فراش زوجها لعنتها الملائكة حتى تصبح".
وفي رواية قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : " والذي نفسي بيده ما من رجل يدعو امرأته إلى فراشه فتأبى عليه إلا كان الذي في السماء ساخطًا عليها حتى يرضي عنها".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "When a man calls his wife to his bed, and she does not respond and he (the husband) spends the night angry with her, the angels curse her until morning".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a man calls his wife to his bed, and she does not respond and he (the husband) spends the night angry with her, the angels curse her until morning"..

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a woman to observe (voluntary
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أيضًا أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال؛ 
" لا يحل لامرأة أن تصوم وزوجها شاهد إلا بإذنه، ولا تأذن في بيته إلا بإذنه" ((متفق عليه وهذا لفظ البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "It is not halali for a woman to observe (voluntary) kufunga without the permission of her husband when he is at home; and she should not allow anyone to enter his house without his permission.".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not lawful for a woman to observe (voluntary) fasting without the permission of her husband when he is at home; and she should not allow anyone to enter his house without his permission."..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1500: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your sub
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" كلكم راعٍ، وكلكم مسئول عن رعيته، والأمير راعٍ، والرجل راعٍ على أهل بيته؛ والمرأة راعية على بيت زوجها وولده، فكلكم راعٍ، وكلكم مسؤول عن رعيته" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects. The ruler is a guardian of his subjects, the man is a guardian of his family, the woman is a guardian and is responsible for her husband's house and his offspring; and so all of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects."."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects. The ruler is a guardian of his subjects, the man is a guardian of his family, the woman is a guardian and is responsible for her husband's house and his offspring; and so all of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects.".

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whenever a woman harms her husband in this world (that is
arabic:

" لا تؤذي امرأة زوجها في الدنيا إلا قالت زوجة من الحور العين لا تؤذيه قاتلك الله!  فإنما هو عندك دخيل يوشك أن يفارقك إلينا" ((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)).

May Allah destroy you! He is only a passing guest with you and is about to leave you to come to us".."

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I am not leaving behind me a more harmful trial for men t
arabic:
وعن أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" ما تركت بعدي فتنة هي أضر على الرجال من النساء" ((متفق عليه)).

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A dinar you spend in Allah's way, or to free a sla
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
" دينار أنفقته في سبيل الله، ودينار أنفقته في رقبة، ودينار تصدقت به على مسكين، ودينار أنفقته على أهلك، أعظمها أجرًا الذي أنفقته على أهلك" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "A dinar you spend in Allah's way, or to free a slave, or as a sadaka you give to a needy person, or to support your family, the one yielding the greatest reward is that which you spend on your family".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A dinar you spend in Allah's way, or to free a slave, or as a charity you give to a needy person, or to support your family, the one yielding the greatest reward is that which you spend on your family"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1507: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The most excellent dinar is one that a person spen
arabic:
وعن أبي عبد الله - ويقال له: أبو عبد الرحمن - ثوبان بن بجدد مولى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
" أفضل دينار ينفقه الرجل دينار ينفقه على عياله، ودينار ينفقه على دابته في سبيل الله، ودينار ينفقه على أصحابه في سبيل الله" ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Thauban bin Bujdud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The most excellent dinar is one that a person spends on his family, and the dinar which he spends on his riding-animal in the way of Allah (in Jihad), and the dinar he spends on his companions in the way of Allah".."
english: Thauban bin Bujdud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The most excellent dinar is one that a person spends on his family, and the dinar which he spends on his riding-animal in the way of Allah (in Jihad), and the dinar he spends on his companions in the way of Allah"..

title: I asked Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), "Would I be rewarded for what I spend on Abu Sal
arabic:
وعن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت: قلت يارسول الله، هل لي أجر في بني أبي سلمة أن أنفق عليهم، ولست بتاركتهم هكذا وهكذا إنما هم بني؟ فقال: 
" نعم لك أجر ما أنفقت عليهم" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Umm Salamah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I asked Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), "Would I be rewarded for what I spend on Abu Salamah's sons? For I can't let them go here and there (to beg people)." Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied, "Spend on them and you will be rewarded for what you spend on them".."
english: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: I asked Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), "Would I be rewarded for what I spend on Abu Salamah's sons? For I can't let them go here and there (to beg people)." Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Spend on them and you will be rewarded for what you spend on them"..

title: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported in a Hadith include
arabic:
وعن سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه في حديثه الطويل الذي قدمناه في أول الكتاب في باب النية أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال له: 
" وإنك لن تنفق تبغي بها وجه الله إلا أجرت بها حتى ما تجعل في في امرأتك" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Masahaba (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) amesema: "Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported in a Hadith included in the chapter of Intention, that Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Whatever you spend seeking thereby the Pleasure of Allah, will have its reward, even the morsel which you put in the mouth of your wife".."

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When someone spends on his family seeking his reward for
arabic:

" إذا أنفق الرجل على أهله نفقة يحتسبها فهي له صدقة" ((متفق عليه)).

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Neglecting one's own dependents is a reason enough
arabic:
وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما قال: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : " كفى بالمرء إثمًا أن يضيع من يقوت" حديث صحيح ((رواه أبو داود وغيره)). 
ورواه مسلم في صحيحه بمعناه قال: " كفى بالمرء إثمًا أن يحبس عمن يملك قوته".
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'as (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Neglecting one's own dependents is a reason enough for a man to commit a sin".The narration in Muislamu is: Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "It is enough sin for a person to hold back the due of one whose provision is in his hand"."
english: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'as (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Neglecting one's own dependents is a reason enough for a man to commit a sin".The narration in Muslim is: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is enough sin for a person to hold back the due of one whose provision is in his hand".

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Two angels descend every morning, and one says: 'O Allah,
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" ما من يوم يصبح العباد فيه إلا ملكان ينزلان، فيقول أحدهما: اللهم أعط منفقًا خلفًا، ويقول الآخر: اللهم أعط ممسكًا تلفًا" ((متفق عليه)).

The other one says: 'O Allah, give destruction to him who withholds".."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1513: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The upper hand is better than the lower one (i
arabic:
وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" اليد العليا خير من اليد السفلى وابدأ بمن تعول، وخير الصدقة ما كان عن ظهر غنًى، ومن يستعفف، يعفه الله، ومن يستغن، يغنه الله" ((رواه البخاري)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "The upper hand is better than the lower one (i.e., the spending hand is better than the receiving hand); and begin (sadaka) with those who are under your care; and the best sadaka is that which given out of surplus; and he who asks (Allah) to help him abstain from the unhalali and the forbidden, Allah will fulfill his wish; and he who seeks self-sufficiency will be made self-sufficient by Allah".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The upper hand is better than the lower one (i.e., the spending hand is better than the receiving hand); and begin (charity) with those who are under your care; and the best charity is that which given out of surplus; and he who asks (Allah) to help him abstain from the unlawful and the forbidden, Allah will fulfill his wish; and he who seeks self-sufficiency will be made self-sufficient by Allah"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1514: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) was the richest among the Ansar of Al
arabic:
عن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: كان أبو طلحة رضي الله عنه أكثر الأنصار بالمدينة مالاً من نخل، وكان أحب أمواله إليه بيرحاء، وكانت مستقبلة المسجد، وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يدخلها ويشرب من ماء فيها طيب قال أنس: فلما نزلت هذه الآية: {لن تنالوا البر حتى تنفقوا مما تحبون} قام أبو طلحة إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: يارسول إن الله تعالى أنزل عليك: { لن تنالوا البر حتى تنفقوا مما تحبون} وإن أحب مالي إلي بيرحاء، وإنها صدقة لله تعالى أرجو برها وذخرها عند الله تعالى، فضعها يا رسول الله حيث أراك الله، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
" بخٍ! ذلك مال رابح، ذلك مال رابح، وقد سمعت ما قلت، وإني أرى أن تجعلها في الأقربين" فقال أبو طلحة: أفعل يا رسول الله، فقسمها أبو طلحة في أقاربه، وبني عمه. ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) was the richest among the Ansar of Al-Madinah and possessed the largest property from palm-trees, and among his possessions what he loved most, was his garden known as Bairuha' which was opposite the mosque, and Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) often visited it and drank from its fresh water. When this Ayah was revealed: "By no means shall you attain Al-Birr (piety, wemaness - here it means Allah's reward, i.e., Jannah), unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love," (3:92), Abu Talhah came to Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and said, "Allah says in His Book: 'By no means shall you attain Al-Birr, unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love,' and the dearest of my property is Bairuha' so I have given it as Sadaqah (sadaka) for Allah's sake, and I anticipate its reward with Him; so spend it, Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, as Allah guides you." Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Well-done! That is profit earning property. I have heard what you have said, but I think you should spend it on your nearest relatives." So Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) distributed it among nearest relatives and cousins.."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) was the richest among the Ansar of Al-Madinah and possessed the largest property from palm-trees, and among his possessions what he loved most, was his garden known as Bairuha' which was opposite the mosque, and Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) often visited it and drank from its fresh water. When this Ayah was revealed: "By no means shall you attain Al-Birr (piety, righteousness - here it means Allah's reward, i.e., Jannah), unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love," (3:92), Abu Talhah came to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said, "Allah says in His Book: 'By no means shall you attain Al-Birr, unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love,' and the dearest of my property is Bairuha' so I have given it as Sadaqah (charity) for Allah's sake, and I anticipate its reward with Him; so spend it, O Messenger of Allah, as Allah guides you." Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Well-done! That is profit earning property. I have heard what you have said, but I think you should spend it on your nearest relatives." So Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) distributed it among nearest relatives and cousins..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1515: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Al-Hasan bin 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with them) took one of the dates of the
arabic:
عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: أخذ الحسن بن على رضي الله عنهما تمرة الصدقة فجعلها في فيه فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: " كخ كخ، ارم بها، أما علمت أنَّا لا نأكل الصدقة!؟ ((متفق عليه)). 

وفي رواية" أنَّا لا تحل لنا الصدقة" وقوله: " كخٍْ كخٍْ" يقال بإسكان الخاء، ويقال بكسرها مع التنوين، وهي كلمة زجر للصبي عن المستقذرات. وكان الحسن رضي الله عنه صبيًا.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Al-Hasan bin 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with them) took one of the dates of the Sadaqah (sadaka) and put it in his mouth, whereupon Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Leave it, leave it, throw it away. Do you not know that we do not eat the Sadaqah (sadaka)?"."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Al-Hasan bin 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with them) took one of the dates of the Sadaqah (charity) and put it in his mouth, whereupon Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Leave it, leave it, throw it away. Do you not know that we do not eat the Sadaqah (charity)?".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1516: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: I was a boy under the care of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and my hand would wander a
arabic:
وعن أبي حفص عمر بن أبي سلمة عبد الله بن عبد الأسد ربيب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: كنت غلامًا في حجر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وكانت يدي تطيش في الصحفة، فقال لي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
" يا غلام سَمِّ الله تعالى، وكُل بيمينك، وكُل مما يليك" فما زالت تلك طعمتي بعد. ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Umar bin Abu Salamah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I was a boy under the care of Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), and my hand would wander about in the dish. Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said to me "Mention Allah's Name (i.e., say Bismillah before you start eating), eat with your right hand and eat from what is near to you". I always followed this way of eating after this incident.."
english: 'Umar bin Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was a boy under the care of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and my hand would wander about in the dish. Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me "Mention Allah's Name (i.e., say Bismillah before you start eating), eat with your right hand and eat from what is near to you". I always followed this way of eating after this incident..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1517: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for y
arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: كلكم راعٍ، وكلكم مسئول عن رعيته، والمرأة راعية في بيت زوجها ومسئولة عن رعيتها، والخادم راعٍ في مال سيده ومسئول عن رعيته، فكلكم راعٍ ومسئول عن رعيته" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects. The ruler is a guardian and responsible for his subjects; the man is a guardian of his family; the woman is guardian in her husband's house and responsible for her wards; a servant is guardian of his master's property and responsible for his ward. So all of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects".."
english: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects. The ruler is a guardian and responsible for his subjects; the man is a guardian of his family; the woman is guardian in her husband's house and responsible for her wards; a servant is guardian of his master's property and responsible for his ward. So all of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1518: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Command your children to perform Salat (prayer) wh
arabic:
وعن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
" مروا أولادكم بالصلاة وهم أبناء سبع سنين، واضربوهم عليها، وهم أبناء عشر، وفرقوا بينهم في المضاجع" ((حديث حسن رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Amr bin Shu'aib reported on his father's authority that his grandfather (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) said: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Command your children to perform Salat (swala) when they are seven years old, and beat them for (not offering) it when they are ten, and do not let (boys and girls) sleep together".."
english: 'Amr bin Shu'aib reported on his father's authority that his grandfather (May Allah be pleased with him) said: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Command your children to perform Salat (prayer) when they are seven years old, and beat them for (not offering) it when they are ten, and do not let (boys and girls) sleep together"..

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Teach a boy Salat (the prayer) when he attains the
arabic: و عن أبي ثرية سبرة بن معبد الجهني رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : " علموا الصبي الصلاة لسبع سنين" واضربوه عليها ابن عشر سنين" حديث حسن رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال حديث حسن. ولفظ أبي داود: " مروا الصبي بالصلاة إذا بلغ سبع سنين".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Sabrah bin Ma'bad Al-Juhani (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Teach a boy Salat (the swala) when he attains the age of seven years, and punish him (if he does not offer it) at ten"..The narration in Abu Dawud is: Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Order a boy to perform Salat (the swala) when he is seven years old"."
english: Sabrah bin Ma'bad Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Teach a boy Salat (the prayer) when he attains the age of seven years, and punish him (if he does not offer it) at ten"..The narration in Abu Dawud is: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Order a boy to perform Salat (the prayer) when he is seven years old".

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Jibril kept recommending treating neighbours with
arabic:
وعن ابن عمر وعائشة رضي الله عنهما قالا: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
" ما زال جبريل يوصيني بالجار حتى ظننت أنه سيورثه" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Ibn Umar and Aisha (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yao) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Jibril kept recommending treating neighbours with kindness until I thought he would assign a share of inheritance".."
english: Ibn 'Umar and 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Jibril kept recommending treating neighbours with kindness until I thought he would assign a share of inheritance"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1521: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded me thus, "O Abu Dharr
arabic:
وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "يا أبا ذر إذا طبخت مرقة، فأكثر ماءها، وتعاهد جيرانك" ((رواه مسلم)). 
وفي رواية له عن أبي ذر قال: إن خليلي صلى الله عليه وسلم أوصاني: " إذا طبخت مرقًا فأكثر ماءها، ثم انظر أهل بيت من جيرانك، فأصبهم منها بمعروف".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) commanded me thus, "O Abu Dharr! Whenever you prepare a broth, put plenty of water in it, and and give some of it to your neighbours"..In another narration of Muislamu, narrated Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him): My friend, (Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake)) advised me saying, "Whenever you prepare a broth, put plenty of water in it, and give some to your neighbours and then give them out of this with courtesy.""
english: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded me thus, "O Abu Dharr! Whenever you prepare a broth, put plenty of water in it, and and give some of it to your neighbours"..In another narration of Muslim, narrated Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him): My friend, (Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)) advised me saying, "Whenever you prepare a broth, put plenty of water in it, and give some to your neighbours and then give them out of this with courtesy."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1522: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, he is not a believer
arabic:
وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: " والله لا يؤمن، والله لايؤمن، والله لا يؤمن!" قيل: من يا رسول الله؟ قال: " الذي لا يأمن جاره بوائقه ! " ((متفق عليه)). 
وفي رواية لمسلم: " لايدخل الجنة من لا يأمن جاره بوائقه".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "By Allah, he is not a muumini! By Allah, he is not a muumini! By Allah, he is not a muumini." It was asked, "Who is that, Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah?" He said, "One whose neighbour does not feel safe from his evil"..Another narration of Muislamu is: Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He will not enter Jannah whose neighbour is not secure from his wrongful conduct"."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah, he is not a believer! By Allah, he is not a believer! By Allah, he is not a believer." It was asked, "Who is that, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "One whose neighbour does not feel safe from his evil"..Another narration of Muslim is: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He will not enter Jannah whose neighbour is not secure from his wrongful conduct".

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "O Muslim women
arabic:
وعنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
" يا نساء المسلمات لا تحقرن جارة لجارتها ولو فرسن شاة" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "O Muislamu women! No one of you should consider insignificant (a gift) to give to her neighbour even if it is (a gift of) the trotters of a sheep".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "O Muslim women! No one of you should consider insignificant (a gift) to give to her neighbour even if it is (a gift of) the trotters of a sheep"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1524: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No one should prohibit his neighbour from placing
arabic:
وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" لا يمنع جار جارة أن يغرز خشبة في جداره" ثم يقول أبو هريرة: ما لي أراكم عنها معرضين! والله لأرمين بها بين أكتافكم. ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "No one should prohibit his neighbour from placing a peg in his wall". Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) added: Now I see you turning away from this (Sunnah), but by Allah, I shall go on proclaiming it.."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No one should prohibit his neighbour from placing a peg in his wall". Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) added: Now I see you turning away from this (Sunnah), but by Allah, I shall go on proclaiming it..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1525: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who believes in Allah and the Last Day let him
arabic:
وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر، فلا يؤذِ جاره، ومن كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر، فليكرم ضيفه، ومن كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر، فليقل خيرًا أو ليسكت" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who believes in Allah and the Last Day let him not harm his neighbour; and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day let him show hospitality to his guest; and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day let him speak good or remain silent".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who believes in Allah and the Last Day let him not harm his neighbour; and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day let him show hospitality to his guest; and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day let him speak good or remain silent"..

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him be kin
arabic:
و عن أبي شريح الخزاعي رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر، فليكرم ضيفه، ومن كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر، فليقل خيرًا أو ليسكت" ((رواه مسلم بهذا اللفظ، وروى البخاري بعضه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza'i (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "He who believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him be kind to his neighbour; and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him show hospitality to his guest; and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him either speak good or remain silent".."

title: I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) , "Which of the deeds is loved most by Allah
arabic: عن أبي عبد الرحمن عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : أي العمل أحب إلى الله تعالى؟ قال " الصلاة على وقتها" قلت: ثم أي؟ قال: " بر الوالدين" قلت: ثم أي؟ قال: " الجهاد في سبيل الله" ((متفق عليه)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "I asked Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) , "Which of the deeds is loved most by Allah?" Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Salat at its proper time." I asked, ''What next?" He (ﷺ) replied, ''Kindness to parents." I asked, ''What next?" He replied, ''Jihad in the way of Allah."."
english: 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) , "Which of the deeds is loved most by Allah?" Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Salat at its proper time." I asked, ''What next?" He (ﷺ) replied, ''Kindness to parents." I asked, ''What next?" He replied, ''Jihad in the way of Allah.".

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "No son can repay (the kindness shown by his father
arabic:
عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم 
"لاَ يَجْزِي وَلَدٌ وَالِدًا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِدَهُ مَمْلُوكًا فَيَشْتَرِيَهُ فَيُعْتِقَهُ"  ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "No son can repay (the kindness shown by his father) unless he finds him a slave and buys him and emancipates him".."

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1532: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah created all the creatures and when He finish
arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : " إن الله تعالى خلق الخلق حتى إذا فرغ منهم قامت الرحم، فقالت: هذا مقام العائذ بك من القطيعة، قال: نعم أما ترضين أن أصل من وصلك، وأقطع من قطعك؟ قالت: بلى، قال: فذلك لك، ثم قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : " اقرءوا إن شئتم: (فهل عسيتم إن توليتم أن تفسدوا في الأرض وتقطعوا أرحامكم. أولئك الذين لعنهم الله فأصمهم وأعمى أبصارهم)  ((متفق عليه)). وفي رواية للبخاري: فقال الله تعالى: " من وصلك، وصلته، ومن قطعك، قطعته".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Allah created all the creatures and when He finished the task of His creation, Ar-Rahm (ties of relationship) said: '(O Allah) at this place I seek refuge with You against severing my ties.' Allah said: 'That I treat with kindness those who treat you with kindness and sever ties with those who sever ties with you.' It said: 'I am satisfied.' Allah said: 'Then this is yours". Then Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Recite this Ayah if you like: 'Would you then, if you were given the authority, do mischief in the land, and sever your ties of kinship? Such are they whom Allah has cursed, so that He has made them deaf and blinded their sight". (47:22,23)..The words in Al-Bukhari are: Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Allah (SWT) says: 'He who maintains good ties with you, I maintain good ties with him; and he who severs your ties, I sever ties with him"."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah created all the creatures and when He finished the task of His creation, Ar-Rahm (ties of relationship) said: '(O Allah) at this place I seek refuge with You against severing my ties.' Allah said: 'That I treat with kindness those who treat you with kindness and sever ties with those who sever ties with you.' It said: 'I am satisfied.' Allah said: 'Then this is yours". Then Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Recite this Ayah if you like: 'Would you then, if you were given the authority, do mischief in the land, and sever your ties of kinship? Such are they whom Allah has cursed, so that He has made them deaf and blinded their sight". (47:22,23)..The words in Al-Bukhari are: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah (SWT) says: 'He who maintains good ties with you, I maintain good ties with him; and he who severs your ties, I sever ties with him".

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1533: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: A person came to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and asked, "Who among people is most des
arabic:
وعنه رضي الله عنه قال: جاء رجل إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: يا رسول الله من أحق الناس بحسن صحابتي؟ قال: " أمك" قال: ثم من؟ قال: " أمك" قال: ثم من؟ قال: "أمك" قال: ثم من؟ قال: " أبوك" ((متفق عليه)). 
وفي رواية: يارسول الله من أحق بحسن الصحبة؟ قال: " أمك، ثم أمك، ثم أمك، ثم أباك، ثم أدناك أدناك".
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A person came to Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) and asked, "Who among people is most deserving of my fine treatment?" He (ﷺ) said, "Your mother". He again asked, ''Who next?" "Your mother", Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) replied again. He asked, "Who next?" He (Mtume (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake)) said again, "Your mother." He again asked, "Then who?" Thereupon he (ﷺ) said," Then your father."In another narration: "Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah! Who is most deserving of my fine treatment?" He (ﷺ) said, "Your mother, then your mother, then your mother, then your father, then your nearest, then nearest".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A person came to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and asked, "Who among people is most deserving of my fine treatment?" He (ﷺ) said, "Your mother". He again asked, ''Who next?" "Your mother", the Prophet (ﷺ) replied again. He asked, "Who next?" He (the Prophet (ﷺ)) said again, "Your mother." He again asked, "Then who?" Thereupon he (ﷺ) said," Then your father."In another narration: "O Messenger of Allah! Who is most deserving of my fine treatment?" He (ﷺ) said, "Your mother, then your mother, then your mother, then your father, then your nearest, then nearest"..

title: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May he be disgraced
arabic:
وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: 
" رغم أنف، ثم رغم أنف، ثم رغم أنف من أدرك أبويه عند الكبر، أحدهما أو كليهما، فلم يدخل الجنة"  ((رواه مسلم))

May he be disgraced, whose parents, one or both, attain old age during his life time, and he does not enter Jannah (by rendering being dutiful to them)".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May he be disgraced! May he be disgraced! May he be disgraced, whose parents, one or both, attain old age during his life time, and he does not enter Jannah (by rendering being dutiful to them)"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1535: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: A man said to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "I have relatives with whom I try to keep
arabic:
وعنه أن رجلاً قَالَ : يَا رَسُول الله ! إنّ لِي قَرابةً أصِلُهُمْ وَيَقْطَعُوني ، وَأُحْسِنُ إلَيْهِمْ وَيُسِيئُونَ إلَيَّ ، وَأحْلَمُ عَنْهُمْ وَيَجْهَلُونَ عَلَيَّ ، فَقَالَ : 
" لَئِنْ كُنْتَ كَمَا قُلْتَ ، فَكأنَّمَا تُسِفُّهُمْ الْمَلَّ ، وَلا يَزَالُ مَعَكَ مِنَ اللهِ ظَهِيرٌ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا دُمْتَ عَلَى ذلِكَ ". ((رواه مسلم)).
swahili: Kutoka kwa Abu Hurairah (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "A man said to Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake): "I have relatives with whom I try to keep the ties of relationship but they sever relations with me; and whom I treat kindly but they treat me badly, I am gentle with them but they are rough to me." He (ﷺ) replied, "If you are as you say, it is as if you are feeding them hot ashes, and you will be with a supporter against them from Allah as long as you continue to do so".."
english: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A man said to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "I have relatives with whom I try to keep the ties of relationship but they sever relations with me; and whom I treat kindly but they treat me badly, I am gentle with them but they are rough to me." He (ﷺ) replied, "If you are as you say, it is as if you are feeding them hot ashes, and you will be with a supporter against them from Allah as long as you continue to do so"..

chapter.title_sw: Mlango wa 1537: Kitabu cha Misingi (Nia, Toba, Subira na Kumcha Allah)

title: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) was the richest among the Ansar of Al
arabic:
وعنه قال: كان أبو طلحة أكثر الأنصار بالمدينة مالاً من نخل، وكان أحب أمواله إليه بيرحاء، وكانت مستقبلة المسجد، وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يدخلها، ويشرب من ماء فيها طيب، فلما نزلت هذه الآية: {لن تنالوا البر حتى تنفقوا مما تحبون} ((آل عمران: 92)) قام أبو طلحة إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: يا رسول الله إن الله تبارك وتعالى يقول: {لن تنالوا البر حتى تنفقوا مما تحبون} وإن أحب مالي إلي بيرحاء، وإنها صدقة لله تعالى، وأرجو برها وذخرها عند الله تعالى، فضعها يا رسول الله حيث أراك الله. فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
"بخ! ذلك مال رابح، وذلك مال رابح! وقد سمعت ما قلت، وإني أرى أن تجعلها في الأقربين" فقال أبو طلحة: أفعل يا رسول الله، فقسمها أبو طلحة في أقاربه وبني عمه. ((متفق عليه)). 

وسبق بيان ألفاظه في: باب الإنفاق مما يحب.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Anas bin Malik (Radhi za Allah ziwe juu yake) reported: "Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) was the richest among the Ansar of Al-Madinah and possessed the largest property; and among his possessions what he loved most was his garden known as Bairuha' which was opposite the mosque, and Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) often visited it and drank from its fresh water. When this ayah was revealed: "By no means shall you attain Al-Birr (piety, wemaness - here it means Allah's reward, i.e., Jannah), unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love," (3:92). Abu Talhah came to Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake), and said: "Allah says in His Book: 'By no means shall you attain Al-Birr, unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love,' and the dearest of my property is Bairuha' so I have given it as Sadaqah (sadaka) for Allah's sake, and I anticipate its reward with Him; so spend it, Ewe Mjumbe wa Allah, as Allah guides you". Mjumbe wa Allah (Rehema na amani za Allah ziwe juu yake) said, "Well-done! That is profitable property. I have heard what you have said, but I think you should spend it on your nearest relatives." So Abu Talhah distributed it among his nearest relatives and cousins.."
english: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) was the richest among the Ansar of Al-Madinah and possessed the largest property; and among his possessions what he loved most was his garden known as Bairuha' which was opposite the mosque, and Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) often visited it and drank from its fresh water. When this ayah was revealed: "By no means shall you attain Al-Birr (piety, righteousness - here it means Allah's reward, i.e., Jannah), unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love," (3:92). Abu Talhah came to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and said: "Allah says in His Book: 'By no means shall you attain Al-Birr, unless you spend (in Allah's Cause) of that which you love,' and the dearest of my property is Bairuha' so I have given it as Sadaqah (charity) for Allah's sake, and I anticipate its reward with Him; so spend it, O Messenger of Allah, as Allah guides you". Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Well-done! That is profitable property. I have heard what you have said, but I think you should spend it on your nearest relatives." So Abu Talhah distributed it among his nearest relatives and cousins..
